rows.name: Trolley Dash
rows.short_description: Trolley Dash is a fast-paced, endless arcade game where you race to grab items, fill orders, and deliver them before time runs out! You must dodge rogue trolleys, navigate shifting shelves, and react fast to keep up with the chaos. Can you get to the top of the leaderboards? Good luck!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Trolley Dash , the frantic endless arcade shopping game where speed, precision, and quick decision-making are key! As a top-down isometric shopper , your goal is simple but relentless: grab the correct items for incoming orders, sort them into your baskets, and deliver them to the checkout—before time runs out! Sounds easy? Think again! Moving obstacles, rogue trolleys, and shifting store layouts will keep you on your toes. The challenge never stops, and every second counts in your pursuit of the highest score ! How long can you keep up the dash before the supermarket chaos overwhelms you? Key Features: 🛒 Endless, Fast-Paced Gameplay – Orders keep coming, and it’s up to you to keep up! There’s no finish line—only the high score. 🏃 Dodge & Weave Through Obstacles – Avoid rogue trolleys, navigate moving and rotating shelves , and plan your route efficiently! 🎯 Two-Basket System – Manage your baskets strategically to grab and deliver orders efficiently. ⏳ Race Against the Clock – The faster you fulfill orders, the more points you earn. But if you take too long, it’s game over! 📈 Global & Local Leaderboards – Compete against friends and players worldwide to claim the title of the ultimate trolley dasher ! 🎨 Vibrant Isometric Art Style – A colorful, stylized supermarket full of life, movement, and just the right amount of chaos. Design: Trolley Dash captures the thrill of classic arcade score-chasing , blending tight controls, fast decision-making, and lighthearted chaos into an addictive gameplay loop. Easy to learn, but tough to master , every run is a new chance to climb the leaderboards. Do you have the reflexes and strategy to become the #1 shopper ? Grab your trolley and prove it!

rows.name: Slime Trials
rows.short_description: A fast-paced, precision platformer where you dash, jump, and build momentum to soar through dangerous levels. Crush the speedrun clock or take your time to collect all the valuable gems and unlock hats for your slime.

Race the clock to set new records for each hand-crafted level.  Explore multiple paths and find collectables to unlock more skins for your character.

rows.name: Virion
rows.short_description: A sci-fi action roguelike with frenetic combat including ranged, melee and dodging
rows.description_html: Created by students at the University of Silicon Valley as a school project, Virion is an isometric action roguelike with a strong emphasis on player expression through movement. It follows a virus called Nebula attempting to escape from the watchful gaze of the Mother Computer, who seeks to eradicate it. Current Features: Combat against three enemy types Ranged and melee combat Procedural generation of levels featuring a variety of handcrafted rooms Powerups that affect gameplay NPCs that give backstory into the world of Virion

rows.short_description: Step into the shoes of a researcher in the depths of the antarctic and uncover the mysteries behind Project Hailstorm.
rows.description_html: Project Hailstorm is a short, 15 minute long narrative driven story set deep within the Antarctic circle. Step into the shoes of a recovery team as they attempt to uncover what happened over half a decade ago. UNCOVER THE MYSTERY Travel deep below the surface of the Antarctic and uncover just exactly what the dig team discovered that day. HIGH QUALITY SHORT-FORM GAMING A videogame short story, experience high quality visuals as you're moved through a dramatic and atmospheric environment set in the depths of the Antarctic. DISCOVER THE BEHIND THE SCENES Take a look at the behind the scenes documentary and look at what it takes to bring something like this to life!

rows.name: Trawler’s Empire
rows.short_description: Build your fishing empire in this relaxing idle tycoon game. Upgrade your boat, explore new waters, catch rare fish, and earn profits—even while offline. Master the seas and grow your Trawler's Empire!
rows.description_html: 🎣 Trawler’s Empire – Master the Seas, Build Your Legacy Trawler’s Empire is a relaxing yet rewarding idle fishing tycoon game where you cast your line, build your fleet, and dominate the seas. Start from humble beginnings at a local pond and expand your fishing empire across vast waters filled with rare and valuable fish species. 🌊 Gameplay Features: ⚓ Explore Multiple Fishing Locations: From peaceful ponds to deep oceans teeming with exotic fish, unlock new locations with every upgrade. 🐟 Fish Encyclopedia: Discover and collect over a dozen unique fish species, each with their own rarity, stats, and value. 🚢 Upgrade Your Fleet: Customize and upgrade your boat for better fishing power and efficiency. Invest wisely to increase your catch rate and earnings. 💰 Idle & Auto-Fishing System: Your trawler keeps working while you’re away! Earn offline income, catch fish, and stack profits even when idle. 📈 Prestige System: Reset your progress for permanent upgrades. Earn fishing power bonuses, increase fish values, and start stronger each time you prestige. 🏆 Become the Ultimate Fishing Tycoon: Optimize your empire, master the seas, and build your legacy as the wealthiest fisherman. ✨ Key Highlights: Incremental gameplay with satisfying progression Fun upgrades and unlockable locations Prestiging for permanent bonuses A relaxing atmosphere perfect for idle tycoon fans Are you ready to cast your line and build your Trawler's Empire? Set sail today and watch your fishing fortune grow!

rows.name: Klondike's Hike: A Solitaire Roguelike
rows.short_description: Klondike, a gold-panning otter, had a vision of golden shores up in the mountains. Help her reach this mythical place in this solitaire-based roguelike! Use items to modify your cards, bend the rules, and power through the many traps in your way.
rows.description_html: Not happy with the cards you have been dealt? What if you could change that? In Klondike's Hike, you battle enemies by completing solitaire puzzles, and you can beat the random odds by modifying your cards and changing the rules of the game to progress further and further against the many hazards thrown at you. Modify your deck until it is unrecognizable and try to defeat all the bosses to reach the Shores of Gold! Modify your cards With the modifiers, you can remove a card's suit, or rank, or even give it attributes it shouldn't have. Place your cards wherever you want! Modify the board You can use items to grab cards from behind piles, reorder whole columns, or even re-deal the entire tableau. Modify the rules Who's to say you can only build down? Use the trading cards to change the very base rules of the game! Your opponents are cheating anyway, so why shouldn't you?

rows.name: Shelter from the Storm
rows.short_description: Rain lashes down soaking you to the bone, you take shelter in a seemingly abandoned house. Navigate through the rooms solving puzzles and trying to escape in this short point & click adventure game.
rows.description_html: Introduction The rain lashes down, soaking you to the bone. You spot an old, dilapidated house looming in the distance - a beacon of shelter in the downpour. You knock loudly desperate to escape the rain. No answer. You try the handle, the door creeks opens... Point & Click You play a curious wanderer who's stumbled into more than they've bargained for. Explore the forgotten corners of the once-grand house, now seemingly abandoned and shrouded in mystery. Find and make us of objects you find lying around, crack codes, solve puzzles and progress through the various rooms of the house while waiting out the storm. Features A classic 2D point & click adventure game with: Simplified interactions - You don't have to randomly try combining every object. If you click on something and have an item you can use with it, you do. Retro graphics - Kicking it old school with a low resolution pixel art style and a 4:3 aspect ratio. Widescreen will never catch on. Manageable length - Tied of never having enough time to finish games? You can probably wrap this one up in about 30 mins. Occasional humour - There's a joke or two throw in for good measure.

rows.name: Bullet Inferno
rows.short_description: A Bullet Hell style game based on Dante's Inferno. Dodge your way through all 9 circles of the Inferno to hopefully find the lord and pray for his forgiveness!
rows.description_html: Cast off by your lord, descend into the depths of the inferno to prove yourself and gain forgiveness! Traverse the 9 layers while dodging and weaving through the countless demons and sinners that seek to impede your progress! Do you have what it takes to brave the inferno? Will you prove to your lord that you're worth a second chance? Controls: WASD/Arrow Keys to Move ESC to pause/skip cutscene Click to advance dialogue

rows.short_description: Crush colossal Kaiju with a game-changing blow! Experience exhilarating attacks with intuitive controls! Explore the world of Kaiju No. 8, recreated with stunning visuals!

Explore the world of KAIJU NO. 8, recreated with stunning visuals! =========================== Introducing KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME =========================== Based on the global hit anime, adapted from the Shonen Jump+ sensation, KAIJU NO. 8 THE GAME brings you into the heart of the action! Witness epic battles between the Japan Anti-Kaiju Defense Force and cataclysmic Kaiju, all rendered in breathtaking graphics! ◆ Overpower colossal Kaiju in epic battles! Engage in an intuitive turn-based combat system, packed with strategic depth! Select your Defense Force officers' skills to attack, and when the Kaiju's core is exposed, unleash devastating ultimate attacks to deliver the final blow! ◆ See the Defense Force in action in stunning details! Feel the raw power of KAIJU NO. 8's signature punch, the razor-sharp precision of Soshiro Hoshina's blades, and the earth-shattering power of Kikoru Shinomiya's ax! All brought to life with stunning, high-end graphics! ◆ Explore the expanding universe of KAIJU NO. 8! Relive the anime's gripping story, discover exclusive original narratives, and delve into the untold stories of your favorite characters! ◆ Featuring an all-star voice actor cast! rows.name: Double Shoulders
rows.short_description: Double Shoulders is a two player action-adventure game. You take control of Lois and Sam, two kids trying to escape from a strange place filled with dangers and challenges. You'll have to work together to get out of this place alive.
rows.description_html: “Two children are confronted with the harsh reality of the place they have just arrived in. They have no choice but to try to escape. Faced with obstacles, their best hope lies in mutual support. Will they make it through a journey that will bring them closer together, reveal secrets as mysterious as they are terrifying, and, above all, save them from a grim fate?” ESCAPE WITH YOUR NEWFOUND COMPANION Play as Lois and Sam, two unlikely friends who must work together to escape this twisted place. HUMANOIDS DEFORMED TO ADAPT TO THEIR GRIM LABOR Be careful, you’re not alone. Strange monstrosities lurk in this place. They were once human like you, but this place changed them. Now, they’re merely shadows of what they once were, and they won’t hesitate to put you back in line. Don’t get caught, or you might end up like them. WITHIN A DARK AND DEADLY ENVIRONMENT HIDING A HEAVY SECRET Traverse the facility and explore a variety of environments. Each one presents its own unique challenges and dangers. WILL YOU ESCAPE THIS PLACE, OR END UP LIKE THE OTHERS ? NB:   Double Shoulders   is a graduation game made in one year by a team of 9 students. Thank you for your consideration regarding potential bugs and performance issues.

rows.name: DUET
rows.short_description: DUET illustrates the Hifuu Club's first encounter. It is a wordless, narrative-driven experience about connection and small moments in life. Step into the subtle yet fateful daily interactions that intertwine Renko and Merry's lives.
rows.description_html: DUET is an interactive story illustrating the Hifuu Club's first encounter. It   is a wordless, narrative-driven experience about connection, small moments, and the quiet magic of two lives intertwining. Renko Usami lives a simple life, endlessly cycling through studying, eating, and sleeping at university. She gazes at the starry sky alone, trying to fill the emptiness in her heart. Then, one day, Maribel Hearn appears—a girl who seems to have stepped from beyond the boundaries of the world... Features & Content: Wordless, Interactive Storytelling : Experience Renko & Merry's subtle yet fateful daily moments through a series of light, meaningful interactions. Handcrafted Atmosphere:  Immerse yourself in lovingly crafted hand-drawn visuals and a gentle soundtrack that enriches the story’s warmth. A Delicate Story to Explore : Step into and witness Renko and Merry's encounter that intertwines their lives. Catch the quiet warmth hidden like a butterfly in the stillness of their shared world. Short, Sweet Experience:  DUET is crafted to be completed in a single sitting. It invites you to slow down and enjoy a calm, quiet, and heartfelt experience. DUET is a Touhou Project fan game, inspired by the indie masterpiece Florence . It paints a story that is sweet, delicate, and profoundly touching.

Features & Content: Wordless, Interactive Storytelling : Experience Renko & Merry's subtle yet fateful daily moments through a series of light, meaningful interactions. Handcrafted Atmosphere:  Immerse yourself in lovingly crafted hand-drawn visuals and a gentle soundtrack that enriches the story’s warmth. A Delicate Story to Explore : Step into and witness Renko and Merry's encounter that intertwines their lives. Catch the quiet warmth hidden like a butterfly in the stillness of their shared world. Short, Sweet Experience:  DUET is crafted to be completed in a single sitting. It invites you to slow down and enjoy a calm, quiet, and heartfelt experience. DUET is a Touhou Project fan game, inspired by the indie masterpiece Florence . It paints a story that is sweet, delicate, and profoundly touching.

rows.name: Shieven
rows.short_description: Venture into the enigmatic Luminora Hospital, where, as an investigator on the brink of ruin, you take on a case that will test your courage. Amidst dark rumors, you'll uncover terrifying secrets that have caused those who ventured too far to disappear.
rows.description_html: Shieven is a suspenseful exploration game that puts you in the shoes of an investigator whose financial situation is on the verge of collapse. In a desperate attempt to solve his problems, he takes on a case at the mysterious Luminora Hospital, a place shrouded in dark and chilling rumors. According to the stories, those who ventured beyond the hospital's surface levels have never been seen again. Dive into the depths of Luminora Hospital and uncover what happened there in the past... Discover chilling secrets that were never meant to see the light... Escape from terrifying creatures or monsters lurking below... Pay attention to everything ... The Security Flashlight is a versatile tool designed to help you face any danger and explore new paths. You'll find it during your journey through the depths of the hospital. With its powerful light and sound, it becomes an indispensable ally to keep you safe and push forward in the darkest moments. Use it wisely... We are an indie studio at the beginning of our creative journey, focused on learning and improving continuously. Our plan includes releasing more chapters of Shieven and exploring new ideas, whether by staying within the same style or venturing into completely different genres. Additionally, we are open to collaborations to keep growing and deliver unique experiences to our community.

rows.name: HAILSTORM
rows.short_description: HAILSTORM is a new take on the classic break breaking arcade game. Break bricks to earn points and build the gambling meter for your next lever pull. Then pull that lever and watch chaos slowly unfold.
rows.description_html: Break bricks with the ball and paddle to build your meter. When its full you can pull the lever for the slot machine and see how lucky you are (or not).

rows.name: Defenders of the Dune
rows.short_description: Defenders of the Dune is a game about overcoming the wilderness and establishing a kingdom in defiance of the land itself. Players will fight to survive each day, experiencing the challenge and pride that comes with building up their base against all odds
rows.description_html: BUILD. DEFEND. CONQUER. Step onto a sunlit beach where imagination meets strategy in Defenders of the Dune ! In this real-time strategy game, players take control of a sandcastle kingdom, constructing buildings, training units, and preparing defenses against waves of enemies. The game revolves around a dynamic day-night cycle that keeps you on your toes. Use the day to gather resources, build fortifications, and expand your territory. But beware, As night falls, brace yourself for attacks from swarming ant armies and other adversaries threatening your sandcastle empire. Features include: Base Building : Construct and upgrade structures to create a thriving sandcastle civilization. Unit Management : Train specialized units to defend your kingdom and launch attacks on enemy burrows. Customizable Strategies : Unlock and experiment with unique buildings, equipment, and units to perfect your strategy. Dynamic Threats : Face off against challenging enemies and contend with building decay outside your base’s range. Final Wave Challenge : Face the ultimate test of your sandcastle empire in a climactic showdown with an overwhelming ant army. Whether you’re a seasoned RTS fan or a newcomer to the genre, Defenders of the Dune offers a charming yet deeply tactical experience. Can you withstand the tide and claim victory, or will your efforts wash away with the waves?

rows.name: Yap Wizards Tower Defence
rows.short_description: Dynamic tower defence with an ever-scaling battlefield and unexpected twists!
rows.description_html: Mad machinations are underfoot on the Dirt Path. Take up arms and defend the Dirt Path with divine arms. Broaden your horizons and dynamically  scale up the battle after each wave! Learn about the the yapping wizards aiding in your Tower Defence! Survive the overwhelming hordes and be granted  epic   ranks from the Grand Tutorial Wizard! Upend the corruption of the system and enact social change, one Gnoblin at a time... Or ruin the fields by enacting zoning for the Ballistas. Again.

rows.short_description: Three dimensional grid turn-based strategy game. Combat the computer or your friends to prove your brain is less smooth than theirs.
rows.description_html: Welcome to 25920! The distance from the lowest submarine to the highest airplane (In America units of course) Your goal is to destroy the enemy craft before they do the same to you. Whoever loses all Submarines OR Boats OR Planes first loses the game. Why? Because war is all about terrain superiority, and how could you fight with no craft? Now this isn't like those other grid based water craft guessing games. There are abilities, boons, and several other twists thrown in to make it a unique game each time. Play against the computer or locally with a friend. Can you beat Alexander the great if Alexander had battleships? Can you beat your snot nosed cousin after family dinner? (Probably that kid is an idiot) There are submarines AND boats AND planes in ONE game. What more is there to say?

rows.name: Eva's Hook
rows.short_description: A 2.5D Platformer with a Grappling Hook, Collectibles, and a Timer for an extra Challenge while different Events are trying to make you fail, 3 different Difficulties, but even the Easiest one could be a hard time for you !
rows.description_html: 'Eva's Hook' is a 2.5D platformer that tests your precision and reflexes through a series of challenging levels. Follow Eva on her journey to break free from the icy prison that holds her, armed only with her trusty grappling hook. Created entirely by a solo indie developer, this game is a tribute to pure gameplay – no frills, no intrusive storytelling. It's just you, your mouse, and your ability to master precise movement. Key Features: 🪝 Intuitive Grappling Hook Mechanic – Move swiftly and accurately with a mouse-controlled grappling system. 🎯 Tight Platforming – Perfect for players who love technical challenges. Every jump and swing counts. 💎 Collect and Explore – Gather coins scattered throughout the levels. ⚡ Multiple Game Modes: Campaign – Traverse 6 core levels and unlock 3 bonus levels with evolving challenges. Speedrun Mode – Race against the clock by selecting levels and aiming for the fastest times. 🌟 Dynamic Events – Experience unexpected shifts that will test and reshape your approach. 🎮 Three Difficulty Levels – Whether you're here for a casual run or a hardcore challenge, there's a mode for you. 'Eva's Hook' won't tell you an elaborate story, but it will offer hours of engaging gameplay. By the end of this adventure, when Eva finally shatters her icy prison, it will be thanks to your skill.

rows.name: Kewter’s Showroom
rows.short_description: A 2000s styled dress up game with a dark twist.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Kewter's Showroom! The only dress up game that really teaches you how to dress! Kewter, the owner of the showroom and long time experienced fashionista, is here to help you! Listen to her suggestions and you're sure to succeed! She does have tons of experience, you know...  You have 7 days to become the greatest fashion diva in the world (well, second best...)! There are themes for every day's fashion show and you will be graded based off how well you matched the theme. Do your best! If you're unsure, you can always use Kewter's recommended items!  Disclaimer! This game contains disturbing content and loud noises.  Game contents: 7 playable days  Fashion shows! Over 70 outfit parts to assemble the perfect combination. Fully voiced cutscenes. 1 ending (+ bonus video if you get perfect scores on all 7 days) Nostalgic 2000s video game sounds and aesthetics. The Steam version includes new exclusive special events!

rows.name: Signal
rows.short_description: Signal is an immersive action-adventure game made as a student project where you attempt to uncover the mystery behind your old mentor's distress message. To succeed in your mission, you will have to use your martial arts skills and fight off hostile creatures that are trying to stop you.
rows.description_html: A dark and mysterious planet There are two unique zones to explore in which many secrets are yet to be uncovered. By overcoming the challenges in your path, you will be rewarded with information about your mentor as well as a new power, but it will not be easy. A hostile welcome A lot of dangerous creatures are roaming around, so be ready to fight and don't let them make the first move. The combat is fast paced and can be brutal if you underestimate your enemies. Perform strong martial arts combos and dodge incoming attacks to defeat your foes. Survival of the fittest Collect as many resources as you can if you want to succeed in your mission. Using the crafting menu you can combine plants to make injections that can heal your wounds or make your attacks more powerful. You can also find all the log entries that you've discovered and some information about the creatures you've defeated by navigating trough your inventory.

rows.name: Beetle Barrage
rows.short_description: Destroy all of the insects in your way! As you shoot, you recoil backward from your weapons as a mechanical beetle.
rows.description_html: About This Game Play as a robotic beetle and destroy all of the insects in your way! Destroy ants with a wide range of abilities and barrage your way to the largest score. As a mechanized beetle, you shoot with your weapon to move from the recoil it has. Scavenge for better abilities to become the one true insect. Features 5 abilities that you can pick up. 2 enemies. Get the largest score as possible. Soundtrack The OST for Beetle Barrage can be found on most streaming platforms, YouTube, Bandcamp, and SoundCloud under the artist: I Have No Mouth

rows.name: Hunter Hitman
rows.short_description: Hunt or be hunted. Execute stealth kills and survive in this action-packed assassin game.
rows.description_html: Hunter Hitman is a fast-paced, action-packed stealth game that puts you in the shoes of a deadly assassin. Tap to move silently through a high-security desert military base. Sneak behind enemies and execute clean assassinations to rack up kills. Outsmart and outmaneuver enemies while unlocking new skills and rewards to boost your game. How long can you survive the hunt? Features Thrilling stealth gameplay with tactical movement. Collect cash to unlock unique skins and customize your look. Earn daily rewards and achievements to keep progressing. Open gacha loot boxes to collect cards. Assemble and upgrade cards level Hunt or be hunted. Stay sharp, move smart, and keep hunting.

rows.name: Hidden Tomatoes 2
rows.short_description: Search for 100 hidden tomatoes in a detailed city. Explore the streets, buildings, and alleys with no time limits. Can you find them all? 🍅
rows.description_html: Find 100 hidden tomatoes scattered across a vibrant 3D city. Explore detailed urban areas with colorful graphics that bring the streets, buildings, and alleys to life. With relaxing music and a calm atmosphere, enjoy uncovering each tomato at your own pace in this visually stunning environment. Gameplay: 🍅 1 Level, 100 hidden tomatoes in a city setting. 👉 Click on the tomatoes you find. 💡 Hint System Features: - Explore a lively city with beautifully designed urban landscape. - No time limits—take your time and enjoy the hunt. - Fun and challenging for players of all ages. Can you find all the hidden tomatoes in the city? Start your adventure now!

rows.name: Alchemist: Journey of the Soul Prologue
rows.short_description: First-person escape room game. Use your magical abilities to solve puzzles or navigate through areas! Explore, use items, brew potions and unlock your full alchemical potential. Are you willing to do what it takes to claim a soul of your own?
rows.description_html: (This is a single player prologue game for Alchemist: Journey of the Soul ) A voice calls to you—a familiar presence, the Alchemist . He speaks of a place that calls to him, an ancient monastery at the mountain’s peak, where your true purpose will unfold.  Explore the monastery, solve puzzles and brew powerful potions. With each new potion a new ability is unlocked. You’ll need to observe closely and think carefully. Α portal opens. A door beyond. And your journey is only just beginning... WISHLIST NOW and follow the journey to its end!

rows.name: Obscura
rows.short_description: Obscura is a first-person investigation game where, you play a medium who must solve cold cases by interacting with various elements and performing rituals. Learn about their past to understand their motives and crack the case. Please understand that the game will features sensitive topics.
rows.description_html: [THIS IS A DEMO] OBSCURA Dive into the mysterious atmosphere of Obscura, a first-person investigative game where you play as a medium determined to solve unsolved cases. Explore places haunted by tragic events and uncover the secrets buried in the shadows. Explore the invisible, reveal the truth. As a medium, your unique gift allows you to communicate with spirits and discover fragments of the past. Search an abandoned apartment, observe the smallest details, and collect objects linked to past tragedies. Each clue brings you closer to the truth, but be warned, some truths are darker than they appear. Rituals to reveal the unspeakable. Collect items marked by the past and use mysterious rituals to uncover buried memories. Combine the right ritual fragments to trigger visions and reconstruct crime scenes. Each revelation will guide you toward solving the case. Will you be ready to face the buried truths of Obscura?

rows.name: Tower Of Penguinaria
rows.short_description: Tower of Penguinaria is a single-player pixel art Roguelite RPG game where you are a Penguin trying to stop the Evil Sealsorer from taking over Antarctica. Through turn based combats where your gear effects what abilities you will learn to aid in battle!
rows.description_html: General: Tower of Penguinaria is a single-player pixel art Roguelite RPG game where you are a Penguin trying to stop the Evil Sealsorer from taking over Antarctica.  What Makes This Game Different: In addition to being a Rougelite, RPG, Dungeon Crawler, Timeloop, game (where character stats improve based on what you wear). Depending on what you wear will change what you're move set in the turn based combat will do! There is also a death loop feature. Dying will make you enter Kenos (land of the dead) where you can unlock metaprogression to give yourself more time, or power, to defeat the Sealsorer who lurks on top of the Tower. Finally a mix of unique enemies, traps, and bosses makes even crawling on this randomly generated 2d dungeon engaging. Timing runs over dangerous spikes, dodging meteors, and blocking attacks on the game map, before heading into the battlefield keeps crawling dynamic and fun! Game Loop: Enter the dungeon to get xp and money Buy new gear to get further (and unlock checkpoints) perish or run out of time, allowing you to spend those hard earned levels on permanent buffs Credits: Developer: RpgPenguin Artists: RpgPenguin, BlueIsTopia

rows.name: Smiling Misery
rows.short_description: Smiling Misery is an interactive tale that introduces us to the story of Margo, a jester who, weary of a comfortable life, embarks on a journey to seek misery. Join Margo on a brief adventure through a Mediterranean medieval kingdom and bring the story to its conclusion.
rows.description_html: Inspired by the medieval Mediterranean. This is the story of a time long past. A time when people lived in peace and well-being in the region of Verigo after an event that would be known as... The Garlic Wars. In an enormous castle lived Margo, a young jester who served her lord at court. Margo enjoyed a life of absolute comfort and privilege; possessions, favors, compliments, and even a close relationship with her king. A dream life that took a turn due to a twisted desire that would blossom in the heart of young Margo... Unhappiness, sadness, all the ills of mankind suddenly turned into guilty desires for the young jester. Thus, one day Margo left the castle with a very clear purpose. 'I want to know misery.' Offering a lifetime of service to anyone who could help her see her desires come true. What the young woman did not know was that the real world would be one very different from what she expected. Main Keys: Space to talk. Left & Right Arrows on the screen to move across the map. Esc for skip the intro. Space to pass text. Esc -> Skip, sometimes.

rows.name: Billie Beetleneck -A detective tale-
rows.short_description: Every story ever written has an alternate world that coexists with ours. When a large number of parallel universes are suddenly destroyed, Billie Beetleneck sets off on his hardest case yet in this interactive visual novel.
rows.description_html: Billie Beetleneck: A detective tale is a visual novel about a beetle trying to solve his hardest case yet. An unusual number of booklice and humans have escaped their worlds to seek refuge in Bugtown due to a large number of attacks from bookworms. Bookworms feed on knowledge by eating up pages of various books and destroying the worlds within in the process. Characters inside the books must flee, or perish during such devastating attacks.  A detective story with some player choices Colorful visuals and characters in anime style A playtime of: 2-4 hours

rows.short_description: A single-player narrative game where you play as a quirky wannabe cowboy exploring the dystopian futuristic world for his own revenge.
rows.description_html: Summary Your ranch has been burnt down, but there are traces of the perpetrator 'EquinoCorp' at the scene! You set off into the city to investigate the mystery behind its destruction, and to get revenge while somewhat helping out others along the way! A single-player narrative game where you play as a quirky wannabe cowboy exploring the dystopian futuristic world for his own revenge. Features - A Linear Story with Branching Narrative Choices - Wonderful Cast of Characters (including yourself as the titular Cowboy! - Interrogating suspects and chasing leads - A variety of mini-games to shake up the pace -Animated cutscenes for every level

rows.name: Down the Rabbit Hole Flattened
rows.short_description: Down the Rabbit Hole is an adventure set in Wonderland prior to Alice's arrival. You will guide a girl who is looking for her lost pet by solving puzzles, uncovering secrets and making choices about the story along the way.
rows.description_html: The immersive game Down The Rabbit Hole re-imagined for 2D! Down the Rabbit Hole is an award-winning title created initially for VR, set in an immersive diorama. For the first time, the game has been reimagined as a 2D point-and-click adventure, perfect for your casual flat-screen needs!  Down the Rabbit Hole Flattened will be made available for free for a limited time! If you appreciate the experience and own a VR headset, please consider checking out Down the Rabbit Hole and the spiritual successor, Escaping Wonderland, to support the developers.  About the game Down the Rabbit Hole is an adventure that takes place in Wonderland prior to Alice's arrival. rows.name: Scoop 'n Shoot
rows.short_description: Scoop 'n Shoot mixes gardening with frantic VR shooting action. Harvest extraordinary plants to create magical ice cream flavors, each with unique powers. Use your creations to blast away the evil magician Kirusza and his minions.
rows.description_html: For centuries, the dark mage Kirusza has lusted after the magical crystals. His goal: unimaginable power. But the wise wizard Skovhir hid the crystals in the last place Kirusza would look: an unsuspecting ice cream parlor. Following Skovhir's death, the fate of the world now rests in your hands. As his apprentice, you have been chosen to continue both the business and the battle. Are you ready to serve up magical scoops and put a stop to Kirusza? Magical Ice Cream Factory Grow and harvest mystical plants to create powerful ice cream flavors. Each flavor unleashes destructive elemental forces effective against different types of enemies. Defend the Shop Kirusza has dispatched his minions, the Semacios, to destroy your business. Use your magical ice and your weapon to fight them off before they can reach the crystals. About the Project Scoop 'n Shoot is a passion project developed by our 5-person student team over the course of 1.5 years. We are proud to finally share the results of our hard work with you! A Note on Development : Since this is a completed student project, we cannot promise regular content updates or expansions. However, we hope you have as much fun playing it as we did making it. Feedback and reviews are always welcome and help us on our future paths as game developers!

rows.name: Pohinki Simulator
rows.short_description: Pohinki Simulator is a survival game set in a polish neighbourhood, where you need to explore the open world in search for trash in order to survive and gain power. Build structures, experiment with found items, and become the most powerful bum alive!
rows.description_html: Pohinki Simulator is a survival game set in a polish neighbourhood, where you need to explore the open world in search for trash in order to survive and gain power. Explore the forgotten streets of Tarnow and find the treasures that others threw away in this abstract reality, filled with secrets waiting to be discovered. You wake up in the middle of the forest as a person known as 'Hu Man', from now on, your day-to-day life is roaming the streets in search for trash, after you collect what is needed to survive the next day, the choice of what you will be doing in your free time is yours - collecting scrap, becoming a thief, exploring the woods, building a base or going to a giant spider's BBQ party - you decide!  Pohinki Simulator aims for player freedom, because of that, if you aren't interested in survival, there is also an adventure mode where you don't have to worry about surviving and can freely experiment with multitude of mechanics the game gives you. Key Features: Absurd humor Freedom of action Inventory management Randomized trash spawning Physics based building Crime system Electricity system Day/Night system

rows.name: FACE LOVE: Face Designer
rows.short_description: ITS VALENTINES SEASON AND EVERYONE'S FACES GOT BLOWN OFF!
rows.description_html: Just Updated The original  FACE LOVE has been given a face lift  with new features and customers! Save your creations to the Face Library , then take them into the brand-new Creative Mode to edit them further: with custom names, face and body colors, and your choice of over 200+ face stickers. Plus, you can save high quality images of your creations to share with friends! About the Game New Recruit! It's time to get Mug-Making and keep the face factory afloat in FACE LOVE: Face Designer! Take a shift at the Face Tec factory, using strangers' Love Profiles' as inspiration to make them brand new faces. A new selection of customers and face parts each time you play! Get creative and work with the parts you're given to complement the customer's personality. Save high quality images of your customers in Photo Mode . Choose from a selection of backgrounds to find one that matches your customer! Brand new ways to customize your saved faces, with the Renamer tool, body and head recoloring , and a gallery of over 200+ face parts . Make a brand new face, or improve an existing customer. All your faces from Play Mode and Creative Modes are saved to the Library. Browse your creations, or return and edit them further! C'mon recruit, there's money to be made!!! LimboLane is a creative duo making silly games that squish and bounce, comprised of designer Day Lane and animator Yugo Limbo. They have a love for the kitschy, the surreal, and the utterly bizarre. They're known for the nod-and-shake puzzle game Smile For Me and the a-pocky-lips stopping adventure Great God Grove .

rows.name: Clickoin
rows.short_description: Click your way through Clickoin - a sleek clicker game where every coin press brings unique skins! Earn up to 4 steam drops per hour, unlock stunning visuals, and grow your collection with clever in-game mechanics.
rows.description_html: Clickoin is an addictive clicker game where every click brings you closer to a stunning collection of coin skins! With clever progression systems and satisfying feedback, Clickoin delivers a rewarding and stylish experience with every tap. Skin Drops: Every 15 minutes, you're eligible for a steam drop - up to 4 per hour ! The game checks for drop eligibility whenever you unlock a new skin through gameplay, giving each click an extra dose of excitement. Drop Rarities: Each drop is completely random and weighted by rarity: Common – 70% Uncommon – 20% Rare – 9% Epic – 0.9% Legendary – 0.1% These drops are purely cosmetic and do not affect gameplay, but offer a fun incentive for collectors and completionists alike.

rows.name: The Seabed's Shining Star
rows.short_description: Under the hazy moon, a shrine maiden meets a star. A short visual novel of a two person conversation. Cup ramen recommended.
rows.description_html: In Hiroshima, there was an infamous shrine.  What was infamous about it, you might ask?  First, the shrine contained a god of desperation.  Gamblers, debtors, and gacha addicts came to pray.  Second, it was being used as a parking lot.  There wasn't a trace of divinity to be found.  Third, the shrine maiden couldn't care less.  She did the bare minimum. Pray, park, or leave.  As that dull shrine maiden swept the leaves,  a shooting star shot across the night sky.  She decided, as if she believed, to make a wish.  Before she could, the star crashed into her car.  'Across the vastness of space, we have arrived!'  ----------------------------------------------------- The Seabed's Shining Star is a leisurely two hour read. It's almost entirely a conversation between two people. Make a cup ramen, settle down, and read it in one sitting. There are no choices to be made, so progress as you'd like.

rows.name: Menticide
rows.short_description: Menticide is an endless runner where you protect a man running from himself. You draw lines to bounce the man around, block off enemies and cut through obstacles. Through strong symbolism and procedural rhetoric we are using the game as an analogue for mental health.
rows.description_html: This game was developed by a team of Clark University students, and was produced by Team EdgeCase. You play as a man having a mental breakdown. He tries to escape from his own mind and runs deeper into it. You play as his protector, drawing lines and moving him around to protect him from enemies that may or may not be real. This endless runner game is an analogue for mental health, and because of that you cannot win. You just try to get a better score than you did last time. There is a global leaderboard so you can compete with others, no matter where they are. Gameplay Instructions: Use the 'a' and 'd' keys, or the arrow keys to move left and right. Use your mouse to click and draw lines that will block off enemies line-of-sight, bounce projectiles away, keep the iron maiden from growing spikes, and to pickup additional health! You have a draw meter that will run out if you draw for too long. It will refill over time, but if it reaches zero, you will not be able to draw until it refills all the way. The trees will slow you down and let the hands catch up to you. Regain speed by sliding along the wall! If you are not happy with your run, press 'r' to reset emmediately. Meet the team. Producer: Milo Justice Programmer: William Titus Programmer: Lucian Terhorst Lead artist: Max Derienze Artist: Anthony Panasenko Artist: John De-Andrade Audio: Jack Hughes Designer: Charlie Schmerzler

rows.short_description: Embark on an epic adventure in The Dragon Odyssey! Customize your hero and battle in dynamic ARPG combat. Explore vast worlds, raid dungeons, and uncover treasures. Play solo or team up in thrilling MMORPG gameplay. Begin your legendary journey today!
rows.description_html: Embark on a grand adventure in a land steeped in legend and magic. Join forces with other players to reclaim your rightful place among the heroes of old! Experience top-tier AAA gaming right at your fingertips. Dive into a world of dragons and legends with just a tap. Whether you play for minutes or hours, The Dragon Odyssey offers an unforgettable adventure. Go solo or team up with friends to defeat colossal foes! Battle swarms of enemies or engage in epic player-vs-player clashes to prove your valor! Explore a vast and enchanting world! Download now and begin your legendary adventure!

rows.name: Pau e Pedra
rows.short_description: A casual battle royale focused on quick matches where players punch, throw rocks, and swing sticks in fast-paced, minimalist combat with friends.
rows.description_html: Pau e Pedra is a small-scale, casual battle royale focused on quick matches and lighthearted multiplayer sessions with friends. There are no complex systems, no deep progression trees — just simple, fast gameplay where players pick up whatever they find on the ground and try to be the last one standing. Combat is minimal and intentionally straightforward: punch with your fists, grab a stick to hit harder, or throw a rock to catch someone off guard. It's easy to learn, fast to play, and ideal for short bursts of chaotic fun with a group. Built with multiplayer in mind, Pau e Pedra offers a clean and responsive experience without the usual complexity of the genre. It’s a simple game made for good times.

rows.description_html: Overview 'Rise of the Penguins' is a 2D Side-Scrolling  Action-Platformer for Gameboy. The game is meant to be simple and linear but with some challenging enemies. The game is inspired by ghost n goblins and a bit of mega man. Features 6 levels with a variety of enemies in each level 2 Extra Levels Boss Rush Mode , Unlocked only after beating all 6 levels 6 mini boss enemies and 8 boss enemies(including the 2 ks ones) and a final boss 6 simple difficulty settings to adjust checkpoints to make the game harder or easier, with checkpoints resetting after a game over but modifiable through these settings. Basic hud that shows the highscore, health and time remaining Janky animations made by me Minimal story with no text -but hoping the game is engaging enough to keep playing

rows.name: Crashed
rows.short_description: Crashed is a third-person stealth game where you play as B.O.B., stranded on the quirky planet SnamSam. The mission? Rebuild the craft and escape! You’ll sneak through restricted areas and take daring routes. A splash of humour as B.O.B.’s detachable head knocks off the Snailmen's heads!
rows.description_html: Crashed is a third-person stealth adventure where you play as B.O.B. After his spaceship collided with an asteroid, he crash-lands on the quirky world of SnamSam. Upon waking, B.O.B. discovers that several parts of his ship have been looted by the local inhabitants, the Snailmen! Your mission? Reassemble the scattered pieces of your spaceship and escape! Infiltrate the Facility Embark on a daring quest through the Snailmen’s labyrinthine facility. Navigate restricted areas brimming with patrolling guards and security cameras that track your every move. Keep out of sight to avoid detection or risk having nearby guards hunt you down. The goal is simple: retrieve your spaceship parts hidden deep the facility and escape. Utilize creative strategies, time your movement, and exploit shortcuts to outwit the Snailmen and slip through their defenses. Use Your Head... Take out Snailmen guards with B.O.B.’s detachable head! Launch it at unsuspecting guards from behind to knock their heads clean off, creating comedic chaos. Steal a guard’s head to open doors leading to restricted areas or unlock special shortcuts. But beware—the guards won’t give up their heads without a fight and will relentlessly chase you to get them back. Don’t worry—the Snailmen are a hardy bunch! Losing their heads is just a temporary inconvenience, and they’ll pop them right back on and keep going. Prepare for an unforgettable adventure where your head is your greatest weapon. Rebuild your ship, outwit the Snailmen, and escape SnamSam—if you can!

rows.name: Assetflip attorney
rows.short_description: Assetflip attorney is a murder mystery satire visual novel, Solve crimes in a world where everyone has gone insane and everything feels like a fever dream, interrogate witnesses, hunt for clues and take down the criminal organization that threatens to destroy reality
rows.description_html: The objective is simple, defend people being accused of murder and find the real killer... the only problem is everyone involved in these murder cases are completely insane and helping you solve the case is the last thing on their mind, on top of that there is an mysterious organization conducting all these killings behind the scenes who will stop at nothing to make your job a living hell so it is your mission to expose take down and expose this mystery! The courtroom is a puzzle where you will be put to the test, analyse what the witnesses claim to have gone down on the night of the murder and prove them wrong , check your evidence and compare it with what there saying to see if there telling the truth, find contradictions and make objections to prove there lying! The courtroom has a long dark conspiracy hidden within that you have unknowingly been trapped in, slowly descend down its layers of lore and escape, watch your back     - Four chapters. that amounts to 10+ hours of gameplay over the course of which the narrative gets increasingly more chaotic (also featuring a secret chapter) - A huge cast of characters . all with unique personalities and interconnecting backstories but beware... not all of them survive - The strongest character in fiction... rows.name: The Forgotten Village (Demo)
rows.short_description: The Forgotten Village is a Fantasy Simulation RPG. Arrive in a rundown Village with nothing but the shirt on your back. Clear the land, Gather Resources, Help the Villagers and Earn new Tools to aid you in restoring the Forgotten Village back to its former Glory!
rows.description_html: The Forgotten Village is a Fantasy Simulation RPG. Help the Villagers by competing various tasks and Quests ranging from clearing the Land to fixing broken objects. Upon Quest completion you will be rewarded with new Equipment and Tools. Equipment will provide passive bonuses, while Tools will allow you to gather resources more quickly. Use your newly acquired Tools to repair Structures, clear the Land and restore The Forgotten Village back to its former glory! Features Gather Resources!   Pick up Sticks and chop Trees to gather more Wood. Explore the Cave and begin Mining to acquire Stone and Ore. Get Fixing! Once you have enough resources. Use your trusty Hammer to fix objects in the Village. Fixing Objects will always provide you with a reward, even if you don't have an active Quest. Quests & Rewards!  Good deeds won't go unnoticed. Fixing Objects & completing Villagers' Quests will reward you with new Tools & Equipment.  Tools & Equipment!  Tools will enable you to gather resources more efficiently, while worn Equipment will grant passive bonuses when worn! Renown:  Fixing Objects & Completing Quests will award renown. Earning Renown will trigger special events such as Mail Rewards or messages from other Villagers.

rows.name: 1.96.9 all update
rows.short_description: The game is simple to play, with players using the mouse to search for hidden NPCs. The game allows players to save while playing, and there is no 'game over' for players, making it easy to play. Some NPCs like to hide, so we recommend exploring the map thoroughly.
rows.description_html: The game is simple to play, with players using the mouse to search for hidden NPCs. Interaction is possible with mouse clicks and it is a single game. The game allows players to save while playing, and there is no 'game over' for players, making it easy to play. Some NPCs like to hide, so we recommend exploring the map thoroughly. The game consists of 20 pages. You can play the game even if you don't understand English. This game allows players to interact with the game only using the mouse. Look for the NPC on the map. You can see pixel graphic NPCs and backgrounds. You can see NPC profile pictures. Among NPCs, there are some who like to hide. This game series is fictional, and the persons, places, organizations, and any all other names, settings and events depicted in this game series have been fictionally created. No identification with actual persons (living or deceased), businesses, places, events, and products, is intended or should be inferred.

rows.name: Elemental Surge
rows.short_description: A challenging action platformer in which players embark on an epic journey fighting their way to the top of towering castle to confront a once-mighty but fallen king. Immerse yourself in an experience filled adventure, danger, and magic!
rows.description_html: Elemental Surge ignites in this action-packed, elemental-powered platformer adventure! Battle your way up a sprawling, enemy-infested castle, reclaiming lost elemental magic as you ascend to face the Fallen King himself in a final, epic showdown. Elemental Surge offers a dynamic gameplay experience, where players harness the elemental powers of fire lighting and earth. Use your newly found powers— Unleash fireballs, lightning strikes, and earth-shattering punches as you battle your way to the top. The more you climb, the stronger you become, unlocking new elements and ultimately combining them into the devastating Elemental Surge. Reclaim the magic, navigate deadly traps and vanquish the king’s relentless soldiers. Your ultimate goal? To reach the summit and confront the Fallen King himself. But beware—the higher you go, the deadlier the challenges. Survive the castle's perils and see how far your elemental mastery can take you. In this epic quest, the power is yours—will you rise to the challenge? Elemental Abilities - Unlock and wield unique elemental powers to overcome enemies and environmental puzzles. Challenging Platforming - Test your skills with precise movement and timing in complex level designs. Dynamic Combat - Engage in fast-paced battles that demand strategy and reflexes This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: TopCraft
rows.short_description: Topcraft is a free, cross‑platform, top‑down sandbox survival game. Explore procedural worlds, mine and craft gear, build cozy bases, and wire contraptions. Battle roaming creatures, clear dungeons, and shape the land—your tiny blocky frontier, your rules.
rows.description_html: Under Development This game is free and already playable, but we continuously work on it further, adding more gameplay features and, most importantly, a multiplayer mode! So buy some Seedlings or Trees to help the developer with that! About the Game Topcraft is a free, cross‑platform, top‑down sandbox survival game in continuous development where every world is procedurally generated. Start with bare hands, mine resources, craft tools, and build a cozy base or sprawling settlement. Farm, wire contraptions, and reshape the land one tile at a time. Explore forests and caves, battle zombies, spiders, and wildlife, and loot dungeons for rare gear. Survive, discover recipes, and pursue achievements as you carve your path in a tiny, tactical frontier. Join officially hosted multiplayer servers to experience MMORPG features!

rows.name: Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing - Prolog
rows.short_description: This is the prologue to Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing. In this detective RPG, the captain of a steamship collapses under mysterious circumstances during lunch. What happened? Question the passengers, discover and combine clues, and succeed in dice-based skill checks to solve the case.
rows.description_html: NOTE: This free game is the official prologue to our main game Inspector Schmidt - The Ebbing . You will solve a tricky case that takes place right before the main storyline of The Ebbing . This case is not part of the main game but serves as the narrative link between Part 1 and Part 2 of the Inspector Schmidt series. Valentin Schmidt, a Bavarian civil servant with truly bad timing, actually just wants to go on a well-deserved vacation to the North Sea. But right from the start, this is overshadowed by a drama: The captain of the steamship that is bringing Valentin and the other passengers to an idyllic North Sea island suddenly collapses during lunch and struggles for his life. Was the captain poisoned? Valentin is tasked with finding out what happened – and discovers a web of relationships, dependencies, and motives among the ship's crew and passengers that he must unravel to find the true culprit. Gameplay Explore the Open World: Move freely on the North Sea steamship in 1870 and search for clues. Initiate a Confrontation: Question the suspects and convict the perpetrators. Engage in Exciting Dialogues: Use the dialogue mechanic to interview passengers, gather intriguing information, and find out who is hiding something. Go on a Trail Hunt: Use your detective instinct to find hidden clues. Combine the Clues: Link information and findings to solve the case. Level Up: Develop your character and decide which skills you want to improve. Pass the Skill Checks: Use your skills in classic pen and paper skill checks (dice rolls). Craft Useful Items: Gather resources and build items and consumables to improve your skills. Make Difficult Decisions: Your actions affect the course of the story. Decide for yourself how you want to solve the tasks—through charisma, diplomacy, etc.—but the mission is clear: Solve the case! Setting The year is 1870. The first functioning transatlantic telegraph cable has been put into operation. It creates hope for a communication-rich and peaceful time between the USA and Germany. The world is coming closer together, and industrialization is also advancing by large steps. However, these changes are not only met with supporters among the population. And then there is also the Franco-Prussian War, which is causing unrest among the people, who are being conscripted out of fear. Valentin Schmidt, a young official from Bavaria, has just solved a tricky murder case in Wolpertshofen, Bavaria. As a thank you, Mr. Haller, the chief commissioner, sends him to the North Sea for rest. After the eventful crossing to Havstedt, Valentin is immediately confronted with the next mysterious death that needs to be cracked... Supported by funds from nordmedia – Film and Media Company Lower Saxony/Bremen Ltd.

rows.name: Palm Cracker
rows.short_description: Delve into a gripping world of puzzles, true ciphers on an old PalmPilot system. Will you uncover the Crypt Killer’s confession and bring him to justice, or will he escape the law?
rows.description_html: Uncover secrets hidden in a relic of the digital age. You’ve acquired a mysterious PalmPilot from the notorious Crypt Killer, the smartest serial killer of the century. Somewhere in this device lies the key to unraveling his confession. But it won’t be easy. You’ll need to crack codes, solve cryptic riddles, and learn real-world decryption techniques in this immersive and challenging detective game. Are you ready to unlock the truth? From the creator of OS simulation titles like 128k, DISOWN95, After Hours, and Atom☭grad. Features Authentic PalmPilot Simulation : Explore the quirks and charms of this iconic device, re-created with loving attention to detail. Puzzles with Depth : Engage with brain-teasing challenges that blend logic, intuition, and real cryptographic concepts. Retro Nostalgia : Relive the magic of 2000s tech, complete with classic games, vintage apps, and handwriting recognition. Prefer your keyboard? That works too! What is the PalmPilot? The PalmPilot was a revolutionary personal digital assistant (PDA) released in the late 1990s and early 2000s. Designed for managing contacts, calendars, and notes, it became a favorite of tech enthusiasts for its portability, handwriting recognition, and early mobile games. In many ways, it was the first glimpse at the modern smartphone—just without the phone. I used to play with my dad’s PalmPilot all the time, and I recently found it in a storage unit. What do you know—after 20 years, it still had battery left! I turned it on and knew right away that I wanted to use it for a computer simulation. Palm Cracker is the result! Is the game really free? Yes! Palm Cracker is 100% free to play, own, and beat. There are no hidden fees or in-app purchases. Wishlist now!

rows.name: Deadswitch Combat
rows.short_description: DEADSWITCH COMBAT is a fast-paced 2D multiplayer shooter. Experience action-packed combat with hundreds of weapons, vehicle combat, and plenty of team-based game modes.
rows.description_html: DEADSWITCH COMBAT is an action packed 2D multiplayer shooter that builds upon the previous games. RANKED PROGRESSION Progress through the ranks by earning XP in-game by killing enemies, scoring objectives, and completing challenges. Unlock new weapons, attachments, equipment, and vehicles to help you achieve victory in combat. Play solo or team-based game modes with other players online, or play local games against bots to hone your skills. CO-OP SURVIVAL Play one of many Survival modes and last as long as you can against endless waves of soldiers, helicopters, zombies, and other creatures. Submit your score in the worldwide leaderboards! FULL WEAPON CUSTOMIZATION Personalize over 200 weapons with optics, lasers, grips, skins, and other accessories. IN-GAME EDITOR Create your own maps and missions with the in-game editor and instantly play them with friends online! Share or browse creations in the Workshop. KEY FEATURES Plenty of game modes and maps Massive selection of weapons, attachments, equipment, and skins Fully customizable characters and loadouts Ranked matches, multiplayer clans, and custom servers Intense fast-paced gameplay In-game editor and mod-friendly Custom multiplayer servers

rows.name: Bonk
rows.short_description: A casual musical idler. Ideal for background sounds while focusing on study or work.
rows.description_html: A casual musical idler. Ideal for background sounds while focusing on study or work. Leave it on in the background to help with focus, or get mesmerized by the pendulum as it creates polyrhythms. Squares move up and down playing notes and awarding 'bonk bucks' when changing directions. Once you get enough 'bonk bucks', you can buy more squares. Once you get 100 'bonk bucks', you can prestige to add a multiplier to every bonk. Then you can spend the multiplier to unlock more features such as other scales and instruments. Once you get a whole bunch of multiplier you can unlock the Creative Mode which allows custom scales, speed change, and setting the number of blocks directly. Features: Custom pitch Echo Squares Auto-Purchase Squares 14 different instruments Mutiple scales Creative Mode - custom scale, speed, and number of squares

rows.name: Rogue Rubber
rows.short_description: The ultimate bath battle. Blast your way through 12 waves of enemy ducks to become the ultimate bath-time companion in this point and click shooter.
rows.description_html: In Rogue Rubber, you play as a rubber duck fighting for survival against a horde of evil enemy ducks. Each level presents a different combination of constraints, enemies, and targets that must be destroyed before the tub runs out of water. Clear all 12 levels to be crowned the ultimate rubber ducky. After you shoot a bubble, you can swim over it to pick it back up as your supply is limited. Hitting an enemy with a bubble destroys the bubble but automatically refills its ammo slot. One hit from a bubble or bubble mine is enough to sink you or an enemy. Controls: WASD Movement Left click to shoot bubble, E or right click to place bubble mine

rows.name: A Tiny Snow Game
rows.short_description: Get ready for an epic snowball showdown! This fun couch co-op game for 1-4 players offers exciting modes like Free-For-All, King’s Crown, and a campaign. With vibrant visuals, dynamic gameplay, and a kid-friendly mode, it’s perfect for all ages. Join the frosty fun and share your feedback!
rows.description_html: Get ready for an epic snowball showdown! Dive into this fun-filled couch co-op snow-fighting game designed for up to 4 players on one screen. Whether you're dodging snowballs, landing perfect throws, or outmaneuvering your opponents, every match is packed with laughter and excitement! Early Access This game is still in development, and I, a solo developer, am thrilled to share it with you in early access! Your feedback means the world to me and will help shape the game into its best version. Please feel free to report any bugs, suggest ideas, or share your thoughts—good or bad! Every bit of feedback makes a difference and is deeply appreciated. Key Features Couch Co-Op Fun : Play with friends and family locally using controllers. Perfect for game nights! Top-Down Perspective : Stay in the action with a clear bird’s-eye view of the snowy battleground. Kids Mode : A special mode with auto-aim assistance and forgiving difficulty, making it fun and accessible for younger players. Dynamic Gameplay : Sprint, slide, and dodge your way to victory while unleashing perfectly timed snowball throws. Various Game Modes : Keep the fun fresh with exciting ways to play. Charming Visuals : Experience a vibrant, cartoon-style winter wonderland that brings the frosty fun to life. Game Modes Free-For-All : Every snowballer for themselves—last one standing wins! King’s Crown : Race against time to earn points while wearing the crown! The crowned player scores extra points, but everyone else is out to take them down. Hold the crown the longest to win. Last Penguin : Watch out for the fishy smell! A mischievous penguin with a bomb chases the smelly player. If it catches them, they explode! Avoid the stink and outlast your friends to win. Campaign Mode : Face off against AI opponents in challenging scenarios and boss fights. Perfect for All Ages Whether you're a seasoned gamer or just looking for some casual fun.  Grab a controller, gather your friends, and let the snowball battles begin!

rows.name: Rogue Worlds
rows.short_description: Rogue Worlds is a chaotic tactical roguelite platformer where you wield the environment and creative abilities to overcome challenges. Outwit powerful guardians and blast, dash, grapple, fight, and charm your way through ever-changing labyrinths!
rows.description_html: Rogue Worlds is a roguelite platformer where you use the environment and creative abilities to overcome challenges. You'll need planning, wits and reflexes to make a way through these ever-changing death labyrinths. The game provides a free (lite) edition of Aura of Worlds, with a shorter campaign and shared progress. Explore strange biomes, escape flooding poison, outwit gargantuan bosses. Do you play defensively with a repeater and energy shield, or swing into the fray with a boomerang and grapple hook? Do you scour the levels for potions and runes; or dive headfirst into the chaos? Along the way, unlock starting gear options, shortcuts, character perks, pets, and more. The friends you rescue on your journey will help you. Each procedurally generated run presents new hazards, layouts, and tactical decisions. You can further customize your build with runes, and gear modifiers that synergize in a myriad of ways. Veterans can push their limits by disabling perks or cranking up the difficulty for greater challenges—and greater rewards. Features Diverse Level Themes : Tidal corridors lined with mines, flickering lights in underground ruins, rising lava pits, and carnivorous gardens. Each environment brings unique dangers and opportunities. Creative Abilities : Master parkour, cloak from enemies, or even enthrall foes to fight on your side. You'll need planning, wits and reflexes to make a way through these ever-changing death labyrinths. The game provides a free (lite) edition of Aura of Worlds, with a shorter campaign and shared progress. Explore strange biomes, escape flooding poison, outwit gargantuan bosses. Do you play defensively with a repeater and energy shield, or swing into the fray with a boomerang and grapple hook? Do you scour the levels for potions and runes; or dive headfirst into the chaos? Along the way, unlock starting gear options, shortcuts, character perks, pets, and more. The friends you rescue on your journey will help you. Each procedurally generated run presents new hazards, layouts, and tactical decisions. You can further customize your build with runes, and gear modifiers that synergize in a myriad of ways. Veterans can push their limits by disabling perks or cranking up the difficulty for greater challenges—and greater rewards. rows.name: Clutch: The Drift Simulation
rows.short_description: Clutch is an effort to create the closest to real life car drifting simulation but in a “game” form. The goal is to create a professional level game that closest simulates real driving with the largest support for modding. The secondary goal is to mimic the fun of real life drifting and community.
rows.description_html: CLUTCH: THE ULTIMATE REALISTIC DRIFTING SIMULATOR Clutch is a passion project designed to deliver the most authentic drifting experience available in a 'game' format. Built for enthusiasts and professionals alike, Clutch simulates the intricacies of real-life drifting, from tire grip to throttle control, all wrapped in a highly moddable, community-driven package. FEATURES Continuously Evolving Experience: While still in its early stages, this game is a work in progress that will be continuously updated and improved based on player feedback and ongoing development. True-to-Life Driving Dynamics: Feel the road as you master clutch kicks, countersteering, and throttle modulation, all designed to replicate the physics of real drifting. Unmatched Modding Support: Expand the experience with fully open modding capabilities, giving players the freedom to create cars, tracks, and gameplay adjustments. Immersive VR Integration: Dive into the world of drifting with support for all major VR platforms, putting you directly in the driver’s seat. Universal Peripheral Compatibility: Whether you're using USB steering wheels, controllers, or other devices, Clutch ensures seamless support for your preferred setup. Interactive Spectator Mode: Relive the thrill of community drifting events by watching and interacting as others take on the track. Engage with the action, just like at a real drift meet. YOUR DRIFTING JOURNEY STARTS HERE Whether you're chasing the perfect line, looking to sharpen your skills, or creating your own custom experience, Clutch is built to evolve with you. With a focus on realism, fun, and community, this is more than a simulator—it’s a drift lifestyle.

rows.name: Cards, the Universe and Everything
rows.short_description: Cards, the Universe and Everything is a unique trading card game with almost limitless possibilities: Dinosaurs, Norse gods, blue-footed boobies, Samurai, volcanoes, even the god particle. With the universe’s thingamabobs and endless strategies, are you ready for this gloriously bonkers game?
rows.description_html: The Only Card Game Where You Can Collect, Battle, and Trade… Everything. Ever wondered who’d win in a fight, Loki or a pug ? T-Rex vs Houdini ? Napoleon or the Sphinx ? In Cards, the Universe and Everything (CUE), these deeply important questions are finally answered. Collect the best of history, science, myths, nature and much more… No paywalls, just good old-fashioned wheeling and dealing with players across the world. Build your dream collection, track down and exchange rare cards, or hoard 37 copies of a Honey Badger just for the hell of it. With over 5,000 cards spanning everything from black holes to Black Hawks, you can build decks that are brilliant, bizarre, or just plain unfair. In case you're wondering, that's more than 434 quintillion possible card combinations per round, so things never get boring. Sure, Space, History and Science might sound like a school project, but really, it’s mostly shouting as Henry VIII flattens your quantum physicist and the angry goose you just played ruins everything. Each arena has its own twists, and every card is packed with curious facts to make defeat feel oddly enlightening. Win trophies, unlock powerful new cards, and collect rewards in regular events. Because who doesn’t love being rewarded for playing cards? Craft Special Cards and Fuse Duplicates Uncover secret recipes, combine duplicates, and create new cards with game-changing abilities. Or just melt down your spares in a blind panic after a crushing defeat.

rows.name: Starling
rows.short_description: Starling is a student made third person base-building exploration game. As an employee of Starling Corp., your mission is to gather resources from across the galaxy. After an unexpected turn of events, you will need to rebuild your base while being assisted by adorable creatures known as starlings.
rows.description_html: Starling is a student-developed third-person base-building exploration game. As an employee of Starling Corp., your mission is to gather resources from across the galaxy and send it back to the corporation to supply your home planet with resources essential for survival. These cute creatures will guide and accompany you throughout your journey. Finding legendary items might unlock cosmetic for your new cosmic friends! Explore the world around you using your jetpack Delve into deep mines to extract valuable minerals Chop down alien trees for wood Fish in serene waters to secure essential supplies Upgrade your tools to access more resources Use these resources to upgrade your gear, repair your base, craft consumables and more! A catastrophic space incident has left your once-thriving space station in ruins, its fragments scattered across the galaxy. Now, it’s up to you to rebuild your base. By repairing various stations in your spaceship, you will unlock the ability to: Smelt ores and refine resources Craft essential items for progression Trade goods with the Starling Corp. Grow crops for supplies and buffs Customize your spacesuit at the cosmetic station

rows.name: SpAIceRocks
rows.short_description: Journey across a dystopian galaxy as an interplanetary mining prospector, matching and collecting valuable minerals across six uniquely haunting worlds. You just need a mouse to play.  SpAIceRocks is a Unity 6 match 3 PC game for Steam that is being developed using as much AI as possible.
rows.description_html: 🚀 SpAIceRocks: Intergalactic Match 3 Mining Adventure Journey across a dystopian galaxy as an interplanetary mining prospector, matching and collecting valuable minerals across six uniquely haunting worlds. Each planet tells its own dark tale - from toxic swamps and polluted underbellies to frozen moons harboring ancient secrets. You just need a mouse to play.  Key Features: 🌎 Explore 6 Distinct Planets: Each with its own atmosphere, character, and exclusive minerals to mine 📈 Dynamic Board Expansion: Success unlocks larger mining operations - start small and expand up to 12x12 grids ⛏️ Strategic Mining Tools: Unlock and deploy powerful clearing tools: Plus Clearers: Clear minerals in a cross pattern Column Clearers: Clear entire vertical sections Row Clearers: Sweep across horizontal lines 💎 Unique Mineral Types: Each planet offers exclusive new minerals to collect and trade 🎯 Progressive Challenge: Clear boards to earn credits and unlock access to new worlds 🎮 Strategic Gameplay: Balance your moves, tool usage, and mineral matching to maximize profits 🏆 Level-Based Progression: Complete collection goals to advance and expand your mining operation Start your mining empire on a humble beginning world, then use your earnings to unlock access to new planets, each with their own valuable resources. But beware - every world has its own dark history and environmental challenges to overcome. Match three or more minerals to collect them, but plan carefully - you have limited moves to meet your collection goals. Use your earned credits wisely: invest in powerful clearing tools, unlock new mineral types, or save up to purchase rights to mine on new planets. Will you become the galaxy's premier mining magnate? Can you unlock all six worlds and uncover their mysterious histories? Start your cosmic mining adventure today! Perfect for fans of: Match-3 puzzle games with strategic depth Sci-fi themed games with dark atmosphere Resource management and progression systems Quick sessions with long-term goals 🎮 Your first mining operation awaits - ready to start your galactic enterprise? Also for AI Fans: SpAIceRocks is a Free to Play Unity 6 match 3 PC game for Steam that is being developed using as much AI as possible.   This open source game has been generated almost completely built with AI: - Game logic generated from Cline (VSCode plugin) + Claude AI & Unity Muse - Graphics from Midjourney processed with Rembg - Music from Udio - Sound effects from and (non-AI) - Font suggestions from a mixture of experts with ChatGPT's and Claude's suggestions winning out so far. - Special effects from Unity Particle Pack (non-AI) The trailer animation at the end was generated with Reflection Image to Text, it its sound track is an extended version of an Udio soundtrack in the game. Thank you to all the awesome providers above!   You can download the Unity game source and art from my site on github.

rows.name: Heat incremental
rows.short_description: Experience this new take on reactor and factory idle style game! More heat management, more building, more explosions! Hope you have fun!
rows.description_html: From the creator of reactor idle, factory idle and city idle! Your mission is simple: HEAT UP THE PLANET , Yes, really. You’ll start with clean technologies like solar panels that barely produce any heat, but soon begin to research less clean methods to produce even more heat. Who knows—you might actually succeed in overheating the planet. Managing excessive heat, however, is not an easy task. Be prepared for challenges and, yes, explosions. MANY EXPLOSIONS. In your defense, explosions also help heat up the planet. Explosions cause financial losses and can bankrupt you though... This game introduces new features gradually. At first, you’ll see only the basics to help you get started, but as you progress, more advanced technologies and mechanics will unlock. It is a long journey with plenty to explore. Disclaimer: This game is HARD. It is also a form of a puzzle game, requiring you to figure out efficient strategies to improve your setup and boost your income. Keep in mind that perfection isn’t the goal—you’ll need to focus on specific areas and make trade-offs. Are you ready for the challenge?
