rows.name: Decorporate
rows.short_description: Become the best weeb in the world!!!!!!!!
rows.description_html: Decorporate is a local multiplayer platform-fighter game. It can be played by 1 to 4 players on a single computer. Controls support both Keyboard, USB controller and Bluetooth controller devices. Players can also choose to fight AI controlled characters, with three different levels of difficulty. The players control game characters who can Move horizontally, Jump, perform Attacks, or use their Special. The game plays like a typical platform fighter, but when a player kills an enemy, they evolve, changing into a new character with different stats and a new Special ability. Each character has a different Special ability: Bull CEO: the most powerful being, who can charge in a horizontal line, damaging everything in his path and only stopping when hitting a wall. Fox Manager: shoots in a horizontal line with a gun. Sheep Employee: she bring death and destruction to her enemies with a devastating vertical jump kick attack. Le Poulet : it's a chicken. Can rocket jump by shooting an explosive egg (downward vertical projectile). Hamster Weeb: only has a non-damaging dash for mobility. Can destroy the anime cassette to evolve into an Ascended Weeb, who can in turn permanently eliminate enemies from the game. There are three different Levels to fight on. The game has multiple gamemodes: Decorporate: basic gamemode: kill enemies to evolve in order to get to the Ascended Weeb evolution. Then, eliminate every other player on the field. Brawl: players have limited lives. Kill the others before they kill you! Otaku Outbreak: all againt one boss battle against a player-controlled Overpowered Ascended Weeb! Good luck!

rows.name: Abyssal Shade
rows.short_description: Abyssal Shade is a deck building roguelike where you dive into a dungeon of the mind. Receives the blessings of your emotions through unique puzzles and expand your deck to protect yourself from the Shades.
rows.description_html: Abyssal Shade is a deck building roguelike where you dive into a dungeon of the mind. Receive the blessings of your emotions and wield them to destroy the Shades that reside within! This game takes place in the void that consists of layers. Each layer has a long deck building roguelike section where you expand and use your deck from the previous floors to defeat your opponents. In between these card game segments there are a variety of top-down rpg puzzles that grant you rewards as you delve deeper into the layers. The battles consist of turn based combat where you play cards from your deck to summon allies and attack your enemy while defending yourself from damage. The game is on the shorter end last likely about 2 hours but is easily replayable with the chance to encounter new cards and develop new strategies.

rows.name: First Steps in the NICU (Discovery edition)
rows.short_description: Welcome to “First NICU Experience”! Experience neonatal care in this serious game. As a nursing student, work with medical staff and families to care for infants and tackle post-discharge challenges. With interactive choices and story-driven gameplay, learn key skills in 1 hour.
rows.description_html: Welcome to “First Steps in the NICU”! This game allows players to experience the world of neonatal care in a Neonatal Intensive Care Unit (NICU) . Through the perspectives of healthcare professionals and families, you will learn about infant care and preparations for life after discharge. Game Overview • Story-driven progression Players take on the role of a nursing student participating in clinical training at a NICU. By collaborating with medical staff and families, you will learn the basics of neonatal intensive care, communication with patient families, and the challenges of transitioning from hospital to home care. • Decision-based story development The story presents choices that help players understand appropriate actions and decisions. Every choice is accompanied by explanations, enabling deeper learning and insight. • Realistic scenarios The game is supervised by neonatologists and NICU nurses, ensuring a faithful recreation of actual medical settings. Features • Approximately 1 hour of gameplay, with a save function that allows you to resume at any time. • Recommended for medical students or middle and high school students interested in healthcare. • Knowledge gained through the game can be applied in daily life or medical settings. Development Background This game was created with the support of the Yuumi Memorial Foundation for Home Health Care and under the supervision of the Department of Pediatrics at Shinshu University. Pediatricians and students collaborated to turn the real challenges of medical practice into an accessible game. Recommended For • Those interested in medical or welfare fields • Families with NICU experience • Anyone curious about societal challenges Development Team • Supervision and Production: Department of Pediatrics, Shinshu University – Yukihide Miyosawa Experience the world of neonatal care with “First NICU Experience” . Through gameplay, you’ll gain insight into the lives of babies, their families, and the dedicated medical teams who support them.

Development Background This game was created with the support of the Yuumi Memorial Foundation for Home Health Care and under the supervision of the Department of Pediatrics at Shinshu University. Pediatricians and students collaborated to turn the real challenges of medical practice into an accessible game. Recommended For • Those interested in medical or welfare fields • Families with NICU experience • Anyone curious about societal challenges Development Team • Supervision and Production: Department of Pediatrics, Shinshu University – Yukihide Miyosawa Experience the world of neonatal care with “First NICU Experience” . Through gameplay, you’ll gain insight into the lives of babies, their families, and the dedicated medical teams who support them.

rows.name: Sixteen Undead
rows.short_description: Drive Like Hell! A high-octane chase through the endless desert! Dodge cops, rock out and tear up the road as a stitched-up teenage Frankenstein!
rows.description_html: Tear up the highway as Jimmy 'Stitch' Munroe - teenage rebel and undead menace! Brought back to life after a mad scientist's experiment goes wrong, Stitch hits the road on the run from the cops trying to bag him and tag him. In this intense endless driving game, you'll need quick reflexes and a lead foot to stay one step ahead of the law! GAMEPLAY FEATURES: Master high-speed driving mechanics as you weave through traffic and navigate challenging procedurally generated roads Keep the cops at bay while maintaining top speeds - the faster you drive, the higher your score multiplier Use your devil-may-care to gain the upper hand - chug a cold one for a devastating speed boost or light up a cigarette to trigger bullet-time reflexes! If you're in a tight situation an emergency boost will help you escape! Compete for glory on the local leaderboard and challenge your friends' high scores Choose your challenge! The 'Braindead' easy mode is perfect for learning the ropes, or try 'Deathwish' mode - the ultimate challenge with enhanced score multipliers and an exclusive leaderboard badge! DYNAMIC SYSTEMS: A procedurally generated highway, no two runs are the same! Adaptive difficulty increases the challenge the longer you survive Dynamic traffic keeps you on your toes The Cops are always on your tail, watch the distance meter or catch a view in your rearview to keep this thrilling chase going!  BLAST YOUR EARDRUMS! Rock out on the chase of your life with the face-melting riffs of JOYFUL TOY , and go apesh*t to North Korea's simian sensation: THE CONG ! This exclusive high-octane soundtrack will keep the energy high and the intensity cranked to 11.

rows.short_description: An action platformer on a distant planet, where your objective is getting home after crashing behind enemy lines. You'll need your trusty pistol; not to kill, but to explore. Along the way, you'll come face-to-face with the enemy, and find you have far more in common than you ever expected.
rows.description_html: An action platformer on a distant planet, where your objective is getting home after crashing behind enemy lines. You'll need your trusty pistol; not to kill, but to explore. Along the way, you'll come face-to-face with the enemy, and find you have far more in common than you ever expected. You awaken in an escape pod: alone, in enemy territory, with nothing but your pistol. You'll use this gun (and any others you find) not to kill, but to explore: destroying obstacles with bullets and using the gun's powerful recoil to navigate stages. You'll learn the history and language of a not-so-alien world with not-so-alien inhabitants, explore their past and present settlements, and make decisions that alter the course of both species' histories.

rows.name: O.W.L. - One Wave Length
rows.short_description: OWL is top down, rogue like bullet-hell that you can play with up to 1 friend. Everything is in beat, including your and the enemies attacks. With each new Instrument, new attack patterns unfold for you which will take you to your final obstacle; The Meowestro, the source of dissonance.
rows.description_html: The Symphonie Forest was once a place of harmony, where melodies flowed with the rivers and every creature moved in sync with the sound of the world. But that harmony has been shattered. The Meowestro , a wicked tyrant, has unleashed waves of dissonance, corrupting the very heart of the forest. The once-peaceful denizens now march to his command, their souls bound by the chaos. Only you - Stryx the Owl and Katt the Cat can withstand against the rising army of foes. Armed with your instruments you must battle through the different seasons of the forest, strike in sync and restore the music to it's people. Gameplay OWL is a top down, rogue like bullet-hell where you go through randomized prebuild levels. Only when you are in beat you are able to defeat the enemies, as the enemies follow the same rule. So listen to the Music patterns your enemies make and predict their attacks to reach the final boss, Meowestro. Your trusty shiny seller is able to take the shinies you collect and gives you small stat increases in return. Every bonfire you encounter you unlock powerful new Instruments that will aid you through your journey, increasing your damage and overall stats.

rows.short_description: Jump, shoot, and throw a lot of barrels in this self-contained FPS boss fight against a massive tornado.
rows.description_html: A Storm is Approaching... In this self contained FPS boss fight, players will use a dynamic movement system to navigate the scores of rubble orbiting an enormous tornado. While dodging falling debris, cyclones and lightning strikes, players will hunt down explosives to hurl into the tornado, then blast them with a shotgun to deal massive damage. With a rough completion time of around 30 minutes, this game is designed to offer a brief and exciting challenge to FPS players new and old alike! Some time in the 90's, probably... An unprecedented storm has gripped the region. The Weatherman, premier meteorologist for Channel 27 News, returns to his workplace to prepare for the worst. From the west, chaotic winds begin to converge... Gameplay Features: Move, jump and ground slam to propel yourself further Pick up, throw and blow up props, crates and barrels Wander around a detailed office environment Simplified control scheme with controller support and full rebinding options Difficulty settings to welcome FPS newcomers and veterans Sodas in the break room

rows.name: 10 Seconds
rows.short_description: Time loop puzzle horror, where you're stuck in a failed experiment and must escape or face being eaten for eternity.
rows.description_html: 10 Seconds is a game that hinges on its innovative design . You are trapped in a failed time loop experiment, where you have 10 seconds to scramble for supplies and safety before a monster is released to hunt you down. Crawl through vents, scour walls, find tools and twist valves. Doing everything you can to escape being eaten alive. When you die, you wake up back at the start. Though you may notice that not everything has gone back to normal. Perhaps the experiment was not perfected before things went awry? This game is designed to be completed in one sitting, only taking about 30 minutes for a single run, so there is no save feature. Make use of the physics system that allows you to pick up and throw items. It may be more useful than you think!

Create Lobbies, join games, and play with multiple friends in this basic hangman game where hilarity can ensure. Enter Any Word Or Phrase Feel free to go crazy and type in any wacky or weird word you can think of to confuse your friends. The harder the word is to guess the better your chances to win will be. Watch out though because for every letter your friends guess correctly they will receive points! Also Available on Other Platforms Play anywhere and everywhere! Hangman is also available on the Google Play Store, Apple App store, and Itch.io store. Play seamless cross platform Coop with all your friends without limitations.

rows.name: A Very Merry Nightmare
rows.short_description: A First-Person 3D Christmas Thriller Game
rows.description_html: A Very Merry Nightmare is a 3D First-Person game made in Unreal Engine. The story follows a young boy named Oliver on Christmas Eve who follows a mysterious doll to another world full of Christmas decorations, however, things are not as wonderful as they seem. Oliver must then figure out how to make it back home before it is too late.  Some features include an AI enemy that can both watch the player from a distance and chase the player when prompted. An interact system with objects like drawers, cabinets, and doors. Players can also eat the various sweets in the world and find hidden notes left throughout the environment.  This game was my Senior Project for my major and was made in 16 weeks. It was also my first project in Unreal Engine. I was the sole creator of the game handling everything but the sound (sourced from Splice) and the 3D modeling (sourced from Unreal Engine Marketplace). I am open to feedback and will have a place for submissions of any issues you might have. I will be taking all feedback into account and am open to adding more to the game in the future. I truly hope you all enjoy this game and I look forward to your feedback!

rows.name: F.O.R.S
rows.short_description: This intense shooter combines combat with trivia, answering questions correctly keeps you safe, while wrong answers drain your health and reveal your location. To recover, you must reach risky map zones, but enemies will hunt you. Only the smartest and most skilled will survive.
rows.description_html: In this high-stakes shooter, firepower alone won’t be enough you need quick thinking too. At the start of each round, attacking players must answer general knowledge questions. Answer correctly, and you’re safe. Get it wrong, and you’ll suffer a deadly disadvantage your health will slowly drain, and your location will be revealed to everyone. The only way to remove the penalty? Reach key zones on the map. But be careful your enemies know where you’re going and will be waiting to take you down. Will you fight through the chaos, outsmart your opponents, or risk it all to recover? Only the smartest and most skilled players will survive. There is a also a deathmatch mode for players to test their combat skills in a free-for-all battle.

rows.name: Investour
rows.short_description: Buy, upgrade, and dominate in this fast-paced multiplayer board game! Compete with quirky characters, strategize your moves, and outsmart rivals in unpredictable matches filled with fun and surprises. Climb the leaderboard and become the ultimate tycoon! The dice are in your hands! 🎲

Compete against friends or players from around the globe as you buy, upgrade, and dominate unique locations on the board. With quirky characters, hilarious interactions, and unexpected twists, every match is a fresh challenge. Key Features: 🎲 Strategic Gameplay: Plan your moves carefully, invest wisely, and use your resources to outplay your opponents. 🌍 Unique Locations: Travel across vibrant, hand-crafted boards filled with exciting places to buy and conquer. 🤩 Hilarious Characters: Choose from a cast of funny, animated characters, each with their own personality and style. 🌐 Multiplayer Mayhem: Play with up to 6 players online, or invite your friends for a private match. 💡 Unpredictable Events: Experience thrilling surprises with every roll of the dice, from chance cards to game-changing bonuses. Whether you’re in it for the laughs, the strategy, or the thrill of competition, this game is your ticket to hours of fun. Do you have what it takes to outsmart your rivals and claim victory? The board is waiting!

rows.name: BETWEEN
rows.short_description: 'May you leave no regrets in this journey of life.' 、 An independent game about death. Explore the past lives in an atmospheric graveyard.
rows.description_html: Credits: Music composed by Esko Vähämäki and sound effects made by Ali Hosseini. Thank you for the great production! ——— 'A journey through death, accompanied by flowers and melodies.' You are a spiritual embalmer in this realm between the living and the dead. Interact with the gravestones by typing the names of the deceased on computer keyboards. Unravel their past stories and settle their souls. Typing is the main interaction, move with WASD and mouse for rotation. ~20mins experience. Interactive graves are marked with colorful flower petals. The rest are only for reading. The graveyard can shift between three worlds: the living, the between, and the dead. Players can puzzle up the deceased's stories across these worlds, and bring a meaningful item to their graves as an act of mourning. ——— This game is a solo production from 2022 to 2024. The instruction part is still a bit shaky; I will try to fix it next year. Before that, there is an interaction walkthrough video attached in the manual, enjoy! This is the first part of a series of graveyard games and is therefore free. The later ones will explore different cultural backgrounds and mourning practices.

rows.name: Incelthread
rows.short_description: A visual novel about a bunny girl, her boyfriend and a rabbit named Tonya
rows.description_html: Guy is planning a meeting with his girlfriend to use their shared photos to prank board visitors with provocative posts. They are both hikikomori who enjoy hanging out together, but circumstances prevent them from living together. Having been traumatized by their past, they must go through a difficult journey of adapting to a new, still unfamiliar life.     I don’t know their names. In general, I don’t know that much... But I’ll try to tell you something! Girl. A little (or maybe a lot???) crazy, energetic, and bright personality. She stutters when embarrassed, loves to tease, provoke, or say something silly... just to let her emotions out! She has a complicated relationship with her parents, she’s an introvert... And sometimes she experiences panic attacks (don’t tell her I told you that)! Guy. A calm, sometimes a bit slow... but very attentive and caring young man (not the tidiest one, I must say!). He is shorter than her, but that doesn’t bother them at all. He tends to be overprotective of the girl but tries to overcome it. He always wears long-sleeved clothes... I can’t say what happened to his parents. However, he is feeling much better now, really! The queen, Miss Galaxy, the ruler of the world! Or just Tonya. A big Flemish Giant rabbit. She currently lives at the guy’s house, though she used to live on his parents’ farm. She loves to chew on clothes and zoom around at night (well, she is a nocturnal animal). Despite her size, she’s the girl’s favorite stress reliever. Yes, our menu is an old-school CRT monitor with exhaust pipes! (don’t ask...) And our textbox is a multimedia device! Inside, you’ll find everything you need—video settings, audio settings, and much more. The technology may be old, but it still works! The girl loves to draw, and you will need to create a drawing for the guy, made by her hand! I hope you manage to make something at least a little better than mine... We tried to add as many animations, camera work, and directing techniques as possible to make the visuals more dynamic and alive! This is a deeply personal story filled with psychological depth, drama, love, and so much more—things that cannot be expressed in words but can only be felt through reading. And I really hope that everyone who reads it will understand what I mean ^^. Enjoy!

rows.name: Eternal Circus: Dancing with Missiles
rows.short_description: Become a nimble mech and defeat bosses while dodging a barrage of missiles in this top-down 3D dodge'm-up inspired by mecha anime and Itano Circus!
rows.description_html: Eternal Circus is a top-down dodge'm up where you can become a nimble mech fighting bosses while dodging barrage of missiles. OUTMANEUVERING MISSILES Your mech can move and dash to avoid missiles EC DRIVE Once the pink EC meter is full, the player can engage the EC Drive. Time slows down considerably, so you have a second to breathe and think out your next move. GAIN ENERGY Dodging enemy projectiles in EC Drive gives you Energy, which is required to attack the boss. The closer you get to missiles and other enemies, the more Energy you get, so riskier plays are rewarded with more Energy. MELEE ATTACK YOUR FOE Once you have enough energy, approach your target to lock on and perform a melee attack! THREE BOSSES Each boss has unique attack patterns. Are you ready to face them? Good luck out there o7

rows.name: Memento Mori
rows.short_description: It's a VR-style room escape game that immerses the mystery and horror atmosphere, acquiring items and performing gimmicks and quizzes to escape this place..
rows.description_html: Where am I and who am I... I don't remember anything.. This is a four-person portfolio developed game, an immersive VR room escape game that escapes from unidentified spaces with a little creepy atmosphere. -synopsis- Having been caught in an unidentified place, I decide to escape from this place first. However, looking at the things that I vaguely remember in the middle of the process, I have a lot of thoughts.. -feature- You can experience an empty horror atmosphere that is immersed and overwhelmed through VR. You can feel the catharsis of surprise. Find the items you need to escape and perform gimmicks and quizzes. You can achieve small achievements through nonsense quizzes and gimmicks. You can find traces of the past by getting your collection through hints everywhere, not just escape. It takes about 30 minutes to an hour of play time and is a VR game enjoyed as a short piece. Get all your collection and find a true ending.

rows.short_description: Roguelite wizard game, where you play as a wizard fighting off waves of monsters and bosses using powerful magic, gathering helper bats and perks. Each time you play, you’ll face new challenges in different biomes, making you think on your feet and try different strategies to win.

We made this game in just seven weeks, putting all our creativity and hard work into it. We hope you enjoy! Made By: Thulfekar Issam Alshreese - Game Programmer and Designer Tom Ellström Johansson - Game Programmer and Designer Special thanks to Isac Ala and Alexander Rydgren for the music and Noah Dovholt for the 2d art illustration

rows.short_description: Seal spirits in style! Guide cute exorcist Pudtan through stunning low-poly 3D environments in this Top-down horror game. Every playthrough offers new challenges as you gather materials, outsmart chasing ghosts.
rows.description_html: Whisper Of Anima is a collaboration by university students from Chiang Mai University , created as part of a learning experience to test and improve our teamwork and development skills. Feel free to share your thoughts and feedback The Gameplay Players will explore locations to search for materials needed to seal the Exorcist's Pot, gathering all the Exorcist's Pot at the final destination. Then, perform the final sealing and escape. However, ghosts will chase and try to stop you along the way. Key Features Isometric view Stunning low-poly 3D Challenging gameplay Dynamic elements (Procedural generated levels) Cute character Leaderboard Mini rhythm gameplay

rows.name: AccuBow VR
rows.short_description: Take your archery training to the next level and practice anytime, anywhere
rows.description_html: AccuBow VR: Master Realistic Archery in Immersive Virtual Reality AccuBow VR redefines virtual archery by blending authentic bowhunting mechanics with cutting-edge VR technology. Designed for archery enthusiasts, hunters, and outdoor adventurers, this platform offers a hyper-realistic training and gaming experience. Perfect your skills, explore dynamic environments, and immerse yourself in thrilling scenarios—all from the safety of your home. True-to-Life Archery Mechanics Attach your VR controller to the AccuBow VR bow and experience the physicality of real archery. Practice drawing, aiming, and releasing with mechanics that replicate the tension, weight, and precision of a traditional bow. Develop muscle memory, accuracy, and strength to enhance real-world bowhunting skills.   Diverse Challenges & Scenarios Hunt Big Game: Track deer, elk, and other wildlife across forests, mountains, and deserts. Survival Modes: Battle through a zombie apocalypse, hunt extinct dinosaurs, or test your reflexes in fast-paced duck-hunting arenas. Why Choose AccuBow VR? More Than a Game: A hybrid of entertainment and practical skill development for aspiring and seasoned archers. Safe & Accessible: Learn proper form and technique without the hazards of live ammunition or expensive gear. AccuBow VR is more than just a game; it's a comprehensive archery training system that offers fun, excitement, and practical skill development. Get ready to draw, aim, and release into a world of endless archery fun! Whether you're honing your skills on the range or diving into action-packed adventures, AccuBow VR is the ultimate choice for anyone passionate about archery and bowhunting. For more information, visit AccuBow's official website and discover how you can elevate your archery experience today!

rows.name: Firework War
rows.short_description: Use a variety of fireworks to fend off misfortune and protect your family!
rows.description_html: During the Spring Festival, light up fireworks to drive away the Badluck Entities ! Firework War combines the traditional custom of lighting fireworks with the strategy of tower defense, delivering a fresh and exciting experience. Classic fireworks like the Rainbow Fountain, Flash Shooter, Fire Wheel, Golden Basin, and Firecrackers take center stage in the game. Your task is to ignite these fireworks, unleash their dazzling effects, and fend off malevolent spirits to protect your home. As you light up the sky, you'll also rack up plenty of joy value . Use it to buy more fireworks and keep the fun going! Immerse yourself in this unique taste of Chinese New Year tradition!

rows.short_description: Poultry Party is a 2D arcade-like action game that gets harder as you go. Dodge, jump over, and extinguish hazards to avoid becoming dinner. Need help? Add up to 17 additional players (yes really) to assist you. Survive as long as you can, or beat the game as fast as you can. The choice is yours!
rows.description_html: Poultry Party! Dash across the stovetop and fend off the flames! Play as 1 of 4 colorful critters and try to survive as long as possible by running, jumping, and dodging. All characters play the same, so don't overthink it! Hazards As long as the stove is on, all sorts of flamming threats will fly in to scorch you! Here's a few of them:                  Fire               Cross Fire                              Coal   Each has unique capabilities and behaviors that you'll figure out as you play. You may even discover more types as you progress... Projectiles                          Egg               Milk              Mud              Water Don't think you have to bend a knee to the flames; you can fight back! rows.name: Rocket Hit
rows.short_description: Explore every star system, orbit numerous stars, maneuver to various planets, and survive asteroids the longest aboard countless miniaturized rockets in Rocket Hit.
rows.description_html: A survival game first and foremost The main objective in Rocket Hit is to survive, not the horrible aliens, but rather the numerous asteroids that detach from their belts to strike directly at the fuselage of your rocket, so you have to be attentive at all times, without ending up charred by a star, destroyed by an asteroid, swept into the vacuum of space by a comet or swallowed by a black hole. A unique atmosphere Enjoy an incomparable atmosphere in star systems each denser than the last, get up close to each planet and star and feel the immensity of the stars and space. With total immersion, relax in orbit on Rocket Hit. A realistic physics The physics of the game's orbits are realistic, providing a simple understanding of orbital physics, even greater immersion, exclusive and innovative gameplay, and much more. A world on a smaller scale You'll notice that the game's scale is far from realistic, allowing you to experience a game with such physics first-hand, but also simplifying exploration and action by giving the game a cartoonish complexion. Complete cosmetics customization and much more Discover a diverse range of star systems and explore them aboard mythical rockets, recreated almost identically, instantly available when you download the game.

rows.name: Guncaster
rows.short_description: Blast your way through hordes of minions to take back your tower in a world filled with evil and chaos. Explore charming, ever-changing environments, expand your arsenal of spells, and reclaim your stolen art of GUNCASTING.
rows.description_html: You are a wizard who’s been evicted from your tower by your treacherous rival, Spellsniper . In the process, she stole your most prized power: the art of GUNCASTING . Worse still, she’s handed pieces of your magic to her chaotic goon army. Armed with only your backup spellbook and whatever 'guns' you can get your hands on, you must climb back up through the depths to reclaim your magic, your tower, and take your revenge. Guncaster is made to embrace the spirit of movement shooters while paying homage to old-school FPS games. It’s a love letter to boomer shooters with a fantasy twist, designed to feel chaotic and satisfying in a bite-sized package. Master the Art of Movement Your magical abilities extend far beyond simply casting gun. Swift, agile, and relentless, you can dash, wall jump, and weave through the battlefield with supernatural speed. Leap across perilous chasms, evade deadly projectiles, and outmaneuver relentless adversaries as you blast your way through the Spellsniper's hordes of nefarious minions. Spellcasting Without Limits Harness the boundless energy of magic and unleash devastating arcane forces upon your enemies. From conjuring fiery meteors to swarms of locusts, Guncaster offers a vast array of spells to fit every playstyle. Whether you prefer calculated precision or chaotic destruction, the choice is yours. Aadapt, experiment, and let your magic reign supreme. Guns: The Ultimate Spell of Destruction When you're out of spells, there's always your most trusted spell...  your gun . These are not mere tools of war; they are extensions of your will, forged to obliterate anything that stands in your way. From rapid-fire machine guns to earth-shaking rocket launchers, your arsenal is built for carnage. Fire away until your spells recharge, and then mix magic with firepower to unleash devastation like never before. Do you have what it takes to wield magic and gunpowder in perfect harmony? Step into Guncaster and find out.

rows.name: Little Robot
rows.short_description: Join me on my first game as an Indie Dev with this casual 15-minute exploration game where players navigate the backyard, as our favorite sad robot, collecting essential components to successfully return indoors!
rows.description_html: Play as an unfortunate toy robot stranded in the backyard, using a slingshot to make your way back inside the house. Collect the three essential parts of the slingshot across three challenge levels, each filled with an obstacle or a puzzle to overcome.  This fifteen-minute adventure is intended to be finished in one sitting.  This is the first of three games in the 'Sad Robot Saga'.  Thank you for trying my first attempt at indie game dev!

rows.name: Neuroarena: Black Duel Master
rows.short_description: Neuroarena is a free online card game featuring unique generated cards that evolve over time. Engage in PvP duels, explore a vast card universe, and enjoy strategic battles in an ever-evolving world. Perfect for fans of collectible card games and epic hero clashes!
rows.description_html: Neuroarena is a free-to-play online card game where players engage in thrilling PvP duels and explore a universe of unique, AI-generated cards. Every card evolves, offering endless strategic opportunities for CCG enthusiasts to create powerful, one-of-a-kind decks. Key Features GENERATE UNIQUE CARDS Harness the power of AI-generated cards, ensuring every card is completely unique. Modify and evolve your cards in real time to create hyper cards that adapt to your strategies. DUEL AND VOTE Challenge other players in PvP duels and vote on the best cards. Win votes to gain experience, unlock new modification slots, and push your cards to their full potential. MODIFY AND EVOLVE Add modifications to your cards, transforming their abilities and appearance. For example, apply a 'Fire' modification to a Fox card to create a powerful Fire Fox. The more modifications you use, the stronger and more distinct your cards become. BUILD YOUR COLLECTION Collect super-unique cards and art modifications to create a deck that’s truly your own. No two decks are alike, making your collection a reflection of your creativity and skill. COMPETE FOR GLORY Earn your place on the leaderboards by winning votes and duels. Invite friends to join the adventure and prove your mastery in this constantly evolving world. The future of CCGs is here – start your journey today!

rows.name: End Transmission?
rows.short_description: If the world was ending, how would you spend your final days? Explore a narrative management game set shortly before the end of the world, about enjoying the time you have left. Play music, take calls, and help the town face the challenges of saying goodbye to those closest to them.
rows.description_html: 'The world is going to end pretty soon, we've known that for some time' Face the End Play as Lenna, a teenager and avid music lover who couldn't take the silence of a decaying world anymore. Determined to bring back a bit of a spark of joy, Lenna broke into an old, abandoned radio tower, reigniting its transmitter. Your mission is to turn that silence into celebration—broadcasting music, taking calls, and boosting the morale of a weary world.  Shape the Sound Utilize a unique music system to create your own soundtrack. Mix and match 9 different instruments per track, and manage your broadcast to the town to create the right mood for its inhabitants. Hear the Story Utilize your unique position as a radio host in the tower to help the townspeople. Hear their story and use your vantage point and your trusty avian companion Tuvi to do the things that matter most in the final days of the world. This game is the product of a six week collaboration project hosted by DADIU. We would like to thank all the lovely people who made this possible - including the amazing Team Tall Trees members, the DADIU program and teachers, as well as the IT University of Copenhagen.

rows.short_description: Iron Skys is a top down bullet hell shooter with rouge like elements. As a lone pilot in an untested prototype vessel, you must defend the empire against a seemingly endless fleet of rebel ships.
rows.description_html: Iron Skys is a  is a vertically scrolling 2D shoot'em up in which a lone pilot must attempt to defeat an overwhelming enemy force. Avoid or destroy waves of enemy ships in order to complete each mission and save the empire! Features: 5 stages with unique bosses and mini bosses 9 alternate fire modes and special attacks 9 passive upgrades

rows.name: NEXO
rows.short_description: Troublemaker new cops Lia and Nia wake up an unidentified core during the operation. 'Fight to protect the city!'
rows.description_html: NEXO is a side-view, 2-player cooperative shooting game where you must defeat a powerful boss within a limited time! Team up with a friend to take down mighty enemies! Each character wields a weapon with both a normal attack and a special attack, and these two types of attacks can interact with each other. Work together to unleash even more powerful combined attacks! Choose your character based on their unique traits! Each of the sisters, Ria and Nia, uses a weapon with distinct characteristics. Select the character that best matches your play style! When two players team up and attack in sync, they can unleash even more powerful attacks! Stop the boss’s invasion of Earth! An alien lifeform has appeared on Earth!! The boss will use a variety of attacks to threaten the players. Use nearby platforms and shields to evade the boss’s attacks as much as possible! Counter the boss’s powerful attacks! At specific moments, the boss will unleash terrifying attacks! Cooperate to counter these powerful moves and turn the tide of battle in your favor!

rows.name: Metal Strike
rows.short_description: Metal Strike is a multiplayer TPS game in the Apocalypse world view. Defeat mechanized monsters with your colleagues and recapture Earth.
rows.description_html: METAL STRIKE - Retake Our Planet Background In 2XXX, humanity was finally expelled from the Earth. AI has chosen to kick its owner out of the planet to survive amid severe pollution. Humanity has effectively fallen, but after years of seclusion and exile, four people finally gathered in one place to reclaim the Earth. Characteristics - a third-person shooting game - Support for up to 4-player multi-play - Four guns to suit your taste - Cool annihilation mission and urgent boss mission Game Objectives - Kill all enemies in the annihilation battle of Stage 1, board the helicopter, and infiltrate the enemy base. - Eliminate the culprit of the incident in Stage 2, the enemy base, and reclaim Earth. - If the difficulty is too high, cooperate with your teammates and use the resurrection system. How to operate moving: WASD Jump: Space Sitting: Ctrl Running: Shift (while pressing) Dash: WASD No. 2 consecutive hits Attack: Left-click Zoom-in: right-click reloading: R Replace gun mode: B Throwing the gun away: Tap long Interaction / Item Acquisition: F When replacing a firearm: Get a replacement firearm after discarding your firearm Features by gun mode - a rifle A mode: basic, continuous (basic damage) B mode: 3-point scanning (high damage) - Shotgun A mode: Basic, high elasticity, basic range (basic damage) B mode: Reduced bullet spread, reduced range (basic damage) - a machine gun A mode: Basic, movable (basic damage) B mode: No movement when fired, (high damage) - Rocket launcher A mode: Basic, low launch speed (basic damage) B mode: 3 consecutive rounds, high firing speed (low damage) Thank you for providing the Cinematic Music. shimtone - Viper

rows.name: Sounds of Her Love 2
rows.short_description: A cute romance visual novel set at an international school in Japan. As you approach the final hours of your school years together, help your sweet but shy girlfriend Ceri overcome her fears to be able to play the harp at the school's graduation ceremony. A tender, wholesome love story awaits.
rows.description_html: A sequel to Sounds of Her Love, a sweet romance story between two students set in an international school in Tokyo. One year has passed since the events of Sounds of Her Love, and your relationship with Ceri has deepened. You have now become a couple and, with your encouragement, Ceri has begun to emerge from her shell. Leopards don't change their spots that easily, however, and though Ceri has been attempting to overcome her innate shyness, she still has a tendency to doubt herself. Wanting to boost Ceri's confidence, you encourage her to perform in the school's graduation ceremony with the members of the music club. This will be one of the greatest challenges the timid Ceri has had to face, but you are sure that she will be able to overcome it. You will be there with her, after all, to reassure her... and you want everybody to know just how far Ceri has come. A cute and sweet kinetic novel (no choices or branches) focusing on a single love interest - your shy girlfriend Ceri! An easily digestible and compelling story (around 40k words / 2-3 hours playtime). Precious character artwork and detailed backgrounds. High quality, English voice acting for all major characters. Original soundtrack.  Bonus features including guest artwork by a variety of talented artists and a quiz mini-game.

rows.name: Modularity
rows.short_description: Modularity is a resource management builder game where the player stitches together flesh and metal in creative ways to construct bigger and greater amalgamations.
rows.description_html: Stitch. Expand. Optimize. You are the architect of an ever-growing amalgamation of flesh and metal. This unique blend of resource management and puzzle-building challenges you to construct increasingly complex structures by seamlessly combining steampunk machinery with organic matter . Carefully balance your resources— blood and steam —as you strategically place parts, ensuring a continuous flow to sustain and expand your grotesque creation. Will you craft a harmonious fusion, or will your construct collapse under the weight of your ambition?

rows.name: I Will Never Fall For My Tsundere Classmate, So I Will Just Date A Background Character Instead!
rows.short_description: A short parody visual novel about romance with a tsundere girl... Or not?
rows.description_html: I Will Never Fall For My Tsundere Classmate, So I Will Just Date A Background Character Instead! is a free short parody visual novel. Story You are a college student who is close to his female tsundere classmate. She is clearly the main heroine of this story, but will she actually end up being your romantic interest? Characters Rikina is your tsundere friend and classmate. She can be a little grumpy at times, but is a good girl at heart. VA: Savvi Lee Rikina's friend is a quiet, unassuming girl also attending the same collega as you and Rikina. She is kind and loves monster movies. Gameplay I Will Never Fall For My Tsundere Classmate, So I Will Just Date A Background Character Instead!  is a linear visual novel in which you read a short 30-minute romance story. You will be able to make a few choices that have no impact on the story. The game is accompanied by two soundtracks and contains full voice acting for Rikina.

rows.name: Bibbidiba fan game
rows.short_description: Bibbidiba fan game is a vibrant and fast-paced platformer inspired by Hoshimachi Suisei’s hit song 'Bibbidiba'. Players must guide Hoshimachi Suisei through magical and challenging levels to reach the final destination and find out what awaits her at the end.
rows.description_html: Bibbidiba fan game is a vibrant and fast-paced platformer that brings Hoshimachi Suisei’s hit song 'Bibbidiba' to life in an entirely new way. Players step into the shoes of Hoshimachi Suisei, navigating through magical worlds. Nothing stands on your way! As players traverse beautifully crafted levels, they must a combination of jump, punch, and of course, throwing shoes to avoid traps and defeat mischievous creatures in order to reach to the end goal. Tick-tock! Tick-tock! The clock is always ticking, adding an exciting time pressure element to the game. Players must complete each level before the clock runs out. And More? Players can take on optional boss or platform challenge to unlock additional bonuses.  This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand 'holo Indie'.(※2) This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of 'holo Indie'. Please note that any monetized derivative work games that include Cover Corp.'s content outside of holo Indie is not covered by these terms and is not allowed. ※1. About CCMC Corp. CCMC Corp. is entrusted with website management (ex: steam) including, examination, publishing and other necessary tasks by Cover Corp. ※2. About 'holo Indie' holo Indie's objective is to cooperate with hololive production fans and creators. It is a game brand that offers 'Game Creator Support Program' for the derivative work games. For more details about 'holo Indie', Please refer to the Cover Corp.'s 'Derivative work guidelines'.

As players traverse beautifully crafted levels, they must a combination of jump, punch, and of course, throwing shoes to avoid traps and defeat mischievous creatures in order to reach to the end goal. Tick-tock! Tick-tock! The clock is always ticking, adding an exciting time pressure element to the game. Players must complete each level before the clock runs out. And More? Players can take on optional boss or platform challenge to unlock additional bonuses.  This game is published under CCMC Corp(※1)'s Indie game brand 'holo Indie'.(※2) This game is allowed to be monetized under the examination and terms of 'holo Indie'. Please note that any monetized derivative work games that include Cover Corp.'s content outside of holo Indie is not covered by these terms and is not allowed. ※1. About CCMC Corp. CCMC Corp. is entrusted with website management (ex: steam) including, examination, publishing and other necessary tasks by Cover Corp. ※2. About 'holo Indie' holo Indie's objective is to cooperate with hololive production fans and creators. It is a game brand that offers 'Game Creator Support Program' for the derivative work games. For more details about 'holo Indie', Please refer to the Cover Corp.'s 'Derivative work guidelines'.

rows.name: Separated by Nightmares: Where Duty Dies
rows.short_description: Separated by Nightmares: Where Duty Dies merges first-person puzzles with a poignant narrative. A driven lieutenant, haunted by hidden grief, confronts a sudden blackout. Clues force him to face buried truths, while a lurking darkness waits in the shadows.
rows.description_html: Separated by Nightmares: Where Duty Dies offers a horror experience that blends first-person puzzle-solving with a deeply woven narrative. Written by the fantasy author behind The Swords of Unforgotten Memories and Worlds Beneath the Shadows , this first chapter introduces you to a workaholic lieutenant who is obsessed with closing every case, driven by a relentless need for answers. His single-minded pursuit cost him his family, yet unknown to most, an even deeper grief haunts him. When an unexpected blackout engulfs the police station, what begins as a simple power check quickly twists into a haunting quest. Ominous notes from the past start to surface, forcing the lieutenant to confront memories he had desperately tried to bury. As you guide him through the station’s darkened corridors, you’ll uncover the true source of his torment. Key Features Story-Driven Horror Immerse yourself in an unsettling narrative revealed through exploration and cryptic notes. First-Person Perspective View the station through the protagonist’s eyes. Mystery and Discovery Investigate hidden clues and unravel the station’s secrets at your own pace. Emotional Depth Engage with themes of loss, grief, and guilt, woven naturally into the storyline. Atmospheric Setting Venture through a dimly lit police station where disturbing encounters and ominous signs lurk throughout the station. Warning: This game has scenes of flashing lights, so it may not be suited for some viewers.

rows.name: Boat Racer
rows.short_description: Three mini games. 'Boat Racer' - high replay ability in that obstacles are spawned randomly each race. No 2 races the same.'Knazi Knockout' 3rd person brawler - it's just fun to beat up Nazis, right? 'Nazi's in the Mist' FPS that is the crown jewel of this trifecta of minigames
rows.description_html: Feature List All 3 mini-games have Steam Leaderboard capability About the Game                                                     Collection of 3 Mini Games Featured: ' Boat Racer ' -  A 3 lap timed race fraught with exploding hazards that you can avoid or shoot with your onboard cannons for time boosts to your turbo charged engine. Takes about 1:20 to complete but VERY high index for replay-ability as you hop back at the start line ready for the next race to try to beat your best scores. Obstacles spawn randomly each game so every race a bit different. Steam Leaderboard ranking available on this game to compare your results with other players ' Knazi Knockout ' -  Be the hot Girl that pummels Hitler and three of his henchman . You can even go to the locker room and change your attire. It's fun, but once you figure out how to beat these guys you will win every time so the fun becomes changing your outfit ' Nazis in the Mist ' - Although the title of this package of mini-games is 'BOAT RACER', I think this mini-game is the crown jewel of the trilogy. An arena style game with randomly spawning enemies where you try to survive 10 rounds. The story behind the 'spawn pods' comes from the larger project still in the works that all 3 of these mini-games were borne from. The Nazis have developed secret weapons that could change the tide of the war and your mission is to capture the blueprints. One such secret weapon is the 'STD'  ( S ubterranean T roop  D eployment ) which is a torpedo like missile that burrows through the ground and pops up on the battlefield. Another secret weapon are Autonomous Super Soldiers ( Robots) - which you hack to be on your side in the fight against evil. That 'helper' Robot is also available in this mini game but you can toggle him on/off if you wish to go it alone. Good luck with that! You don't get points for the helper's kills, but he will be a great help in getting you further into the game. Only 10 rounds sounds like a cakewalk but it's actually quite difficult to complete the mission. In many  MANY hours of play testing, I have only succeeded in surviving all 10 rounds ONCE. Steam Leaderboard ranking also available for this mini-game as you can upload your scores even on failed missions. If you see a leaderboard score that seems VERY high - it's because they accomplished the mission - all 10 rounds - and got a 10,000 point bonus

rows.name: Prank
rows.short_description: A girl wakes up in the grass, only to find she has lost her memory and grown wings. Playtime: ~30 minutes + endless mode
rows.description_html: Indie, platform jumping, ultra-short RPG. Come and uncover the mystery behind the protagonist's background together! [Game Features] Simple and intuitive controls Exciting and thrilling gameplay A story full of mysteries A black home page, monochromatic grass, monochromatic characters, text-based tutorials laid out directly, drifting characters, a character that automatically looks to the right, areas almost entirely represented by text alone, a castle you can enter without any guidance, a monochromatic interior of the castle, a second level where you don’t know where to go, lights that don’t change between morning and night, a health bar that isn’t centered, a young hero in the story who shouldn’t be able to fly but does, a chase scene with no sense of urgency, misaligned dialogue boxes, characters that haven’t changed in twenty years… [Development Team] Developer: Budai Art (TBD): Jeannie Cheung Music: Sara Garrard

rows.name: Gaunts Gambit | Multiplayer FPS
rows.short_description: Gaunts Gambit is a multiplayer first person shooter game. Set in an abandoned school left empty because of a rampant virus, former students sneak back in fighting over control of the grounds and buildings.
rows.description_html: DESCRIPTION: Gaunts Gambit is a multiplayer first person shooter game. Set in an abandoned school left empty because of a rampant virus, former students sneak back in fighting over control of the grounds and buildings. GAMEMODES: 2v2 TeamMatch Zombies FFA 2V2 TEAMMATCH: Players are divided into two teams of two, where they battle for their team in a singular building. The team with the most kills wins the match! ZOMBIES: Players face waves of zombies, barricading entrances to slow them down. Survive as long as possible against the increasing difficulty! FFA: Players compete solo in a battle for the highest kill count before the timer runs out.

rows.name: The Lost Desert aka Cube Game 9x
rows.short_description: The Lost Desert is a online multiplayer shooter game is made in the Blitz3D game engine. It works on basically any PC hardware with windows on it. It is mainly for windows 95-98 but works on XP and above to 11.
rows.description_html: The Lost Desert is a open-world shooter. Main thing about is a game that works on very old PC hardware and windows version but it works on modern hardware and windows version too so it's very cross play compatible. Better to play with friends as it is multiplayer game. We are a team of two but we are committed to the development. Maps: Spawn map: It's the most finished at this point. Has 4 main buildings and a watch tower. There are lot of trees and there is a river. There is a grass in form of sprites. All of the graphics are based on settings. Small desert map: It's more like a small wasteland with rusted barrels ruins old rusted fences and big rocks. This map is not very complex and it's used for a battle royal game mode. Big forest map: This map is not very finished, it has 4 watch towers lot of concrete buildings. This map as the spawn map has lot of trees the same grass and lot of lakes. It's the biggest one in the game and will have way more buildings and features in the future. Big desert map: This map isn't finished at all has just a few monuments and a big hill but other then that it's just a big desert. Sub maps. 3D platforming map: This is a big map with platforms and its finished. A old mine map: This map is a old mine with crystals and support beams. Lobby map: It's a lobby. Current Features: 4 main maps and 3 sub maps so there is a lot to explore. Raccoons. 2 weapons: pistol and machine gun. Ammo system. Ammo boxes that fill the players ammo supply, they re-spawn on the maps randomly. Day and Night cycle. CRTs with animations. Old buildings. Simple and complex terrain. With trees, 3d or 2d water (based on settings). Complex start settings menu. 3D platforming map with jumping platforms. Planned Stuff: More NPCs. Expansion of the big forest and big desert maps. New interesting buildings in all maps. Controls: WSAD movement Space Jump Mouse camera movement or arrow keys R to open/close doors Esc main menu arrow keys to move in menu Tab to show scores V to activate gametype 2 needs at least 3 player to be useful  F1 debug menu F2 third person F3 first person Ctrl Build, Alt Shoot 1 or 2 to change weapons Main maps: F4 is the spawn map F5 is the small desert F6 is the big forest F10 is big desert Sub maps: F7 is the map with the platforming F8 is cave/mine map F9 is indoors map

rows.name: Astral Blaze
rows.short_description: Embark on a quest for a rumored treasure while exploring ruins of an old civilization. A half survivor and half roguelike type game with partly randomized dungeons and character development by choice of cards found in the dungeons. Featuring unique dash attack and simple controls.
rows.description_html: ASTRAL BLAZE     Explore the ruins of an old city where no human has entered for hundreds of years due to claims of dangers the place now holds. Guided by eternal flames and following the torn pages of an old mysterious diary, revealing facts about the journey someone endured before you; painting to mind a once more advanced civilization which left this place migrating to altered states of existence leaving the less fortunate behind.     Or is this just an illusion? As your memory fails to connect to the past.. nor has you envision a future.. all you and your group of adventurers are left to care about is the tangible treasure mentioned in the diary, perhaps it may get across the otherwise mistaken stories. FEATURES: A half survivor and half roguelike type game with partly randomized dungeons. 12 dungeons that can be completed in nonlinear fashion 7 imposing bosses 7 playable characters each with 1 passive character only ability and initial stat setting Character customization and empowerment by choosing random cards found in chests giving element of choice All hand drawn pixel graphics Gameplay defining unique dash attack mechanic. Optional brief storyline

rows.name: Digitum
rows.short_description: A bored old wizard pokes his finger into a tiny portal — and you fall out! In this fast-paced arcade adventure, race through twisted levels, master the physics, and perfect your runs to beat the clock… and your friends on the leaderboard.
rows.description_html: Step into a magical adventure like no other! Have you ever wondered what it would be like to be a rock, an olive, or a small, perfectly rollable sphere? Ever dreamed of racing downhill at breakneck speed, just to go faster than your friends and claim victory? Look no further— welcome to Digitum! Here, you take on the role of an old, used magician, pushing objects through finger-sized portals simply because… well, you’re bored and you can. As the player, you control one of these curious little objects, guiding it from portal to portal in a never-ending game of whimsical physics and chaotic fun, trying to improve the time you take to finish a level ! The goal of the game is to complete each level as quickly as possible while avoiding obstacles that add time to your timer. To move forward, you give an impulse to the object you control. A loading bar displayed beneath the object indicates the strength of the impulse. If the bar turns red, an additional boost is triggered, making you go even faster. The game features a multiplayer mode with a real-time leaderboard showing the scores of your friends and the top players. Many successes can be unlocked by completing challenges — some of which are hidden — and allow you to obtain new skins for your object.

rows.name: CRAZLIPSE
rows.short_description: CRAZLIPSE is a game where officer Stefan Vincenzo uncovers a zombie apocalypse at the 'Starry Sky Tree.' After meeting scientist Matheus, he’s teleported to a zombie-infested zone to survive and fight.
rows.description_html: CRAZLIPSE is a game set in a seemingly ordinary city. Everything changes when Stefan Vincenzo, one of the police officers investigating zombie cases, is called for the gigantic 'Starry Sky Tree', an iconic landmark of the city. There, he talks to Matheus, a scientist and his boss, about the zombie apocalypse known as CRAZLIPSE. After the dialogue, Stefan is teleported to a place infested with undead, where your mission is to survive and eliminate them! ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Credits : Programmer : Yan Massoni Game Studio Art : Yan Massoni Game Studio Music : Yan Massoni Game Studio / MagmaPocket! Level Design : Yan Massoni Game Studio / MagmaPocket! Characters and Animations : 3D Arrow Model : Alihan - 'Direction Arrow' , Licensed under CC Attribution 4.0) Tree, Fire Effect, Gun and Bullet Models : Epic Games Matheus Voice : My Dad (I love you, best father in the world ❤) Apartment Model : Elizabeth Dada - 'Low Poly Apartment Building' , Licensed under CC Attribution 4.0) Gun Sound : سلاحكم - 'WM-AR4' ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- The CRAZLIPSE Game is a simple zombie game, as it was made for the final project of my course, the game offers: Game Features: Zombie Combat: Face over 100 zombies scattered across the map, each with simple movements ready to challenge you. Use basic weapons to defeat enemies and survive as long as possible. Simple and Straightforward Map: A unique and functional scenario focused on action and strategic movement. Map elements include open areas and closed spaces to vary combat. Easy-to-Learn Gameplay: Intuitive controls that allow any player to get started quickly. Simple and fluid mechanics, ideal for short gaming sessions. Focus on Challenge and Survival: Survive increasingly intense waves of zombies. Find the best strategy to last as long as possible.

rows.name: Monmusu Girls: Autobattler
rows.short_description: This is a strategic and adventurous idle auto-battler where you'll collect a variety of monmusu girls, form your adventuring team, and challenge the Demon King! Each girl comes with unique skills and bonds, and mastering the right combinations is the key to victory. Embark on a magical journey!
rows.description_html: FOLLOW US Twitter: @Monmusu_Girls About the Game In a fantasy world of magic, the power of the Demon King is awakening, and the fates of the monmusu girls are beginning to intertwine. As the leader of an adventuring party, you’ll recruit a diverse group of monmusu girls, each with their own special abilities, to create a powerful team. Venture into uncharted lands, unlock hidden stories, and uncover the dark secrets behind the rise of the Demon King.   Key Features Strategic Team Composition, Easy to Play: With auto-battler mechanics, your success depends on how effectively you set up and combine your team. Vast Character Collection, Infinite Possibilities: Collect a variety of monmusu girls, unlock their exclusive skills and bonds, and experiment with endless strategies. Roguelike Elements, Making Every Adventure Unique: Encounter random events and rewards, ensuring each adventure presents a fresh and exciting challenge. Idle Gameplay, Rewards While You Rest: Even when offline, earn rewards to strengthen your team and evolve your girls into formidable warriors. Immersive Fantasy World: As the story unfolds, dive deep into the demon world, meet new allies, and enjoy an engaging, fun-filled adventure.   In a world filled with demons, can you lead the girls to victory, uncover hidden truths, and change the course of fate?   The adventure begins now!

rows.name: Jianghu Diary
rows.short_description: The game recreates the ever-changing scenes of the ancient martial arts world. Players can experience rich gameplay in the game, such as freely exploring the rivers and lakes, making friends with various heroes and heroes, and challenging various martial arts masters.
rows.description_html: The game combines the romantic feelings of the martial arts world with the relaxed fun of playing games. In the game, players will play as a novice martial arts hero, gradually growing from a small newcomer to a legendary figure of the martial arts alliance leader. The game is set against the backdrop of ancient rivers and lakes, with beautiful and delicate graphics that recreate the ever-changing scenes of the rivers and lakes. Players can experience rich gameplay in the game, such as freely exploring the rivers and lakes, making friends with various heroes and heroes, and challenging various martial arts masters. At the same time, the game also incorporates placement gameplay, allowing players to easily enjoy the fun of the game while feeling the fierce competition and charm of unparalleled martial arts in the martial arts world. In the game, players can recruit various heroes, cultivate their martial arts skills, form their own martial arts sects, and collect resources and create divine weapons through gameplay placement, ultimately becoming the leader of the martial arts alliance to unify the Jianghu. At the same time, the game also features rich plot tasks and activities, allowing players to experience different martial arts storylines and feel the passion of the martial arts world. Whether you are a fan of martial arts culture or a player who enjoys playing idle games, it will bring you a brand new gaming experience, allowing you to fully enjoy the martial arts sentiment and idle fun in front of the screen.

rows.name: Grocery Store Tycoon - First Store
rows.short_description: Grocery Store Tycoon - First Store allows players to take their first steps as a store owner by managing and expanding their very first shop. Start with a small store, optimize its layout, stock shelves efficiently, and serve customers to grow your business.
rows.description_html: Grocery Store Tycoon - First Store allows players to take their first steps as a store owner by managing and expanding their very first shop. Start with a small store, optimize its layout, stock shelves efficiently, and serve customers to grow your business. Careful planning and strategic decisions will be key to turning your humble beginning into a thriving supermarket! Operate the Cash Register yourself if you would like to challenge the speed of your best cashier, or simply do not want to pay the wage. Swipe as fast as you can to avoid long queue times and unhappy customers. Stock Shelves by carrying a case at a time from the warehouse or use a cart to transport larger quantities. Purchase Placeables such as Cash Registers, Shelving, Coolers, Freezers, Produce Shelves, Shopping Cart Corrals, Shopping Basket Stands, Material Handling Equipment, and Decorations. Interactive UI to manage your store through customer statistics, supply and demand of goods, pricing adjustments, placeable condition viewing, and employee management. Unlock Item Types, Placeables, Management Tools, Employee Hiring Capacity, Store Expansions, and the opportunity to purchase other stores by gaining experience passively, by working, or by completing bonus objectives. Maintain placeables, return carts and baskets, and keep the store clean to keep your store operating at its full potential. Manage Employees to keep them happy or they may quit! Assigning an employee to the job they would like, the wage they want, and not overworking them all contribute to the employee's happiness. Unreliable employees may call in and affect your happiness. Customers must be satisfied to get good reviews and keep your store in good standing. Having the goods they seek, keeping them in the store for as little time as possible, and having a charismatic employee behind the cash register all contribute to the satisfaction of customers.

rows.name: Alice in Disguise
rows.short_description: Help Alice rescue her friends to save Wonderland! Alice in Disguise is a stealth puzzle game where you disguise yourself as chess pieces and move like them to solve sneaky challenges. Use potions, magic mirrors, and quick thinking to stay hidden — all wrapped in a charming and colorful art style.
rows.description_html: In Wonderland, the evil Red Queen has captured Alice’s friends and she is the only one who can save them! Will Alice be able to sneak into the Royal Castle and free them all? Gameplay Alice in Disguise is a stealth game with chess-based puzzles where you must complete a series of levels without getting caught by enemies. Levels are set on chessboards where Alice must disguise herself and act like the castle guards to go unnoticed. Enemies are chess pieces with different movement patterns: so, when disguised as one of them, Alice will move with the corresponding scheme. Abilities like resizing, invisibility, and teleporting will help you complete the puzzles. Features Chess-based puzzles of increasing complexity. Stealth sections based on disguises. Special abilities and effects to discover. Cute and appealing graphic style . Try to rescue all of Alice's friends and defeat the evil Queen to save Wonderland!

rows.name: ZHONG XING NEW VILLAGE
rows.short_description: ZHONGXING NEW VILLAGE is a multiplayer online game centered on regional revitalization, featuring the history and guided tours of attractions and regional revitalization stories, encouraging more people to participate in revitalization activities in Zhongxing New Village.
rows.description_html: ZHONGXING NEW VILLAGE This is a multiplayer online game focused on regional revitalization. (1) Basic Gameplay Use WASD to move forward, backward, left, and right. Q and E for close-range and long-range attacks. 1, 2, 3, 4, Z, X, C are seven skills available for use. All locations on the map have buttons to enter. In addition to viewing photos, players can solve puzzles to gain experience points and skill points. Solving puzzles allows players to level up and helps strengthen the entire town. (2) Game Features Housing System Players can choose the location of their house within Zhongxing New Village at the start of the game. Houses can restore health and block enemy attacks. Upgrading house types and skill levels allows for changes in appearance. Action Points Killing enemies does not grant experience points but rewards action points. Action points have a limit, which increases with skill upgrades. Browse Photos, Solve Puzzles, and Level Up Clicking on area photos consumes action points. Solving puzzles and pressing buttons at the right time grants significant experience and levels. Explore Revitalization Areas to Gain Skills Clicking on revitalization area photos may trigger questions. Answering correctly grants upgrades to various skills, including both passive and active abilities. Seven Major Skills During multiplayer gameplay, the seven major skills can support teammates, making them stronger. Skills include: Healing, Agility, Resilience, Weakness, Magic Attack, Lightning, and Vulnerability. Multiplayer is recommended to maximize the synergy of skill support among teammates. Skill Points and Professions Each level-up grants additional skill points. Every 50 levels, players can allocate profession points. Different profession point bonuses can bring significant changes to gameplay.

rows.name: Poker Clicker
rows.short_description: Earn chips by revealing randomly generated poker hands and unlock gems for powerful bonuses. And don't worry if you're not getting any goals or feeling like you're missing a strategy. It's all about the endless clicking, and it's the perfect way to relax and unwind.
rows.description_html: A perfect blend of tapping fun and poker hands! Get ready for a thrilling mix of clicker gameplay and poker hands! In Poker Clicker, you earn chips based on the strength of randomly generated poker hands - from a simple high card to the elusive royal flush. Each tap of the Joker card reveals a new hand, bringing you closer to the ultimate jackpot! Use your earned chips to purchase gems or poker hand updates that unlock special bonuses and accelerate your progress towards higher scores. Key Features: Simple yet addictive gameplay - perfect for poker enthusiasts and casual players alike. Dynamic scoring system based on poker hand rankings. Gem Shop - boost your performance and maximise your winnings! Stylish graphics and intuitive interface for a seamless experience. Don't forget, every click gets you one step closer to unlock one of 30 unique Joker Card designs. And don't worry if you're not getting any goals or feeling like you're missing a strategy. It's all about the endless clicking, and it's the perfect way to relax and unwind.

rows.name: Fireplace Simulator
rows.short_description: Simulate your cozy fire, add logs and feed the fire to customize it to your preferred experience.
rows.description_html: Warm yourself by the hearth and enjoy a soothing, atmospheric experience with Fireplace Simulator . Set the mood by adding logs to the fire, chopping new ones when supplies run low, and exploring the room for hidden interactions. Whether you’re unwinding after a long day or looking for a calm backdrop, Fireplace Simulator invites you to relax and enjoy the soft crackle of burning wood.  Earn Steam Achievements!   Key Features Start or Quench the Fire: Ignite a roaring blaze or let it gently die out at your own pace. Feed Logs to the Fire: Keep the flames going with a steady supply of wood. Cut New Logs: Run out of logs? No problem—chop more to keep the cozy ambiance alive. Change the Weather: Adjust the elements outside to suit your mood. Explore Your Surroundings: Interact with items around the room to discover hidden details and further enhance the atmosphere. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the peaceful crackle and glow of your own virtual fireplace!

rows.name: Ghostie's Escape
rows.short_description: Dance with death in this intense dodge-and-survive experience that pushes your reflexes to their limits. Find clues to make your way out of an executioner's chamber where every shadow holds danger.
rows.description_html: Inspired by the brutal boss battles of Cuphead, you must rely on your wit, agility, and intimate knowledge of your surroundings to survive and make your way out. Turn the executioner's chamber against itself as you dodge, weave, and manipulate the environment in your desperate bid for freedom. Master the art of evasion through precise movement skills Cartoon-style animations Face challenging patterns that demand quick thinking and good reflexes Transform the executioner's own tools into your means of escape Customize your controller and keyboard bindings Controller support included - for the best experience, we recommend playing with a gamepad. Music made by Marc-Olivier Pépin

rows.name: Haunted Hues
rows.short_description: Travel to the world of Amille as Larue, an eager art curator looking to make a name for themselves. Build your reputation by talking with collectors and locals, and explore the ever-expanding gallery as you buy more artwork. But beware, as every choice matters when day turns to night...
rows.description_html: Wow, another great day to be rich! Travel to the world of Amille You did it! After months of searching, You've worked hard and finally found a wonderful place to begin exhibiting art from all over the world. The gallery space is filled with old pieces (and some secrets...), but could use some big collections to really drum up excitement. Bargain with collectors The journey to curating the greatest collection of art will bring you face-to-face with some of Amille's most curious individuals, each with their own unique personality and tastes. How far are you willing to go to get what you want? Survive the night Not everything is as it seems in the gallery. Discover what horrors lie in the dark at night, and do what you must to survive... Gameplay Features -Every choice matters. Speak with collectors, locals, and staff to build your reputation -Reputation only goes so far... Gain money to bid on and buy art from collectors -A menagerie of horrors come alive at night. Use your knowledge from the day and do what you must to survive -Become immersed in the game's unique art style

rows.name: Ruyn HD
rows.short_description: Ruyn HD is a remake of my minimalist boomer shooter Ruyn, rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5. It keeps the fast, combo-driven gameplay of the original, but now features modern visuals, smoother controls, updated audio, and tighter gunplay. Ruyn Classic and the 2D and 3D level editors are included.
rows.description_html: What is it? Ruyn HD is a remake of my minimalist boomer shooter Ruyn , rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5 . It keeps the fast, combo-driven gameplay of the original, but now features more modern visuals, smoother controls, updated audio, and tighter gameplay. The levels are short, intense, and built for momentum—just you, some weapons, and a ton of enemies to blast through. The focus is on pure, simple shooter mechanics: fast movement and nonstop action. T he original Ruyn Classic is included , and the level editors work across both versions , so you can build once and play in either style. Ruyn HD is 100% free — no ads, no microtransactions, no DRM. The original Ruyn Classic , the 2D/3D level editors , and the launcher are all open source and public domain. The HD version's Unreal Engine code is not open source due to engine licensing restrictions, but everything else is yours to modify, share, or build on. How do I play it? The basic goal is simple: eliminate all enemies and reach the exit. If you're chasing a high score, it’s all about speed, variety, and combo flow . Each time you kill an enemy, a combo bar appears at the top of the screen—it drains quickly. Kill another enemy or collect a gem before it runs out to keep your multiplier alive. The longer you maintain it, the higher your score climbs. But there’s more: the game rewards creative kills . Use different weapons or methods to earn style bonuses . Repeating the same kill type will reduce the bonus—so keep it fresh if you want to score big. There’s also a bonus for finishing the level quickly, so don’t hang around too long. Note:  Ammo is shared over multiple weapons. When you collect some shells, you have access to the shotgun and double barrel shotgun straight away. This works the same for the plasma which is shared across the plasma rifle and trident. Tip:  Use the single-barrel shotgun when you need something that fires fast and the double-barrel shotgun when you need more grunt. This can help when you're trying to keep up a combo. How do I make and share my own levels? You can find detailed tutorials on how to build your levels here on github gists(See Online Manual URL on this page) and in the community hub.  If you have any questions just fire me a message in the community hub. All in-game music by GTDStudio (aka Palrom), licensed under OGA-BY 3.0.

rows.name: Clockwork Sword
rows.short_description: Slash, stab, and shoot your way through a multi-tiered museum filled with corrupted automata, customizing your weapon with the scraps of the fallen. Clockwork Sword is a thrilling isometric hack and slash, in which you utilize combinations of weapons and elements to conquer your foes.
rows.description_html: Slash, stab, and shoot your way through a multi-tiered museum filled with corrupted automata, customizing your weapon with the scraps of the fallen. Clockwork Sword is a thrilling isometric hack and slash, in which you utilize combinations of weapons and elements to conquer your foes. In Clockwork Sword, every part of your weapon can be customized to fit your playstyle. Forms dictate the move set of the weapon and the range at which you fight. Charges apply devastating elemental effects and change the dynamic of combat. Gears add enhancements that allow you to specialize your weapon further. From flaming spears to life-stealing Gatling guns, the choice is up to you. The weapon of Clockwork Sword has two sides that each have their own form, element and set of gears. In the heat of combat you can switch between these modes to adapt to whatever you may encounter. Is it worth having a balance of melee and range or should you double down on on your strengths and brute force any obstacle in your way? Fighting enemies in Clockwork Sword will build up the pressure gauge on your weapon. When your pressure is full, switching between modes will unleash a massive special attack unique to each form. Time your weapon switches right for massive payoffs.
