rows.name: The Sixth Sorrow
rows.short_description: The Sixth Sorrow is a short, narrative-driven horror game where your choices impact the story. To what lengths can a mother's love drive her?
rows.description_html: “And a sword will pierce your own soul also.” Things haven't felt right since the accident. Your mother's passive aggression, your father's refusal to speak, and strange things around the house... Are they unable to move on, or is something even more sinister lurking beneath the surface? Dark Secrets Be a part of a character-driven narrative as you unravel a mystery engulfed in grief, sorrow, and maternal love.  Unsettling Atmosphere Be immersed as you explore creepy environments that each feature their own eerie sound design and captivating retro aesthetics. Choices Matter with Multiple Endings Engage in interactive dialogue that shapes your relationships and how the story unfolds. With multiple endings and hidden secrets, more than one playthrough is encouraged. Interactive Mechanics Gameplay extends beyond simple key collection, featuring minigames and puzzles that engage players and advance the narrative.

rows.name: Late Night Mystery
rows.short_description: A terrifying story that immerses you in a dark world full of horrific surprises that will leave the player frozen in fear.
rows.description_html: Late Night Mystery  is a first-person horror video game that immerses you in an intense and mysterious experience. Jason enters his home returning from a quiet night out dining, but when he arrives, something unexpected happens: there have been changes that will make your hair stand on end! And the protagonist! Will he manage to survive and uncover the truth? Explore dark hallways, collect key items, solve clues, and navigate oppressive environments filled with tension. You'll need to keep your composure to uncover the truth hidden in the corners of home... and survive whatever lurks in the shadows. Key Features: A horror story with elements of mystery and suspense. First-person gameplay focused on exploration and interaction. Terrifying environments and an oppressive atmosphere. Medium-length gameplay, ideal for a complete experience without being overly long.

rows.short_description: Concentration Required is a tough bullet hell made to challenge your focus and reaction time. The game has 6 unique retro-themed music tracks with 5 levels plus a tutorial and endless mode.
rows.description_html: Fast-paced bullet hell where you try and dodge all projectiles while collecting as many coins as possible with in the time limit.
rows.about_html: Fast-paced bullet hell where you try and dodge all projectiles while collecting as many coins as possible with in the time limit.

rows.name: Welcome Home
rows.short_description: Where home feels wrong, and you're anything but welcome
rows.description_html: Welcome Home is a psychological horror game that immerses you in the unsettling life of a secluded village preparing for its annual festival. Experience a chilling tale of tradition , trust , and terror , narrated through your journey of uncovering dark secrets and making choices that determine your fate. PSX Style 12 NPCs Stealth & Survival Multiple Endings The game is around 30 - 60 minutes long depending on your skills and playstyle. Warning: This game contains themes of religious rituals, unsettling imagery, blood, violence, and psychological distress.

rows.name: PEXIT 8
rows.short_description: Penguin × Exit 8 : A unique combination Escape from the endlessly looping hallway. If you find an anomaly, choose YES PEN. If there is no anomaly, choose NO PEN. All anomalies contain penguin elements. Penguins are after you.
rows.description_html: Penguin × Exit 8 : A unique combination Escape from the endlessly looping hallway. If you find an anomaly, choose YES PEN . If there is no anomaly, choose NO PEN . All anomalies contain penguin elements. Answer correctly 8 times in a row to escape. A mixture of cuteness and fear. ※Pressing 'Continue' allows you to collect undiscovered anomalies. Penguin Hotel This game is a spin-off of the mascot horror series 'Penguin Hotel.' You don’t need to have played 'Penguin Hotel' to enjoy it. If you’re interested, give it a try! About video production and distribution Please include the name of this game in the distribution and video title. Please put a link to SETAM in the summary section. Other than the above, we do not specify anything else. Please use common sense. We want many people to know this game. So videos and distribution are welcome.

rows.name: Death in the Gulag
rows.short_description: Stories from the Russian Gulag
rows.description_html: Enter the haunting world of a 1930s-1950s Russian Gulag in this 2D top-down narrative experience. Your time is limited—your survival is fleeting—but before your journey ends, you'll uncover the voices and stories of those who shared this harsh existence. A Story-Driven Experience Explore a stark, oppressive prison camp where every corner holds a story. Listen as prisoners and guards recount their harrowing experiences, all inspired by true accounts from the Gulags. A Unique Approach to Gameplay With no combat, puzzles, or objectives, the focus is solely on immersing yourself in the narratives of those around you. The game's core is its atmosphere and the hauntingly human stories it brings to life. 2D Top-Down Visuals Navigate beautifully crafted, minimalist environments that reflect the bleakness and isolation of the Gulag. Original Soundtrack Featuring a custom score that blends haunting melodies and atmospheric soundscapes, the music draws you deeper into the emotional weight of the stories. A Somber Reflection This is not a game of triumph or escape but an experience of reflection—an opportunity to bear witness to a part of history often overlooked.

You will explore a virtual economy based on the Steam marketplace, where you can interact with other players and trade your items. Main Features: Clicker gameplay: Click the anvil to earn diamonds and open creatures that give you items. Creatures and rare items: Discover creatures that provide valuable items that can be sold on the Steam Marketplace. Simplicity and fun: The gameplay is easy to understand and highly addictive, perfect for short gaming sessions. Step into the world where each click could bring you a new item to sell!

rows.name: Lithium
rows.short_description: Play as one of three social groups of your choice who mobilize against a planned lithium mining project. The developer seeks to start mining quickly, you aim to halt this project and initiate a debate about a just and environmentally friendly solution.
rows.description_html: In Lithium , you play as one of three social groups of your choice – Activists, Locals, or the City – who mobilize against a planned lithium mining project in Cínovec, Czechia . The developer seeks to start mining quickly, regardless of the locals’ interests. You aim to halt this project and initiate a debate about a just and environmentally friendly solution. Will you stall the mining project so the developer cannot finish his projects? Or will you join forces with the remaining social groups for a collective action? The second can be reached by organizing a deliberative forum about the environmental consequences of such mining.   To win the game, it is essential to cooperate with all social groups to gain societal support for your actions. Each social group has different actions and tools at its disposal.   Every action you take may provoke unexpected reaction. You to consider various factors when choosing a winning strategy. These factors include the local community, the global economy, the climate crisis, the impact on nature, and a just energy transition. Investigating lithium mining in Czech Cínovec and the global context of energy transformation is the central theme of the new ecogame Lithium , developed by the art Blue Pulsar kolektiv for the exhibition Symptoms of the Future at the Hraničář Gallery (September 2024—February 2025).

rows.description_html: Welcome to It’s Raining Acorn! —an idle pachinko drafting game where strategy meets nature in a beautifully crafted, vertically scrolling forest. It sits on the side of your desktop and you can leave it running while you work, but good luck focusing when you see those acorns bounce, roll, and trigger satisfying combos across your custom-built forest. Key Features Pachinko-Style Fun : Place, tweak, and upgrade your pieces to create the most efficient acorn-catching setup. Idle with a Twist : Unlike typical idle games, this one won’t let you completely forget about it. The falling acorns, playful animals, and bouncing balls are just too satisfying to ignore. A Dynamic, Living World : Mix and match animals, plants, and landscapes to create a vibrant ecosystem that’s always evolving Fits Right into Your Screen (Or Not) : Built to sit unobtrusively on the side of your your screen. Relaxing Yet Hard to Resist : Don’t be deceived by it’s relaxing vibes, the game is cleverly designed to make it hard to stop playing once you start.

rows.description_html: Get ready to dive into the ultra-dynamic universe of Hyperdrive Horizon , an electrifying space racing game where speed, reflexes, and adrenaline are the keys to victory! Game Modes Single player: Challenge yourself to beat your own records and improve with every race. VS AI: Test your skills against highly competitive AI opponents designed to push you to your limits. Ships and Customization Unlockable Ships: Earn new ships with unique designs as you race. Customizable Colors: Make your ship your own by choosing from a variety of vibrant color schemes. Features: Boosts and barrel rolls: Use boosts to speed past your opponents and barrel rolls to skillfully dodge obstacles. Procedurally generated tracks: Every race is unique, offering fresh and unpredictable challenges with dynamically generated terrain. Global Leaderboard: Compare your best times and achievements with players from around the world to see who is the fastest racer. Race across a vast lunar canyon, dodge obstacles at high speed, and collect boosts to push yourself even further. With fluid gameplay and increasing difficulty, Hyperdrive Horizon offers a tough challenge for players seeking fast-paced action. Are you up for the challenge? Play Hyperdrive Horizon and experience a game that combines the simple with the extreme!

rows.short_description: Spooky Night is an online social deduction game of teamwork and betrayal! Uncover the werewolves among you before they wipe out the village. During the day, chat, deceive, and vote to eliminate a suspect. At night, use your role’s abilities to gather insights or strike. Can you survive?
rows.description_html: Wishlist to help us release the game! 🎃 Welcome to Spooky Night 🎃 Trust is scarce, betrayal thrives, and every decision can be your last. Spooky Night is the ultimate social deduction game, bringing friends and strangers together in a thrilling battle of wits and strategy. Will you expose the werewolves or fall victim to their cunning schemes? 🧩 How to Play Day Phase : Talk with other players and vote to eliminate someone you think is a werewolf. End of Day : The player with the most votes is eliminated and their role is revealed. Night Phase : Werewolves attack, while villagers and other roles secretly use their abilities to protect, gather clues, or take action. Win the Game : Villagers win if all werewolves are eliminated. Werewolves win if they equal or outnumber the villagers. 🎉 Why You’ll Love Spooky Night Every round is a fresh, unpredictable adventure. With a variety of unique roles and endless player strategies, no two games are ever the same. Build trust (or break it!). This game is entirely free to play! You'll earn rewards after every match and can unlock a wide range of character customizations. Purchasing the game allows you to acquire skins faster and expands your inventory.

rows.short_description: Dying Sun is a cozy surfing game in which you play as Hurabi, a young nomad on a solar-powered sailboard, searching for the mysterious causes of the extinction of an ancient, highly advanced civilisation. On her journey, she travels through grandiose landscapes where nature and technology meet.
rows.description_html: [THIS GAME IS A DEMO] Stuck in an alien world, explore the sand dunes of Dying Sun to find a way to break free. The desert offers several paths, and it’s up to you to explore them at your own pace. Discover an ancient ruin to deepen your understanding of the world’s history. Let yourself be soothed by a gliding flow, slide freely across the sands, and interact with artifacts from a long-lost civilization. The deeper you venture into the ruins, the more challenging it becomes to navigate. Only by strengthening your symbiotic relationship with the desert can you find a way out and perhaps uncover a few secrets along the journey. A flow-oriented game with vibrant movements. ● A handcrafted cinematic experience in a poetic world. ● Glide, jump, and learn the ways of the desert to unlock your full potential.

rows.name: Kingdom of Piss
rows.short_description: Join two punk-rock royal heirs, Pretty Piss Princess and Asian American, as they dodge their royal duties in favor of adventures. This hilarious visual novel, inspired by TROMA films, follows the duo as they navigate the absurdities of royal life, and embrace their rebellious spirit.
rows.description_html: Step into the world of Kingdom of Piss , a wild, punk-infused visual novel that blends irreverence, adventure, and bizarre humor. Meet our rebellious heroes—two gay royal heirs who’d rather be crowd-surfing at a concert than ruling a kingdom. These two misfits are stuck in a situation they never asked for, as they navigate the chaos of royal life while craving freedom. In this hilarious, over-the-top visual novel inspired by TROMA films and Rocky Horror, join Pretty Piss Princess and Asian American as they confront the absurdity of their privileged positions and escape into their punk-rock fantasy. With no shortage of wild adventures, dark humor, and heart, they’ll face impossible choices and laugh in the face of tradition. Whether it’s battling absurd political schemes, sabotaging stuffy royal events, or just blowing off steam at a local dive bar, this couple is out to prove that sometimes the best way to rule is by refusing to follow the rules. Prepare for offbeat humor, vibrant characters, and a whole lot of ridiculous fun as you experience this rebellious journey. Will they dodge the crown and create their own future, or will destiny force them to wear it? Get ready for a rollicking ride where being royal doesn’t mean playing by anyone’s rules!

rows.name: R/A\W
rows.short_description: Anthology of anti-war stories by award-winning authors from Russia
rows.description_html: Four stories. Thousands of raw wounds. R/A\W is a collection of anti-war visual novels developed over the past three years. NO WAY! Sasha drives home along the country roads, pacing from stop to stop, as she calls on Agnia, who is... not doing well. It's going to be a small and personal story, as if out of our world, isn't it? THE BEAST The story of two ordinary guys trapped in a war, facing a difficult choice: inevitable doom tomorrow or the shame of desertion today. NEW ANGEL SANCTUARY Shenetz returns to his once abandoned homeland and meets a girl who has defeated Death. What happened to her and the place over the years? FAREWELL TO DERE The Fog, which sows anger and hatred, covers the City, but no one but the protagonist notices it. To stop the Fog, he sacrifices everything.

rows.name: What The Chuck?
rows.short_description: Jump, Dodge and Chuck your way through a variety of battlefields in this local platforming multiplayer game. Play with two to four players in a chaotic and cartoony free-for-all. Prove yourself as the ultimate woodchuck warrior and crush your friends' dream of achieving gold!
rows.description_html: Throwables At the start of each match, every player is randomly assigned a single throwable. These throwables vary from a fiery molotov cocktail to Thor's hammer or a simple stone. But the true chaos doesn't end there—throughout the course of the match, five additional random throwables will spawn, scattered across the arena, each one offering fresh opportunities to turn the tide of battle in unexpected ways. Abilities With a total of 8 unique ability cards, players are equipped with a variety of strategic options that allow them to quickly escape sticky situations or cleverly put their opponents in a difficult spot. Maps Engage in epic battles across nine uniquely designed battlefields. Venture into the frozen expanse of the icy tundra; clash in the eerie silence of a dusty, abandoned library; or face the heat and danger of a molten volcano. Each battlefield immerses you in a new world, forcing you to adapt your strategy and conquer diverse environments to claim victory. Special   The five chaotic cards are game-changers in every sense, introducing twists and turns that no one sees coming. Whether you’re on the winning side or mounting a comeback, these cards ensure that no match is ever truly decided until the very end.

rows.name: Lawnmower Day
rows.short_description: A simple collection game with spawning tokens and enemy
rows.description_html: Help the mom get ready for Lawnmower Day - by staying one step ahead of the three dogs...and the lawnmower!  Collect the 'presents' the three dog have left in the yard so the lawnmower does not hit the presents, or you!  Those three pesky dogs will drop more presents during gameplay that must be collected before the lawnmower runs over the presents.  And watch out, the lawnmower gets faster with each present you collect.  Obtain game achievements as you collect presents and increase your score.

rows.name: Athos'Code
rows.short_description: Discover a lively manuscript that will tell you the story of Athos as you embody him in his most epic battles. Athos' Code is a story-driven sword fighting game that takes you to the heart of the quarrels of the French province in the XVIIth century.
rows.description_html: Discover a lively manuscript that tells the story of Athos as you embody him in his epic adventures. Athos' Code is a sword-fighting game that takes you to the heart of the quarrels of the French provinces in the 17th century. Combat System Take part in Athos' rise to glory, embodying him in his most tragic skirmishes! Just like him, you'll have to master the rapier and show your agility to be the best swordsman. Break through your opponent's defenses or strike back after parrying! Box-by-box storytelling Complete the myth of Athos by navigating his book through a dynamic square-by-square narrative system punctuated by combat and story boxes. 5 levels Follow Athos' story through 5 levels, mixing humor, drama and battle. Pick up where you left off at any time. Toggle-On Narration mode Experience the game's story without having to fight. Thanks to Narration mode, the story follows its own course, with you intervening only when crucial decisions are made.

rows.name: Mecharashi
rows.short_description: Mecharashi is a mecha-themed tactical turn-based game. The game adopts a unique part-destruction combat system, where you can assemble mechas however you want, equip a wide selection of weapons, and choose your favorite pilots to engage in battle.
rows.description_html: Mecharashi is a mecha-themed tactical turn-based game. The game adopts a unique part-destruction combat system, where you can assemble mechas however you want, equip a wide selection of weapons, and choose your favorite pilots to engage in battle. When any part of a mecha is destroyed, its battle efficiency will diminish significantly. By focusing attacks on the most critical enemy parts, you can gain a clear strategic advantage. As a mecha commander, your task is to achieve victory through strategic insight and journey through a world shaped by war, where profound stories of dire conflict and unassailable hope are born! ■ Tactical Turn-Based Mech Action, Unparalleled Next-Gen Graphics Every detail, from scene design to the mech models, is crafted in a solemn, realistic style to achieve the ultimate expression of mech aesthetics. ■ Story Stages Combining Engaging Narratives and Tough Challenges Surrounded by the immersive environments of Milkhama, players command a mercenary unit, exploring the world and shaking up the political machinations behind the scenes, becoming key players in a story that will shape history. ■ Build and Customize Your Mecha Squad On Milkhama Island, countless mecha factories vie for supremacy, leading to the creation of classic mechas with diverse designs and performance features, along with an array of corresponding weapons. You can customize the bodies, arms, legs, and weapons of your mechas to form a mecha squad tailored to each battle's needs, then outfit them with elite pilots, each boasting a unique personality and backstory. You can also customize the paintwork of your mechas and weapons down to the finest details, with over 120 free colors available by default. ■ Revolutionary Turn-Based 'Part Destruction' Gameplay The hit points of different mecha parts are calculated separately in battle, allowing for individual part destruction. This feature opens the doors to a world of infinite strategic possibilities. Destroying the torso, the part with the highest hit points, will directly neutralize the target, while breaking the arms or legs will impair weapons and mobility. Your every choice must be considered in advance, based on the current situation on the battlefield. Thank you for your interest in Mecharashi. We look forward to meeting you in Milkhama!

rows.name: Requiem of Dread
rows.short_description: Requiem of Dread is a single-player Top-down shooter with rogue-lite elements made in a university project. Dive into mysterious dungeons filled with unique monsters and challenging bosses. Shoot your way through waves of enemies, upgrade your equipment and character and travel into the dark.
rows.description_html: The minimalistic gameplay and the retro pixel-art makes it easy to get started and deep dive into the dark worlds of Requiem of Dread. Embark on an adventure into the darkness to defeat foes and bosses with increasing difficulty. Fight your way through 3 handcrafted dungeon maps, from haunted graveyards, monster-filled forests to the empty tombs in the pyramids. Beware of what you will find there! We composed a melodic horror sound that will companion you through the exciting experience. This is a student project made in Godot 4.3. In a group of four students, we had two months to learn and adapt different techniques and create this alpha version. The music is handcrafted and composed to immerse the player into a world of death, destruction and discomfort. The bosses will do everything to keep you on the edge of your seat, so don't take too much time to appreciate their animations. The skill tree allows you to spend your collected coins on buffs. Open the skill tree, go on a shopping spree and come back to finally kill the reaper! Controls: Play with mouse and keyboard. Moving – W,A,S,D Shooting – Left Mouse Skill tree– ESC Spend your earned gold Weapons – Number keys 1,2,3

rows.name: Cat Syndicate: Istanbul
rows.short_description: Get ready for a mix of chaos, strategy, and cuteness in the heart of Istanbul. Run your own cat business among the city's legendary street cats, grow your lira income. It may look adorable... but underneath lies a game that rewards careful planning, just like navigating the Grand Bazaar itself.
rows.description_html: Do you love cats? How about a bit of chaos, strategy, and cuteness all mixed together? Then welcome to Istanbul's purr-fect neighborhood. Run your own little cat business in the heart of where East meets West, team up with uniquely talented Turkish feline friends, grow your production — and make some lira along the way. It may look adorable on the surface… but beneath it lies a system that rewards smart decisions. Key Features ✔ Historic Istanbul Setting – Build your cat empire across neighborhoods inspired by iconic Istanbul locations, from the Grand Bazaar to the Bosphorus waterfront. Meet legendary Turkish cat breeds in their natural habitat. ✔ Limited Space, Endless Possibilities – Make the most of Istanbul's narrow streets and compact shops. Every tile matters in this bustling metropolis. ✔ Cycle-Breaking Spirits – Special spirits inspired by Turkish folklore can turn the tide of a match — but triggering them takes skill. ✔ Turkish Cat Collection – Collect dozens of cats including the swimming Turkish Van, and the beloved street cats that rule Istanbul's alleys, each with unique passive abilities. ✔ Bazaar Shops, Turkish Treats & More – Personalize your system with special items like simit stands, fish markets, and tea houses that boost your production. ✔ Lira & Rent System – Optimize your income and don't forget to pay your rent... or you'll be sleeping with the street cats under the Galata Bridge! ✔ Synergy & Interaction – The way your cats interact can make or break your economy — just like the real cat colonies of Istanbul. A bit of Turkish tea, a bit of organized chaos — and a whole neighborhood of fur-covered economy. In this Istanbul neighborhood, everyone finds their own way. Are you ready to find yours? Don't miss the cutest corner of Istanbul. Add it to your wishlist!

rows.short_description: The 3D anime-style shooting game 'E.T.E' is launching early access soon. It offers three unique environments—sea, land, and air—plus a system for developing female characters and mechas. Famous voice actresses like Sakura Tange, Kana Hanazawa, Rie Tanaka, and Mikako Komatsu voice the characters.
rows.description_html: Travel benefits Gift Pack Redemption Code: IaPjQcehk Bqdj8DWD3 sJaXw9iE1 How to receive: Copy the redemption code - click on the avatar in the game - receive the redemption code Join QQ group, Discord and community discussion group to receive special gift packages Follow us QQ群：820485351 YouTube:E.T.E X:E.T.E-steam Bilibili：AITA-ETE About the Game The in-game refresh time is UTC-7 [Worldview] In the near future, conflicts arise across the globe as factions compete for power and resources. Noah Technologies has developed a powerful, adaptable tactical exoskeleton known as [E.T.E] and constructed a massive ring-shaped orbital base called [Sky Vault] , equipped with superweapons, to monopolize the world's resources. The skies are shrouded by vast steel structures, darkness looms, and despair spreads. In response, humanity's major factions united to launch a counterattack against Noah Technologies, a war that nearly annihilated the Earth's surface ecology. Following this, the factions jointly developed new combat mechs, [E.T.E] , and formed the 'Human Alliance,' entering a stalemate with Noah Technologies. Somewhere in this fractured world, a combat organization under the 'Human Alliance,' known as the Ninth Accord, awaits the arrival of a guest... rows.short_description: Four friends battle their way across space to claim a once-in-a-lifetime wish. Their lives are in your hands.
rows.description_html: A strange wish fulfilling entity has appeared on the edge of the universe. You and your team pilot a combined MEKA to get to it, but you're not the only ones there... rows.name: Bloodline
rows.short_description: Revenge against the forces of good! That is the goal of the dark elf Belphora, who wants to avenge the death of her father. Explore the beautiful pixel art world, find items to improve yourself and fight various enemies in this Metroidvania-like game. Fight for glory and revenge!
rows.description_html: Play as Belphora, a daughter of war who lost her father in the battle against the Light. The forces of Light have taken over your castle—your home. You are the sole survivor! Engage in close combat against your own minions, who have fallen out of control. Use magical stones that can be embedded in your sword to gain special advantages. To reclaim your castle, you must pass through the dark Darkmoon Forest and defeat its powerful guardian. Once you reach the castle, eliminate all enemies who have occupied your home and face the almighty Angel of Light to drive back the forces of Light. Key Features: Classic side-scroller with action-packed gameplay Explore various regions and discover hidden treasures Battle diverse enemies with unique fighting styles Confront two formidable bosses who stand in the way of your bloodline Collect souls and purchase useful equipment to grow stronger

rows.name: The Future is Ours
rows.short_description: You're going to spend 3 days at summer camp! Explore the camp, do camp activities and get to know your fellow campers as you learn about LGBTQ+ issues and more in this storytelling adventure. But, a dark secret awaits
rows.description_html: Welcome to this fantastic summer camp! You will spend the next 3 days doing various activities, exploring the area and above all, learning about various LGBTQ+ issues during your stay. Activities Enjoy the varied activities that the camp offers, such as a game of scavenger hunt, archery or the talks that take place every night around the campfire. Your adventure Explore the different areas of the camp and take the opportunity to talk, interact and get to know your fellow campers better. How you respond in your interactions can influence the outcome of your experience. LGBTQ+ themes and more The camp will bring up a wide variety of LGBTQ+ issues related to sexuality, gender, phobias and more that will lead you to learn about them in order to better relate to the camp.

rows.name: Health Insurance Claim Denier
rows.short_description: An incremental game about denying health insurance claims. 🚫
rows.description_html: Denying health insurance claims has never been so fun and easy! Click your way to increased shareholder value. Health Insurance Claim Denier is a satirical incremental/idle/clicker game where you take on the role of a claim reviewer operating with absurd efficiency. Start out manually clicking the denial button to reject claims, then upgrade your operation to include items which automatically deny claims and upgrades which boost your stats. Your productivity will increase exponentially, leading to trillions of claims denied as you dominate the industry! Send customers into crippling medical debt with the help of: 20 items to auto-deny for you 30 upgrades to boost your efficiency

rows.name: Pale Abyss
rows.short_description: Descend into the Pale Abyss, a cursed chasm where the forgotten truths of a dying world fester in its depths. Inspired by games such as King’s Field and Shadow Tower, Pale Abyss is a first-person action RPG about exploration and adventure. Currently it's just a demo with about 1 h of playtime.
rows.description_html: Our precious sunlight… taken by that… thing. The Pale Abyss, they call it. A wound in the earth, an accursed maw that swallows all it touches. And from its depths spills that pale, unholy light. Lay your eyes upon it… Our warm and golden sunlight has been dragged down into that darkness, twisted and defiled. Mocking us with what was taken! Immersive First-Person 'King's Field-Like' Exploration Master the tactile combat of old school melee and magic when battling strange creatures and traversing the depths. If you want to survive the Pale Abyss, you'll have to fight with every scrap you can find. Long lost weapons, spells and consumables will aid you on your way. Let the Abyss change your very being with the unique Otherworldly Influence System   In the Pale Abyss the otherworldly beings seem to clash and influence whatever mortal beings dare to descend its vast depths. Your actions in battle and during exploration shape your mind and body as you drift towards either the Abyssal  or the Occult . Many secrets and powers are connected to the otherworldly, but when trifling with the eldritch, you might discover unheard of dangers as well...  Beautiful Old-School Aesthetics Harken back to a simpler time in gaming where the few polygons we had jittered and shifted away as we were in awe of the first instances of 3D on our CRT screens. Pale Abyss combines its more modern gameplay with this nostalgic aesthetic to bring a whole new experience in a familiar form. From Humble Origins to Stalwart Explorer Choose from 6 different starter classes with unique origins and let your choice of character stats and Level Ups empower you and the way you fight!  Rich Asynchronous Multiplayer Communicate with other delvers with Chatter Pebbles. Leave behind cryptic messages for other players to find and feel the faint echoes of other players' journeys as you traverse through the Pale Abyss.  Small team with big aspirations Pale Abyss is a student project by a team of three people made within six months. As such, this game is currently only a short Demo with about 1 hour of playtime, but we will continue providing updates in the future. Our humble team at Permanent Crab Studios consists of one Programmer, one 3D Artist and one Musician. While it ain't much, it's honest work, so please enjoy this experience we created for any Adventure Game enthusiast.

rows.name: Tricks, Treats and Mirrors - An EoG Side Story
rows.short_description: 'Trick-or-Treat' doesn't always get you a treat.
rows.description_html: When a mysterious voice lures a young girl into a secluded home promising her candy, her friends must venture inside to save her, armed with nothing more the powers granted to them by their Halloween costumes. Will they be able to uncover the dark truth buried within, or will they crumble like broken mirrors? Features Enjoy a horror - comedy visual novel with references to certain IPs taking place in the world of Echoes of G , an upcoming visual novel! Select one of two routes as you search through a shady home on Halloween night. Choose between the tomboyish Misako Harima and the elegant Princess Quinn on your quest to find their friend, Echo! Make choices that will decide the fate of every single character and unlock multiple different endings. Choose wisely, as your decisions can lead to a good or bad ending for each of them! Gorgeous artwork illustrated in a (mainly) monochrome style! Uncover the darkness that plagues Halloween! WARNING: Contains brief instances of flashing lights.

Open drawers, cabinets, and move objects to discover the most unexpected hiding spots. Every corner of the offices holds surprises and challenges as you explore a richly detailed isometric 3D environment. Features Innovative 3D hidden objects : An innovative game combining classic exploration mechanics with a 3D isometric environment. 🚀 Nearly 500 hidden cats : Find cats of all colors, sizes, and personalities. 😺 Secret cats : Discover special cats in unique hiding spots. 💡 Detailed interactivity : Open furniture, move objects, and interact with the environment. 😻 Hint system : Use hints to highlight a random cat when you're struggling. 🔎 Are you ready to prove you're the master at finding cats?

rows.name: Primal Fray: Prologue
rows.short_description: Primal Fray:Prologue is a turn-based strategy roguelite set in the world of Primal Fray. Discover the origins of the story and witness the beginning of an adventure leading into the main game. Enter the Rift,battle enemies, build a team of Primals, outsmart your foes and uncover secrets of the Rift.
rows.description_html: Primal Fray: Prologue is a thrilling turn-based strategy roguelite where combat unfolds on procedurally generated, hex-based flying islands. Outsmart and defeat even the most powerful enemies with your cunningly assembled team of Primals. The Adventure Begins In Primal Fray: Prologue you will enter the Rift as a member of the first expedition, sent to extract resources vital for restoring Earth ravaged by climate change. The fate of humanity rests on your shoulders. Build Your Team During each run, you'll compose your own team of mighty Primals. You will need to think strategically, adapt your tactics to the ever-changing conditions, and find clever ways to utilize the resources at your disposal.  Face the Guardian In the end, you will have to face a powerful boss with unique mechanics and attacks. Are you up to the task? Make sure to build the best possible team of your Primals and defeat the powerful Guardian of the Grove! Procedurally Generated Challenge With every run, you embark on a unique adventure. Each map is procedurally generated, meaning no two fights are the same, and every encounter presents new challenges and opportunities.  Primal Fray Primal Fray: Prequel is just the beginning of the journey! Dive into an epic adventure with Primal Fray, filled with battles, bosses, and challenges. Fight your way through the Rift and be the first one to uncover all its secrets! Visit the Primal Fray Steam page and add it to your wishlist today!

rows.name: Reap
rows.short_description: One swing. One cut. One endless harvest.
rows.description_html: One swing. One cut. One endless harvest. Welcome to Reap, the most relaxing (or obsessive?) game about cutting grass you’ll ever play! Carve through endless fields and watch the grass explode into glorious coin showers. The more you reap, the richer you get—simple as that! What’s the Deal? One-button gameplay – Tap. Swing. Cut. It’s that easy. Endless reaping – The grass never stops growing, and you never stop cutting. Coins, coins, coins! – Grass drops nothing but pure, shiny currency. The rarer the coin, the harder it is to find. Rare finds – Every now and then, a new ultra-rare coin is added. Slice. Collect. Repeat. How deep will you reap?

rows.name: Death Drive
rows.short_description: Death Drive is a road trip visual novel inspired by classic American Gothic fiction.
rows.description_html: There isn’t much you need for a road trip, just a car, the road, and enough snacks to get you through. Whether it takes days or weeks, as long as you keep going, you’ll reach your final destination. You just have to keep driving. You aren’t running away from something, but you might be running towards something. People say road trips are better with company; you’ve never really agreed. Still, you ended up with company—it seems like Helia, a strange woman you picked up along the way, means to stay with you for the entire trip.                                At least you’ll have someone to talk to.                         Death Drive is a visual novel that takes place entirely inside your trusty jalopy as you make the trip across the country from your hometown to the ocean's shore. With only your dark thoughts and a mysterious hitchhiker you met along the way for company, you must navigate the interstate highways to your final destination, making decisions, defining your character in dialogue, and encountering increasingly strange and haunting events. Features: Tale inspired by classic American Gothic fiction and authors such as Poe, Lovecraft, and King. Branching Narrative Multiple Endings Complex Characters Full Voice Acting Beautiful and Haunting Art (by human artists)
rows.about_html: There isn’t much you need for a road trip, just a car, the road, and enough snacks to get you through. Whether it takes days or weeks, as long as you keep going, you’ll reach your final destination. You just have to keep driving. You aren’t running away from something, but you might be running towards something. People say road trips are better with company; you’ve never really agreed. Still, you ended up with company—it seems like Helia, a strange woman you picked up along the way, means to stay with you for the entire trip.                                At least you’ll have someone to talk to.                         Death Drive is a visual novel that takes place entirely inside your trusty jalopy as you make the trip across the country from your hometown to the ocean's shore. With only your dark thoughts and a mysterious hitchhiker you met along the way for company, you must navigate the interstate highways to your final destination, making decisions, defining your character in dialogue, and encountering increasingly strange and haunting events. Features: Tale inspired by classic American Gothic fiction and authors such as Poe, Lovecraft, and King. Branching Narrative Multiple Endings Complex Characters Full Voice Acting Beautiful and Haunting Art (by human artists)

rows.name: Poco
rows.short_description: Poco is the story of the world's smallest clown, who is banished from the circus and finds themself in a mysterious undergrowth full of lost and broken things. Explore, meet strange creatures, solve puzzles, and help Poco return to the circus in this charming 2D/3D hybrid point-and-click adventure.
rows.description_html: Poco is a 2D/3D hybrid point-and-click adventure game where you play as Poco, a two-inch tall clown who is banished from a giant walking circus, and left to fend for themselves in the undergrowth of the Below World, where they befriend and enlist the help of the local homunculus population to build a rocket. Explore the beautiful, cluttered Below World... Where everything broken, lost, or unwanted from the Worlds Above comes to decay. Find items, solve puzzles, and engage in interactive minigames to complete quests. Meet and befriend a cast of 5 homunculi: bizarre little creatures representing the 5 senses. Enjoy the deliciously detailed 2D painted backgrounds and joyously cartoony 3D animation.

rows.name: SurfsUp
rows.short_description: SurfsUp is a free-to-play, high-speed multiplayer platformer where precision movement and air-surfing are the keys to setting your personal best time or even breaking a world record!
rows.description_html: Classic surf re-imagined in the Godot game engine. Free to play and made for everyone. SurfsUp is a faithful recreation of the community air-surfing that is designed for both veterans and newcomers. Whether you're chasing world records or riding your first ramp, SurfsUp offers precise movement, a competitive feel, and an easy entry point into one of gaming's most iconic experiences. Features Multiplayer, Your Way Surf solo or with friends. Join public lobbies or host your own with full control over map selection. Surfing Mechanics Perfect your technique in high-speed air-surfing. Ride ramps, carve tight turns, and launch massive jumps with precision and flow. It's all about momentum, timing, and control. Multiple Game Modes Featuring class Surf, Bhop, Climb (KZ), and Long Jump there's variety with every map Daily Map Rotation A new random set of maps every day keeps sessions fresh and helps you master a wide range of techniques.  All maps are included with the optional Supporter Bundle. Classic Surf Maps Play on iconic maps like Utopia, Boreas, Summit, and Mesa, no unlocks or paywalls. These community classics are always available , letting you sharpen your skills on the maps that helped define the genre. Built in Voice Chat Teach, trash-talk, or just socialize. Voice is fully integrated into every lobby. Global and Friends Only Leaderboards Compete worldwide or with your crew. Every run counts. Cosmetic Item Drops Earn tradable player models and surf animations just by playing. Supporter Bundle DLC An optional upgrade that unlocks all maps, custom lobbies, unique cosmetics, and supports the future of the game's development.

rows.name: Four Mini Kingdoms War
rows.short_description: This is an RTS game less than 300MB, but it already contains many interesting game mechanics, There are many types of soldiers and tactics for you to choose. Support LAN online battle. Special Thanks for Pixel Art <Tiny Swords> UwU~ I hope you will be interested in more RTS games after playing :)
rows.description_html: This is a small-to-medium RTS game that takes up less than 300MB on the hard drive, but it already has most of the elements required for a classic RTS game, let you quickly experience the fun of RTS games at any time ~UwU. You can collect resources, recruit soldiers, conquer neutral creeps, build buildings, deploy defenses or gather troops to attack the enemy, and play online battles on the LAN! The resources in the game are divided into three types: gold, wood, and meat. You can send your soldiers to collect these resources. These three resources have their own uses: gold coins are used to recruit human soldiers, meat is used to recruit goblin soldiers, and wood is used to build buildings. Each soldier and building has different ability values ​​and special effects. And soldiers can jump onto the buildings of their own team, and different special effects will be obtained depending on the buildings. Choose the map you want to play: the terrain, map size, resource richness, and distance between the camps will bring different gaming experiences. You can freely adjust the difficulty: simply suppress the enemy, fight evenly matched, or take on the most difficult challenge. Play the campaign alone or play online battles on the LAN, try to destroy castles everywhere in different modes, and win the Four Mini Kingdoms War! Special thanks to the pixel art <Tiny Swords> for the beautiful graphics UwU~ I hope you will be interested in more RTS games and other games using <Tiny Swords> after playing :)

rows.name: Waifu Shop
rows.short_description: Welcome to Vesper Island! Build your harem of sexy waifus, grow your shop, and amass a fortune in this unique mix of shop and dating sim. Recruit lusty workers, uncover the island’s secrets, and become the ultimate Master Trader while collecting all the hot babes!
rows.description_html: Turn your small island shop into a paradise of wealth and lust! Start with a tiny shop and turn it into the hottest spot on Vesper Island, filled with sexy babes and desire. With your trusty and busty assistant, Harmony, and a team of horny workers, you’ll attract customers, expand your shop, and soon enough, your business will transform into a sizzling harem of the island’s hottest girls! Unlock the island’s secrets, earn naughty rewards, and collect all beautiful girls while building your empire! Send your adventurers on daring missions, and watch as they reward you with exotic treasures… and their eager bodies! Each worker and customer has their own story, secrets, and kinks to explore. Flirt, gift, and charm your way into their hearts and beds to unlock steamy H-scenes and deeper connections. Dive into thrilling visual novel-style stories, packed with uncensored sex scenes and animations that’ll leave you wanting more. With surprises and sexy events around every corner, Vesper Island is never boring. So, what are you waiting for, Master Trader? Grow your shop, expand your harem, and get ready for a wild ride: craft, trade, and love your way to the top!

rows.name: Senet: Households
rows.short_description: Prove you're blessed by the gods in this Online Multiplayer Ancient Egyptian Board Game.
rows.description_html: PROVE YOU'RE BLESSED BY THE GODS Play an Ancient Egyptian board game.  Play against your friends on steam.  Learn new ways to play with -never seen before- special house rules.  Customize the rules to your liking.  Experience a story where you travel through ancient Egypt.  All environments are fact checked by professionals.  Senet Households is a free to play digital adaptation of the Ancient Egyptian Strategy Board game senet. Senet households adds to the base rules of senet with special house rules. The game also brings 3 different historically accurate environments of an Ancient Egyptian farm an Ancient Egyptian festival and an Ancient Egyptian Palace based on the Amenhotep III Palace. Every environment has it's own character with an Ancient Egyptian Farmer's Child, An Ancient Egyptian Priest and An Ancient Egyptian Pharaoh.

rows.name: Scrongly
rows.short_description: Scrongly is a free poker themed roguelite deckbuilding game inspired by Balatro. Make one card straight flushes, blow up your whole deck with bombs, play seven card poker hands, and much more!
rows.description_html: Scrongly is a free poker themed roguelite deckbuilding game inspired by Balatro. Make one card straight flushes, blow up your whole deck with bombs, play seven card poker hands, and much more! Start with a standard deck of 52 cards, or use one of the unlockable decks Earn chips by playing strong poker hands Spend those chips between rounds in the shop on new cards to add to your deck, many of which you won't find in a typical deck You can also purchase Baubles, which change your run in significant ways, like letting you earn chips for discarding aces, or giving multiplier bonuses to hands that contain a lot of face cards Lastly, you can purchase unique zodiacs for all 18 playable hand types, from high card to seven of a kind. Zodiacs improve the power of all played hands that contain that hand type, so that you can transition into higher tier hands without losing your investment Ten difficulties to climb through Boss levels that will challenge your builds Variants system that lets you play the game the way you want to. Like always having a certain Bauble? You can start the game with it. Want Zodiacs to be more powerful and cost less? You can do that. Change your starting deck, the efficacy of special cards, the score thresholds, and a multitude of other options Daily games show off some of the power of the Variants system and have a set seed each day. Compare your score with your friends! Stats tracking and old games are stored, so you can see how far you've progressed Unlockable Baubles Save game system lets you play at your pace

rows.name: The Fable of Fairy Glen
rows.short_description: A Richly Layered Story: Explore themes of sacrifice, loyalty, and resistance as you witness the far-reaching consequences of one man’s selflessness. This is a free story driven game.
rows.description_html: The Fable of Fairy Glen is a narrative-driven RPG that merges historical events with a vibrant fantasy setting. Set in a small Welsh village during the tumultuous mining strikes, the story follows a humble farmhand who becomes entwined in a tale of sacrifice, community, and unseen forces at play. As mining strikes devastate the local community, a kind-hearted farmer makes the bold decision to give away his wealth to aid the struggling miners and their families. But his generosity comes at a cost—mysterious Elves, tied to the prosperity of the land, begin to pressure him to capitulate, threatening both his livelihood and the balance of the glen. The farmhand, caught in the middle, must navigate the growing tensions, uncover the true nature of the Elves’ motives, and decide where their own loyalty lies. Key Features: A Richly Layered Story : Explore themes of sacrifice, loyalty, and resistance as you witness the far-reaching consequences of one man’s selflessness. Historical Meets Fantasy : Experience a unique blend of Welsh mining history and Celtic folklore, where the struggles of the real world intertwine with the enchantment and danger of the magical.

rows.description_html: Cat vs Dog War: Ultimate Strategy Showdown! Cute Pets, Brutal Brain Battles ——Only 5% Global Clear Rate! Dare to Enter This 'Adorable Hell'? One wrong step, and your paws will be forever locked in canine fortresses! Developer's Manifesto 'We craft the cutest looks and the cruelest traps—victorious players' neural synapse density will surpass chess grandmasters!'

rows.name: Beastly Bites
rows.short_description: A fast-paced action-adventure where a cursed woman wields an oversized chopstick to battle food-themed monsters. Progressing through surreal realms, will she be able defeat the Food God who's behind her curse and reclaim her humanity?
rows.description_html: A Deliciously Twisted Adventure Awaits! Step into a world where every bite has consequences—and every battle brings you closer to redemption. Beastly Bites follows a starving young woman cursed by the Food God and transformed into a supernatural food-human hybrid.   To reclaim her humanity, she must battle food-themed monsters across magical realms, ranging from colorful festival streets to the grand temple. Her journey of redemption and confrontation is driven by fast-paced combat with an oversized chopstick! Gameplay Features Dynamic Chopstick Combat: Players wield an oversized chopstick to execute fast-paced, rhythmic combos, counters, and dodges, rewarding skill and timing. Transformation Progression: The protagonist gradually restores her human form as she defeats food-based foes, providing both narrative and gameplay progression. Unique Food Foes: Battle against imaginative enemies inspired by cursed food dishes, each with unique mechanics and designs. Immersive Environmental Storytelling: Explore a surreal, magical realm filled with visually rich and narratively engaging locations such as abandoned festival grounds, mystical lantern-lit gardens, and the Food God’s grand temple. Controls Movement: Left Joystick/WASD Camera: Right Joystick/Mouse Interaction:  L1/E Skip Dialogue:  R1/Left click Light Attack: L1/Left click Heavy Attack: R1/Right click Run: B/Shift Dash: L2/Ctrl Targeting: R3/Middle Mouse click Pause: Start/ESC About Us Beastly Bites is the result of  eight weeks of collaboration  by a team of 15 students from  DADIU  ( Danish Academy of Digital Interactive Entertainment ). Hailing from universities across Denmark, we combined our talents in  design, programming, art, and sound  to create this flavorful, action-packed game. This game was made by... rows.name: Veil of Sanity
rows.short_description: Veil of Sanity: Echoes of the Carnival (Chapter 1) combines psychological horror with intense gameplay. Keep your sanity intact as you explore a forsaken carnival. More chapters coming soon!
rows.description_html: Veil of Sanity: Echoes of the Carnival (Chapter 1) Welcome to the haunting world of Veil of Sanity: Echoes of the Carnival , the first chapter in a psychological horror series. Set in a derelict carnival, this game immerses players in a tense and atmospheric battle for survival. Key Features Thrilling Chase Gameplay : Evade the relentless pursuit of a terrifying clown while navigating the carnival grounds. Problem-Solving Under Pressure : Fix broken generators, repair electrical boxes, and locate essential tools—all while being hunted. Creative Combat : Outsmart your foe by luring them into traps. Use tools you find to gain the upper hand and survive the night. Dynamic Sanity System : Keep your mind intact by managing your fear and using rare resources to fend off psychological effects. Atmospheric Exploration : Dive into the dark, abandoned carnival, exploring areas like twisted funhouses, eerie tents, and more. What to Expect This first chapter offers a standalone horror experience that blends stealth, strategy, and light problem-solving with a tense and unfolding story. Future chapters will expand on the narrative with new threats, environments, and challenges. Will you survive long enough to uncover the truth?

rows.name: Bubba Yuga
rows.short_description: Bubba Yuga is a 2-player couch co-op puzzle game based on the Slavic folktales of the Baba Yaga. Playing as a pair of tied together witches, you and a friend must work together with your walking house to capture all the woodland children and break the curse that’s been placed upon your family.
rows.description_html: A curse! The three Baba Yaga sisters have been cursed for their misdeeds. Two of the sisters have been tethered together by magic and the third… well, she’s been transformed into a house! You must work together to solve puzzles, find the children, and lift the curse from your family. In this cute co-op game, players can use their magic to both lift objects and one another to navigate through puzzle-filled woods. Throughout these woods, players will find lost children and bring them back to the house-sister that follows you through your journey. Together, the sisters can use their tether to: Dangle off ledges Pull physics objects about the environment Yank the other player And more! Birds of a feather must work together. Bubba Yuga must be played using controllers. The game only supports local multiplayer. Bubba Yuga was created in 6 weeks by students at the University of Utah for the Master of Entertainment Arts and Engineering program.

rows.name: Cemetery Warrior 7 Boss Rush
rows.short_description: Cemetery Warrior 7 Boss Rush. It is a hardcore 3D Shooter from the first person, where you have to defeat 11 strongest bosses!
rows.description_html: Cemetery Warrior 7 Boss Rush. It is a hardcore 3D Shooter from the first person, where you have to defeat 11 strongest bosses! All the best bosses from the previous parts are collected here: here is a giant worm from the 4th part of the game, and a mighty dragon from the 5th part, as well as a number of COMPLETELY NEW bosses, for which you need to choose a special tactic! There are no restrictions! Just choose a boss and test your skill! Boss battles are quite hardcore and will require the player to study the behavior of bosses, as well as the competent use of the Dash - the main skill of the demon Zexus. If you hit the timing and dodge correctly, you can avoid any damage, but this requires a good reaction and competent use of endurance energy. (based on the principle of souls-like games) The game also has a survival mode, where you can fight with ordinary enemies and set your own survival record. For the survival mode, the player receives special coins that can be spent on temporary bonuses - boosts, in case the bosses still seem too difficult. rows.description_html: Hit and Stand Blackjack is a relaxed 2D card game where you play classic blackjack at your own pace. No timers, no pressure — just sit back, play your hand, and enjoy the calm atmosphere. The only sound in the game is a gentle background music track , designed to help you relax. Prefer silence? You can easily adjust or disable the music in the settings. Features: Classic solo blackjack Over/Under side bet: Guess if your starting hand totals over or under 13 for bonus credits Split pairs for more chances to win Multiple difficulty levels — from casual to challenging (note: on Hard mode the player’s hand count is hidden) Five unlockable achievements Relaxing background music only (no sound effects) Multiple included backgrounds to choose from Customizable audio and language settings Whether you're unwinding after a long day or looking for a chill card game, Hit and Stand Blackjack is your perfect match.

rows.name: Run, Veggies!
rows.short_description: Three unlikely heroes— a fiery tomato, a clever ear of corn, and a strong cabbage — must combine their unique skills to escape a dangerous food processing plant! Leap, swing, and smash through puzzles, hazards, and hidden threats before they end up on the plate. It’s time to Escape the Plate!
rows.description_html: Escape the Plate! Meet Tom, Cornelius, and Cabb! — A fiery tomato with a knack for reaching high places, a clever ear of corn who launches kernels with pinpoint accuracy, and a strong, gentle cabbage with a heart of gold. Trapped in a sprawling food processing plant, this unlikely trio must combine their talents to leap, swing, and smash their way through a maze of deadly machinery, perilous platforms, and creeping threats. Teamwork is their only hope as they solve tricky puzzles, avoid unseen dangers, and face off against more than just machines — These challenges will test more than just their roots. The factory isn’t empty… and getting out won’t be easy. Can this veggie trio make it out before they’re turned into someone's next meal?

rows.name: Heist Royale
rows.short_description: Heist Royale is a chaotic multiplayer heist game where strategy, sabotage, and speed determine who escapes with the most cash! Race to rob a heavily secured bank, outsmart rivals, and dodge security—all while pulling off hilarious tricks and betrayals. Work together or backstab your way to victory!
rows.description_html: Heist Royale is a fast-paced multiplayer heist game where strategy, sabotage, and teamwork collide! Gather your friends and race to rob a heavily secured bank on a mysterious abandoned island. But there’s a twist—everyone is out for themselves! Will you outsmart your rivals, trick security, and escape with the most cash, or will you get caught in the chaos? 🏦 Plan, Steal, Sabotage! In Heist Royale , you’ll need quick thinking and clever tactics to navigate a high-stakes heist. Every match is a race to break into the bank, grab as much money as possible, and escape before your rivals do. 🔥 Key Features: 🎭 Multiplayer Mayhem – Play online with your friends (only private rooms). 🏃‍♂️ Every Robber for Themselves – Work together… or backstab your way to victory! 💰 Dynamic Heists – Security systems, guards, and unexpected events keep every match unpredictable. 🎮 Easy to Pick Up, Hard to Master – Simple controls with deep strategic possibilities. 😂 Chaotic Fun – Traps and hilarious physics-based interactions make every heist unique. 🕵️‍♂️ Customize Your Crook – Play as quirky fruit-headed robbers in stylish suits. Can you pull off the perfect heist, or will you be left empty-handed? Find out in Heist Royale !

rows.name: Restoring the Past
rows.short_description: Restore ancient artifacts in the company of a cat!
rows.description_html: Hello everyone, I’m an indie game developer with five cats. This is a free 2D puzzle game where you restore damaged artifacts from various periods of ancient history. Move and rotate the pieces to complete the restoration like a jigsaw puzzle! Game Features: Each level showcases a beautifully crafted ancient artifact, accompanied by a brief introduction. Simple mouse controls: Left-click to move, scroll to zoom, and right-click to rotate. A nostalgic art style with relaxing background music. A peacefully sleeping cat will always be by your side—come and unwind!

[Gameplay] Try to find all the hidden cute cats in the shortest time, catch them, and enjoy the fun of discovering cats. [Unique Scene] From rural areas to neighborhoods, from markets to New Year, you can find cute cats hidden in various scenes. Discover the cats in each scene. [The Strongest Brain] Through different scenes, exercise your brain, improve your observation skills, find hidden cats, and hone the strongest brain! rows.name: ACS
rows.short_description: What's more American than Fast Food? How about cooking it with guns! Switch between individual weapons to move ingredients, cook and deliver them to your customers before they lose their patience.
rows.description_html: You are an underpaid employee trying to pay off your student loans at Joe's Freedom Burgers, the only Fast Food Joint where burgers are prepared authentically American with the use of firearms and firearms only. Choose your weapons to maneuver food around the kitchen. Each weapon has its own niche - try them all to find out what they're best at. As you are cooking, your boss Joe Hannes is looking over your shoulder - and will routinely point out the mistakes you make. Quality matters - each time you deliver an order, you will get a rating from the customer. They're quite picky - to get the perfect S rank, you'll need to become one with your firearms. At the end of the shift, all your mistakes will be added together. If the customers at the end of the day aren't happy with your performance, you will be fired!

rows.short_description: Differences Online - a game of attention and speed! Find the differences between two pictures faster than your opponent in exciting duels. Unlock new levels and locations, improve your attention, and compete for the top spot in the rankings. Play stress-free and enhance your skills.
rows.description_html: 🔍 Two similar pictures? Only at first glance! 🏆 Spot the differences faster than your opponent and prove who’s the real observation master. Each round is a duel of perception, where the first to find all the differences wins. Play online against real players, prove your observation skills, and climb the leaderboard! 🗺️ Discover New Locations! As you progress, you’ll unlock new themed picture sets. Explore different game settings, enjoy beautifully crafted scenes, and sharpen your skills with every level. 🧘‍♂️ Train Your Mind & Relax at the Same Time! This game is perfect for improving focus or simply winding down after a long day. No stress, just a fun and engaging experience that helps you concentrate and enjoy the challenge. Ready to test your observation skills? Jump into Differences Online and prove you have the sharpest eye!

rows.short_description: Wake up and embrace your new powers. In this Bullet Hell Fast-FPS, dare to take on mystical creatures to defeat the God Raj. Nirvana awaits...
rows.description_html: Wake up and embrace your new powers. In this Bullet Hell Fast-FPS, dare to take on mystical creatures to defeat the God Raj. Nirvana awaits... • A mystical universe to explore A mystical temple with many facets, from sacred halls to forgotten crypts, all linked by a mysterious power of divine might, awaits you. On your quest, discover lost artifacts, battle corrupted creatures and restore the sacred balance. • Fast-FPS Bullet Hell: A daunting challenge Immerse yourself in fast-paced, merciless gameplay where every second counts. Master your powers to survive the relentless hordes of opponents. • The story of Ari, a young earthling with unique powers Ari, unwillingly absorbed into a mystical world, has accidentally inherited the consciousness of several entities. rows.name: Death to the Universe: ACT I
rows.short_description: This game is for people who enjoy classic 3D Platformers, but also have an interest in indie games that combine storytelling, character design and gameplay. Death comes with abilities to challenge any obstacles. Shoot a hookshot to swing across gaps, or wield his scythe to shred any opposition.
rows.description_html: 'Death to the Universe: ACT I' is a story-driven, 3rd person action platformer which takes place at the end of time. Play as Death, voiced by Kevin Miller (Sly Cooper), in a surreal, shattered world where the concept of death has begun to lose meaning. Despite The Universe falling apart, he clings on to the duty of his job. The Universe itself, voiced by Cassianne Lawrence, is a playful and antagonistic character who mocks and challenges Death at every turn. Represented through the map itself and sometimes as a pair of floating rock hands, The Universe tries to maintain control of an assured, continued existence. Follow Deaths existential journey towards the final souls, as he reveals underlying truths about the underlying fabric of The Universe and learns that his job might be more complex than he anticipated. The game is a mix of dark humor, cosmic absurdity, and existential reflection, blending entertaining gameplay with narrative depth. This game is the product of a six week collaboration project hosted by DADIU.

Your task is to find 100 hidden tomatoes cleverly concealed in this serene and captivating environment. With soothing background music and stunning visuals, this game offers a peaceful yet engaging experience for players of all ages. Gameplay: 🍅 1 Level, 100 hidden tomatoes in a lush forest and riverside setting. 👉 Click on the tomatoes as you spot them. Features: Explore beautiful forests, sparkling rivers, and rustic rural homes. No time pressure—enjoy the calm and take your time. A perfect mix of relaxation and challenge for hidden object enthusiasts.

rows.name: Cats & Critters: A Dungeon Claw-er
rows.short_description: Adventure and cast spells with up to three friends in this local co-op, cat-themed dungeon crawler! Explore a coastal forest filled with enemies and loot, and use a variety of unique abilities to tackle challenges as you journey to retrieve the Golden Yarn.
rows.description_html: 'Cats & Critters: A Dungeon Claw-er' is an enchanting party game that casts up to four players as cat wizards working together to defeat the evil dragon Frank and recover the golden yarn. This whimsical, pick-up-and-play experience captures the essence of miniature tabletop adventures with its simple controls and low-poly art style. Grab a few friends to help you defeat pesky critters, solve some puzzles, and earn magical loot. Along the way, use a variety of spells and collect the most sparkles to prove that you’re the coolest cat! Play solo or recruit up to three friends in local couch co-op! Explore an ever-changing archipelago with new layouts each time you play! Discover all 18 whimsical spells and cast them to defeat your enemies! Compete for sparkle points along your adventure to achieve the highest score! Customize your cat wizard with 19 fun accessories and tons of possibilities! This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

With tensions between dogs and cats in the city at an all-time high, however, you will be forced to make moral decisions, fight for survival, and save the city.

rows.name: DUNGEON OF LOVE: Catch Monsters
rows.short_description: Capture monsters, discover their human form, and fall in love with a unique cast of girls while exploring dangerous dungeons. Love has never been this adventurous!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Dungeon of Love! Ready to dive into dungeons filled with danger, excitement, and… your next romantic date? In this world, every battle can change your destiny because the monsters you capture won't just join your team—they might become your dream partner! Explore Dungeons and Capture Hearts Face wild creatures, but don't underestimate them—once captured, they reveal their true form: magical girls with personalities as unique as they are irresistible! The shy sorceress? The bold warrior? Choose wisely whom you charm, as each one has much more than meets the eye. Build the Refuge of Your Dreams When you're not fighting (or flirting), focus on upgrading your base. Train, sharpen your skills, and earn money to gear up for your adventures. Remember, even the best adventurer needs a cozy spot to relax and… socialize! Discover Their Secrets (and Perhaps Their Hearts) Every girl has her story, her preferences, and her special moments with you. Talk to them, get to know them better, go on romantic dates, and unlock unique rewards in your gallery as you grow closer to them in ways you never imagined. Management and Customization: Turn your refuge into a place worthy of a hero and their conquests. Art That Captivates: Every character and dungeon is designed to delight your eyes and your heart. rows.name: I'm Pregnant at 16
rows.short_description: 'I'm Pregnant at 16' is a visual novel about tough choices, growing up, and navigating relationships during an unexpected pregnancy. Personal stories and the consequences of decisions are balanced with awkward moments, chat messages, inner thoughts, and memes.
rows.description_html: I'm pregnant at 16 — A visual novel about tough choices and their consequences. This story will guide you through the heroine's experiences, her search for meaning, and her attempts to find her place in the world. Complex relationships with family, friends, and her first boyfriend force her to make important decisions that will shape her future. In this visual novel, you will lead the heroine through moments of joy and despair, through mistakes and redemption. Make choices that will affect her life, her relationships, and how she shapes her future. Game Features: Deep Characters: Explore the heroine's relationships with her loved ones, friends, and her first boyfriend. Uncover their hidden motives and feelings. Emotional Story: The game touches on difficult topics such as love, responsibility, social pressure, and personal experiences. Serious Themes: Issues like abortion, teenage pregnancy, and coming of age are not just plot points—they are essential to understanding choice and self-identity. Humor: Inner monologues, memes, chats, and awkward situations add some levity to the tense moments. Follow the heroine's journey to the end and discover the consequences of her decisions. The backgrounds and music in the game are partially AI-generated. This allowed us to release the project for free. The characters, story, and script were created by real people. Recommended Age Rating: 16+. By downloading the game, you confirm that you are aware of the recommended age rating.

rows.name: Sound of Survival
rows.short_description: Sound of Survival is a rhythm ego shooter where you have to shoot on the beat. Fight in a cyberpunk City against hordes of robots while you groove to the music. Shoot and hit on the beat to get stronger!
rows.description_html: Fight and survive to the beat against various robots that want to bring you down. Improve yourself each round to face the boss in the final showdown. Sound of Survival is a rhythm shooter with Vampire Survivors elements, offering multiple unlockable levels and difficulty modes. Gameplay Fight against the onslaught of machines in each round. Shoot in sync with the music using the different modes of your weapon to optimally take down various enemies. After each round, you can individually upgrade yourself and your weapon in the shop menu to perform better next round. Choose a suitable song and begin the upcoming round. Shoot on the beat Shoot, jump, and dash perfect to the beat to increase your damage, leaving your enemies with no chance. You can choose from a variety of songs composed specifically for this game. Each song has a unique speed and duration, helping you find the track that best fits your playstyle. Metaprogression After each playthrough, you have the opportunity to further upgrade yourself, your weapon, or the shop to perform even better in the next level. Defeat the boss to unlock additional levels or difficulty modes and prove that you have the best sense of rhythm.

rows.name: OmOneko
rows.short_description: “A story about cat girls … with bite.” Nekos have evolved in the shadows of human society. Beautiful. Mysterious. Chaotic. And now, three of them live with you. Will you be able to get past the stigma and grow closer to them? OmOneko is a tale of cat and mouse... and rats.
rows.description_html: When our main character finds himself as the owner of three nekos – cat girls – his quiet world is suddenly beset with the conjoined problems that having three cats and girls in the house can bring. Overcoming both everyday and not-so-common difficulties, will our main character finally find peace and stability again—and maybe something more? OmOneko is a bishoujo-style game made by fans like you. It uses a text and sprite-based visual novel model with a NVL styled text box. This game was inspired by other passion projects such as  Katawa Shoujo  and  Doki Doki Literature Club ; since those games are free, so is this one! A unique and more cinematic presentation of the choice-driven Visual Novel medium. Three unique routes and ten possible endings. An engaging tale told by unusual characters containing over 260,000 words. Several deep and nuanced stand-alone stories woven together means 20+ hours of story-rich gaming. Original soundtrack of more than 50 songs and variations. Several hundred environmental and character images, and over 200 backgrounds. No AI was used in the making of this game. Extras area including a “Library” to view all manga, graphic novels, and comics that you unlock along the way, including: SinKitty, Nyako Maids, Red Rocket, Cat’n a Rat, and more!

rows.name: Beamdown
rows.short_description: Beamdown is a 3D top-down hack&slash action game featuring fast combat, upgrades, and difficult big bosses. Explore the different planet environments, take down large bosses, upgrade your character, and repeat.
rows.description_html: Beamdown is a 3D top-down action game featuring fast combat, upgrades, and difficult big bosses. Explore the different planet environments, take down large bosses, upgrade your character, and repeat. Beam down to each planet and conduct research for the Societias Philanthropia! Take on varying enemy types and combine your upgrades to create the ultimate kit! Players will play as E.R.O. 4, the Societias Philanthropia’s newest iteration of Research Operatives. Beam down to various planets on a research quest from the Societas Philanthropia! Discover new enemies and customize your abilities to become the ultimate killing machine! Players will play as E.R.O.4—the newest and shiniest research operative robot available—as they crush foes in their way. Fight and utterly decimate each planet’s guardian in the name of the SP! Experience unique and exciting combat scenarios with each boss—reaping bountiful rewards upon defeating them! Create the kit that works best for your own playstyle! E.R.O. 4 is a highly adaptable robot that comes with a refined selection of upgrades to use on its research journeys. You want to dash as much as possible, dive into danger and deliver devastating melee damage? You got it! Want to become lord of fire and burn everything in sight? That’s an option! The Societas Philanthropia has accounted for all your burning desires with the most innovative robot they’ve ever made. Explore different worlds as E.R.O. 4! Find different cultures and ways of life as you research planets for the Societias Philanthropia. Immerse yourself in the universe the Societias Philanthropia is creating, and discover their true intentions.

rows.description_html: About the Game Welcome to Vinyl Drop , the ultimate game for music lovers and collectors! 🎶 What’s the game? Tap, collect, and trade virtual vinyl records. Spin your way through a world of rare finds, legendary albums, and a community that lives for the groove! 🛒 How to Play: Collect Vinyls – Open random drops every few hours. Trade & Upgrade – Use the Steam Marketplace to trade with other players. Build your dream collection. Discover Rarity – Every drop is a chance at Common, Rare, or Legendary vinyls. Start building your collection today!

rows.name: No throwing
rows.short_description: There is only one level of the 3D fixed view integral mini-game.Maneuver the robot to hit falling items and protect the chickens.
rows.description_html: No throwing There is only one level of the 3D fixed view integral mini-game. Control the robot to crash into the dropped items to avoid damage to the chickens and accumulate rage points at the same time, reaching 100 rage points to clear the level. The robot gets bigger with every 25 points of rage. Chickens will die if they are hit by a dropped item, and the game will fail if their number is reduced to zero. Mode of operation: keyboard Move: W/S/A/D Jump: Space Suspension: ESC Toggle Full Screen/Window: F11 Clearance Conditions: 1. Reach 100 rage. End Conditions: 1. All the chicks are dead. 2. Close the game. PS: Watch out for the shadows of dropped items! will greatly increase the hit rate of the robot. Gas cylinders are area damage and are best prioritized for impact. Good luck. 'High-altitude throwing, the pain of the city'
