rows.name: Butterfly X
rows.short_description: A free cute puzzle game from the Butterfly series of games. You can choose any level to pass through. The caterpillar can't jump on its own! It can fly from place to place bouncing off various game objects in its path. It also moves around the level on pipes. Use logic and have fun!
rows.description_html: A free Butterfly X game featuring characters from all versions of the Butterfly series of puzzle games. You can choose any level to pass through. But it will be great if you pass them all, helping the caterpillar to fulfill its mission. As usual, the caterpillar can't jump on its own. It can fly from place to place like a butterfly, bouncing off various game objects in its path. It also moves around the level on pipes. We hope you will enjoy it and have fun! Features - Collect all the flowers to advance to the next level. - Kill bees and bounce off objects to advance to the end of the level. - Use pipes along the way to overcome obstacles in the level. - Moving objects help to pass the level. - There are several paths, find the right one. - Beware of the blue bird, it pecks to death. - The levels are very different, be alert.

rows.name: Cipheur
rows.short_description: Cipheur is a free cryptogram game, allowing you to test your logic and language skills against 100 quotes by famous people. Do your best to discover intriguing patterns, unfold the coded messages step by step, and enjoy the incomparable satisfaction of deciphering another sentence.
rows.description_html: Letter by letter, word by word, sentence by sentence - the work of a cryptographer is far from easy. Luckily, we have you, our talented codebreaker! Take your place at the machine and confront diverse, highly intriguing encrypted messages, all requiring sharp thinking and cleverness to unravel. Step by Step At first, each message will seem like incomprehensible gibberish - convoluted, seemingly meaningless. However, nothing could be further from the truth! By deciphering subsequent letters and words, you will quickly find a pattern that will allow you to decipher the entire message. So much to discover! Uncovering a variety of quotes rich in humor, wisdom, or insight can be challenging, yet with 100 levels to complete you are sure to have enough room to hone your skills and become the true expert. Each new message grants a sense of satisfaction and an insight into the wisdom of the brightest people in history!  Nearly endless content Your decoding journey can continue almost endlessly, with Cipheur offering a rich supply of extra coded message packs. Test your wits against sets like Last Words, Proverbs, Stupid Laws, Uncommon Words and many more! All this wrapped in a pleasant, simple and concentration-friendly visual layout to help you work and relax. • 100 quotes by famous people - fun, witty or insightful - we have them all • 3 difficulty levels to allow you move forward in your own pace • Helpful hints system • Numerous achievements to unlock • An unusual gameplay focused solely on deciphering coded messages

rows.name: Blight's Grasp
rows.short_description: Explore a foreign planet on a journey to find your lost sister and a cure for this corrupted world. Fight through waves of enemies using a combination of this world's elements. Will you be able to piece together a solution or will it already be too late?
rows.description_html: Carve a path through this planet: Battle your way through a variety of environments, and fix broken down portals using power cores you find in the environment. With your grit, wits, and some elbow grease you’ll overcome and overpower any obstacle in your way. String together your on unique attacks: In Blights Grasp you can mix and match your different fighting styles with the alien elements you can harness, creating a variety of effects and combinations. The act of mixing these elements and styles is quick, allowing for on the fly moves and strategies.  Features: A 3rd Person Action Game centering on melee combat. Use your ranged attack to extend combos and hit far away enemies. Collect power cores to buy power ups and fix portals. Navigate environments using your jumps and dashes. Switch between different fighting styles and elements using the radial menu.

rows.description_html: Liquor Store Simulator: Prologue is a free prologue to the game Liquor Store Simulator about building and growing your own store. You start your business in a small shop that you bought on credit. At first, it won’t be easy—you’ll have to work the cash register yourself, accept deliveries, keep track of inventory, and maintain order in the sales area. But hard work and smart decisions will help you turn this modest store into a thriving business with a wide selection of products and satisfied customers. In this free prologue, we invite you to explore some of the mechanics we’ve prepared for you. We’ve created a lot of content, but we’ve saved most of it for the full release, which is coming very soon! In the meantime, add the full version of Liquor Store Simulator to your wishlist and enjoy the prologue! Management Purchase goods, arrange store equipment as you see fit. Alcohol Licenses Buy alcohol licenses. This will give you access to more expensive and premium drinks. Customization Change the color of walls, ceilings, and floors. Make your store unique and unlike any other. Expansion Expand the sales area and storage space. This will allow you to offer your customers an even wider variety of products.

rows.name: Alpha League HD
rows.short_description: Alpha League HD is a free-to-play, hero based Autobattler. In Alpha League, simply pick and build your favorite hero in a Roguelike fashion with 12 different combat genres, and then battle the other 7 Bots or Players to be the winner.
rows.description_html: About us Beaveroid a new studio, founded in 2022, with 6 members. We will continue supporting the game as long as you are still a part of the community. About the game Alpha League is a Roguelike-based Autobattler game. You will choose your favorite hero, build your heroes with 12 different combat genres, and adjust your strategy corresponding to 10+ different maps. There is also drafting and artifacts involved. Download now and try it out! Pick your hero, play each game with a randomized fun map Build you skills and grow stronger Fight with friends to get the best artifacts Be the FINAL WINNER!

rows.name: STAY ALIVE
rows.short_description: A deep web community celebrates Halloween with a live broadcast. Girls are kidnapped and forced to navigate a scenario full of deadly traps for the viewer's entertainment.
rows.description_html: The game unfolds from a third-person perspective. Players take control of girls who must navigate a scenario while avoiding dangerous traps. In this game you will die many times! And in the most violent and agonizing ways possible. STAY ALIVE is a game of trial and error. Discover the limits of your patience and test your skills – how far can you go without dying in the attempt? Bloody game.

rows.name: Supershot
rows.short_description: The best of gaming's golden age with modern functionality
rows.description_html: This is a retro style nostalgic game! It's not just a throwback to the past: it mixes the best of the past with the best of the present! Differently than old games, Supershot has new elements like shooting with the mouse cursor. It's an action-adventure game, in which you will be jumping platforms, dodging ghosts, finding hidden items, shooting ghosts and solving riddles! It has magic, shots, hearts, lives, flight and more! Easy to learn, it is great for kids! It's fun as retro games and complete as today's games! It's simple and fun, you won't have a headache playing it! 24 stages! Gamepads can be configured with Steam! Math Perfect and Good Play Fun and Ironic Parody of Games Contains the full Supershot game

rows.name: The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show
rows.short_description: The incredible Mr. Rabbit invites you all to a mysterious magic show! Celebrate 10 years of Rusty Lake with a new free-to-play point-and-click adventure that promises to delight and… shock you with its sleight of hand!
rows.description_html: Take a seat, get comfortable, and prepare to solve some puzzles in The Mr. Rabbit Magic Show! This anniversary free-to-play adventure from Rusty Lake will take you through 20 whimsically bizarre acts bound to test your ability to think outside the “box”. Don’t be surprised when things are not what they seem… or are they? Features 10 years of Rusty Lake A free to play short but magical game filled with secrets and unexpected twists that will put you in a celebratory mood There will be music... and more A magical soundtrack accompanied by rich sound effects and unexpected voice actors Take a step back A chance to peek behind the curtain of the extravagant magician also known as Mr. Rabbit!

rows.name: Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle
rows.short_description: Pip Puzzle is an action puzzle gem game where you flood your opponent’s side with gems by smashing your own gems. Fight through Arcade, or play online against your friends. Find a character with a unique skill that best fits your play style, and battle through stages that evolve while you play!
rows.description_html: Unleash Your Puzzle Mastery in Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle! Dive into a world where strategy meets chaos! Harness the unique skills of each character to dominate the board: Net gems and relocate them for the ultimate setup. Smash through layers of gems with brute force. Crush your opponents' gems by strategically dropping balls on them. Or, for the mischievous mind, torment your opponent by turning their gems black and white, sending their strategy into disarray! Choose your path, master the chaos, and outwit your foes. The choice is yours in Pip Puzzle: Pip and Ooma's Battle! Ready to play like never before? Step into a world where every stage is a new spectacle! As you solve puzzles watch the icy excavation site melt into a sea of lava with visuals and sounds heating up the challenge. Navigate through a dystopian Tokyo where the fog grows thicker, the music somber, and the puzzles more enigmatic. Explore a scrapyard in the vastness of space, where the silence of the cosmos is broken by clanking metal, and the stage itself comes alive with each move. Choose your favorite character, from a bad-mannered witch with even worse-mannered hair, to an amnesic explorer full of grit.

rows.name: By Bait or By Bullet
rows.short_description: By Bait or By Bullet is a bombastic 2D fishing rogue-lite adventure with both story-rich top-down exploration and action-packed platforming combat, made with Unity and available on Windows and through WebGL!
rows.description_html: By Bait or By Bullet  is a bombastic 2D fishing rogue-lite adventure with both story-rich top-down exploration and action-packed platforming combat, made with Unity and available on Windows and through WebGL! The Rock Beyond Reality - Converse with the curious collection of characters who have been dragged beyond reality as you gear up for your next tentacular tussle. These odd bedfellows have stories aplenty, and more importantly, they’re willing to part with some valuable gear in the hope that you’ll be the one to defeat the sea beast once and for all. Fishing Dock - Play a fishing minigame to buoy your battling power and collect fish from the strangest ocean this side of nonexistence. Time your casts and reels with the mouse to maximize your menagerie of munitions! Maelstrom - Dive into battle against 3 fearsome limbs of a great interdimensional octopus! Use your mouse and keyboard to give Contra and Cuphead a run for their quarters in frenetic 2D run n’ gun boss battle mania as you jump and dash your way to victory (or usually, defeat). By Bait or By Bullet does not feature any controls/input configuration. HUB WASD to move around, and press E to interact with NPCs and buy items. FISHING Use the left mouse button to select your bait on the BAIT LOADOUT screen. You can also click on bait you've already chosen to get rid of it. On the FISHING screen, press the left mouse button to cast your line. To reel your line in, press the left mouse button when the reel prompt appears. To get a better catch, reel in your line when the circle shrinks into the green! COMBAT Use the mouse position to aim your gun, and the left mouse button to fire. Use A and D to move left and right, and LEFT SHIFT to dash left or right. Use the space bar to jump; hold the space bar down to jump higher. If you have multiple weapons, use TAB to switch between them. AUDIO Music and SFX volume sliders DIFFICULTY In Options -> Gameplay there is an assist mode heading that includes Invincibility: Toggle this on and take no damage when hit. +1000 shells button: Shells are the currency used to buy permanent upgrades. Press this each time you want a 1000 shell boost to your buying balance. You can use this to buy upgrades a little earlier, get practically infinite shells, or anything in between. In the Hub/The Rock Beyond Reality right before the dock: Press E to pick up Skipper: Skipper will float around close to the player and constantly shoot at the boss, damaging it. Press E in the same spot if you'd like to disable this feature. Press E to pick up the alternate bobber: The bobber makes the fishing section more lenient. It lengthens the 'Perfect!' window of the reeling/caught portion, and it widens the optimal landing area for the bobber. The probability of getting junk is also passively lowered. Practically, this means more shells and more useful items in combat. Press E in the same spot if you'd like to disable this feature. VIDEO Gameplay brightness + saturation sliders (Disclaimer: These features were not fully implemented. We did not remove it in hopes that this limited version can still help those who need/prefer it. These settings don't apply to UI elements.) There are, to our knowledge, currently no actions the player can take that crash the game. You can enter combat without a weapon equipped, making it impossible to deal damage. In the full game, the current plan is to force the player to take the starter gun (Rotten Salmon) with them every time they fight.

rows.name: Aura Kingdom - Impact
rows.short_description: [Aura Kingdom: Impact] is an anime-style fantasy MMORPG. Explore a vast world, fight with dynamic skills, and switch classes freely. Summon Eidolons to aid in battle. Try the new Floating Cannon class with powerful ranged combos and seamless skill use.
rows.description_html: The classic Japanese anime fantasy MMORPG world, Aura Kingdom: Impact, officially returns with a global version launching soon! Featuring a passionate anime style, stunning characters, and elements of fantastical adventure. Players will experience the brand-new class 'Floating Cannon,' along with innovative gameplay such as Eidolon Inlay and free weapon switching, delivering an unparalleled adventure experience. 'Awaken Resonance! Eidolon Awakening, Fateful Fracas begins now!' Form contracts with Eidolons, connect destinies, and resonate to forge the strongest Ties That Bind! Protect the origin, conquer fate! Venture into the fantasy world alongside your Eidolon and explore the infinite possibilities brought by Eidolon Awakening. Global Version Game Features [New Class 'Floating Cannon' — A technological revolution of elemental Rift!] Harnessing ice and fire elements with the ability to switch attributes, it gains temporary superpower through 'Rift Mode.' In battle, entering Rift Mode allows the Floating Cannon to attack with a secondary attribute for enhanced strikes, neutralizing potential effects between attributes. [Free Weapon Switching — Your combat style, your choice!] No need to retrain characters: Experience different Skills combinations without recreating characters. Freely switch main weapons to adapt to various battle scenarios and craft your unique combat style. [Eidolon Inlay × Resonance System — Create your exclusive combat archetype!] Equip Skills with Eidolons: Alter combat effects and create exclusive fighting styles. Reduce the burden of strengthening new Eidolons and easily cultivate ultimate power. Focus on leveling up primary Eidolons while newly acquired ones can level up using the Resonance system. [Weapon Inlay × Enhancement System — Forge your personalized divine weapon!] Cultivate exclusive divine weapons: Enhance weapon specialization levels to unlock more gem inlay slots. Customize diverse combinations to create your ultimate personal weapon. [Convenience System × Global Communication Without Borders] Origin Helper: Offers features like automatic Item usage and discarding Items for easier character management. Language switching and real-time translation: Eliminate communication barriers and foster connections among global players.

rows.name: Stagees - Just Play !
rows.short_description: Stagees is an interactive music platform where the user experience will be a “short cut” to music playing and gives an instant feel of being able to play the sounds for any song in the world, simply by using only a few buttons. Try out the included songs, import own songs, or check out the Store.
rows.description_html: Stagees is currently free and in Beta, and we are keen to get feedback and development ideas from users / testers !, for more details please check out the early access section. Experience music in a fantastic new way ! Play any song in the world with 2-6 buttons. Choose an instrument and join your favorite band by yourself or together with friends.  Use the buttons S, D, F, J, K, L in single-play to 'catch' the notes as in a traditional rhythm game, but this time you are providing the sounds and playing side by side with your dearest artists. Correct player buttons for multi-play can be found under the FAQ section on the Stagees www homepage. For tutorials and other playing examples please watch the Stagees Youtube channel. Although Stagees is a game-like music playing platform it includes some great educational elements. Go for it, challenge yourself and truly enjoy music like you never thought was possible. Practice a bit and start to improve your personal best in single-play and be amazed how fun it is to play music with friends using Co-op multi-play. Examples of users who will most likely find joy in using the platform:                            Persons who enjoy playing music games Persons who have a general interest in music or are involved in music somehow Persons who would like to learn and understand music further Person who might be restricted to play traditional instrument for instance due to an injury Persons who like to share or gather music experiences Persons who would like to play in a band Persons who know how to make music but do not play any traditional instruments Persons who would like to learn to make music Persons who would like to get inspired to try out other music instruments Persons who have ever dreamed of becoming something in music No previous musical background required, go ahead and Just Play !

rows.name: Relic Hunt
rows.short_description: Relic Hunt is an exciting clicker game where each click earns coins and gives you a chance to obtain rare items for your collection. Gather unique artifacts, participate in mini-games, including poker!
rows.description_html: Relic Hunt is an exciting clicker game where every click earns coins and offers a chance to obtain valuable items necessary for collection sets. As you progress and achieve new milestones, the collections unlock unique features and enhance your stats. The game also includes mini-games, such as poker, where players can compete against each other by betting their earned coins. Collect sets, participate in mini-games, and expand your collection of unique items!

rows.name: Cubey Quarry
rows.short_description: Mine ores, smelt or grind, get money, build your quarry and repeat.In this small free to play game you slowly build up a quarry, either with your friends or by yourself, it's a perfect game to have running in the background and checking up on every once in a while.
rows.description_html: Cubey Quarry is a clicker/idle game about building up a quarry, you can either invest clicks in long term using the drill or grinder, or get some quick and fast action with using your pickaxe and smelter, with all of these tools combined you can optimise your time and build up your own quarry as quickly as possible. You can join with up to 3 other people (1-4 players) making things go a little faster, and it never hurts to share your progress

rows.name: Vast Haven-1 VR
rows.short_description: Step into Haven-1, the world's first commercial space station. Unlock its hatch to navigate through the interior of the station, where you can interact with the storage area, the crew quarters, the Haven-1 Lab, and a stunning, 180-degree view of Earth.
rows.description_html: Step into Haven-1, the world’s first commercial space station. Built by Vast in Long Beach, California, Haven-1 is a next-generation space station, home to an innovation lab for both private astronauts and government missions. In this journey, you’ll be guided by NASA Veteran Astronaut and Vast Lead Astronaut Andrew Feustel as you unlock the hatch to enter Haven-1, navigating your way through its corridor to explore the interior of the space station. Explore and interact with crew storage areas, the common area, the ergonomic crew quarters, and payloads in the Haven-1 Lab. Enjoy an expansive, 180-degree view of Earth through the domed window, and experience the overview effect like a real astronaut. Discover the future of space habitation from the point of view of an astronaut and experience life aboard Haven-1, where innovation meets the cosmos.

rows.name: Hopeguard
rows.short_description: Hopeguard is a third-person dark fantasy game about loss and acceptance. You have been chosen to eliminate the Dragon Queen, but the confrontation will not go as expected. Journey through caves, ruins, and forests to solve environmental puzzles and fulfill your quest -but with a new perspective.
rows.description_html: Your order of knights has been slaying dragons for generations. Now, only the Queen remains and you have been chosen to eradicate her. However, at the peak of the sacred forge, the confrontation will not go as expected… Hopeguard is a third-person dark fantasy game centered on the themes of loss and acceptance. Journey through caves, ruins and forests to solve environmental puzzles and fulfill your quest—but with a new perspective. YOUR CORNERED NEMESIS As the last of her kind, the Dragon Queen fights with the desperation of a dying breed. Could it be that she resists so fiercely to protect something precious? WITNESS THE REMNANTS OF WAR The Hopeguard knights have paid a heavy price in their ancestral hunt. Finding an alternative path through the ruins won’t always be easy. MY FAITHFUL SHIELD! You are trained to survive and your shield has saved your life countless times. THE SACRED CRYSTALS GUIDE THE WAY Ancient, dormant magical mechanisms can be reactivated, but they will clearly need to be realigned.

rows.name: All Abug!
rows.short_description: Faced with the threat of a wave of toxic fumes, embark on an expedition to save yourself from certain death. Gobble up obstacles on your path to allow your caterpillar to move along and board survivors who also seek asylum!
rows.description_html: All Abug! is an adventure in a larger than life setting. Embody a lizard with its caterpillar friend by its side in a cartoony environment as you seek asylum from the Great Dusting. Although seemingly dark, this game will make you blow some air out of your nose with its silly humour. GOBBLE UP EVERYTHING ON YOUR PATH From plants to enemies, use your super long lizard tongue to gobble up different resources at your disposal and use them to your advantage. Feed your caterpillar, destroy obstacles and grapple to new heights with your all-in-one tongue! ACCOMPANY A GIANT CATERPILLAR In the face of danger, leave no insect behind. As your caterpillar friend advances along the path, remove obstacles that block its way and defend it from infected enemies that try to stop you. Feed it resources that cross your path to use its special abilities like a SUPER HOT FIRE BREATH ! BOARD PASSENGERS An unforgettable journey surrounded by insects with unique personalities seeking shelter from the apocalypse. After meeting at the stations, they will board your caterpillar and journey with you to safety, commenting about the events around them. Learn more about this larger than life world through the eyes of its citizens.

rows.name: Highrise
rows.short_description: Highrise is your virtual home, where over 50 million users connect, play, and express their digital selves. Create a unique avatar, design custom spaces, and join vibrant communities for gaming, chatting, and events. With creativity, and a thriving community, Highrise offers endless possibilities.
rows.description_html: WELCOME TO HIGHRISE – YOUR VIRTUAL HOME ON THE INTERNET Step into Highrise, the ultimate social playground where you can connect, play, and express your digital self. Whether you're here to make new friends, build amazing spaces, or show off your unique style, you'll be joining a thriving community of over 50 million people exploring a world of endless possibilities. CONNECT THROUGH PLAY Immerse yourself in a vibrant online universe with millions of users. Instantly join thousands of interactive rooms for gaming, casual chats, or unforgettable events. Chat in real-time via messages or voice and forge meaningful connections. Compete in weekly events to win exclusive outfits and rewards. Enjoy a safe and welcoming environment, supported by our world-class moderation team. EXPRESS YOURSELF, YOUR WAY Design a one-of-a-kind avatar that reflects your personality and style. Customize your profile with a unique background, bio, and favorite items showcase. Share your thoughts, experiences, and creativity through text, images, or videos on the Feed. Bring your artistic vision to life by designing new items in community contests. Build and decorate virtual rooms to create the perfect hangout for you and your friends. FOR THE COLLECTORS & TRADERS Discover a treasure trove of 50,000+ collectible items , with fresh drops every week. Buy, sell, and trade in the player-run marketplace to level up your outfit and earn profits. Spot an outfit you love? Inspect, trade, and negotiate directly from the Inbox. Keep track of must-have items with your personal Wishlist. Use advanced filters and categories to find exactly what you're looking for in seconds. Your Highrise adventure starts now. Step into a world where creativity knows no limits and every interaction is a new possibility. Are you ready? 🚀

rows.name: Good Lord! Everyone at the Reunion For My Religious All-Girls School Is a Trans Man... And They're Hot?!
rows.short_description: Are you really the only woman at the ten year reunion for your religious all-girls high school?! Catch up with your old graduating class and maybe learn a thing or two about yourself in a hilarious weekend romp at a posh vineyard. What could possibly go wrong?
rows.description_html: It's been 10 years since you graduated from a private Christian all-girls high school, and you decided to head to the unofficial reunion hosted by your old bestie. It's a weekend retreat at a fancy vineyard you photograph happy couples at all the time, but when you get there... You're the only cis woman who was invited?! And everyone you went to school with is a hot guy now?? ~~~ Good Lord! Everyone at the Reunion For My Religious All-Girls School Is a Trans Man... And They're Hot?! (or Trans Masc Reunion for short) is a romantic comedy otome game featuring a cast of all trans masculine love interests. Catch up with your old graduating class and maybe learn a thing or two about yourself in a hilarious weekend romp at a posh vineyard. What could possibly go wrong? Features 3 Trans Masc Love Interests All Happy Endings! Original OST Original Character Art Playable Wordcount: 30k+ Goose. Your Love Interests Elias delos Santos the Party Host Pronouns: he/him  Ethnicity: Filipino American Occupation: Wedding & Events Coordinator Your high school bestie, a social media hound, and just about the only person you kept in touch with from high school all these years. He came out to you 9 years ago and has been the singular queer person you personally know (or at least, that's what you thought). You're not sure if you've ever met anyone as simultaneously chill and stressed out as Elias is, but hopefully he can relax this weekend. Angel Devin the Withdrawn Metalhead Pronouns: xe/xem/xir, he/him Ethnicity: African American Occupation: Farming Co-Op Organizer Voted 'Most Likely To Be Possessed By Demons' by the class, Angel used to be the weird outcast whose metal music you could hear from xir earbuds while passing by. Xe has a tendency to wander away from large crowds, but you attribute that to xem being more shy than misanthropic. Honestly, what concerns you more is the fact that no one seems bothered by Angel going off by xir lonesome. Liam Goodwin aka LuciferSatan69420 Pronouns: he/him Ethnicity: Caucasian American Occupation: Social Media Influencer A former Christian cheerleader who preached and practiced 'Modest is Hottest.' In the last two years however he’s made a full 180° to “All Skin, All Sin.” He takes immense pride in the video series that turned him into a star, “ASMR I’m Your Mean Boyfriend.” Will you finally have the chance to get some revenge on Liam this weekend?

rows.name: PolyCore
rows.short_description: Certainly not another rage platformer.
rows.description_html: Polycore A 2D pixel-art platformer with a geometric twist. You are Polycore, a sentient 12-sided interdimensional being, peacefully orbiting a strange, colorful planet—until a mysterious spaceship blasts you out of the sky. Crashing into the planet’s core, you're shattered, reduced to a mere triangle. Your mission: rebuild yourself, piece by piece, and seek revenge. Climb. Collect. Conquer. Begin your journey in the crater you created. Every jump challenges your agility and your mind, as you hunt down your lost sides, each one reshaping your form. As you evolve from triangle to square to dodecagon, your thirst for vengeance increases exponentially. Features: Dynamic shape-shifting mechanics Smooth, responsive platforming built for precision and experimentation Epic finale: Reclaim your full form, return to orbit, and bring the battle back to the stars Will you reclaim your sides and your strength? Or stay shattered forever? The Polycore, an eldritch being of shape and form. The silent fractal adventuerer explores the reaches of deep space, orbiting an unknown planet. Suddenly, as it searches for more shapes, it is knocked into the atmosphere by a ship of intruders warping in. Falling through the surface of the planet, it finds it has lost form and must regain its shape. Trapped within the depths of unfamiliar ruins, with only one way out! Will you help the Polycore utilize and build back its geometry and escape back into the void?

rows.name: Chlorofell
rows.short_description: Master an arm cannon built from the scraps of your enemies, specialized ammo, and quick thinking, to tear your way to the heart of the mechanical scourge threatening your planet.
rows.description_html: Chlorofell is an isometric action shooter focused on mastering quick thinking and manual reloading. You play as a soldier of nature’s wrath, and fight through a factory of environments where plants and technology collide, and squads of enemies coordinate to stop you. With a limited shield covering your fragile amount of health, you can be easily overwhelmed, but through mastering the speed of movement, manual reloading, and the specialized ammo you’ll find along the way, you just may make it all the way to the source of this scourge and have the chance to finish this fight. Tight movement and shooting in an isometric prospective 4 levels to fight your way though 3 special ammo types to discover and leverage Focus-encouraging gameplay with manual reloading and a reload combo system This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Killer Chat! - Original Edition
rows.short_description: Killer Chat! is a satirical serial killer dating chatsim. Play as a (customisable!) writer as you pretend to be a serial killer, get inspiration for your book, fall in love and try not to call the cops through a whirlwind six months with your murderous beau of choice. What could possibly go wrong?
rows.description_html: After asking too many murder-related questions online (for your book), you get an invite to a... serial killer chatroom?!  What the...? Killer Chat! Original Edition brings the award-winning satirical serial killer dating chatsim you know and love to Steam ( Public Favorite & Honorable Mention, Spooktober Jam 2024 ). Play as a (customisable!) writer as you pretend to be a serial killer, get inspiration for your book, fall in love and try not to call the cops through a whirlwind six months with your murderous beau of choice. Who knows? You might find your happily ever after... or headline the news as a gruesomely lovesick corpse. It's honestly up to you.  SO YOU'RE A SERIAL KILLER. SUPPOSEDLY. A reporter by day, an aspiring writer by night: you've been asking all the important questions on the dark web.  Like, how do you bury a body? How do you kill someone with a crowbar with the right angle to cause blunt-force trauma? What's the best way to hide from law enforcement? If you're to write a good crime book, this is how you'll do it. Suddenly, ERROR! UNKNOWN  invites you to a server... with a warning. 'don't be so obvious smh You're Gonna Get Caught'. ... It's a serial killer chatroom. You may be slightly screwed. WELCOME TO HELL, LOSERS! Play as a (fully customisable!) character as you…  Desperately pretend to be a serial killer… just like the other girls serial killers. So they don't kick you out. Or kill you. Oh god, they might kill you.  Get to know some killers. You might as well scope this out, right? No better chance to gather accurate first-hand data for your book.  Huh, they're actually kind of nice?  Oh shit, he's hot. And she's hot.  Maybe you can… date… some murderers? What even is your life. FEATURING WHO OTHER THAN... YOURS TRULY?  Customisable MC! (Name, username, personality, gender, face, body, clothing, accessories, what kind of  pseudo  serial killer you are...) Four  serial killers love interests across all genders (male, female, non-binary)...  Story-rich, choice-based branching towards 8 unique endings. Make voice and video calls to the server's serial killers, listen to voice messages, get them to accept your friend requests, and more! Write your own status, biography, and messages in chat! Four illustrated CG's. Custom-made OST and sound effects. A playtime of approx. 2-3 hours per route, 9-12 hours for all routes. We're planning on adding many more features exclusive to the Expanded Edition (also on Steam!), so stay tuned for the full announcement. However, how much content we can add depends on how much we get funded! CONTENT WARNINGS:  Death, murder, references to abuse, and serial killers... but you knew that. MEET THE SERIALS! AND THE REST... (An arsonist, a slasher out of the '90's, a surfer who trips into killing, a lonely hearts poisoner ... you'll have to play the game, won't'cha?)

rows.name: Cozy Aquarium
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in a beautifully designed world where you can create, decorate, and manage your very own aquarium while enjoying soothing Lofi music. Whether you're looking to unwind after a long day or boost your productivity, CozyAquarium offers something for everyone.
rows.description_html: Just Updated Version 1.02 Major Update 70 types of ambient white noise 40+ ground textures 10+ wall textures 20+ dust and weather effects 900+ new decorative objects, including natural landscapes, steampunk themes, and fantasy worlds 20 types of gemstones that drop when feeding fish Three selectable desktop aquarium sizes Clock and Pomodoro timer can now be freely dragged 31 LOFI music tracks About the Game Cozy Aquarium – Relax, Decorate, and Immerse Yourself Welcome to Cozy Aquarium , an experience that blends relaxation with productivity. Immerse yourself in a beautifully designed world where you can create, decorate, and manage your very own aquarium while enjoying soothing Lofi music. Whether you want to unwind after a long day or enhance your focus, Cozy Aquarium offers the perfect escape. Key Features 🌿 Aquarium Decoration – Customize your aquarium with a variety of aquatic plants, decorations, and colorful fish. Let your creativity flow and craft your own underwater paradise! 🐠 Aquarium Management – Build and maintain a thriving aquarium! Take care of your fish, attract visitors, and earn coins to expand and upgrade your aquatic world. 🕒 Productivity Tools – Stay focused with built-in features like the Pomodoro Timer and To-Do List , helping you balance relaxation with efficiency. 🎵 Calming Lofi Soundtrack – Sit back, relax, and enjoy a carefully curated selection of Lofi tracks that create the perfect atmosphere for your aquarium adventure. ✨ Stress-Free Gameplay – No rush, no pressure – Cozy Aquarium lets you play at your own pace and enjoy a peaceful experience. Cozy Aquarium is more than just a game – it’s a peaceful retreat from the busyness of everyday life. Whether you love decorating, managing, or simply unwinding, this cozy game is the perfect choice for you. Take a deep breath, dive into the world of Cozy Aquarium , and let the serenity wash over you.

rows.name: Campoca
rows.short_description: Enter Campoca, where feel-good activities and delightful interactions are yours to enjoy completely for free! Collect joyful memories and turn your campsite into a charming, heartwarming retreat!
rows.description_html: Step into a world of pure joy with the game Campoca . This game is your go-to feel-good experience, filled with fun minigames and surprises!  Immerse yourself in an interactive wonderland where every element is designed to bring a smile to your face. This game brings happiness right into your heart with very simple controls - just bring your mouse or trackpad! Explore the campsite and earn rewards from feel-good activities and use them to decorate your very own space. Everything in Campoca  is absolutely free to download and play, with no in-game purchases or data collection. Campoca is where wholesome relaxation awaits you. Every moment is designed to fill your heart with the happiness, something much needed today!

rows.name: Ventomori
rows.short_description: In this asymmetrical multiplayer co-op puzzle game, brave the treacherous unknown and endeavour on a deadly, desolate planet. Be the eyes from above or the scout on the ground and work together with a friend to uncover the mysteries and escape from the planet Xanahspati.
rows.description_html: Ventomori is a 3D asymmetric puzzle co-op that places you centre stage as intrepid astronauts on their way to Planet M-113, Xanahspati, hoping to unveil the secrets behind a mysterious distress call. Join forces to brave the unknown, Choose to be the eyes from above on the space station as the Control player or conquer your fears as you plunge headfirst towards planet Xanahspati as the Scout. Work in tandem to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and ensure each other’s survival as you traverse. But be careful, silence here… is quite deadly. Discover the past, reveal the future, Towering ruins of intrigue await in this narrative driven world. Take in the melancholic sights and deduce the history of the unseen Padullurians as you navigate around monoliths of ancient, alien technology and the planet’s harsh, bone-rending winds. If at first you don’t succeed…, Try and try again to hone your experience with each attempt. With every pass, you gain the most valuable of resources. The digital bodies may fade, but the ever-present minds remember.

rows.name: Culinary Wizard
rows.short_description: A magical action platformer following the life of an apprentice chef learning to master the secrets of the culinary arts under the tutelage of a newfound teacher. Journey through magical lands, bring ingredients to life, and slay foes using kitchen tools, all in a classic 32-bit pixel art style.
rows.description_html: Embrace cooking techniques like never before After being fired from a previous job as a line cook, a young chef is hungry for new work. One morning a mysterious job offer appears that beckons you towards a mysterious, magical restaurant. Culinary Wizard is a traditional 2D action-platformer made in a cozy 32-bit pixel art style. Bring ingredients to life and travel between unique worlds, battling hunger one customer at a time. Refine your palette and master the techniques of the culinary arts to deliver tasty meals to happy customers, no matter the request. Game Features Traditional side-scroller action in a retro pixel art style, with a dash of modern zest. Level up with powerful skills and abilities! Smash your way to victory with a mighty tenderizer, throw in a dash of salt when in a pinch, or slice foes to pieces with a cutting edge chefs knife. Take your skills to new heights with your trusty spatula, or roll through the competition with a wooden rolling pin. Become an interdimensional chef and travel between distant worlds to cook for quirky customers with absurd appetites that are almost as bad as their jokes. Spice up your fashion sense with over 15 wacky costumes to wear! Choose your favorite cooking styles to make your culinary journey unique. A vast selection of sweet and savory food-based enemies all brought to life with traditional 2D frame-by-frame animations. Hand crafted environments with seamless parallax, giving that sense of depth to a flat world. A handful of sound effects custom made for each enemy that gives them some extra flavor. 20 trophies to earn and display proudly in your bedroom as you advance through your cooking career. Flexible keyboard/controller inputs that let you rebind buttons to anything you want to best fit your gaming playstyle. Hungry for more? Complete Culinary Wizard to unlock recipes from the secret menu; a chef's greatest challenge! Expand your palette as an interdimensional chef Each new world you travel to along your culinary journey is just as weird as the last, with level layouts carefully hand crafted in a traditional 32-bit pixel art style. As you discover new worlds, a variety of new ingredients become available that make each world feel unique and full of life. Refine your palette and master the techniques of the culinary arts to deliver tasty meals to happy customers, no matter the request. rows.short_description: Through The Ages is a real-time high end graphical cinematic that takes us on a nostalgic journey through three of NVIDIA's iconic GPUs in unprecedended visual detail featuring visuals that push even the NVIDIA RTX 4090 to its limits.
rows.description_html: Through The Ages is a 17 minute real-time high end graphical cinematic that takes us on a nostalgic journey through three of NVIDIA's iconic GPUs in unprecedended visual detail. rows.name: Built to Scale Solitaire
rows.short_description: Have you had a busy day from work? Is the daily grind stressing you out? Try Built to Scale Solitaire, a uniquely designed card game inspired by Zachtronics' solitaires!
rows.description_html: Take a load off your mind with  Built to Scale Solitaire , a uniquely designed card game about building a musical scale, inspired by Zachtronics' solitaire games. ASSEMBLE:  Stack cards in ascending order by suit, but take care around the Widget cards which need to be assembled  in a free cell! BUILD SCALES:  Each card sent to the foundation is part of a scale. Arrange your cards right and they'll all fall into place automatically. TUNES TO SOLVE TO:  Jam out to original music written by GenericArrangements! Warning: they're  very  catchy... HD TEXTURES:  Play with new, 4K-ready card textures, or switch back to classic textures at any time. STATS & ACHIEVEMENTS:  Track your best (and worst) games with built-in stats and earn Steam Achievements.

rows.name: Shojo Warriors
rows.short_description: Shojo Warriors is a fast-paced multiplayer brawl game set in a vibrant, anime-inspired fantasy world, made with『CliCli』. In this game, you'll purchase and combine equipment during battles to help the girls achieve victory through growth and strategic gameplay.
rows.description_html: As passionate fans of Nijigen and action-packed competitive games, the four of us set out to create an intense, fast-paced brawl game. After months of learning and experimenting with the game development tool 'CliCli,' we are excited to present our passion project. Welcome to our discord and share your thoughts! Exciting and Tense Gameplay Mechanics In a chaotic arena filled with unpredictability, defeat your opponents and seize their bounty points. Once defeated, you'll lose your bounty points—there’s no such thing as a permanent lead; a comeback can happen instantly! Unique Equipment System In between the thrilling battles, you can purchase various abilities through a unique equipment system, allowing you to create your fighting style. Crush your opponents in the next round and enjoy the strategy and economic management of the game! Joyful Stealth and Positioning Utilize map obstacles for strategic positioning and master the art of dodging and weaving. Grow and develop in the corners while observing the chaos unfold. Conserve your strength before launching a joyful ambush to snatch the bounty!

rows.name: Take Care (of me)
rows.short_description: My name is Lorena. I don’t know where I am or how I got here. I just woke up in a bathroom, locked in, but I will escape this place and figure out what’s happening.
rows.description_html: Take Care (of me) Take care (of me) immerses you in a first person dark and suspenseful environment where you will have to complete an Escape Room filled with a variety of puzzles. 'Where am I, what am I doing here?' This is the question our protagonist asks herself when she finds herself trapped in a bathroom with no memory and little chance of survival. She tries to escape, and with every door she opens, fragments of her past are revealed, while the shadows of mystery close in around her. As fear grows and memories intertwine, the only way out seems to be confronting the evil that haunts her. Will she escape her own mind before it's too late?

rows.name: WASTED
rows.short_description: A surreal group of generic ATMs acts like bumper cars in an arena, roaming around set on a desolate square quay in an infinite ocean. As a first-person player, you ram into other bot ATMs before they hit you. This is an indie art video game by Studio Alona Rodeh, Berlin, Germany.
rows.description_html: Games for dummies: A bunch of anonymous ATMs act like bumper cars in an arena, roaming around set on a desolate square quay surrounded by an infinite ocean. As a first-person player, you ram into other bot ATMs before they hit you to earn cash. Spoiler: you always lose. Designed for PC, using keyboard or Xbox controller. Play @Kunstmuseumgelsenkirchen or download for free to play at home! This is an indie art video game by Studio Alona Rodeh, Berlin, Germany. It was produced for  Interzone , a solo show at Kunstmuseum Gelsenkirchen (2024-2025) with the support of Stiftung Kunstfonds_SoloProjekt, the Ministry of Culture and Science of the State of North Rhine-Westphalia, Alfried Krupp von Bohlen und Halbach-Stiftung, and Artis. WASTED can be played with an X-Box controller (preferred) or keyboard. X-Box Controls: Up/Down = Accelerate Left/Right = Steer Left/Right Menu Button = Pause/Restart Keyboard Controls: Up/Down = Accelerate Left/Right = Steer Left/Right Esc = Pause/Restart Z = Left Trigger Space = Right Trigger

rows.name: GeoGuessr Steam Edition
rows.short_description: Explore the world with GeoGuessr Steam Edition! Compete against others, climb divisions, and prove your geography skills. Travel to stunning locations, analyze clues, and make your best guess. Quickplay Duels is unlimited Free-to-play, Competitive Duels is subject to payment/subscription.
rows.description_html: The Free edition includes unlimited Quickplay Solo Duels and Quickplay Team duels. In-game purchase of 1 year Steam Pass is required to play Competitive Solo Duels,   or be on an Unlimited Yearly or Elite Yearly subscription. GeoGuessr Steam Edition takes you on a journey around the world, challenging you to recognize locations and outsmart your opponents. Each round places you in an unknown location, where you must use landscapes, signs, and landmarks to pinpoint your position. Face off against players worldwide in exciting multiplayer battles. Climb the leaderboard, sharpen your geography skills, and discover famous landmarks or hidden corners of the world. Every guess brings you closer to victory. Do you have what it takes to be the ultimate champion? In this edition, you’ll compete against players from around the world in Competitive Solo Duels. This game mode is structured around a ranking system and with skill and perseverance, you can rise to the prestigious Champion Division, where the best players face off to prove their mastery of the world. On your way to the Champion Division, you’ll access new features and game modes, such as No Move and the legendary NMPZ.                        In addition to the full Solo Duels experience, you can access Quickplay Solo Duels and Quickplay Team Duels - available for both paying and free users. Team up with a Steam friend and play together against another duo from anywhere in the world!                 The free offering includes: Unlimited access to Quickplay Solo Duels Unlimited access to Quickplay Team Duels To unlock the full Competitive Solo Duels experience, you’ll need to purchase a GeoGuessr Steam Pass inside the game, or be on an Unlimited Yearly or Elite Yearly subscription. General notes: Having a GeoGuessr browser subscription does not grant you full access to the GeoGuessr Steam Edition , unless you have an Unlimited Yearly or  Elite Yearly subscription. Nor does a GeoGuessr Steam Pass grant you access to the GeoGuessr browser version. GeoGuessr Steam Pass holders will be able to cross-play against GeoGuessr browser subscribers and vice versa.

rows.description_html: Holy Hoop is a basketball game, get the highest score possible! Get a random basketball drop every 3 hours to grow your playable collection! How does the Holy Hoop 3 hour drop pool work? First a collection is selected. (Collections are in the drop pool for a limited time and may not return once removed.) Then the rarity is selected: Cloud-Touched (Common) Skyborn Celestial Divine Lastly a wear rating is picked: Playground Survivor (Worst) Street-Worn Game-Tested Court Ready Pristine Bounce Once dropped, basketballs can be played with in game, or traded, or sold through Steams Inventory Service. Features: Basketball in a heavenly court Basketball Skins using Steams Inventory Service Friends Leaderboards Stats Achievements

rows.name: El Pasante Elementalista
rows.short_description: [VR Only] Escape room VR game where you embody a beginner magician seeking to graduate. Enter an ancient crypt to return the golden scroll using your powers and creativity. Extract elements, cast spells, interact with the environment, and combine spells to create new ones in this mystical adventure!
rows.description_html: You are a beginner magician! You are a beginner magician seeking to graduate from the Arcania magic academy, and to do so you must embark on a wonderful adventure to the ancient crypt to return the golden scroll and graduate as a professional magician! But be careful in the crypt there are challenges that you must solve with a lot of creativity and with your powers to achieve it! Extract, cast and combine your powers! As a beginner magician you will be able to extract elements from the environment and then be able to cast them and interact with the environment. You will also be able to combine these elements to create new powers! Solve puzzles in a variety of ways! The ancient crypt is full of challenges at all levels that can be solved in different ways, will you be able to solve all the mysteries with your creativity?

Your objective is to speed your way to the top with various challenges such as lava, time limits, and crashing. Stair Tap offers a variety of game modes, including: Classic - The classic gameplay Race - Race to the 200th stair before your time runs out Rising Lava - Escape the lava in a never-ending loop Lights Out - Scale your way through the darkness Flipped - Classic.. But sideways! Freebie - Enjoy some free money Endless - Do whatever! Can you get the fastest time? This game is heavily inspired by the game 'Stair Tappers'.

rows.description_html: We are a two-person team passionate about tower defense and auto-battler games. We've created a turn-based tower defense game inspired by Chinese mythology and Eastern legends using 『CliCli』. Join our discord, we hope you enjoy the game and look forward to your support and feedback! Features: Enjoy flexible, randomized recruitment mechanics with three tiers of hero cards and various synergy options to strengthen your tower. Take on challenges and defeat elite enemies to earn rewards, unlock bounty missions, and maximize your profits. Focus on reward monsters to test your team’s output, enhancing the power and star ratings of your faction’s 'Hero Towers' through an evolving economy. Defeat relentless beasts and become a legend!

rows.description_html: Soda Splash is the first game created by our two-person team. As a new team, 『CliCli』 is an efficient game editing tool that has helped us significantly in our development. Join our discord, we welcome your feedback and suggestions to help us improve! **Game features** Dive into an exhilarating multiplayer co-op survival PvP game! Unleash your strength, agility, and intelligence to crush your soda cans, and flood the enemy with theirs! Choose your favorite character and let destiny decide your skills! Strategically utilize life springs and the shop to gather resources, grow stronger, and stay on your toes to avoid being surrounded. Team up to wipe out the soda cans—going solo will only leave you vulnerable! Stock up on gear, and with seamless teamwork, achieve an epic victory!

rows.name: Cor Draconis
rows.short_description: In Cor Draconis, players gather a team of magical adventurers, conquering dungeons and collecting enough fossils to revive the dragon that once protected the lands. Grow your settlement into a bustling city, rid the land of monsters, and restore magic and peace to the nation once more!
rows.description_html: A wandering team of adventurers stumble upon a powerful, magically-infused dragon heart. They decide to harness this power in order to create a settlement for themselves and other adventurers. As the town becomes larger, the settlers realize they are not alone, there are small encampments of many sorts of foes, from goblins, to giants, to the undead! After banding together and killing the dragon, the monsters have used its carcass as power for their settlements. However, they must have missed the most powerful remnant of them all, the heart! These fiends have guarded their most valuable treasure, the dragon’s fossils, with their lives. If one could combine the heart with all the fossils who knows what may happen? Features include: City Building - Construct and upgrade buildings to increase your power and to grow your settlement into a bustling city! Dungeon Crawler Mini-game - Explore your way through dungeons and defeat monsters though D&D-style combat.

rows.name: Minimalist Box
rows.short_description: It's a traditional Sokoban game where you can rewrite the classic Sokoban gameplay with subversive physics rules in 4 dimensions , 96 brain-burning puzzles! In the symphony of boxes and physical changes, become the ultimate strategist who reconstructs the logic of space!
rows.description_html: Minimalist Box – A multi-level Sokoban challenge 【About this game】 Minimalist boxes is an innovative puzzle game with Sokoban as the core gameplay, redefining the classic mental challenge through four distinct physics rules. Journey through 96 carefully designed levels, experience new puzzle-solving dimensions from traditional logic to unique themes, and feel the intellectual storm brought by each step in the seemingly simple movement of boxes. ▌Four dimensional themes, breaking through the stereotype • Classic Echo (24 levels) Relive the sheer fun of the golden age of Sokoban and solve retro-style puzzles with precise step counts using the most basic pushing rules in the grid maze. Each level is the ultimate test of spatial planning skills. • Double-sided (24 off) Step into the realm of quantum entanglement! Take control of two different cabinets at the same time and plan the best route in brainstorming! Note: Different chests need to reach different destinations, e.g. red chests cannot reach blue destinations • Gravitational (24 levels) When the box has gravity, the place that looks like a dead end may be the secret to clearing the level! Take control of the gravitational boxes that attract each other, make the boxes attract each other, and plan the best route! Note that normal chests cannot be attracted. • Ice (24 levels, stay tuned) Predict your predictions on the eternal ice! Once the block is pushed, it will slide to the end of the path, so take advantage of this feature to push the box to the end! Every slip is an irreversible game of time and space. ▌Core features ◆ 96 hand-polished puzzles: 24 levels of progressive difficulty curves for each theme, from beginner guide to brain-burning level ◆ Dynamic physics rule system: The unique interactive logic of each world brings 4 completely different puzzle-solving experiences ◆ Minimalist art style: no bells and whistles, enjoy the most original Sokoban! ◆ Puzzle data analysis: Have a record of the number of steps you have cleared, challenge your limits, and find the best solution in many routes! 【For such players】 ✓ Classic Sokoban enthusiasts looking for rule innovations ✓ Physics puzzle addicts crave multi-dimensional challenges ✓ Strategy gamers pursue the thrill of precision computing ✓ Casual users enjoy progressive brain workouts Join this cross-dimensional pushbox revolution now and prove that you're the best master of space strategy in the multiverse in the collision of classic rules and physics anomalies! With each push, the possibilities of the world are being reconstructed...

Once the block is pushed, it will slide to the end of the path, so take advantage of this feature to push the box to the end! With each push, the possibilities of the world are being reconstructed...

rows.name: Bounce IT
rows.short_description: Keep the ball bouncing non-stop, earn high scores, level up, and unlock new skins and cosmetics in this addictive arcade challenge.
rows.description_html: Bounce It is a fast-paced arcade game built around one core rule: Keep the ball bouncing from side to side. Each bounce keeps you in the game. Time your inputs well to maintain the rhythm and stay on track. Across every game mode, the challenge is to keep the motion going while adapting to new patterns, obstacles, and setups. Score higher, survive longer, and unlock new content as you go. Earn experience by completing levels and improving your score. As you level up, you’ll unlock skin tokens to get skins and visual effects to personalize your experience. Core Features Signature Bounce Mechanic A satisfying side-to-side bounce that defines every mode and challenge. Progression Through Play Gain experience by reaching milestones, and improving your runs. Unlockable Skins Customize your ball, bouncer, particles, trail and much more! Endless Score Runs Push your skills to the limit in endless modes. Minimalist Visuals with Focused Gameplay Clean, readable presentation designed to keep you immersed and in control. Developer Note Bounce It is my first experimental Steam project, created mainly as a way to learn and grow as a developer..

rows.name: Project Gravity
rows.short_description: Take the role of a test subject tasked with testing out a new experimental device capable of changing the gravitational pull of any objects it is used on. With this at your disposal, you must complete a few puzzles in this short single-player experience.
rows.description_html: Take the role of a test subject tasked with testing out a new experimental device capable of changing the gravitational pull of any objects it is used on. Your mission is to complete a series of tests designed to challenge the capabilities of the device. Features: The device allows you to change the gravitational pull of yourself, allowing you to 'fall' in any direction you please. Similarly, you can use this device on other objects as well, which allows you to send any object flying into whatever direction you please. As you progress through the tests, the Overseer will monitor your progress and talk to you as you play.

rows.name: Compass of Destiny: Survivors
rows.short_description: Compass of Destiny: İstanbul oyununun assetlerini kullanarak hazırlanan Survivors modu, aksiyon ve hayatta kalma öğelerini yoğun bir şekilde yer veren özel bir oyun modudur.
rows.description_html: Compass of Destiny: Survivors Using assets from Compass of Destiny: Istanbul, Survivors mode is a special game mode that heavily features action and survival elements. Set in the mystical atmosphere of Istanbul, players must survive against ever-increasing waves of enemies. Key Features of the mode: Endless Waves of Enemies: Players face more challenging and diverse enemies with each wave. Dynamic and Infinite Maps: Various maps set in different locations offer players different strategies. From rural areas to historic streets, the game is played in a variety of areas. Equipment and Power-ups: Players can earn new equipment, upgrade existing abilities and gain unique powers between waves. Content Unlocked Over Time: Players can unlock new enemies, equipment and abilities as they reach certain levels. Point System: The time you survive, the number of enemies you kill, and the level you reach determine your score. This increases competition and encourages players to perform better. Strategy Advice: Manage your stamina and limited power carefully. Enemies become more dangerous as you progress, so making the right investments in power-ups is critical. Make good use of the map's features to gain an advantage in tight spaces or scatter enemies in wide areas. Survivors mode offers gamers a fast-paced, exciting and highly replayable experience.

rows.name: Ultranatural
rows.short_description: Ultranatural is a fast-paced PvP arena shooter where skill and speed rule. Battle friends on one hand-crafted map with a single essential weapon. Easy server hosting makes it simple to jump into intense duels or team skirmishes. Pure, straightforward competition awaits!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Ultranatural , a no-frills PvP arena shooter built for quick, competitive fun. This is a student project from S4G Berlin, designed with simplicity in mind to modernize the classic arena shooter experience. In Ultranatural, you’ll face off against friends on a single, carefully designed map, using one traditional weapon to prove your skills. The focus is on skill-based combat, fast movement, and intense one-on-one or small team matches. With easy-to-host servers, it’s a perfect way to settle who’s the better shot among your group. Whether you’re a fan of old-school shooters or just looking for a quick, straightforward game to play with friends, Ultranatural keeps the action sharp, simple, and fun.

rows.name: Lost City of Bardo
rows.short_description: A massive open-world maze adventure game.
rows.description_html: [Official Game Guide in the Community Hub] Embark on an epic journey into the heart of the Great Maze of Bardo, a place where few have ventured—and none have returned. Within the Great Maze, you’ll find lurking dangers, hidden treasures, and new challenges at every turn. Can you navigate its depths and escape, or will you become trapped forever? This game is free to play but includes In-App Purchases to aid your journey. The Save Sword Inventory item grants unlimited saves, making it easier to complete the game. While save swords can be found within the Great Maze, they are rare. The Lost City of Bardo is a vast open-world adventure game. The Great Maze is so immense that you could wander for years before finding your way out! To grasp its true immensity, here’s a zoomed-out view from one corner of the Great Maze: Along the way, you’ll encounter sources of wisdom, valuable allies, and powerful potions to aid your journey. The game’s built-in guide will let you know your current task, and scattered throughout the maze, special devices will help you overcome obstacles and uncover new paths. Even with these tools, the sheer scale of the Great Maze is overwhelming. The game’s task system will always inform you of what you need to do next. Completing these also unlocks corresponding Achievements. Each task prepares you for the next, and although tasks can be completed out of order, you will always know what you need to accomplish to finish the game. The Game has four stages: The first stage of the game focuses on preparing for The Arena. During this phase, you will learn essential skills, including how to gather resources and use various devices within the Great Maze. You will discover how to collect and create crystals, utilize gold and diamonds, cultivate special mushrooms, and craft powerful potions! Once you enter The Arena, you’ll face nine grueling levels that will test everything you’ve learned so far. Conquering The Arena will reward you with a powerful weapon—the Plasma Gun—which is key to progressing further in your quest. In this stage, you’ll need to gather additional resources, primarily gold, and journey to the center of the Great Maze. It may sound daunting, but don’t worry—you now have the Plasma Gun and a new ally to help guide you! This is one of the most challenging stages of the game. Everything you’ve done so far has been preparation for this moment: a journey to each corner of the Great Maze. Here, you must face the three great monsters of Bardo and return victorious, having gathered the four Great Crystals. The Monster of the East In the far eastern reaches of the Great Maze dwells a massive, eight-legged creature known only as Shadow. Her hunger is insatiable, and the skulls of her victims litter the ground. No one has ever seen her—only her shadow. And by then, it’s already too late… The Monster of the West In the westernmost reaches of the Great Maze lurks a dreaded beast known as the Kraken. Its tentacles rise from the inky depths beneath your feet, striking with lightning speed. Only when every last one has been severed will it reveal its hidden treasure. But navigating this place is no easy feat—traps and obstacles lie in wait at every turn, and the slightest misstep will send you plummeting into the abyss below! The Monster of the North In the northernmost reaches of the Great Maze dwells a legendary beast without a name. He resides in a vast abyss, guarding a great treasure. This foe cannot be defeated—but he can be outwitted, if you are quick enough! The Great Crystal he protects is the key to unlocking the final phase of your adventure. With the four Great Crystals in your possession, the final challenge awaits. The Great Maze has tested your skill, endurance, and wit— you are ready uncover the final secrets of Bardo! The Legend Awaits…

rows.name: The King's Legend
rows.short_description: Fight your way to victory by strategically sacrificing, upgrading, and regenerating your pieces. Duel your friends in this fantasy turn-based strategy game, seizing every advantage you can. Let the wiser king become the legend!
rows.description_html: The King's Legend A gritty, medieval fantasy turn-based strategy game where every move is a matter of sacrifice. Sit at the war table as a king locked in a deadly duel against a rival monarch. Across a hex-based battlefield, command an evolving army of Soldiers, Knights, Wizards, and powerful Legends. With each turn, you must make brutal decisions—sacrifice your own to strengthen the rest, upgrade your forces, and regenerate lost pieces to outwit your opponent. Played for millennia, this ancient game is more than tradition—your kingdom’s fate hangs in the balance. Challenge your friends in intense 1v1 battles where cleverness trumps brute force. Think carefully, strike boldly—only the smartest king will rise to legend. A Duel Demands Two.  The King's Legend is a head-to-head experience—built for rivalry, not solitude. Whether side by side or connected through Steam Remote Play, a challenger is required. No friend at the ready? Seek one out. A true duel waits for no one.

rows.name: 19th-century Printing Press Experience VR
rows.short_description: A hands-on educational experience that guides you through the process of printing on a 19th-century printing press.
rows.description_html: Would you like to experience how books were once printed? Take the role of a printer as you are guided step-by-step through printing on a 19th-century cast iron printing press. The printing press you will operate is a virtual reproduction of one owned by William Morris (1834–1896), who used it to print The Works of Geoffrey Chaucer (1896) for his Kelmscott Press. The “Kelmscott Chaucer,” as it is more commonly known, is one of the most beautiful books ever produced, and you will print its title page. The printing press was later owned by type designer Frederic Goudy (1865–1947). The press’s association with Morris and Goudy led it to be nicknamed the Kelmscott/Goudy Press. The Kelmscott/Goudy Press now lives an active life at the Cary Graphic Arts Collection at the Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT). The following team of students, led by Professor Shaun Foster and Curator Steven Galbraith, brought the press to life in a VR setting. Lead on the app:  Aidan Grant  Danielle Bertone, Bailey Cohen, Zach Darrow, Sam Donez (Lead), Aidan Grant (Lead), Caspian Halbert, Morgan Hamilton, Sean Herman (Lead), Devin Klibanow (Lead), Andrew Lytle, Matthew Mouthon, Grant MacWilliam, Hunter Ostrander, Jessica Torregrossa, Hannah Wertz, and Boyu Xu.   Initial work began with a BreakThru Grant from the Rochester Regional Library Council.

rows.name: Trapventure
rows.short_description: A tough, rage-inducing platformer where you solve puzzles, dodge traps, and navigate through deadly obstacles to escape a cursed fortress. Good for players who love a challenge and don’t mind a little frustration along the way.
rows.description_html: Trapventure is a tough but fun medieval adventure where you’ll be solving tricky puzzles, dodging deadly traps, and battling skeletons. Play as an archer and test your reflexes and brainpower as you jump across floating platforms, face off against enemies, and work your way through dangerous environments. It's a challenge, but that’s all part of the fun! Key Features: Traps & Puzzles : Solve puzzles and avoid traps that’ll test your timing and smarts. Platforming Fun : Jump, dodge, and time your movements. Rage-Inducing Challenge : It's designed to make you sweat. Expect to fail, expect to try again, and expect to love the thrill of overcoming tough obstacles. A Note from the Developer Trapventure is my first fully completed game, developed solo while I was learning game development. Starting from a background in Level and Game Design, I pushed myself to learn more about programming and game creation through tutorials and personal effort. This game is the result of that journey, a small but intense adventure filled with challenges. I hope you enjoy the experience as much as I enjoyed making it. Thank you for playing!

rows.name: Shrimp Keeping Simulator
rows.short_description: Grow, feed and care for your shrimp pals. Watch your shrimp multiply and sell your colony when they become too numerous.
rows.description_html: Grow, feed and care for your shrimp pals. Watch your shrimp multiply and sell your colony when they become too numerous. Gameplay Loop! You start with an empty aquarium which you can decorate a little bit and buy some shrimp for. After adding some plants and ghost shrimp you'll need to feed and otherwise care for your shrimp. When you get too many shrimp you can sell them to make money and then buy another species or more decorations! The game features around 30 minutes of gameplay but can be played for longer if you really like shrimp. Features: 2 shrimp species Feeding Aquascaping Cute lads

rows.short_description: Idle Commonwealth is an idle game that pays homage to the best of the idle genre. Start small, grow your commonwealth, maintain morale, establish governance, invent technologies, trade and conquer your neighbors.
rows.description_html: Idle Commonwealth is a incremental game where you will develop your community, increase the population, construct buildings, assign your residents to various professions, set taxes and governance, discover new technologies, and establish relations with other nations. Main Features: collect and produce various resources build workplaces as well as housing for your population research new technologies to unlock further development opportunities establish the type of government and set tax rates discover other nations trade with or conquer your neighbors earn in-game achievements to enhance your capabilities prestige to boost your production and unlock new content The game is still evolving! The upcoming updates will include features such as genetic modifications for the population, space colonization, and more...

rows.name: Magic Soldier
rows.short_description: Embark on an epic journey in Magic Soldier, a 2D open-world MMORPG. Explore vast landscapes, fight powerful foes, craft unique items, and team up with players worldwide. Adventure awaits, shape your destiny today !
rows.description_html: Dive into a breathtaking fantasy world with Magic Soldier ! Discover a 2D open-world MMORPG where exploration, adventure, and strategy come together. Embark on a journey in a rich and vibrant universe where every decision shapes your destiny. Explore a vast world filled with mysteries, dungeons, and hidden treasures. Take on epic challenges by battling formidable bosses and hordes of enemies. Create your unique hero with customizable skills, equipment, and styles. Forge alliances with other players to overcome challenges or engage in thrilling PvP battles. Experience crafting and economy by gathering resources, crafting items, and trading to thrive.                 Join a growing community and dive into an unforgettable adventure !               Open-World Exploration : Roam a vast and vibrant fantasy world filled with secrets, quests, and hidden treasures. Epic PvE Combat : Battle dangerous creatures, challenging bosses. Epic PvP Combat : Engage in epic battles in the PvP arena with a ranking system for the 'Magic Soldier number 1' title, earning points through victories and losing them through defeats. Profession System : Perfect all 7 available professions to gather resources, craft powerful items, and boost your gameplay potential. Character Customization : Choose your class, skills, and equipment to build a hero that reflects your playstyle. Skill Enhancement System: Improve and optimize your character’s skills to maximize your potential and become the ultimate soldier. Trading System : Buy, sell, and trade items with other players or merchants based on the variety and value of the items. Enchantment System : Enchant your gear multiple times to enhance its stats and unlock the maximum potential for endless progression. Upgrade System : Upgrade your gear up to +10, with success and failure mechanics. Use special items to prevent level loss and push your equipment to its full potential. Multiplayer Experience : Join forces with players worldwide for cooperative missions or compete in player vs player arenas. Wild Zones : Enter dangerous wild zones where PvP is permitted, and be cautious as high-level players may risk losing items in these areas. Karma System : In wild zones, killing another player increases your karma. At certain thresholds, your name's color changes, showing your assassin rank. Karma resets only if you're killed in a wild zone. Guild System : Create or join a guild to share resources, and work together to dominate the world of Magic Soldier !         Secret Zones : Discover hidden areas with extremely powerful bosses that drop unique items. Instance System : Face challenging instances in Normal or Elite mode (for the brave) either solo or in teams to earn exclusive rewards. Survival Mode :  Take on survival instances, where each round brings tougher challenges and loot that varies based on the rounds you've survived.          Codex System :  Track your global progress throughout the game in the Codex. Once you complete it 100%, unlock a unique item that will set you apart from other players. Teleportation System :  Once you discover the relevant areas in the game, the teleportation system will allow you to quickly travel between them for easier exploration. Bestiary System :  Once you've gathered information about a monster, you can view its loot, attack types, and defense types in the bestiary to help you strategize your battles. Embark on your journey today and prove you're ready to conquer all that this world has to offer, with over 150 hours of gameplay waiting for you !
