Take on epic challenges by battling formidable bosses and hordes of enemies. Create your unique hero with customizable skills, equipment, and styles. Forge alliances with other players to overcome challenges or engage in thrilling PvP battles. Experience crafting and economy by gathering resources, crafting items, and trading to thrive.                 Join a growing community and dive into an unforgettable adventure !               Open-World Exploration : Roam a vast and vibrant fantasy world filled with secrets, quests, and hidden treasures. Epic PvE Combat : Battle dangerous creatures, challenging bosses. Epic PvP Combat : Engage in epic battles in the PvP arena with a ranking system for the 'Magic Soldier number 1' title, earning points through victories and losing them through defeats. Profession System : Perfect all 7 available professions to gather resources, craft powerful items, and boost your gameplay potential. Character Customization : Choose your class, skills, and equipment to build a hero that reflects your playstyle. Skill Enhancement System: Improve and optimize your character’s skills to maximize your potential and become the ultimate soldier. Trading System : Buy, sell, and trade items with other players or merchants based on the variety and value of the items. Enchantment System : Enchant your gear multiple times to enhance its stats and unlock the maximum potential for endless progression. Upgrade System : Upgrade your gear up to +10, with success and failure mechanics. Use special items to prevent level loss and push your equipment to its full potential. Multiplayer Experience : Join forces with players worldwide for cooperative missions or compete in player vs player arenas. Wild Zones : Enter dangerous wild zones where PvP is permitted, and be cautious as high-level players may risk losing items in these areas. Karma System : In wild zones, killing another player increases your karma. At certain thresholds, your name's color changes, showing your assassin rank. Karma resets only if you're killed in a wild zone. Guild System : Create or join a guild to share resources, and work together to dominate the world of Magic Soldier !         Secret Zones : Discover hidden areas with extremely powerful bosses that drop unique items. Instance System : Face challenging instances in Normal or Elite mode (for the brave) either solo or in teams to earn exclusive rewards. Survival Mode :  Take on survival instances, where each round brings tougher challenges and loot that varies based on the rounds you've survived.          Codex System :  Track your global progress throughout the game in the Codex. Once you complete it 100%, unlock a unique item that will set you apart from other players. Teleportation System :  Once you discover the relevant areas in the game, the teleportation system will allow you to quickly travel between them for easier exploration. Bestiary System :  Once you've gathered information about a monster, you can view its loot, attack types, and defense types in the bestiary to help you strategize your battles. Embark on your journey today and prove you're ready to conquer all that this world has to offer, with over 150 hours of gameplay waiting for you !

rows.name: Juggling
rows.short_description: It's a game where you just keep clicking. Click to see the girl juggling.
rows.description_html: It's a game where you just keep clicking. Keep clicking anywhere on the game screen. No operations other than clicking are possible. The girl juggles the soccer ball every time you click. If you continue juggling a certain number of times, the background image may change.

rows.name: The Void Chronicles Chronis
rows.short_description: Every decision matters. It’s a race against the clock in a story where paranoia, creativity, and courage are your only allies. Will you break the loop, or will time break you?
rows.description_html: Artemis, a struggling writer who doesn't believe in himself. On July 7, 1947, he finds a mysterious pocket watch on his porch. He thinks nothing of it until something happens to his neighbour, and all of a sudden time has restarted to when he woke up. Can Artemis find out the source of the time loop and figure out how to break it? Game Features -Figure out what in Artemis's routine must change to progress forward. -Meet Artemis's cheerful neighbour named Melody, who is always ready to help. -Immerse yourself in the 1940s aesthetic. -Narrative Driven Experience -A free time-loop game where every reset reveals a new layer of the mystery. Presented by JBOStudios and brought to life by the brilliant mind of the solo-developer at Soul Narrative Games, this experience sheds new light on the time loop genre!

rows.name: LATEX, LEATHER, LIPSTICK, LOVE, LUST
rows.short_description: A self-described 'chronically online' trans guy goes to a kink club thinking it will fix him. It doesn't.
rows.description_html: 'My social circles are divided into three, stalwart, mutually exclusive groups. A first of chronically online Tumblr users. I've drifted in and out of several and now exist in one with next to no ties to my home country. A second of extremely normal heterosexuals. The worst they've seen are Instagram wellness reels and Discord does not exist to them. And now, apparently, a third of rubber-coated kinksters who want to rearrange my guts. I feel like someone like me shouldn't have a third. ” LATEX, LEATHER, LIPSTICK, LOVE, LUST is an interactive fiction piece for unemployed British trans men in their 20s with no career prospects whose only major social interactions happen over Discord. Other people can play it as well, I guess. Play the game (for free!) that had people giving such rave reviews as: 'So beautiful, so intense, so funny.' 'I almost cried at several points, and ended up crying at the end.' 'dear god this was an experience' 'the first interactive fiction to make me feel *actually* anxious and afraid' '[slurs]' And won the most controversial entry in IFComp 2024!

rows.name: Endless Horizons
rows.short_description: You have landed on another planet to fulfill your hero duties. This is your life that you love. Save the Jellyfish from their Shark Adversaries.
rows.description_html: Endless Horizons is a walking simulator that deals with the problem of seeking validation through others and how it grows old and exhausting as time goes on.  You will land on an alien planet with the task of helping the native Jellyfish people. You use your electricity ball to remove the invasive shark species from the Jellyfish homes. Along the way you will learn more about what motivates you as a person and the internal struggles of Commander Storm. Features - A compelling narrative about what drives Captain Storm - A cool alien planet with habitants to walk around and explore - Electricity Powers to help the native people

rows.name: FIND ALL 7: Japan
rows.short_description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 7: Japan! You will have to explore the unique scenery of an ancient temple and a colorful summer festival. Look for hidden items and color this mysterious painted world.
rows.description_html: Hidden in the sakura branches, the ancient temple holds many secrets. The summer festival is in full swing, and even the Yokai have come to visit. You will have to find all the hidden objects in this area, so that the black and white world will be painted in bright colors and come to life. You decide what items you want to find! Enjoy the game with atmospheric music. Suitable for the whole family Game features: - 150 search items - Option to choose the item you want to search for - Increasing level of difficulty - There is a hint - Interactivity. Items can also be searched inside buildings - The world is populated by inhabitants, each one has a story to tell - Coloring levels - 2.5D effect - Possibility to meet Yokais

rows.name: Kombi
rows.short_description: Kombi is a fun, minimalist, grid-based puzzle game. The aim of the game is to move tiles across the board, picking up points along the way, in order to end up with a single tile with a value that matches the number of the target tile.
rows.description_html: Kombi is a fun, minimalist, grid-based puzzle game. The aim of the game is to move tiles across the board, picking up points along the way, in order to end up with a single tile with a value that matches the number of the target tile. While it starts off simple, the later campaign levels introduce enough complexity to keep you entertained and scratching your head for hours. And once you've completed the campaign levels, you are free to enjoy an unlimited selection of custom levels, allowing you to play the game indefinitely. There are no limitations or locked levels, each level can be completed in any number of turns, though there is a special completion badge awarded if a level is completed within a certain number of turns. Features 100 campaign levels of various grid sizes A custom level generator allowing you to choose any difficulty you want Minimalist design Relaxing background music Unlimited UNDO options if you make a mistake 4 different themes, including dark mode

rows.name: Auto Adventures
rows.short_description: This is a free hero builder auto-battler. Embark on a rogue-like adventure choosing items and skills to make the most powerful hero you can, all the while auto-battling against other players!
rows.description_html: Auto Adventures is a free asynchronous PvP hero builder that combines the strategic decision making of a rogue-like with auto-battles against other players. Throughout your adventure you will choose items and skills to make the strongest hero you can while auto-battling other players until you achieve 10 victories, or die trying! This game features: Hundreds of unique items each with different abilities and effects. Choose items that synergize well with each other to create crazy powerful heroes! Dozens of different monster encounters. Defeat monsters to take their items! Find rare and powerful items from strong monsters. Several different archetypes of items, and skill stats for each. When you level up, choose to allocate your stat points to become better at using certain kinds of items. Asynchronous PVP: During each round you make choices to improve your character, such as buying items or defeating monsters. At the end of each round you then auto-battle against another player's character in a PvP matchup. We use an asynchronous match-making system which means that you can take as long (or as short!) as you want to make your turn. There are no round time limits. A globally shared item pool: When players use an item, that item becomes rarer and will show up in shops less often. This system automatically ensures that over-powered and popular items will stop appearing, thereby keeping the meta fresh and dynamic.

rows.name: Clay Beats
rows.short_description: Clay Beats is a casual couch co-op rhythm game where two players take on two kindred cats who aim to become masters in their craft... pottery! Embark on an adventure, meet new clients, and become the pawttery masters of Potteria!
rows.description_html: Get together with your friend, slap yourselves down onto a couch, and prepare for a Cattacular  time! Clay Beats  is a rhythm-based co-op game where you and your bestie get together to craft pottery for desperate customers in need! In the village of Potteria you two play as orange and black fuzzballs, cats training to be pawtastic  pottery partners! Play through several unique songs, meet whacky characters, and work together to become  pawttery  masters! Features Immerse yourselves in a casual couch co-op experience! Encounter unique and comedic characters! Play through seven engaging levels and custom-made songs! Enjoy the sights the village of Potteria has to offer! Create custom cat-made ceramics! Work together to become the pottery masters of Potteria! Requirements 2 controllers are required to play the game!

rows.name: Stele
rows.short_description: Stele is a challenging and intellectually stimulating puzzle game where players need to utilize movable stone pillars and plan their routes to trigger a series of events, paving the way for a small square to reach its destination smoothly.
rows.description_html: Stele is a challenging and intelligent puzzle game filled with problem-solving and decryption. The game features four chapters, encompassing a total of 96 meticulously crafted levels. Each level tests players' logical thinking and strategic planning abilities. Gameplay Mechanics Players need to utilize movable stone pillars and plan their routes to trigger a series of events, paving the way for small squares to reach their destinations smoothly. However, you must consider the element of 'timing' as setting complicated routes will consume more time, but sometimes it becomes a necessary means to clear the level. The game includes various mechanisms, and triggering them can introduce multiple possibilities, leading to unexpected ways to complete the level.

rows.name: Bygone Dreams: Prophecy
rows.short_description: Bygone Dreams: Prophecy is a free prologue for a high fantasy Action-Adventure game set inside a surreal dream world. Face fantastical adversaries, solve puzzles, and fight your way through challenging bosses in your quest to save the world's matron deity and stop the nightmare consuming the dream.
rows.description_html: Bygone Dreams: Prophecy is a prologue version of the full game Bygone Dreams, it features the first 2 levels with 2-3 hours of gameplay depending on difficulty settings and your skills. VANQUISH THE NIGHTMARE, RESTORE THE DREAM Winner of the Reboot Develop 'Visual Excellence' award. Winner at the 2021 WN Dev Contest as chosen by Epic Games. Bygone Dreams is a high fantasy action adventure with RPG elements set in a surreal dream world. The dream land of Lume, under the protection of its matron deity, is being threatened by a terrible Nightmare. Embodying the spirit known as Wa, you are the world's last hope for survival. To aid you in your quest, you must seek out the world's Guardians - powerful creatures worshiped and revered in times long before the corruption seeped in. However, the task ahead is anything but easy, as the Guardians themselves succumbed to the Nightmare. FEATURES Explore the dream-land of Lume, a vast world full of mystery and danger. Face dozens of epic bosses standing in the way between you and the salvation of the Dream. Fight your way through the game using a combination of melee weapons, ranged weapons, and magic. Customize your equipment to suit your play style. Experience the story on Normal difficulty or get ready for an exceptional challenge on Heroic mode - a ramped up difficulty featuring revamped boss fights and additional Heroic-only bosses. Unlock handcrafted higher difficulty levels. Experience the epic story with over 2 hours of fully voiced cutscenes. Show your mastery in special time trial and no damage boss challenges. The game will take players on an inspirational adventure featuring elements from Slavic mythology and medieval Bosnian folklore. An epic orchestral soundtrack will set the tone of the journey in over 50 original songs full of traditional instruments and melodies. Take a leap into the world of Bygone Dreams and prepare yourself for an unforgettable experience!

rows.name: Deeper Underground
rows.short_description: Trapped underground after a nuclear apocalypse, a fake survival expert must face the fallout of his lies. Build, scavenge, and lead your community in this darkly comedic survival game where every choice matters.
rows.description_html: Trapped underground after a nuclear apocalypse, an unqualified survival “expert” must now lead a growing community of followers who believe in his every word. In Deeper Underground , you must scavenge, build, and lead while keeping morale high and your lies intact. Manage resources, make tough choices, and navigate the psychological pressure of maintaining your fake expertise—because if the truth gets out, survival might be the least of your worries. Key Features: Base Building & Resource Management – Construct and expand your underground shelter, ensuring your community has enough food, water, and supplies. Scavenge the Ruins – Venture into the wasteland in search of valuable resources, but be wary of dangers lurking in the darkness. Choice-Driven Narrative – Shape the story with the lies you tell and the decisions you make—will you admit the truth or keep up the façade? Dynamic Community System – Manage followers with different personalities, needs, and levels of trust in you. Keep them loyal… or risk rebellion. Survival Mechanics – Monitor hunger, radiation exposure, and mental well-being as you fight to stay alive in a crumbling world. Moral Dilemmas – Sacrifice individuals for the greater good, hoard resources, or inspire hope—your leadership style will define your fate. Can you keep your followers alive… and your secret hidden?

rows.name: Brews & Blood: Origin
rows.short_description: Brews & Blood is a Atmospheric Horror game where you manage your uncle's liquor shop for one night in a remote Indian village.
rows.description_html: ' Brews & Blood: Origin' is a Atmospheric Horror game where you need to manage a liquor shop in a remote Indian village and escape it's horror. Story: Your uncle calls you for a last-minute favor—he needs you to cover a one-night shift at his liquor shop in a remote Indian village. But why did your uncle choose to hand over his shop to someone else on the very night of the Red Moon? The truth is revealed as the night unfolds.  One shift. One cursed night. Will you survive the horrors of the Red Moon? Gameplay: First-Person Horror Simulation: Manage the liquor shop, serve customers, and complete small tasks—until the horror takes over. Deep Atmospheric Horror: A slow-burn experience where fear creeps in through eerie silence, disturbing visuals, and unsettling encounters. Horror Chase Sequences: As the curse takes hold, terrifying entities will hunt you—run, hide, or find a way to fight back. Car Driving Mechanics: Escape through the haunted village in a desperate drive for survival, but the roads may not lead where you expect.

rows.name: Gladiator Rumble
rows.short_description: Where your audience transforms into fierce gladiators, ready to fight for glory in the ultimate Twitch-integrated battle simulator.
rows.description_html: Welcome to Gladiator Rumble! Where your audience transforms into fierce gladiators, ready to fight for glory in the ultimate Twitch-integrated battle simulator. 🔹 What Is Gladiator Rumble? Gladiator Rumble is a unique game built for streamers and their communities. rows.name: Speedway Challenge 2025
rows.short_description: Feel speedway emotions thanks to realistic riding physics. Play online mode with friends or local in career mode, league mode, challenges, tournament and quick matches. Are you ready for the challenge?
rows.description_html: Put your kevlar and helmet on, get on your motorcycle without brakes and hit the track for glory in the 'Speedway Challenge 2025' game! This product will allow you to fulfill all your speedway dreams - become the next world champion, as well as lead your beloved club to the league pedestal. The path of your individual or club career is up to you. Game modes waiting for the player: - Quick Match - a quick way to stand with your rivals under the tape and fight a fierce battle for victory! Choose the teams, indicate the location and go, because the referee has started the two-minute clock, so it would be a shame to be late for the first race. - Career (after in app purchase) - create a new virtual rider or choose one of over a thousand available riders and lead his career according to your own discretion. It's up to you whether you'll become a speedway globetrotter or lead a quiet life and riding once or twice a week. - League (after in app purchase) - build a club from scratch or choose one of the available centers and lead it to the very top in one of several European leagues. Make sure to have a team that complies with the regulations, but remember to be able to afford the salaries. The medal will be the summary of your hard work. - Challenges - accept the challenge and do the task that awaits you. Achieve a specific result as a team or individually, win expected number of times or do not let the rival achieve a significant score. - Online - test your skills in a confrontation with players from all around the world in the ranking game or invite a group of friends (after in app purchase) to play together. You will compete on almost 70 tracks from all over the world - from South America, through the Antipodes to Europe, with competitors who have been precisely reproduced in terms of skill level and riding silhouette. Each competition will be held in accordance with the applicable rules of speedway sport.

rows.name: Defend the vault
rows.short_description: You're a gun at a bank in front of a vault. There are robbers approaching to destroy the vault. You must shoot the enemies to defend the bank vault to prevent the robbers from getting in. Keep it going.
rows.description_html: A very simple, casual, relaxing shooting game. All you have to do is defend the bank vault by shooting the red enemies. Don't let them destroy the vault. Game is an endless enemy game. Game ends when the bank vault is destroyed. Game is very simple. Controls are: W: Move up S: Move down Space: Shoot Player can also wrap around the screen if too high or too low. Useful if enemy spawns far away from you. Game was made with Unity Engine.

rows.name: Panic Room: Ghosts of the Past
rows.short_description: What awaits a prisoner who wakes up in the house of a host known for his cruel games?
rows.description_html: You find yourself in a dark, ominous mansion. Twilight, creaking floorboards, whispers from the void... The house is full of visions of the past and ghostly shadows lurking in dark corners. At every moment, you feel the hostile gaze of an invisible observer between your shoulder blades. To find a way out, you must explore the rooms, peer into the most hidden corners, search for keys, solve puzzles, and complete tasks. Nothing here is accidental – every action affects your future fate. You must make a choice: join the Followers or go into the Underground. But what if both paths are part of someone else's game? Who can you trust when every word could be a lie, and any help could be a carefully planned trap? Something greater is happening behind the scenes. Someone is pulling the strings, arranging the pieces, and setting the rules. Are you a puppet or a puppeteer? Unravel the conspiracy. Learn the terrible truth. Walk the path from a pawn to a player. It's not an ordinary story. It's 'Panic Room: Ghosts of the Past', where escape is just an illusion. Are you ready to fight for freedom? The game offers you: ·        A non-linear, captivating plot that holds your attention from the first minutes. ·        Detailed locations with realistic textures that create a deep immersion in the world of the mysterious mansion. ·        A variety of puzzles, collections, and mini-games in the hidden object genre. ·        Several modes of searching for objects for diverse gameplay. ·        The ability to add friends, communicate, help each other, and give gifts. ·        A completely free game with regular updates and events.   You will love this game if: ·        You enjoy the 'hidden object' or 'I seek' genre, like finding hidden objects, solving complex puzzles, and collecting collections. ·        You like captivating stories with mysteries, unexpected twists, and a dark atmosphere.   'Panic Room: Ghosts of the Past' is a game available for free on PC, phones, and tablets. Join and become part of an exciting mystical adventure!

rows.name: Empower Your Intent
rows.short_description: Built for those who want to better themselves. A unique rhythm game designed to help reclaim your motivation and attention. Focus the timing and direction of your movements to burst projectiles into a mesmerizing eruption of flower petals.
rows.description_html: Empower Your Intent is an atmospheric rhythm game that helps build mindfulness and intentionality while consuming entertaining software. Researched and designed to enhance your mental state while avoiding addictive patterns. Mesmerizing projectiles are choreographed to the rhythms and melodies of the music. Focus the timing and direction of your sparks to burst the projectiles into an eruption of flower petals.   Potential Uses: A healthier alternative to ease cravings for highly-addictive software like social-media and other games.  A ritual to boost motivation and productivity before starting a bout of focused work. Relax: in general or to prepare for sleep.  Energize and train reflexes/ coordination.  Introduce gaming to those seeking to train new skills. (Has accessibility features so that people with no prior gaming experience can enjoy) Obviously you can just use it to have fun and enjoy the music too :p

rows.name: Shifter
rows.short_description: Shifter is a minimalist and atmospheric puzzle game where you must navigate a shifting square through intricate puzzle-box levels to find the exit. With 60 handcrafted challenges spread across six unique zones, each with a unique twist. Can you master the shifting mechanics and escape every room?
rows.description_html: Shifter is a minimalist and atmospheric puzzle experience that will challenge your spatial reasoning and problem-solving skills. In this unique puzzle-box adventure, you control a shifting square that moves continuously in a chosen direction until it hits an obstacle. Your goal? Find the perfect path to the exit. With 60 handcrafted levels spread across six distinct zones , Shifter introduces a variety of mechanics that keep gameplay fresh and engaging. Navigate through teleporters, activate moving walls, avoid deadly spikes, and discover even more surprises along the way. Each zone presents new challenges, encouraging players to think ahead, experiment, and refine their strategy. 🔹 Minimalist Aesthetic – A clean and atmospheric design that keeps the focus on the puzzles. 🔹 Unique Puzzle Mechanics – Master teleporters, shifting walls, spikes, and more. 🔹 60 Handcrafted Levels – A carefully curated difficulty curve with satisfying solutions. 🔹 Relaxing Yet Challenging – No timers, no pressure—just pure puzzle-solving satisfaction. 🔹 Immersive Sound Design – A subtle, atmospheric soundtrack that enhances the experience. If you love clever puzzle games that require foresight and experimentation, Shifter will keep you thinking from start to finish. Can you find the right path through every level and escape the puzzle box?

rows.name: Under Ichigo Love me baby!!! in TOKYO SUPER ARENA 2025
rows.short_description: A rhythm action game based on the viral idol trio 'Under Ichigo' is here! Experience their first arena concert at one of Japan’s largest venues, 'Tokyo Super Arena,' recreated in real-time 3D. Enjoy professionally motion-captured dances and an intuitive, beginner-friendly rhythm game.
rows.description_html: A rhythm action game based on the viral idol trio 'Under Ichigo' is here! Their first solo arena show is fully recreated in real-time 3D! Take to the stage at one of Japan's largest venues, 'Tokyo Super Arena,' meticulously replicated down to the smallest details. Enjoy breathtaking productions featuring over 100 types of dynamic lighting and stage effects. And that's not all - the movements, provided by expert motion actors, are recorded using professional motion capture technology, allowing us to capture every action, right down to their fingertips! The simple, intuitive rhythm action gameplay makes getting to grips with the game a breeze, even for newbies to the genre! There are 8 original songs for you to enjoy, with exclusive costumes for each, allowing you to fully savor the girls' evolving charm. One standout feature in this game is 'Live Customization.' Select your favorite member to stand in the center position, change vocal parts, customize outfits, and create your own unique performance. Personalize your very own 'Under Ichigo' experience! This game blends realistic live production, easy-to-learn yet hard-to-master rhythm action, and a high degree of customization. Join Under Ichigo and create the ultimate live performance! About 'Under Ichigo' Love as sweet as strawberries, aimed straight at your heart! Meet Under Ichigo, a three-member idol unit from LIGHTUP PROMOTION, featuring Himeka Momoyama, Miyu Yuzuhara, and Mei Aoyama! 🌸 Himeka Momoyama (Momoyama Himeka – Ichigo Pink) The spoiled princess of Under Ichigo! Born into a family of entertainers, she's been in the industry since birth, so has lived a very sheltered life. Nickname: Hime-chan 🍋Miyu Yuzuhara (Yuzuhara Miyu – Ichigo Lemon) The energetic style icon of Under Ichigo. Shy but full of curiosity, she absolutely loves all things cute. Nickname: MyuMyu 💙Mei Aoyama (Aoyama Mei – Ichigo Blue) The earnest leader of Under Ichigo. A former child star, she dreams of becoming an actress in the future. Nickname: MeiMei

rows.name: What happened on the Moon?
rows.short_description: Built by Professor Ward, you are an AI Moon Rover on a mission to investigate mysterious activity on the lunar surface...
rows.description_html: After a few weeks of observing unusual activity originating from the Moon, Professor Ward assembles an AI Moon Rover to undertake a mission to investigate the cause. 3 months before the mission is due to launch, a man calling himself Dr. Hoffmann appears and takes control of the mission. Unable to stop him, Professor Ward must now rely solely on the rover to complete the mission and find out the truth... Features Explore the lunar surface in the style of a 2D hill climbing game Use your gripper arm to navigate obstacles Manage your power supply with your solar panel Begin to uncover the mystery of what happened on the Moon ...

rows.name: Everyone Fights
rows.short_description: Everyone Fights is a turn based city building and conquering strategy game. Complete with a map creator, character creator, campaign, multiplayer, and loads of characters with their own unique ways to play.
rows.description_html: Everyone Fights is a turn-based strategy game where you build structures, recruit an army, and battle for land. Choose from 20 unique commanders , each with their own special unit, building, power, super, and trait . Command your army to victory through a series of campaigns to take over the world! Your goal is to capture enemy HQs while defending your own, whether battling AI, challenging friends, or playing through the campaign . Success requires managing both your army and city, building a powerful force to dominate the battlefield. With a diverse array of units at your command, engage in tactical combat and adapt your strategy as the day and night cycle reshapes the fight. As visibility shifts and unit effectiveness changes from dawn to dusk, new challenges and opportunities emerge. Get creative with the extensive level and character creators . Design custom maps with unique terrain and play styles. Craft your own commander—whether it's a fun, unique character or the most powerful leader possible. Lead your forces through four different campaigns in a war for global supremacy. Capture cities, unlock new characters, and battle for a world under your faction’s banner. Everyone Fights gives a new city-building spin to the familiar turn-based war gaming genre. Try it out!

rows.name: Math Attack
rows.short_description: Math Attack is a mathematical puzzle game about using math operations to reduce expressions to zero. Each level presents a clever numerical riddle hidden behind deceptively simple notation. It’s a game of logic, foresight, and elegant solutions.
rows.description_html: Math Attack is a mathematical puzzle game, built around the idea of using math operations to attack various expressions and reduce them to zero. Each level presents a new expression involving integers, irrationals, complex numbers, or even polynomials. Armed with a limited set of operations like subtraction, logarithms, and differentiation, your challenge is to determine the optimal order in which to apply them. There are three categories of levels presented as folders in the level select: Real, Complex and Functions. Each category requires you to deduce certain properties of the expressions you work with. With no tutorial or hand-holding, you're dropped straight into a mathematical labyrinth, left to uncover how each operation shapes the expressions before you. Trial, error, and insight are your only guides. Features Minimalist Design – A clean and focused interface that keeps the math front and centre. 39 Handcrafted Levels – Puzzles spanning three distinct mathematical domains: Real, Complex, and Functions. Built-in Info Tool – Peek under the hood of each expression and visualize how different operations affect it. Free-Form Level Selection – Tackle any level in any order. No restrictions, just exploration. Undo & Redo – Experiment freely with different strategies and operation sequences.

Use these items to fight back against the zombie ducks! Build!
rows.about_html: DuckStruck is a top down bullet hell pixel art shooter, where you play as... a duck! Featuring engaging battles with all kinds of duck enemies, and an epic OST made by Simeon G, your goal is simple: survive for as long as possible! Survive! Build  using a variety of items, purchased in the shop using the in-game currency: Zombie Beans . Items include turrets, blocks, rail guns, sonar emitters, and much more! Use these items to fight back against the zombie ducks! Build!

rows.name: I Wanna Ascend
rows.short_description: As you climb this place, you will fall countless times, sinking into despair. Prove that you're not just a loudmouth coward—reach the top. The 2D platforming jump game that will break your keyboard: I Wanna Ascend.
rows.description_html: Hey, do you want to ascend there? 'Hey you' 'Let me give some advice' 'Don't waste your time, you'd better just stay in this shelter' 'It suits a coward like you' Countless hardships and trials await you. Spikes everywhere, spinning saw blades, falling platforms, and merciless terrain... Hmm... Maybe the smoking guy was right. Perhaps it's better to stay in the shelter and not waste your time... Hmm... Do you still want to Ascend this place? Then prove it with your actions. Features: This game was made by a single person. Frustrated? Don’t worry. Just climb again. The developer took 30 minutes to clear the game. Talk to the friends you meet along the way! A crown awaits at the end...? Charming retro-style graphics and sound. The smoking guy... you might even grow fond of him...? Watch out for the blue hole...!

rows.name: First Steps in Child Developmental Support
rows.short_description: Yuuka, a nursing student, is doing a summer practicum at a Child Development Support Center. Explore the facility in a role-playing format and experience child support activities. Learn about medical care, therapeutic interventions, and home healthcare over three days.
rows.description_html: Welcome to “First Child Development Support”! This game is a serious game that allows players to experience the field of child development support. From the perspective of medical and welfare professionals or family members supporting children’s growth, players can learn about child development support and the flow of therapeutic interventions. Game Content • Story-based Progression Players take on the role of a nursing student or support worker participating in a practicum at a child development support facility. They will assist children with developmental traits and work with support staff and caregivers to learn about practical interventions and how to address challenges. • Choices that Influence the Story Throughout the story, players will encounter various choices that help them learn about appropriate support methods and the importance of communication with caregivers. Each choice is accompanied by explanations to deepen understanding of child development support. • Realistic Scenarios Supervised by experts in child development support, the game faithfully reproduces real-life support settings. Players will experience how professionals such as nursery teachers, child development support managers, and occupational therapists collaborate in providing support. Features • Approximately one hour of gameplay, with a save function allowing players to resume at any time. • Recommended for medical and welfare students, as well as middle and high school students interested in child development support. • The knowledge gained in the game can be applied to parenting and professional support settings. Recommended for • Those interested in child development support and therapeutic interventions. • Those who want to learn about child development. • Parents and support workers looking for appropriate support strategies. Development Team • Production & Supervision: Shinshu University Department of Pediatrics, Yukihide Miyosawa Voice in the preview video by Experience the World of Child Development Support In First Child Development Support , you will encounter children with developmental traits, their families, and the professionals who support them. Through gameplay, you will gain insight into the importance of support and the real challenges faced in the field. [Medical Disclaimer] This application provides information related to child development support and therapeutic interventions; however, it does not offer medical advice or individual diagnoses. The information within the app is general in nature and is not a substitute for personalized guidance or diagnosis. Although this application is supervised by medical professionals, we cannot guarantee the accuracy or completeness of the information provided. Always refer to official sources or consult a medical professional for advice. The developers and associated third parties assume no responsibility for any outcomes or damages resulting from the use of this application. Users are expected to act based on their own judgment and responsibility.

rows.name: Eye on You!
rows.short_description: Control your gaze with the arrow keys and stop the cute prisoners from escaping! A surveillance action game that requires quick decision-making and full concentration!
rows.description_html: You are the only warden of this prison! But there are five cells, and the prisoners are constantly trying to escape. The red circle represents your gaze. Move it with the arrow keys to warn prisoners and prevent their escape. As time passes, the prisoners' escape gauge fills up. If you lose focus, the prison may be empty before you know it. A time management surveillance game that tests your quick thinking and reflexes! How many prisoners can you keep under watch?

rows.name: Skilander
rows.short_description: An immersive power fantasy simulator with tactical ski'ing and dying elements.
rows.description_html: Grab your Ski's and race downhill while avoid melting ice caps and perilous pits in Skilander ! Proudly utilizing Ken Silverman's Build engine to provide what's possibly the first ever tactical FPS (First Person Skiing) game ever! Skilander is a game designed with the fun of speedrunning in mind and comes with an easy Quick reset, encouraging competitive play and improving your times through the built-in high score system. You play as Connor MacGleisberg , taking on the challenge of mastering 3 difficult Skiing slopes. But you are not alone! The legendary ski shop maintainer Seppo from the city of Jaemsae is there to provide you valuable assitance! Remember – when in doubt, the right way is always the downhill. Reach speeds you could have never imagined before and control the awesome power of 'Snowquelching' ! Some highlights: - Six funky tracks utilizing Ken's own KDM digital music format for some authentic 90s tech. Never used in Build engine games before! - Cool speedrunning friendly features such as quick reset, in-game timer and Full Run Tracking - Three Gnarly stages to master with a fully voiced over fourth tutorial stage to get you started - Supports both keyboard and controller play, Glorious! - Want to make maps? Just open one in any compatible BUILD editor, save and play your own creations, Way cool! - Most of all, expect some Outrageous lighthearted fun!

rows.name: Yurei Hunt
rows.short_description: Yurei Hunt is a multiplayer hide & seek prop hunt game where deception is key. Play as a Yurei, possessing objects & using abilities, or as a Hunter, relying on instincts & proximity voice chat to track them. With a world full of tricks, surprises & eerie tension, every match is a battle of wits.
rows.description_html: Yurei Hunt – A Supernatural Prop Hunt Like No Other Yurei Hunt is a multiplayer prop hunt game set in a world of haunted, mystical locations. Play as a Yurei, a ghost that can possess almost any object to hide, trick, and escape, or as a Hunter, searching for spirits disguised in plain sight. Each map is filled with interactive elements that both sides can use to outsmart each other, making every round a thrilling mix of strategy, deception, and quick thinking. Proximity Voice Chat Immerse yourself in the haunting atmosphere of Yurei Hunt with real-time proximity voice chat! Communicate with your teammates and strategize, but beware—your voice travels just like in real life. The closer you are to someone, the clearer they hear you. As you move away, your voice fades into the eerie silence. Ghosts can whisper... or taunt! Hunters and ghosts alike can use voice chat, making every round an intense mind game. Feel the tension rise as you hear distant whispers in the dark—was that your teammate... or something else? Stay silent, stay hidden... or risk being heard! Immersive Environments & Evolving Gameplay Explore diverse maps inspired by eerie traditional Japanese locations and futuristic cyberpunk cityscapes . From cursed shrines cloaked in mist to neon-lit streets pulsing with energy, every setting offers unique ways to outmaneuver your opponents. Key Features 🌏 Diverse Maps – Haunted shrines, dense forests, cyberpunk streets, and more, each designed for mind games and strategy. 🌀 Tactical Abilities & Deception – As a Yurei you can turn into almost any object in the map and you can manipulate your surroundings, creating illusions and using darkness to evade capture. 🎮 Multiplayer  – Play with up to 8 players , competing with friends or online opponents. Dynamic Weather: Thick fog, sudden snow, or lightning strikes can change visibility and create new strategies for both Yurei and Hunters. Dynamic World Elements: Each map features unique interactive elements that shape the game. Turn off streetlights with switches to cloak Yurei in darkness, or extinguish lanterns in shrines for a stealthy escape. From flickering neon signs to creaky doors, every environment offers new ways to hide, hunt, and manipulate the shadows. ⚡ Advanced Graphics & Performance – Powered by Unreal Engine’s latest technology , with Nvidia DLSS ensuring smooth, high-performance gameplay . Will you become the hunter or the hunted ?

rows.name: Lunacid - Tears of the Moon
rows.short_description: Lunacid: Tears of the Moon is a First Person Dungeon Crawler made with the Sword of Moonlight - King’s Field making tool from 2000. Explore various dungeons for powerful weapons and spells to forestall the previsioned end of the world.
rows.description_html: Lunacid: Tears of the Moon is a First Person Dungeon Crawler made with the Sword of Moonlight - King’s Field making tool from 2000. Explore various dungeons for powerful weapons and spells to forestall the previsioned end of the world. The Kingdom of Lyria rests in darkness, surrounded on all sides by the vast poison sea. In ages long past, brilliant silver moonlight fell upon Lyria, leading to its accession as a great kingdom of magic. But this time of solace may soon end. Calamis Cerulean was granted a vision of this macabre future, the Great Old One who sleeps beneath the earth will soon awaken from it's slumber and plunge the world into another dark age. He must venture into dangerous lands to gather magics of light and dark. Only then can he coax the silver moonlight to fall upon the Great Old One and lull it back into a deep sleep.

rows.name: Apple Rabble Dazzle
rows.short_description: Harvest apples all year round!
rows.description_html: A game about harvesting apples all year round through the power of dance! Pay attention to the sage's moves, when it's your turn repeat them! Be careful though, dancing is not all you'll be doing: At the end of each season a fearsome foe will crash your party... no more dancing! Dodge their attacks and parry stars to defeat them! Features! Play through four stages (seasons): Spring, Summer, Autumn and Winter! Face off against bosses at the end of each season! Multiple difficulties to select from, including a 'Custom' mode to tweak the game to your liking. Multiple Game Modes! All game modes can be played up to four players! Arcade: Go through all four seasons and beat the game! Boss Rush: No apples! Defeat every boss in a row. Endless: Only apples! Harvest as many as you can without making mistakes. Versus: Take turns deciding moves and outperform your friends!* *Versus is the only mode that requires a minimum of two players.

rows.name: Scare Crow
rows.short_description: Play as a mischievous crow in this stealth-meets-tower-defense game. Outsmart invading squirrels with traps and jump-scares to drive them out of your backyard.
rows.description_html: In Scare Crow, you will unleash your inner prankster by playing as Casey the Crow, who is feuding with squirrels over their limited food source. In a blend of stealth and 3rd person tower defense gameplay, you will hide and set traps to jump-scare your skittish enemies and send them fleeing your territory in fear. Protect your birdseed Your precious bird feeders are under siege! Sergeant Squeak and his squirrel army are eyeing your tasty treasures with greedy determination. Your mission is to stop them before they sink their paws into your beloved snacks. Every seed you save brings you closer to victory—and every loss stings. Lure your enemies Publicly known intel: squirrels love acorns—and that love is a weakness you can use against them. Toss acorns in strategic spots to lure these knuckleheads off their paths......and right into whatever you’ve got waiting for them. Scare invading squirrels These skittish squirrels may come in numbers, but a good scare is all it takes to send them scrambling! From leaping out of bushes to sneaky greetings from behind, unleash your arsenal of pranks and watch them panic, scatter, and bolt across the yard in hilarious chaos. Play your way! Outsmart your furry foes—whether by jump-scaring, trapping, or kicking their butts off the bird feeders, the choice is yours! Use balloons, sandboxes, beehives and other hilarious backyard props to turn your territory into the ultimate prankster’s playground!

rows.name: Faceless
rows.short_description: Faceless is a fast-paced action-adventure game with tight combat, platforming, and strategic customization. Dodge traps, battle mechanical foes, and equip mystical masks to alter your abilities. With easy-to-learn mechanics and fluid movement, it delivers an intense yet accessible experience.
rows.description_html: In this short but intense action-adventure game, you play as a faceless guardian, the last protector of a dying village lost in the endless desert. When a lone traveler destroys the village’s only water source, you are tasked with delivering justice—only to uncover a deeper mystery that could halt the relentless desertification of the world. With responsive combat, easy-to-learn mechanics, and about two hours of fast-paced action, Faceless is an accessible yet challenging experience. Master its fluid movement and strategic encounters to uncover the truth and reclaim the desert’s lost life. The fate of your village—and perhaps the world—rests in the hands of a warrior with no face, but endless resolve.

rows.name: Little Luna
rows.short_description: Little Luna is an engaging puzzle-platformer where every step is a race against time! Help little moth to escape the dark and dangerous cave!
rows.description_html: In  Little Luna , you play as a brave moth who has fallen deep underground, far from the light of the surface. Guided by the mysterious power of  Luna —a lost goddess of lunar light—you must navigate treacherous terrain, solve intricate puzzles, and find your way back to the world above. But  Luna  is more than just a guide; her magic is the key to your survival. Can you harness her power and escape the darkness? What happens when every second counts, and every mistake could lead to failure?  Little Luna  invites you into a world where logic and quick thinking become your greatest allies. Travel through mysterious platforms, activate magical lunar blocks, and find your way through intricate puzzles. But don’t think it’s easy! These blocks don’t just activate—they can move, reshaping the level before your eyes. And time? It’s never on your side. You’ll need more than just brains—you’ll need lightning-fast reflexes.

rows.name: Triage
rows.short_description: Step into the role of a doctor in the town of Stagmarch, where an otherworldly illness is mutating residents. Get to know your patients, diagnose their illnesses, and treat them. However, you have limited medicine, and every day your patients get worse. How far will you go to save others?
rows.description_html: Step into the role of a doctor in the town of Stagmarch, where an otherworldly illness is mutating residents. Get to know your patients, diagnose their illnesses, and treat them. However, you have limited medicine, and every day your patients get worse. How far will you go to save others? MEET THE PATIENTS WHO YOU SAVE MATTERS Your patients all hold important roles in Stagmarch, and the town will feel their absence. More than just their fates rest in your hands. YOU CANNOT SAVE EVERYONE There's not enough medicine to go around, and as the only doctor you'll have to decide who gets treated and who gets left behind. LEARN ABOUT YOUR PATIENTS Throughout 3 days of work at the town's clinic, get to know your patients. Find out who they really are. CRAFTING To treat the sick, harvest herbs from the clinic’s garden and make your own medicines from them. Refer to the prior doctor’s notes if you need to, because if you screw it up you could make things worse... IMMERSIVE ATMOSPHERE In this mansion turned clinic, discover what sort of secrets linger within these halls… Triage features many endings, all different varieties of bad! Triage was developed over the course of 1 academic year as part of the Champlain College Game Studio capstone project.

rows.name: shutterbuds
rows.short_description: Explore a National Park with up to 3 of your photojournalist friends. Take jobs from top magazine brands, then hit the trail in search of interesting landmarks and goofy creatures to photograph. Use your pay to buy useful items and cosmetics. You’ll be sure to make the front page in a flash!

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER shutterbuds contains a bunch of funny and interesting cosmetic options for you to unlock and personalize your character with! Some of them may cost your your hard-earned words, but if you complete enough jobs you're sure to make plenty of money. YOU HAVE A CAMERA AND CAN TAKE PICTURES Armed with your trusty Rejec brand digital camera, you can take photos of anything you see. You can caption these pictures, display them in game, or save them to your PC. SILLY LITTLE GUYS The park is filled with a variety of unique creatures, all with their own behaviors and personalities! MAKE THE FRONT PAGE IN A FLASH As you complete more jobs, the magazines you work for will be filled out with your photos. As you improve, new magazine issues are unlocked with more challenging missions. Some say that a picture is worth 1,000 words, but as a rookie, yours are gonna be worth less until you build your rep.

Some of them may cost your your hard-earned words, but if you complete enough jobs you're sure to make plenty of money. YOU HAVE A CAMERA AND CAN TAKE PICTURES Armed with your trusty Rejec brand digital camera, you can take photos of anything you see. You can caption these pictures, display them in game, or save them to your PC. SILLY LITTLE GUYS The park is filled with a variety of unique creatures, all with their own behaviors and personalities! MAKE THE FRONT PAGE IN A FLASH As you complete more jobs, the magazines you work for will be filled out with your photos. As you improve, new magazine issues are unlocked with more challenging missions. Some say that a picture is worth 1,000 words, but as a rookie, yours are gonna be worth less until you build your rep.

rows.name: Angvik : Returns
rows.short_description: A fan game capturing the nostalgia of Angvik! Embark on a challenging and fun-filled 2D action platformer adventure with unique equipment and combat styles.
rows.description_html: Angvik: Returns is a fan game inspired by the platform action game Angvik , which was loved for its unique atmosphere and high difficulty. While maintaining the original's core philosophy of 'only one chance', it adds a different kind of fun with new content. As the last hope of a fallen kingdom, the player embarks on a journey to reclaim the lost legacy and restore the balance of the world. Unknown creatures, dangerous terrain, and various weapons and items that can be obtained through exploration await you along the way. But don't let your guard down. With only one life, you must survive until the end. [Key Features] - 6 unique classes: Play with different weapons and strategies - New level design: Different map composition and terrain traps from the original - Various enemies and boss monsters: New enemies and attack patterns that are different from the original add to the tension. - Exploration and rewards: Find hidden artifacts and equipment throughout the map to strengthen your abilities. - Leaderboard: Register your name and country on the leaderboard with quick and accurate play.

rows.description_html: Witch Hazel is an enticingly cozy, witch themed whimsical gardening simulator where you can immerse yourself in the unique joy and whimsy of tending to your very own magical garden. Play as the intrepid Hazel Newt, a young, adventurous garden witch, and develop your powers, grow magical plants, and maybe even find your own witchy animal companion! As your mystical powers grow, unlock new seed types and discover what each plant has to offer! Explore different patterns in your garden and discover what secrets lie within the magical plots. Witch Hazel is a lovely escape from the stressors of life into a relaxing, cozy world of whimsy and wonder. Gardening simulation -Five magical items to discover -Four magical plants to grow Three days of whimsical gardening fun This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. rows.name: Pawns of War
rows.short_description: Dark parallel world in which humanity has destroyed itself. And only small colonies have survived the last centuries holding on to power at the expense of the totalitarian regime of government. You were thrown here after your death, is this how you were given a second chance?
rows.description_html: Searching for a ray of salvation inside this nightmare. The year is 2044. There is a war going on in the world between two superpowers. On neutral territory, you will have to guard the base as usual, but suddenly the war catches up with you here. You will have to assemble a squad of different characters, equip them, give them weapons and join the battle. The battle scene is presented in the form of 3x3 cells. Place the units correctly on it, choose the battlefield and win against a randomly generated enemy units. Upgrade your characters, buy weapons in the store for in-game currency, and perform daily boss battles. Experience fear and anxiety when faced with unknown nightmares, manage your resources carefully. An atmospheric action autobattler and a short-story about personality, memory, as well as the horrors of the unknown and unknowable awaits you.

rows.name: CLTRS
rows.short_description: Sometimes to reach the climax you just need to explore...
rows.description_html: CLTRS is an experimental and artistic game that invites players to discover and explore pleasure through an intuitive, sensory, and short experience. Designed as a meditative and interactive journey, the game transforms education into an act of play, curiosity, and empowerment. With one-button gameplay and a peaceful, aesthetic world , CLTRS offers a unique perspective on pleasure, intimacy, and body awareness. Through symbolic interactions and fluid exploration , the game provides an opportunity to reconnect with a part of the body too often overlooked.

rows.name: Rezarus
rows.short_description: An online first-person tank arena combat game where teams of 3–10 players go up against one another in arcade-style warfare—seize control points, capture enemy flags, outmaneuver and outduel your foes. Dare you master the keys and dominate the retro designed arenas like the OG gamers once did?
rows.description_html: Step into the cockpit of Rezarus and experience a pulse-pounding fusion of retro aesthetics and firepower built on a modern game engine. Seize control points, capture enemy flags stations, and outmaneuver and outduel your foes. Your mission is simple: destroy the enemy before they destroy you. 🌐 Online : First-person tank arena combat game, teams of 3–10 players go up against one another in arcade-style warfare—with every keystroke determining victory or defeat. ⌨️ Revolutionary keyboard-only controls : Say goodbye to boring copypasta twitchy mouse-aiming and hello to precision maneuvers that reward the dance of mastering both your tank's position and turret aim. Every movement is mapped to your keys, creating a tactile battlefield experience that grows deeper and more rewarding the longer you play. Whether you’re coordinating a pincer in Capture the Flag or holding the line on a contested control point, keyboard tactics become your ultimate weapon—something no other first-person tank combat game can touch. Once you master them, you'll never be able to go back to a mouse-controlled tank combat game again. Four Electrifying Game Modes 🚀 Total Wars CTF:  Unleash chaos with an arsenal of tanks and weapons at your fingertips. Seize control points, capture enemy flags, and wage all-out war by any means necessary—whether you rain shells from afar or charge headlong into the fray. In Total Wars CTF, victory belongs to the bold and the relentless. 🚀 Laser Wars:  Streamlined and simplified, yet tactical as ever. Each player commands a single tank equipped with a laser cannon, plus one customizable module to tweak your playstyle. With perfectly balanced loadouts, teamwork and coordination are everything—so lock in with your squad and execute flawless flanks. 🚀 Phoenix Wars:  Two shots; one chance to reign supreme. This mode strips combat back to raw FPS fundamentals: lead your target, dodge incoming fire, and prove your sharpshooting prowess. Every engagement tests your reflexes and decision-making—survive the heat, and you’ll rise from the ashes like a true Phoenix. 🚀 Impulse Wars:  Gravity is your deadliest weapon. Instead of chasing kills, you’ll mastermind physics: push your opponents towards towering ledges, launch them off ramps, and watch them tumble into oblivion. Impulse Wars rewrites the rules of engagement—outsmart your foes and let physics do the rest. Early Access Join us in Early Access! After extensive alpha testing and with core gameplay fully in place, we’re opening up the gates so you can help us fine-tune server performance for bigger online battles. Your feedback will help guide future optimizations that ensure not only smooth larger-scale combat, but also fun. Your participation will help shape Rezarus’s future along with the rest of the community passionate about bringing back the fun in arcade style tank warfare. 🎯 Hop onto Rezarus today and be among the first to redefine tank warfare! It's free and there's no account registration necessary! Indie by Design, AAA in Ambition Rezarus is the passion project of a solo developer and dedicated closed-alpha testing community. Don’t let “indie” fool you—Rezarus already provides an online experience that stands up to big-budget blockbusters. Smaller team, bigger heart: creative freedom fuels innovation here, making your arcade-style tank warfare experience truly one-of-a-kind!

rows.short_description: StarLusts is a bullet hell-style shoot ‘em up game which fuses sci-fi, mecha, and anthropomorphic themes. Players become Captains of an Earth Federation ship, leading mecha Cadettes through space to battle alien threats and capture ancient beauties called Mimics.
rows.description_html: At the critical moment of humanity's survival against the threat of an alien civilization As the Commander, you will become the hero to save the Federation! What!? The fleet also has super cute female crew members for you to discipline?! 💖 Digi, the Jade Rabbit A dish's triumph isn't just about flavors that bring tears of joy, it's a dazzling fusion of color, aroma, and taste, a feast for both eyes and palate! Even in a cooking clash, the Fifth Regiment's grand performer, Digi, seizes every chance to leave the crowd gasping. From plating to sizzling stir-fries, every detail weaves her magical stage performances, turning the kitchen into a thrilling spectacle. She's not just here to win your taste buds... She's after your heart and soul! 💖 Allee Winter, the Lustrous Gold Shark When it comes to cooking, Allee stays true to her usual precision and powerhouse flair. Her signature spicy chili oil, the rising steam and rich aroma swirling as she stirs the pan with practiced ease... one can no longer tell whether the enticing scent comes from the dish, or Allee herself. Every element, from the bold seasoning to the astonishing flavors, is a result of her calculated perfection. That said, the kitchen is often left in utter chaos, and many brave taste testers can't help but grimace at the first bite... 🌌 Mimic Beauty × Cross-Species Earth girls no longer satisfy you? Now explore outer space for more intelligent female lifeforms! Jellyfish-like girls, octopus-like girls, and various stunning mimic girls await, offering ultimate pleasure for you to experience! 🚀 Bullet Hell × Strategic Builds Exhilarating STG bullet hell shooting gameplay paired with a customizable weapon system! Equip diverse weapons, armor, and chips based on enemy traits to create the ultimate personalized mech and break through relentless bullet barrages! 💋 Exclusive Bonds × Interstellar Encounters Each girl has a unique personality and secret. Through intimate interactions, gradually unlock their hearts—from innocent shyness to unspeakable deep desires...!!! rows.short_description: 17 Ways Not to Die is a movie, first and foremost. A movie in which you can influence what happens on the screen. There are 17 endings, or not endings, or not 17, I don’t know. I don’t care.
rows.description_html: 17 ways to not die - this is Young Odd Unique Fantastic Awesome Giant Good Original Tasty game well, in short: two Russian homies are sitting in their hut and start hearing strange sounds from the roof, naturally they go to check what's going on there. And then... you have the opportunity to decide what happens next, but to be honest, I don't care. Just enjoy and don't expect anything serious from this short adventure. We're just funny. Dynamism and nonlinearity: there are like 17 forks, but that's not certain Unusual narration: I won't say how many endings there actually are Real cinema: you'll see a movie with live actors ATTENTION! Thank you for your attention!

rows.name: B.A.D. Institute
rows.short_description: Once you come to B.A.D. Institute, you'll never leave. A first-person survival horror game where hiding and outsmarting your enemies is the only way to survive. Uncover the mystery of what happened at this boarding school and how to escape with your life.
rows.description_html: After transferring to Brightwater Art & Design, a boarding school in Utah, Háo awakens to find the school's campus overtaken by monstrous creatures taking appearances from people he once knew. Equipped with only a phone, attempt to escape this campus where danger lurks at every corner. With enemies roaming the halls that can't be defeated, Háo must learn what happened and how to survive in this new world. You'll hide, explore, outsmart, and survive using only your wits. Can you survive your stay at B.A.D. Institute? FEATURES Explore the campus of Brightwater Art & Design to find a way out Stun enemies with your phone to escape dangerous situations Use your surroundings to your advantage to hide from enemy sights  Find papers that influence the course of the story

rows.name: The Last Son of Vorona
rows.short_description: In this first person combat adventure, you have one job: Destroy the plague before it destroys you. Slash, dash, jump and run through rats or run the rat race yourself.
rows.description_html: After an alchemist spent his days working to craft the philosophers stone, he accidentally released a plague onto the Transylvanian village of Cavarna. Izaak is the last member of a family of hunters who sought to create a land free of persecution, and their missing leader wanted to achieve that dream through Alchemy. After accepting a job in the village, Izaak slowly meets familiar faces while seeking the end of the plaguebearer.  Find a way to stop the plague from consuming you and cavarna. In The Last Son of Vorona, you start with nothing but a bounty  from Cavarna's Priest- '...an evil that once hid in shadows now leeches from the castelul and our count has disappeared...' Features Engage in first Person Melee combat where you slash through rats and dash to avoid attacks. Explore the Helltorn village of Cavarna and uncover the tragedy of Cavarna through it's peoples last notes. Take a break in the serene Cavarnian Forest. Turn into a rat and navigate Castelul Cavarna's rat maze. Race against time before the Lycanthropic Plague takes over your body. Find out what happened to the Sons of Vorona and who (or what) is responsible for the plague. If you want to make God laugh, tell him your plans. built for educational purposes.

rows.name: WARMONGER:45
rows.short_description: WARMONGER:45 is a large-scale sci-fi multiplayer FPS that features the worldwide conflict between the Federation of America and the United Nations of Eurasia. Face-off in 30-vs.-30 combat to dominate the battlefield using numerous specialized classes.
rows.description_html: YEAR: 2045 In a future under constant threat of complete annihilation , several technologically-advanced superpowers have combined. Now, they're sending their enhanced soldiers and war machines to claim as much territory as possible. Will you hold the line for the overwhelming force of the Federation of America , or push back alongside the United Nations of Eurasia ? Key Features Large-scale multiplayer that allows up to 60 players at once (30v30). Dynamic stat system . Each class has a different set of health and weight. Weight determines walking speed, stamina usage, and stamina regeneration. Weight-based weapon sway that affects accuracy. Diverse class system with specialized soldiers for every situation. Assault (w/ ammo box) Engineer (w/ deployable wall) Medic (w/ medic bag) Sniper (w/ marksman rifle) Advanced classes that become available as the battle wages on.
rows.about_html: YEAR: 2045 In a future under constant threat of complete annihilation , several technologically-advanced superpowers have combined. Now, they're sending their enhanced soldiers and war machines to claim as much territory as possible. Will you hold the line for the overwhelming force of the Federation of America , or push back alongside the United Nations of Eurasia ? Key Features Large-scale multiplayer that allows up to 60 players at once (30v30). Dynamic stat system . Each class has a different set of health and weight. Weight determines walking speed, stamina usage, and stamina regeneration. Weight-based weapon sway that affects accuracy. Diverse class system with specialized soldiers for every situation. Assault (w/ ammo box) Engineer (w/ deployable wall) Medic (w/ medic bag) Sniper (w/ marksman rifle) Advanced classes that become available as the battle wages on.

rows.name: Lex Talionis A
rows.short_description: Lex Talionis A is a team-based, 4 player, couch co-op where aliens fight astronauts, drones, and bosses for revenge against humanity. Choose from four aliens with unique abilities and survive together in this 2D Run n' Gun Adventure.
rows.description_html: Lex Talionis A, the law of retaliation, whereby a punishment resembles the offense committed. As Aliens you must fight your way through astronauts, drones and bosses in order to enact your revenge on the humans for their hostile takeover. Every alien life is sacred, and in this team based couch co-op experience you will have to place your trust in your companions to not use all your lives. There are four aliens to choose from with abilities ranging from a golf club to summoning a mammoth. But no matter who you choose you mustn't give up on your assault..THIS..IS..WAR!

rows.name: Wuthering Waves
rows.short_description: Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world.
rows.description_html: Wuthering Waves is a story-rich open-world action RPG with a high degree of freedom. You wake from your slumber as Rover, joined by a vibrant cast of Resonators on a journey to reclaim your lost memories and change the world. We're working to resolve Wuthering Waves' compatibility with STEAM DECK and will share updates in the community. Thanks for your understanding! Welcome aboard, roving voyager. Upon the shores lay the silent embers of a world during the Ebb Tide. Desolated by the Lament, the erstwhile creations and earthly beings are left static. But they strike back, strong enough to penetrate the silence. Humanity has risen anew from the ashes of the apocalypse. And you, Rover, are poised for an adventure of Awakening. Companions to meet, enemies to conquer, new powers to gain, hidden truths to unveil, and unseen spectacles to behold... A vast world of endless possibilities awaits. The choice rests in your hands. Be the answer, be the leader, and follow the sounds to arrive at a new future. As Wuthering Waves echo endlessly, mankind set sail on a new journey. Rise and embark on your odyssey, Rover. Desolated by the Lament, civilization is born anew / Delve into an expansive world Embrace high degrees of freedom in immersive overworld explorations. Utilize flight, grapple and wall dash to travel great distances and overcome obstacles with little strain for stamina consumed. Strike fast and unleash your inner warrior / Engage in smooth & fast-paced combat Avail against enemy attacks in smooth and fast-paced combat. Apply easy controls of Dodge, Counterattack, Echo Skill, and unique QTE mechanisms that allow the fullest possibility of battle experience. Forte awakened, journey alongside your companions / Encounter Resonators Compose a harmonious battle concerto with Resonators of different abilities. Their unique Fortes revealing distinctive personalities will be your strong assets for the journey ahead. Power of your foes at your command / Collect Echoes to aid you in battle Capture lingering phantoms of Tacet Discords to harness your own Echoes. Upon this mystic land of everlasting reverberations, master a diverse array of Echo Skills to defeat formidable enemies.

rows.name: Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator - Prologue
rows.short_description: Test drive the game with three chapters challenge in this prologue version. Manage your mini racer car shop, sell mini cars and spare parts, and unleash your creativity with custom builds. Test drive your creations on the race track before putting them up for sale.
rows.description_html: Experience Prologue Version Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator Prologue is your introduction to the world of mini car shop management! This Prologue version provides a taste of the full game, offering a similar experience with select content limitations. Manage your shop, customize mini cars, and take them to the race track for unique challenges. Get a feel for the exciting gameplay before diving into the full Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator! Experience special Prologue challenges across three unique chapters, each designed to introduce you in managing your shop, customizing mini cars, and racing them on the track! Find Rare Spare Parts Each car pack features a gacha system that adds an extra layer of excitement! Try your luck and draw for rare spare parts that could be the key to building your ultimate mini racer. Every draw offers a random part, making each pull a thrilling opportunity to enhance your collection. Sell Mini Cars Access a selection of highly detailed miniature racing car models designed to attract car enthusiasts. Carefully manage your stock to always have the best selection available, keeping your customers satisfied. As the shop owner, you can also start your personal mini car collection by opening car packs! Sell Spare Parts In addition to selling mini cars, provide a variety of spare parts to enhance their performance. From mini engines to wheels and unique components, offer your customers the best selection for building their dream cars. Each part has different quality levels and performance attributes, making inventory management a crucial strategy. Custom Car Showcase Show off your most impressive custom-built mini cars in a dedicated showcase area! Here, you can display your masterpieces for customers to admire and purchase. Set your own price based on the car’s performance and rarity. Test Drive Your Car Take your custom-built mini cars for a test drive on a race track! Experience their speed, handling, and unique upgrades firsthand. Special race challenges are available in the Prologue version, allowing you to push your creations to the limit and refine your builds for optimal performance. Mini Racer Car Shop Simulator Prologue offers an exciting preview of the full game, making it the perfect starting point for you. Begin your journey today and turn your shop into the ultimate destination for customers!

rows.name: Melodic Mage
rows.short_description: A rhythm-based action shooter where you play as a mage, casting spells and dodging to the beat. Battle through dynamic levels, defeat challenging bosses, and unleash the magic of music!
rows.description_html: Unleash the power of music in Melodic Mage , a 2D pixel art action shooter where every attack and dodge must follow the rhythm! Play as a wizard battling through dynamic levels, casting spells, dashing, and dodging— all in sync with the beat . Key Features 🎵 Rhythm-Based Combat – Cast spells and dodge enemy attacks in sync with the music. 🧙‍♂️ Magical Arsenal – Unlock and choose between different mages. ⚔️ Challenging Enemies & Bosses – Conquer diverse levels, each with their own final boss. 🎶 Hard mode  – For those looking for a challenge, the hard mode will punish you every time you miss a beat. Master the rhythm. Control the magic. Become the Melodic Mage!

rows.name: Fallen Vestige
rows.short_description: Seeking vengeance against the creatures that killed his family, embark on a journey to find the source and uncover the mystery of the creatures in this open-world light RPG with horror elements. Explore, scavenge, fight, and survive through means such as parkour, puzzle solving, and skills.
rows.description_html: SAVE THE HUMAN RACE Seeking vengeance against the creatures that killed his family, embark on a journey to find the source and uncover the mystery of the creatures in this open-world light RPG with horror elements. EXPLORE AN OPEN-WORLD Venture through a post-apocalyptic earth from your homestead and uncover unearthly threats where danger lurks in every corner. Explore enemy encampments and abandoned points of interest such as caves and bunkers to find ways to access the source of the creatures. DISCOVER A COMPELLING STORY Unravel the story behind the downfall of earth, piece together clues scattered throughout the world to uncover the truth behind the monsters. Why are they here? FIGHT TO SURVIVE Face off against terrifying threats, hostile entities that lurk in the dark and prowl the desolate world whilst avoiding environmental hazards. Armed with axes, hammers, knives, rifles, stealth takedowns, and throwables such as grenades and more. PLAY HOW YOU WANT Whether you want to play with guidance or want to uncover the story yourself, with an intuitive objective system that can be enabled or disabled, you choose how to play the game. PARKOUR Scale infrastructure utilising means like vaulting, climbing, and jumping to reach areas otherwise inaccessible. PUZZLES Solve puzzles using clues found in the vicinity to crack safes and unlock access to new areas. SKILL TREE Gain XP through eliminating enemies and exploring locations to provide permanent benefits to your character, furthering strength, speed, stealth, and health. SCAVENGE Loot powerful equipment to improve your arsenal that will aid you in your journey from abandoned structures teething with threats. DYNAMIC WEATHER Immerse yourself in photogenic environments that features a real-time light-cycle and a weather system that features rain and snow.

The game feature only story text that you will follow in a linear or non linear way in order to understand the story overall.
