rows.name: Phyllosoma
rows.short_description: You are a lone hunter who awakens in darkness. Within a cursed fortress where reality and hell intertwine, your goal is clear: Reach the top. Fight horrific enemies, grow stronger, and face what awaits at the summit.
rows.description_html: You are a lone hunter who awakens in the darkness. In a place where reality and hell are twisted together, there is only one goal : Reach the top of the fortress. Fight horrific enemies that seem to have crossed over from hell. Challenge yourself, grow stronger, and press onward. At the summit, face the being that awaits you. Features A 3D Soulslike Set in a Fortress Battle unfolds within a cursed fortress where hell and reality have merged for unknown reasons. Overcome cursed enemies and ascend toward the upper levels. The Fallen Fortress Explore every corner of the fortress to find your path upward. Look carefully—items needed for survival may be hidden nearby. Fast and Intense Combat The fortress is filled with many types of enemies. Strike down anything that blocks your way. Manage your stamina and control the flow of battle—your enemies are relentless. Guard & Counter System Guard at the exact moment of an enemy’s attack to trigger a Perfect Guard . Follow up with a Counter Attack . Master Perfect Guards and Counters to survive. Soul Gauge System The Soul Gauge is gained through normal attacks. Spend it to unleash powerful attacks on your enemies. Face Powerful Enemy Some enemies are extremely powerful. Use your Soul Gauge skills and items wisely. A Dreadful Presence Awaits At the upper levels of the fortress, the most terrifying being awaits you. Overcome the trials and move beyond. About the Team Team Respect Guild  is a small indie team of four developers who love games. We will continue to create fun and challenging experiences. Thank you for playing.

rows.name: Myth of Lumi
rows.short_description: Myth of Lumi is a 3D physics-based turf war game where you duel rival magicians in card throwing showdowns. Recruit Lumis, mystical creatures bound within your playing cards, to aid you in battle and carve your path to fame and fortune.
rows.description_html: Myth of Lumi is a 3D physics-based turf war game where you duel rival magicians in card throwing showdowns. Set in the underground utopian city of Prospera, play as Luce, an ambitious street performer striving to join the legendary Conclave—an elite circle of top-tier magicians. Recruit Lumis, mystical creatures bound within your playing cards, to aid you in battles and carve your path to fame and fortune. Master your skills, outwit your opponents, and rise to the top! THROW PLAYING CARDS Perfect your craft by adjusting your card throwing technique, Cover the most ground with your cards to dominate the battlefield. UNLEASH YOUR MAGIC Unlock more Lumis as you play. Harness the unique magical abilities of each Lumi to stack the deck in your favor. Chain multiple skills together to optimize your deck synergy! YOUR DESTINY AWAITS Rise through the ranks of Prospera's legendary magicians through dazzling displays of magic and high-stakes trials. Will you prove your worth or will your name be lost in the shuffle?

rows.name: JungleBoys
rows.short_description: Enter the jungle to fight for your survival in this local splitscreen showdown. Heal up, collect items to use in combat, and look for other players to fight in custom lobbies with friends. Last player standing wins. Gameplay in the jungle supports Xbox controller use for up to 4 players.
rows.description_html: JungleBoys is a multiplayer survival game set in a jungle where only tactful survivors will emerge victorious. Create a custom game with friends and battle for survival. Game Features: Intense Jungle Battles – Navigate a dense jungle filled with treasure chests, strategic vantage points, and other players looking to fight. Item Collection & Combat – Search for useful items to gain an edge over your opponents. Use items to revive when knocked down. Last Player Standing – Fight until the bitter end—when only one player is standing and downed players cannot revive in time, the game is over. Custom Lobbies – Play in local splitscreen lobbies with friends using Xbox controllers. Community & Support – Join our JungleBoys Discord Server to discuss the game, share feedback, request new features, and get support from fellow players and the development team.

rows.description_html: MEET YOUR NEW FRIEND: BUBS! A collection of 20+ minigames, follow Bubs the Cat as he leads you through a series of 5-second activities whether you like it or not Created in 48 hours for the Vancouver Global Game Jam 2025, by a team of almost 20 people, made using the Godot Engine.  Inspired by WarioWare and Four Second Frenzy. CONTROLS: A true 1-button game, BUBBLEWARE supports keyboard, mouse, controller and touchscreen. The only input is movement and one button! rows.name: The Door
rows.short_description: “What if every door you opened was a window into your own mind?” Welcome to The Door, a captivating narrative game where exploration and reflection are at the heart of the experience.
rows.description_html: Welcome to The Door, a narrative and psychological game where every choice confronts you with your own thoughts. 'What if every door you opened was a window into your own mind?' In The Door, you will have to go through a series of trials where each door represents an inner reflection. Between light and darkness, hope and doubt, you will have to solve puzzles and make decisions to move forward. But will you be ready to face what your mind has in store for you? Gameplay and main mechanics A narrative game based on choices: each door plunges you into a dilemma to solve. Symbolic puzzles: play with lighting and interactions to progress. An immersive atmosphere: an intriguing narration accompanied by a striking sound atmosphere. An introspective journey: explore themes such as solitude, failure and resilience. A short but intense experience: designed to leave a lasting mark.

rows.name: Dreamland
rows.short_description: A group of young people decides to find out why they are seeing mysterious symbols. As they unravel the mystery, they travel through other worlds that are indistinguishable from those seen in dreams. One can only hope that this will not turn into a nightmare for them...
rows.description_html: Dreamland Welcome to Dreamland - a mysterious and fascinating world of dreams, where reality intertwines with fantasy, and fear and admiration go hand in hand. In this game, you will go on a fascinating journey through a world inhabited by mythical creatures and creepy characters. Plot We see the world through the eyes of Alexey, an ordinary worker at the logistics company 'Watcher's Cargo.' He has long stopped communicating with his old acquaintances. However, after several unusual incidents, Alexey begins to see symbols. Gathering together, the group decides to uncover the root cause of the events that have occurred to them. The young people travel through several dimensions, solving puzzles and interpersonal conflicts along the way. But will they be able to overcome themselves and untangle this story? Everything depends entirely on the player and their choices. This story is just a brief excursion into a vast and mysterious world of dreams. Will it turn into a nightmare? Characters In Dreamland you will meet many colorful characters, each with their own story and personality. Each of these characters adds uniqueness and depth to the atmosphere of the game. To some, they may seem very familiar. Isn't it? Style Dreamland combines elements of a visual novel and an interactive book, creating a familiar, yet unusual style. Bright colors and bizarre shapes intertwine with dark shadows and ominous silhouettes, creating a contrast that immerses the player in a dream world. The music, filled with mysterious melodies and sounds of nature, enhances the atmosphere and helps you forget about reality. Immerse yourself in the world of Dreamland, where every action you take matters, and every decision can change the course of events. Are you ready to face your fears and uncover the secrets of this eerie and beautiful kingdom?

rows.name: Colossal Crisis
rows.short_description: A fast-paced 2D hack-and-slash platformer where you battle through 7 levels and face off against two towering giants. Master precision combat, overcome deadly enemies, and reclaim a ruined island from the brink of collapse.
rows.description_html: Can a lone swordsman stand against giants? A once-thriving island now lies in ruins. Towering giants, led by the tyrannical Master Giant, have brought the land to its knees. In this fast-paced 2D hack-and-slash platformer, you are the island’s last hope, a lone swordsman with nothing but your blade, your will, and the resolve to bring down the colossals who shattered your world. Precision Hack-and-Slash Combat Master a tight and responsive combat system that rewards skill, timing, and strategy. Chain together sword strikes and dodge through deadly attacks in fluid, fast-paced battles. Conquer 7 Action-Packed Levels Battle your way through a journey across diverse environments, from shattered villages and stormy skies to the gates of a ruined castle in the land of the giants, Humungo . Each level brings new enemies, platforming challenges, and a path deeper into the giants' domain. Face the Colossals Two towering titans stand in your way: the brutal Earth Giant, and the ultimate force behind the island’s downfall—the Master Giant. These boss battles are intense, cinematic showdowns where only precise movement and brutal counters will carry you to victory. Save What Remains The war against the giants has already devastated the island. Now, with only fragments of hope left, you must face overwhelming odds, reclaim the land, and put an end to the chaos once and for all.

rows.name: Last Hit Titan
rows.short_description: Strategically place turrets and build defenses to maximize your firepower against colossal Titans! Experiment with different setups, optimize your battlefield, and take down legendary creatures with the most efficient tactics. Every decision counts in this unique tower defense experience!
rows.description_html: An endless battle against powerful Titans! In this massively cooperative tower defense game , terrifying Titans travel from player to player. Every attack you land helps weaken these colossi, and the player who delivers the final blow receives rewards to become even stronger. Build, Upgrade, Survive Start with walls and a basic turret. Place your defenses strategically to maximize damage. Unlock and equip increasingly powerful towers through Titan loot. A Unique Economic Ecosystem Looted towers are Steam items . Buy turrets and walls with the money earned by attacking the Titans. Each 3h you can loot a tower. Each Titan has a special  loot table . The stronger the Titan, the more valuable its rewards. Merge towers and get upper guality tower !  Face Ever-Strong Titans Massive monsters with tons of health points. A pathfinding system that makes them either go around or destroy your defenses. Join the battle and leave your mark on the fall of the Titans!

rows.name: Lingua Franca
rows.short_description: Lingua Franca is a puzzle game all about taking pictures. Help a young girl capture an alien by finding the materials she needs to make her trap, photographing the world to get others to help her, and maybe even helping them along the way.
rows.description_html: Lingua Franca is a 3D puzzle adventure game where you explore your neighborhood and take pictures to help others. Not out of the goodness of your heart, of course, there’s an alien on the loose! Play as Asa, a young girl with a master plan to capture the alien and prove its existence to those around her. All you have is your camera and your wits, and you’ll need them to convince your neighbors to give you the materials you need to build your trap. By showing them pictures of the world around them, you will save a lost cat, crush a one-sided crush, and help two friends meet once again. With their help, the plan will go off without a hitch! Features: Three vibrant characters with their own stories, struggles, and silliness. A quaint, Japanese-inspired neighborhood to explore. One very confused alien whose only crime is its constant camouflage.

rows.name: Dark Jump: Endless Ascent
rows.short_description: In this fast-paced platforming challenge, precision and skill are key. Master 10 unique characters, traverse dynamic worlds, and overcome relentless enemies.
rows.description_html: Leap, Conquer, and Push Your Limits in This High-Stakes Infinite Platformer! Traverse treacherous landscapes, evade relentless enemies, and test your reflexes in this fast-paced infinite jumper. Whether you're a casual player or a seasoned platforming expert, this game offers endless action and challenge. Master Unique Characters & Unlock Powerful Abilities Choose from 10 distinct characters , each with their own abilities and playstyle. Uncover a secret character waiting to be discovered and push your high score even further. Adapt your strategy and find the perfect hero to dominate the leaderboards. Conquer Ever-Changing Worlds Explore 5 dynamically designed worlds , each packed with unique obstacles, enemies, and hazards. Every run presents a new challenge, ensuring no two playthroughs are ever the same. Collect, Upgrade, and Rise to the Top Gather coins as you progress, smash through enemies, and unlock exclusive rewards. Elevate your experience with new characters and abilities to refine your strategy and reach new heights. Features: ✅ 10 Playable Characters – Each with distinct abilities, including a secret unlockable character. ✅ 5 Unique Infinite Levels – Diverse environments, unpredictable hazards, and escalating difficulty. ✅ Challenging Enemies & Obstacles – Test your reflexes with increasingly difficult platforming. ✅ Coin Starter Bonus  – Downloading the game provides a free 450 coins to unlock an extra new character or level of your choice right off the bat. How high can you climb? Prove your skills, set new records, and conquer the ultimate infinite platforming challenge!

rows.name: FP Racer
rows.short_description: A short solo racing experience in a minimalistic setting.
rows.description_html: Do you like the turns? Like the high speed maneuvers in Spa or Glen? FP Racer is all about the turns. It's the feeling of control at a God-like level. Immerse yourself in the world of FP Racer! FP Racer is a short solo racing experience. It has 9 levels. There is a leaderboard for each level. It is like a runner with car handling controls. There is no AI or competitive element except for the leaderboard. It has a minimalistic design.

rows.name: Robbery Day
rows.short_description: This is a first-person shooter where the player controls one of three characters. Each has two types of weapons, allowing them to adapt to different tactical situations. The gameplay combines dynamic shootings and robberies.
rows.description_html: The game is a first-person crime action game with three main locations: Bank, Jewelry Store and Meth Lab . The player takes on the role of a criminal, performing robberies, fighting the police and cooking meth to sell. Each location has its own mechanics.

rows.name: Wild Space
rows.short_description: Wild Space is a turn-based strategy game where dice rolls determine your luck, but it's up to you how you use it. Use your dices wisely and be the quickest ship in space. Choose your path carefully and upgrade your ship along the way. Outwit your opponents and master the dice to claim victory!
rows.description_html: Wild Space is a turn-based strategy game where dice rolls determine your luck, but it's up to you how you use it . Use your dices wisely and be the quickest ship in space. Choose your path carefully and upgrade your ship along the way. Outwit your opponents and master the dice to claim victory! At the beggining of every new game, you can choose which systems of the ship you want to upgrade! A branching path will lead you to the final boss. Plan your route wisely in order to take the most advantageous path! You can't control the number of the dices, but you can pick and choose what to do with them! Along the galaxy you'll find special places where luck and strategy combine so you can level up your systems and have certain advantages in combat.

rows.name: Taskbar Looters
rows.short_description: Taskbar Looters is a simple idle game where animal looters collect treasures on your desktop while you focus on other tasks.
rows.description_html: Taskbar Looters is a very simple idle game where you recruit animal looters to break open chests right on your desktop. Recruit Looters: All you need to do is spend coins to recruit looters, and they will happily open chests for you automatically! However, no matter how badly they want to, they can't break open chests that are out of reach. Collect Treasures: Gather coins and stars from chests! Use coins to unlock and recruit a variety of looters, and spend stars to upgrade them, making your looters stronger! Looters are Interactive: Each type of looter has its own reaction when clicked. Through interaction, you can help them find nearby chests—or even distract them!

rows.name: Green Revival
rows.short_description: The Valley is in trouble! It's infected by thrown out batteries. Plants are endangered by poisoned soil and hungry bugs munching on every leaf or branch they can find. Only young Plant Spirit can find the source of the harm. Fight bugs, collect and plant new seeds and seek allies to save the Valley!
rows.description_html: You are a young Plant Spirit who is trying to save his ancestral Valley. It is dying from an unknown source of infection, with bugs becoming more dangerous and plants no longer growing. What happened and who will help you fight back? Start the adventure and find out the answers. The path lays from the safe and familiar garden to the farthest corner of the Valley, where the source of the poison is hiding. Our hero will travel through the forest and mountains. And in the caves Spirit will have to face another danger - pitch black darkness. Spirits don’t have bodies, so they are unable to affect the world around them. The only things they can do are moving and observing. But after long years of living in the Valley spirits learned another trick - possessing plants. While hiding inside a plant Spirit can shoot seeds to plant new plants or to protect himself from hungry bugs. Each plant shoots differently, for example, ficus shoots poisonous juice and chestnut throws a heavy seed that strikes down anything in it’s way. Each plant can be useful in a different situation! Hungry bugs and exploding batteries - those are the enemies that Spirit will have to face on his way. Each of them has a weakness against a certain type of plant. Our hero is going on a dangerous journey but he won’t have to be on his own, Old Spirit, his teacher, will help and support him the entire time. From the safety of the garden, of course. Also during his adventure Spirit will meet new unexpected friends, some of which will join and travel with him. To save endangered plants Spirit will have to collect new seeds while travelling. And, of course, learn how to use the new plants. Old Spirit gathered all the information about Valley’s plant life in a handbook which Spirit will be able to read at any time. The source of the poison, giant battery monster, won’t be an easy target. To save the Valley Spirit will have to figure out a strategy and use the most effective plants. And his friends will help him!

rows.name: The Gallery
rows.short_description: The Gallery is a first-person puzzle game where every painting holds a secret. Explore a mysterious art museum, solve observation-based riddles, and unlock new rooms by deciphering clues hidden within the artwork. Will you uncover the truth behind the gallery?
rows.description_html: The Gallery , a mysterious first-person puzzle adventure where every painting hides a secret. Navigate two eerie galleries, each containing eight rooms filled with mind-bending puzzles, cryptic clues, and interactive artwork. To progress, you must decipher riddles, manipulate paintings, and uncover hidden patterns to unlock the next door. With no time limits, an immersive ambient soundtrack, and a unique collectible system, The Gallery offers a relaxed yet thought-provoking experience. Observe, experiment, and solve—can you uncover the gallery’s ultimate mystery? Key Features: 🖼️ Painting-Based Puzzles – Change, rearrange, and decode artwork to solve intricate riddles. 🔎 Interactive Environment – Pull levers, rotate paintings, and manipulate objects to unlock secrets. 🎵 Atmospheric Soundtrack – A haunting yet relaxing ambiance enhances the experience. 📜 Collectibles & Hidden Clues – Find and display artifacts that reveal more about the gallery. 🚶 Explore at Your Own Pace – No timers, just a deep dive into the world of art and mystery. Wishlist now and prepare to unlock the secrets of The Gallery !

rows.name: Bait & Tackle
rows.short_description: Catch exotic fish and fight comical sea-monsters as you chase after The One That Got Away in this fishing-centric boss rush!
rows.description_html: Get Hooked on this Fishing Adventure… Where The Fish Fight Back! Step into the boots of a legendary fisherman returning from a shameful retirement. Travel the coastline chasing after exotic fish and regaining your forgotten skills. But beware – deadly catches are lurking everywhere… Take down a variety of comical bosses in fast-paced, high-intensity fights! Cast your fishing line like a grappling hook to sling yourself around stages, while also using your rod to smack sea monsters into submission! The One That Got Away… Long ago, The Big One got away and forced you into an early retirement. But now, you finally have the chance to redeem your reputation following recent sightings of the mythical monster! Follow the trail of rumors while taking down other terrible creatures that have been terrorizing the coast, including Mini Minnow , Big Bass , Crude Crab , and Swordmaster Swordfish .  No Laughing Matter. Don’t let their wacky appearance fool you: each boss fight will push you to your limits and provide fresh challenges that force you to make the most of the fishing rod you wield. You’ll learn to master various movement techniques and boss patterns while constantly switching up strategies and adapting on the fly! As you improve, chase high scores as you replay past fights and challenge yourself with Super-Boss versions of fights! A suite of accessibility options ensures that you can play by your own rules and rise to any challenge. Gotta Fish ‘Em All! Chase after dozens and dozens of unique fish (and secret easter eggs) in each location! With unique rarities and difficulties, filling up your Fishdex is no easy task…  Download for Free Today! Filled with hand-crafted pixel art, gut-busting jokes, and nail-biting challenges, the world of Bait & Tackle awaits… Grab your fishing rod, cast your line, and chase after The One that Got Away !

rows.name: QuestionBank
rows.short_description: Challenge the limits of your knowledge! This is an exciting trivia competition game with millions of questions waiting for you to conquer. Come join the challenge—who will become the ultimate King of Knowledge?
rows.description_html: 'QuestionBank' is a trivia game where you get one free quiz attempt every day. Each time you answer a question correctly, you consume one attempt and earn a unique 'Cat Coin.' Answering 30 questions correctly in a row will unlock the legendary 'Golden Scroll,' but there are only 1 million attempts available in total. By continuously answering questions, you not only test your knowledge and challenge your limits, but also compete with players worldwide! With every correct answer, you're one step closer to claiming the title of Quiz Champion! The 1 million+ question database covers everything from simple arithmetic to the creator's wildest ideas. With daily non-intelligent recommendations, it adapts to a brainpower marathon for players of all ages!
rows.about_html: 'QuestionBank' is a trivia game where you get one free quiz attempt every day. Each time you answer a question correctly, you consume one attempt and earn a unique 'Cat Coin.' Answering 30 questions correctly in a row will unlock the legendary 'Golden Scroll,' but there are only 1 million attempts available in total. By continuously answering questions, you not only test your knowledge and challenge your limits, but also compete with players worldwide! With every correct answer, you're one step closer to claiming the title of Quiz Champion! The 1 million+ question database covers everything from simple arithmetic to the creator's wildest ideas. With daily non-intelligent recommendations, it adapts to a brainpower marathon for players of all ages!

rows.name: End Chess Arrow
rows.short_description: It seems like Chinese Chess, but perhaps you can hold the entire game with just a crossbow. A strategy-based turn-based roguelike game.
rows.description_html: This time it's Chinese chess, but you have to play alone against the enemy. You can act every turn and have the long-range shooting ability of a crossbow; the enemy's army is closing in, and they will act whenever their patience runs out. On your turn, you can choose to move or shoot. Your crossbow has an extremely long range, but it is only precise in a flat shot within effective range. At long distances, the shot will randomly land somewhere within the expected area. Skillfully control the distance between you and the enemy to avoid being checkmated, and decisively shoot arrows to weaken the enemy’s ability to act, perhaps finding a slim chance of survival in the deadly battle. After each level, the shop will randomly offer various options for both character and enemy buffs. You can spend gold to strengthen yourself or take a risk by choosing to give buffs to the enemy, earning extra money to further enhance your own abilities. Balance the risks and rewards, and make careful decisions as you face increasingly complex challenges. In this unpredictable battlefield, who knows whether you can defy fate and perhaps truly end some of the boring chess games. Each game typically takes around 15 minutes to complete. The core gameplay is mostly complete, but we are still working on gameplay refinement, balance adjustments, and performance optimization . Your feedback is invaluable in helping us further polish the game and enhance the final experience.

rows.name: Railway Chai Wala
rows.short_description: Step into the world of Ramu, a spirited railway chaiwala at the bustling Fakripur station. Life isn’t just about brewing chai—it’s steeped in mystery! Uncover dark, masala-filled secrets in this Psychological Thriller Game with a blend of suspense and Indian flavor!
rows.description_html: Step into the chaotic yet captivating life of a Railway Chai Wala at the Fakripur railway station, where the rhythm of trains is matched only by the hustle of hungry passengers. Ramu, a hardworking chaiwala running his shop at the Fakripur railway station. From brewing chai to frying samosas, serving guests, and selling cola, your daily tasks are as lively as the trains rushing past. But beneath the vibrant surface of sizzling samosas and steaming chai lies a web of secrets waiting to be unraveled. Key Features: Chai Brewing: Show your skills in brewing the perfect cup of chai and coffee, delighting passengers with authentic Indian flavors. Indian Snacks Galore: Serve crispy samosas, prepare mouthwatering vada pav, and offer chilled Kokila Kola to satisfy a variety of cravings for hungry travelers. Engage with Passengers: Meet a colorful cast of characters, each with their own quirks, stories, and sometimes with eerie behavior. Railway Platform Realism: Experience the sights, sounds, and chaos of a bustling Indian railway station, complete with dynamic crowds and lifelike audio. Eerie Mysteries Unfold: Encounter strange events and uncover the hidden, spine-chilling secrets lurking in the station’s shadows. Authentic Indian Vibes: Immerse yourself in the cultural essence of India with vibrant visuals, detailed environments, and an atmospheric soundtrack that brings Fakripur to life. Whether it’s brewing chai or unraveling mysteries, Railway Chai Wala is a game that blends the warmth of Indian hospitality with the thrill of suspense. Can you thrive as Fakripur’s favorite chaiwala while braving the station’s enigmatic secrets? The answers await in this one-of-a-kind adventure!

rows.name: Art House
rows.short_description: Art House is a 2D puzzle platformer in which you play as a woman who gets trapped with her children inside the paintings of her recently deceased mother. Navigate through painting rips and use a magical paintbrush to escape and come to terms with your grief.
rows.description_html: In Art House, step into the life of Lisa, mother to Ollie and Zoe, who's struggling to pick up the pieces of her life after the passing of her mother, Betty. After returning to Betty's mountain home, Lisa and her kids get trapped inside of Betty's paintings where her memories come to life. Guide Lisa through hauntingly beautiful paintings while solving puzzles and confronting the shadows of the family’s past. Navigate a journey through grief and towards healing that lingers after the final brushstroke. Features : Hand-drawn 2D environments inspired by Impressionism and Post-Impressionism Environmental puzzles combining platforming, object manipulation, and strategic enemy avoidance Dynamic layer-switching through painting rips to navigate foreground and background Magical paintbrush mechanics to restore broken objects, move platforms, and repaint the world Multiple enemy types with unique behaviors, including patrolling, lurking, and rip-chasing A fully voice-acted, narrative-driven experience told through memories and evolving paintings

rows.name: Chaos Classroom
rows.short_description: Chaos Classroom is an action-roguelite, bullet-heaven where the player selects a team to fight hordes of make-believe enemies in an imaginative dream version of the school, with the option of swapping between different students as they try to make it to the end of each week.
rows.description_html: Chaos Classroom is a fast-paced action roguelite and bullet heaven adventure that takes place in the imagination of a group of students. Players will navigate through reimagined school settings—gymnasiums into castles, math class into a witch's paradise, and science class into a lab for variety of slimy experiments. All of these teeming with a variety of make-believe monsters. Team up with a dynamic cast of students, each bringing their unique abilities, personalities, and playstyles into the fray. Swap seamlessly between characters to strategize, exploit enemy weaknesses, or adapt to the challenges the imaginative school world throws your way. Survive escalating waves of whimsical foes and collect powerful upgrades as you strive to make it through the chaotic week. Will you master the creativity-fueled chaos and emerge victorious, or will the classroom get the better of you and end up in detention? Jump into the action and let your imagination run wild!

rows.short_description: Survive for a long time against endless waves of wild boars with the lonely protagonist. Then, set your best score and brag to your friends.
rows.description_html: About This Game Survive for a long time against endless waves of wild boars with the lonely protagonist. Then, set your best score and brag to your friends. When the game starts, a boar will spawn at each respawn location. All wild boars rush towards the protagonist. If you defeat a boar, you get 1 point. The game ends when the main character's HP becomes 0. Play time Takes 40 minutes based on a score of 100 Controls The character moves using W, S, A, and D, J for attack, and K for dash.

rows.name: Napolitan Hotel
rows.short_description: A thrilling horror game where strange phenomena and mysterious entities disrupt your night shift. Can you finish your work and become a full-time employee?
rows.description_html: Welcome. It’s your first night shift as a staff member at the Napolitan Hotel. Your tasks at the hotel are very simple. Your main duty is to complete the safety checklist placed on each floor. If you notice any suspicious objects or items in the hallway, call the front desk to receive appropriate instructions. However, there may be situations that the front desk cannot resolve. For example: The elevator you’re in suddenly moves to a floor you didn’t select. The power system unexpectedly shuts down, turning off the hallway lights. A strange sound gets closer and closer to you... To prepare for such situations, make sure to familiarize yourself with the Staff-Only Safety Guidelines passed down by senior employee Steve. Use all your senses to make it through the night shift safely. If you do your job well, you may become the full-time hotel staff member you’ve always wanted to be. Good luck.

rows.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Words of Vengeance
rows.short_description: Type like your life depends on it in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun – Words of Vengeance! Smite the enemies of the Emperor with every keystroke spelling their demise. But every typo could mean the difference between life and death.
rows.description_html: The Mechanicum of Mars have gifted you a blessed new weapon - a keyboard! Brutally decimate hordes of daemonic scum with every keystroke, in this fast-paced rail shooter. None can stand against the might of your WPM!  RETURN TO GRAIA   Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun - Words of Vengeance is a creative twist on epic boomer shooter Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun. Instead of mowing down your enemies with elite FPS skills, kill the relentless hordes of enemies that descend upon you by typing out words.  Set in the world of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun, play as Malum Caedo on his mission to cleanse Forge World Graia of cultists, traitors and Chaos daemons that threaten to overrun it.    THE EMPEROR GUIDES YOUR HAND Put your typing skills to the test by typing out randomised words and phrases from Warhammer 40,000 lore to end the lives of your foes. Time to brush up on the spelling of Manufactorum, Incommodus, and Astronomican!   Obliterate your enemies by quickly typing their death sentences but beware as one typo could spell your own demise.   FEATURES  Creative reimagining of Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun as a first-person typing game.   Randomised words and phrases from Warhammer 40,000 lore to make every playthrough unique  The faster you type, the quicker you kill.   Difficult to master with 4 difficulties for every level

rows.name: HardDriverz
rows.short_description: Burn rubber across futuristic cityscapes on twisting gravity defying tracks with customizable karts in this competitive arcade racer!
rows.description_html: HardDriverz is an arcade racing game where players can customize their karts to compete through fun, twisty, futuristic tracks that defy gravity. Pick different cool, unique power-ups that will help you get ahead of other racers as you compete to be the fastest racer. Race through six tracks that showcase three terrain themes as you compete against AI racers! Each track is set in one of three different terrains digitally recreated within a packed stadium, filled with eager spectators ready to see who will win the race. Start your race through the iridescent roads of “Disc Drive” as you boost through to victory. Twist and turn through the hilly dunes of a sandy “Android Arena” wasteland. Fly through the neon-lit cyberscape of “Circuit City” as you see a vibrant city inside of a computer. Customize your kart to look and play the way you want to! Choose how you want to play by customizing how your kart looks. Change your kart’s wheels, spoiler, and engine to adjust your acceleration, handling, and weight abilities. You can even choose what colors to make your kart and driver. There are over a hundred possible kart combinations, so discover your unique race champion. Powerful pickup items will give you the edge over your competitors! Utilize six different pickup items that can give a variety of fun abilities that can help you further your advantage or catch up to the competition. From shields to speed boosts and a tractor beam that’ll drag you to an opponent up ahead, these powerful pickups will be key to your victory. Made by the students at SMU Guildhall HardDriverz was made by the students of Cohort 34 at SMU Guildhall as part of their Team Game Project II course over the course of a 12-week development cycle.  Click the 'Visit the Website' link in the list to the right of this description for more information.  Thank you for supporting this team, and please help spread the word if you enjoyed it.

Discover a diverse cast of dinosaurs with a range of unique abilities. Get ready for a primordial tower-defense adventure!
rows.description_html: Get ready for a tower defense game 65 million years in the making! Assemble a herd of unique dinosaurs to defend against an onslaught of invading insects.  Control the Terrain! Dinos TD flips the tower defense genre on its head! You control the battlefield! Draw the paths your enemies walk on. Place Biome tiles to give your Dinos boons! Dinosaurs! Dinosaurs! Dinosaurs! Discover a wide range of Dinosaurs each offering a new way to strategize and synergize with the environment and other dinos. Level up each Dino to unlock flashy new abilities.  Avoid Extinction! Play around destructive world events like the meteor! Become the master of dinosaurs in Dinos TD!

rows.short_description: A brutal, arcade-style dungeon crawler with modernized combat, Souls-like intensity, and retro-inspired visuals.Classic Dungeon Crawling Reimagined Arcade Souls-Like Gameplay
rows.description_html: The Path of Blades A brutal, arcade-style dungeon crawler with modernized combat, Souls-like intensity, and retro-inspired visuals. Enter the Dungeon. Survive the Unknown. You’ve been thrown into a treacherous labyrinth where survival is instinct, and every decision is the difference between life and death. Navigate dark corridors, dodge deadly traps, and engage in visceral melee combat as you carve your way through this ever-hostile dungeon. Classic Dungeon Crawling Reimagined First-Person & Third-Person Combat Dynamic Combat System Wield an arsenal of melee weapons, dodge with i-frames, and use skillful timing to survive. Arcade Souls-Like Gameplay Destructible Barrels & Loot – Smash your way through the secondary environment to uncover hidden rewards. Unforgiving Traps & Ambushes. Pixelated Modern Aesthetic – A fusion of Doom-inspired retro pixelation with modern lighting and physics for a fresh but nostalgic experience.

rows.name: Hermes' Runner
rows.short_description: Hermes Runner is a 3D movement-based open level parkour punk game. Freerun using Hermes’ boots, deface billboards, and make deliveries in a reimagined 2000s Greek city where the Gods are real, and they own everything.
rows.description_html: The Gods are impatient. Don’t keep them waiting. Hermes Runner is a fast-paced parkour game set to the backdrop of an alternate universe Greek city defined by its hyper-capitalist Pantheon. Traverse the city as quickly as possible to please your celestial boss, and tag things along the way to be stylish while doing it. Speed-based movement system - Master a momentum based movement system to navigate the city. Deliveries to colorful characters - Engage with colorful, voice-acted characters that give a glimpse into the alternate reality setting. Spray painting, sticker tagging, paint bombs - Leave your mark on the city with unique tags. Hermes' Runner is produced by Hermes Devs LLC, a member owned indie studio brought to you by senior students at Utah Games. We hope you enjoy early access, and we hope you keep up with our upcoming final touches!

rows.name: Whispers of the Architects
rows.short_description: Echoes of the Architects is a fast-paced real-time strategy game where creativity drives victory. Design modular, programmable units to build your perfect army. Adapt and outsmart your opponents in dynamic skirmishes that reward tactical precision, ingenuity, and strategic mastery.
rows.description_html: Demo Content In this demo, you’ll get a hands-on experience with the game’s core mechanics, including the modular design of your units and their programmable functionality. The demo showcases the initial levels, featuring two maps and providing enough points to experiment with approximately ten modules and tactics. Gameplay Echoes of the Architects is a real-time strategy game that rewards creativity, strategic depth, and adaptability. Victory lies in your ability to design and deploy customizable, programmable units to dominate the battlefield. At its heart is a robust unit customization system, letting you build armies tailored to your playstyle. Combine modules like locomotion systems, weapons, and repair tools, and define your units’ roles—whether gathering resources, defending key points, or executing precision strikes to outflank enemies. Battles are fast-paced and dynamic, demanding sharp strategic thinking and quick adaptation. With programmable units capable of executing complex maneuvers autonomously, you can focus on your tactics rather than high actions-per-minute gameplay. As you advance, unlock new modules, unit classes, and tactical options, continuously evolving your forces. Explore diverse planets, each with unique environments and challenges, as you expand the fight across the galaxy. In Echoes of the Architects, every decision matters. Success depends on how you configure your army, time your deployments, and outmaneuver your opponents in the relentless chaos of war. Key Features Design with Precision : Craft modular, programmable units, each tailored to play a specific role in your customizable army. Shape your strategy, one unit at a time. Adapt Strategically : Analyze your opponent's strengths and weaknesses to deploy the perfect combination of units for any challenge. Flexibility is your greatest weapon. Deploy Tactically : Master the art of timing and positioning in dynamic skirmishes. Outsmart your enemies with clever builds and adaptable tactics. Dominate the Battlefield : Unlock powerful modules and advanced tactics to upgrade your army, overcoming tougher foes and securing victory through superior innovation. Asynchronous Multiplayer : Enjoy stress-free gameplay with pausable battles and unlimited, always-on replayability Story The galaxy was ours to conquer—or so we believed. In our unyielding quest for dominance, humanity delved too deeply into the void, awakening a force beyond comprehension: the Architects. Silent, enigmatic, and devastatingly efficient, they seized our greatest creations—turning humanity’s own advanced technologies into instruments of annihilation. Entire worlds fell in mere moments, their skies darkened by the machines we once called progress. Now, you stand as one of the last sparks of resistance, seeking shelter on a scarred and broken Earth—a planet consumed by the wars and greed of its past. With only the remnants of human ingenuity at your disposal, you command the battlefield from a distance, deploying what’s left of our scattered forces. Clues that hint at the true nature of the Architects, their purpose, and why they were waiting for us to awaken them. Understanding them might be the key to victory—or a revelation too dangerous to confront. The demo showcases the initial levels, featuring two maps and providing enough points to experiment with approximately ten modules and tactics. Gameplay Echoes of the Architects is a real-time strategy game that rewards creativity, strategic depth, and adaptability. Victory lies in your ability to design and deploy customizable, programmable units to dominate the battlefield. At its heart is a robust unit customization system, letting you build armies tailored to your playstyle. Combine modules like locomotion systems, weapons, and repair tools, and define your units’ roles—whether gathering resources, defending key points, or executing precision strikes to outflank enemies. Battles are fast-paced and dynamic, demanding sharp strategic thinking and quick adaptation. With programmable units capable of executing complex maneuvers autonomously, you can focus on your tactics rather than high actions-per-minute gameplay. As you advance, unlock new modules, unit classes, and tactical options, continuously evolving your forces. Explore diverse planets, each with unique environments and challenges, as you expand the fight across the galaxy. In Echoes of the Architects, every decision matters. Success depends on how you configure your army, time your deployments, and outmaneuver your opponents in the relentless chaos of war. Key Features Design with Precision : Craft modular, programmable units, each tailored to play a specific role in your customizable army. Shape your strategy, one unit at a time. Adapt Strategically : Analyze your opponent's strengths and weaknesses to deploy the perfect combination of units for any challenge. Flexibility is your greatest weapon. Deploy Tactically : Master the art of timing and positioning in dynamic skirmishes. Outsmart your enemies with clever builds and adaptable tactics. Dominate the Battlefield : Unlock powerful modules and advanced tactics to upgrade your army, overcoming tougher foes and securing victory through superior innovation. In our unyielding quest for dominance, humanity delved too deeply into the void, awakening a force beyond comprehension: the Architects. Silent, enigmatic, and devastatingly efficient, they seized our greatest creations—turning humanity’s own advanced technologies into instruments of annihilation. Entire worlds fell in mere moments, their skies darkened by the machines we once called progress. The more contracts you win and successfully complete, the faster your company will grow, advancing toward industry leadership. CHARACTER NEEDS Manage your own needs by drinking coffee to boost energy and taking timely restroom breaks to stay productive and efficient throughout the workday.

This gives you a taste of the core gameplay experience and a glimpse of what’s waiting for you in the full version! 'Conveyor Belt Sushi Simulator' is a cozy first-person simulation where you serve sushi to customers, earn money, and grow your sushi restaurant business. PROLOGUE FEATURES: Make sushi and place it on the conveyor belt, allowing customers to pick their favorite sushi. Order stock from the supplier using your tablet. Clean the table for the next customer and deal with troublesome customers before they cause any trouble.

Features: 7 different events to react to Seeing the timer go up Collect Steam Achievements Compete with other guards through an Online Leaderboard This game will test your patience, how long can you guard the button?

rows.name: Dusty
rows.short_description: Dusty is a fast-paced multiplayer shooter where strategy and skill determine victory. Join intense battles in Capture the Flag, Team Deathmatch, and Free for All, with more modes coming soon. Choose your team, fight for dominance, and experience adrenaline-fueled combat!
rows.description_html: Dusty is an intense multiplayer shooter where strategy, teamwork, and skill come together for thrilling combat. Players are divided into two fierce teams, Phantom and Blaze , battling it out across a variety of game modes: Capture the Flag , Team Deathmatch , and Free for All(More gamemodes will be added) . In Capture the Flag , players work together to outmaneuver and outsmart the enemy team to secure the flag and score points. Team Deathmatch challenges each team to dominate the battlefield, trying to get more kills than enemy. For those who prefer the chaos of solo combat, Free for All throws players into an all-out battle, where it's every player for themselves. Whether you're a tactician coordinating with teammates or a lone wolf aiming to be the last one standing, Dusty offers fast-paced action, intense firefights, and a variety of strategies to keep you on the edge of your seat. Join the fight, choose your team, and prove your dominance in the ultimate arena!

rows.name: ONE MAP - Never Ending Battle Royale
rows.short_description: One Map is an online shooter where the entire world fights in the same never-ending battle. No lobbies, no waiting—just instant action. The dynamic map adjusts to the player count, ensuring non-stop combat. Survive, compete, and help break the world record for the most players online in a game.
rows.description_html: One Map is a revolutionary online multiplayer third-person shooter game where the entire world joins a single, never-ending battle royale. With no match-making wait times, you instantly dive into continuous PVP action, surrounded by players from across the globe. Gamers are tired of complicated menus and long waits — in One Map, the focus is on what matters most: the action. The map dynamically adjusts its size based on how many players are online, so it's never too big to feel empty or too small to feel crowded, ensuring the perfect balance for engaging gameplay and strategy. When you die, jump straight back into the death match and keep trying to survive longer than before. The goal is simple: survival. Play solo and rely on your own skills, or team up with friends to get an edge in this intense third person shooter. Every second counts, and the clock is always ticking. It’s simple to play but hard to master—perfect for those looking for a real shooter challenge. One Map’s goal is to break the world record for the most players online in a single game. With its continuous game design, One Map brings players together in one massive, real-time battle royale. The current record is 8,825 players, and we need your help to beat it. Join the fight, stay alive, and make gaming history in this ultimate survival showdown. Features: One Global Game: No more waiting for match-making! Everyone around the world is playing the same game, so there's always a strategy-packed match to join in this intense PVP arena. Dynamic Map Size: The map expands or contracts based on the number of players online, ensuring it's never too big or too small, creating the perfect environment for intense action and strategic play. Survive Together or Alone: Play solo to test your skills, or team up with friends to gain an advantage in this intense third person shooter. Real-Time Leaderboards: Track your progress with in-game leaderboards that rank every current player based on survival time. The player who has survived the longest will be ranked first, followed by the rest. Additionally, view daily, weekly, and all-time leaderboards that highlight the top players in this thrilling battle royale experience. Combat Variety: Take down opponents your way—shoot them in PVP combat, sneak up for an assassination, or celebrate a win with dance moves. Choose Your Character: Pick from a variety of characters with unique appearances. They all perform the same but let you customize your look on the battlefield. How long can you survive? The longer you stay in the game, the greater the battle royale challenge. Dive into One Map - Never Ending Battle now, and see how long you can last in this intense multiplayer action and strategy game!

rows.name: Discussion Over Dinner
rows.short_description: You receive a dinner invite from an awkward new neighbor and things go great.
rows.description_html: Discussion Over Dinner is a simple, snappily paced experience which forces you to quickly formulate coherent responses to your new neighbor's almost interrogatory questions in real time. As you keep the conversation flowing, study your host's body language for any sign of irritation while remembering to keep your own physical mannerisms in check. Depending on your social skills you may be able to leave the table good friends! Or you might become another secret he'll have to hide from a future dinner guest. Discussion Over Dinner is designed specifically to be played on computer with a keyboard and requires every key to be working properly in order to play. Please only play the game if it's running at a smooth framerate to avoid any potential softlocks or sequence breaks!

As you wait for your friends to arrive the next day, a strange message is broadcasted on national television, signaling the start of a nightmare you can’t escape.
rows.description_html: ANALOG Analog is game series that combines a first person horror experience with analog horror . SKIN OFF Skin off is the first game in Analog, where you play as a teenager during summer break. You decide to stay at your uncle's house away from the city with your friends. A strange message, however, appears on the TV that changes your plans. Follow the instruction if you want to survive.  With its VHS like visuals  and  creepy atmosphere  Skin off fully immerses you to its nostalgic  90's aesthetic , so you can experience analog horror in the appropriate environment.

rows.name: My life with you
rows.short_description: 'My Life with You' is a STORY DRIVEN experience that follows the journey of a young SINGLE MOM who must BALANCE life's challenges while raising her child. An emotional journey focused on the BOND BETWEEN MOTHER AND CHILD, marked by obstacles, growth, and love.
rows.description_html: 'My Life with You' tells the story of a young woman who, after falling in love as a teenager, ends up getting pregnant. Abandoned by her boyfriend, she must face the challenges of being a single mother, balancing work, household responsibilities, and her dream of building a better future for herself and her child. Living with her grandmother, she seeks a job to support their home while dealing with the struggles of motherhood and the possibility of finding love again. At the core of it all is the bond between mother and child, showing the highs and lows of a journey filled with challenges, growth, and love. This project was carried out with resources from Complementary Law No. 195/2022 – Paulo Gustavo Law, funded by the Paulo Gustavo Law, IECINE/RS, the State Department of Culture of Rio Grande do Sul, the Ministry of Culture, and the Federal Government, with execution by Sorora Game Studio. A sensitive narrative experience, with little to no text, accessible in any language. Explore the protagonist’s everyday life: caring for her child, searching for a job, and navigating her emotions. Play at your own pace—no timers, no pressure—just experience and connection.

rows.description_html: Kollywood: The Game is a stop motion video, comedy game with quick-time event fight scenes inspired by Tamil Cinema. Synopsis: It's been a long day for Baasha as he is watching a Tamil movie, sitting on his living room couch. He falls asleep on his couch... and in that moment, his life is changed forever. Taken from his living room and dropped into the world of Tamil Cinema, Baasha has to work his way through the movie to get back home. Gameplay: Complete the Quick-Time Events (Hold or Mash) to play through fight scenes. Failing QTE sequences will play a fail scene and then return to previous checkpoint. Dialogues are fully voiced in Tamil, with English subtitles. Estimated Gameplay Time: 15-20 minutes

Synopsis: It's been a long day for Baasha as he is watching a Tamil movie, sitting on his living room couch. He falls asleep on his couch... and in that moment, his life is changed forever. Taken from his living room and dropped into the world of Tamil Cinema, Baasha has to work his way through the movie to get back home. Gameplay: Complete the Quick-Time Events (Hold or Mash) to play through fight scenes. Failing QTE sequences will play a fail scene and then return to previous checkpoint. Dialogues are fully voiced in Tamil, with English subtitles. Estimated Gameplay Time: 15-20 minutes

rows.name: Aker Fern 2
rows.short_description: Take on the role of Dan Tern, a young man in whom the consciousness of Mikołaj Fern—a man from five hundred years ago—has awakened. Discover the mysteries of the past, confront the curse that haunts him, and conclude a story that never reached its end.
rows.description_html: Aker Fern 2 – a visual novel unlike any you've experienced before! Continuing the story of mystery, destiny and the impact of the past on the present In the 16th century, in a world filled with superstition and mystery, there lived a man named Mikołaj Fern. He was no ordinary traveler but someone who sought to discover truths that could change his fate. Traversing the lands of the Republic, he tracked supernatural phenomena and eliminated them not out of concern for humanity but out of a desire to escape his inevitable fate. His life ended with a public execution, but the story he began was not finished. New story, new hero, same fate After more than five hundred years, Dan Tern was born, an ordinary boy leading a quiet life until memories of a previous incarnation shatter his reality. Mikołaj Fern has returned, but this time in a different body and era. The mystery he carries enters the modern world, entailing events that will not only change his fate but also uncover the truth about the Shatris Core —an enigmatic element that influences human destiny. A new approach to narrative – changing perspectives Aker Fern 2 is a sequel to the visual novel released in 2020, distinguished by its innovative narrative form. This time, the story will not be told from only one perspective. The game introduces a system of changing characters , allowing the events of the previous part to take on new meaning and new plots to weave into a unified, immersive story. Multifaceted story – events are presented through the perspectives of different characters, allowing a deep understanding of their motivations and emotions. Coherent, linear narrative – although the game contains smaller choices, its main asset is a strongly developed storyline without unnecessary bifurcations, allowing you to focus on its quality. Character development – Dan Tern, like other characters, will evolve over the course of the game, affecting how you experience the story. Climate and style – a combination of humor and mystery The game's style is inspired by anime aesthetics, featuring clear outlines and a relatively simple yet thoughtful color palette. However, Aker Fern 2 is not just about beautiful illustrations; it is primarily a story that combines elements of mystery, drama, and comedy . The narrative surprises with emotional moments and unexpected humorous twists. Secrets of the past – discover the secrets Fern has been hiding and learn the consequences of his past decisions. Exaggerated humor – light and comedic moments contrast with more serious themes, creating a unique dynamic. Action elements – dynamic scenes that can be compared to the shounen's showy parts. What can you expect in the full version? The game's demo offers only a snippet of the story; the full version contains ten times more content! You can expect: More locations and illustrations – each scene has been designed with attention to detail to immerse the player in the right mood.. An extensive soundtrack – atmospheric music that provides depth. In-depth storyline – new chapters, new mysteries, and new emotions! Refreshed graphics – elements known from the demo have been improved and enhanced. Key information Platform: PC (Steam) Genre: Visual novel (visual novel) Engine: Ren'Py Free demo available on Steam Who is this game for? If you appreciate a deep, engaging narrative and are interested in stories of mystery and time travel , then Aker Fern 2 is for you. The game will especially appeal to those who love visual novels with an intriguing plot but do not shy away from humor and dynamic scenes . Why is Aker Fern 2 worth playing? Unique combination of genres Aker Fern 2 is primarily a visual novel that combines elements of thriller, drama, fantasy, and subtle humor . The game offers a story where the mysteries of the past intertwine with the characters' personal choices. Instead of imposing a pace, it allows the player to discover its details independently. It's a story-driven journey that explores the impact of decisions, destiny, and self-understanding—without unnecessary embellishments or exaggerated drama. A deeper understanding of the plot Although the game doesn't offer many plot bifurcations, the player, in the role of an observer, has the opportunity for a deeper understanding of the characters and their motivations. This is not a classic interactive story where choices change the course of events; instead, the player discovers different layers of the same story , analyzing the fate of the characters from various perspectives. This approach allows for a deeper immersion into the presented world and an understanding of what truly drives the characters . Heroes – who are they, and how do they affect the story? Dan Tern / Mikołaj Fern – two personalities, one destiny The main character of the game is Dan Tern , an ordinary young man leading a quiet life until his consciousness becomes permeated by memories of his previous incarnation. Mikołaj Fern comes back to life, and his memory begins to dominate Dan's mind. They are both the same person, but their life paths intertwine to form one cohesive character. Together, they form a full-bodied character: on one hand, a determined young man, and on the other, someone who has experienced too much to be naive. Other characters Ajris We meet Ajris at a time when her life had completely fallen apart, and she was contemplating suicide. As she plunged further into the lake, she heard the laughter of an older man—Mikołaj Fern. His behavior irritated her greatly, but his words made her decide to abandon her intention and eventually follow him. Since then, Ajris has accompanied Mikołaj Fern on his travels. Over time, she began to appreciate him as a man who changed her life. She recognized that if she had to sacrifice herself to save him, she would do so without hesitation. However, at one point in the story, she finds Mikołaj Fern hanging from a noose. When Mikołaj Fern's soul is burdened with a curse, forcing him to kill his own family, Ajris confronts his chained soul and is mortally wounded. However, she discovers a way to free him. Her soul is separated from her body, and the curse is sealed inside. Mikołaj's soul finds peace and passes away, while Ajris's soul remains trapped in the human world for 500 years—until Mikołaj's consciousness awakens in Dan Terna. From then on, Ajris, as a spirit, constantly accompanies him. Sana Gabler Sana was created from a combination of the curse incumbent on Mikołaj Fern and Ajris' body. The body was supposed to remain sealed for eternity, but Dan Tern opens the sarcophagus, hoping to restore Ajris to her body. However, he discovers that over 500 years, the curse has developed a consciousness. He decides to name her Sana and observe her behavior among humans to determine if she poses a threat. Blanka Surma Blanka is Dan's close friend and one of the most decisive characters in the game. She was by his side when the memory of Mikołaj Fern awoke in him. She is a meticulous person and a model student, but she also has an impulsive nature and is excellent at fighting, which has earned her the nickname 'Amazon' in the past. Weronika Furman Weronika epitomizes laziness—whiny, insufferable, and reliant on convenience, preferring others to do the work for her. Despite this, she is the president of the student government. What no one knows is that there is a secret related to the creation of the school where Dan ended up. She is a shadowy figure and plays a key role in the story. Tatiana Mika Tatiana is a girl with 'reporter's ADHD'—she's always seeking sensationalism and isn't afraid to step in where she shouldn't. In the past, she encountered the Last Devil and survived the confrontation thanks to Dan Tern's help. This experience left a mark on her character and motivations, which we discover throughout the game. Erika Flis Erika is the daughter of a school principal, and her life is marked by rebellion against her father and the rules imposed on her. She is energetic and spirited, often leading to absurd situations. Although Erika seems to be Tatiana's opposite, their fates intertwine in surprising ways. Ariel Biernat Ariel is a character shrouded in mystery. He accompanies Erika and Feliks on their comedic, yet often twisted, adventures. His motives remain unclear, and behind the facade of intelligence and precise actions lies a mystery yet to be uncovered. Karen Lasota Karen is one of the most enigmatic characters in the world of Aker Fern . She is quiet and aloof, giving the impression of someone who does not understand the reality around her. Her presence arouses anxiety and curiosity; she is an enigma that intrigues both the characters and the players. Game mechanics – what sets Aker Fern 2 apart? Narration based on emotions – the characters react to situations in a dynamic way, which makes the story more realistic. Stylized graphics and animation – anime aesthetics combined with refined lines make every scene resemble a frame from a high-quality animated series.. Why should you play? Aker Fern 2 is the full version of a game born from a passion for storytelling. It expands on the plots from the earlier demo , enriching them with new perspectives, characters, and mysteries. This visual novel not only narrates the fate of its characters but also allows players to reflect on their own choices and their consequences. Our goal was to create a game that combines an immersive storyline with an unconventional atmosphere—something we would want to experience as players ourselves. We put our hearts into every detail, from the dialogues to the music, to ensure that the story of the Aker Fern world captivates you completely. The game is completely free, just like our previous projects. We aim to promote Polish visual novels and want everyone to access our work without financial barriers. If you've played the demo, you know that Aker Fern is more than a simple game—it's a story awaiting your interpretation and decisions. We encourage you to discover the whole story and learn the truth about the Shatris Core. We hope you find something here that inspires, intrigues, or simply allows you to have a nice time.

rows.name: Wardoll
rows.short_description: Wardoll is wargame campaign that you play as a doll on a commander vs commander game mode. Build, spawn toy soldiers and send them to battle! In a top down perspective you can experience a backyard battle with riflemans, tanks and AT but also your doll has a special gun that you can use.
rows.description_html: Bring back nostalgia with this commander vs commander wargame. You will experience battles of toy soldiers with rifles, tanks and rockets that will help you reimagine how playing with dolls is. Each team has 1 commander and all the game revolves around it. You need to make sure to keep yours alive while trying to defeat the enemy one. If the commander die the game is lost, if you kill the enemy commander the game is won. The enemy commander is the one standing on their base and yours is the US Army Cavalry Scout 19-D Wardoll. You will send riflemans or tanks to the enemy commander? 50, 100 or 200 soldiers is enough to controll the battlefield? Long battle with toy soldiers or short operation to kill enemy commander? Is time for you to experience what it feels to play with a doll in a way that you have never seen before! Rifleman - They cost 60 gas and 20 earth, is the backbone of your toy army. You can spawn units pressing the picture of it on the bottom left corner. You need a 3D Printer in order to build the and they apear where you build the printer. Select them with left click and order the position right clicking the terrain. Tank - They cost 100 gas and 100 earth. You can spawn units pressing the picture of it on the bottom left corner. You need a 3D Printer in order to build the and they apear where you build the printer. Select them with left click and order the position right clicking the terrain. Anti Tank - They cost 100 gas and 100 earth. You can spawn units pressing the picture of it on the bottom left corner. You need a 3D Printer in order to build the and they apear where you build the printer. Select them with left click and order the position right clicking the terrain. Resources: Earth - You start with full resouces and make more all the time. If need to get resources faster just need to build more excavators. Gas - You start with full resouces and make more all the time. If need to get resources faster just need to build more pumpjacks.

rows.name: Luck and Fear
rows.short_description: A tense survival horror game where you must explore a dark, ever-changing hotel, solve puzzles, and evade a relentless killer. Every playthrough is unique, with randomized environments and unpredictable dangers.
rows.description_html: You wake up on the tenth floor of an abandoned hotel. Your head hurts—someone has attacked you, and now you’re trapped. You have no idea why this happened, but one thing is clear: you must escape. But the hotel is not just any abandoned building. It’s a maze of dark corridors, locked doors, and unexpected dangers. The way out is full of obstacles—and worst of all? You’re not alone. Game Features: Exploration and Puzzle Solving – Search for keys, hidden objects, and clues to progress through locked rooms and hallways. Survival Against a Killer – A mysterious enemy roams the halls looking for you. You must be careful, hide, and use your environment to survive. Intense Horror Atmosphere – Dynamic lighting, disturbing sounds, and a terrifying environment create a constant tension that will keep you on edge. Diverse Escape Routes – Choose from various ways to escape the hotel. Will you take the long, safer route, or risk a shorter but more dangerous route? A Mysterious and Shocking Story – Discover secret letters, and clues scattered throughout the hotel that will help you understand the hotel’s and the killer’s dark past—and your connection to it. A Random and Unpredictable Experience – Every time you play, the experience will be different. The hallways, rooms, and keys are randomly placed, making each escape attempt challenging and surprising.

rows.name: Magic Madness VR
rows.short_description: Magic Madness VR is an immersive elemental PvP arena where every motion is magic and every spell is a choice. Battle up to four players in fast, skill-based VR combat, mastering Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water across evolving arenas that test balance, reflex, and true elemental control.
rows.description_html: Welcome to a world where balance and chaos exist side by side. Magic Madness VR is a fast, full-body VR battle arena where up to 4 players clash using the primal forces of Wood, Fire, Earth, Metal, and Water. Every fight feels alive, spells twist through the air, the ground shakes beneath your feet, and the world bends to your rhythm. It’s not just about power; it’s about flow, timing, and instinct. Breathe in, move with purpose, and let the elements guide you. In the arena, control isn’t everything, connection is. Play as Brock Lee , Cobra Flash ... ...or as your spirit animal character ! Choose your spell loadouts ... ...and win the battle with your unique strategy ! Elements are living expressions of power, identity, and intent: Wood embodies growth and renewal. It thrives through movement and adaptation, twisting and expanding with unending vitality. Fire is passion made power... wild, consuming, and ever-transforming. It destroys to create and burns to be reborn. Earth stands firm, unmovable and eternal. It is patience, resilience, and strength forged through stillness. Metal is the edge of precision and discipline. Cold and deliberate, it strikes with perfect timing and unwavering resolve. Water flows with grace and intelligence, bending around resistance and reshaping the world through persistence. Dodge, throw, and strategize in real-time. Engage in intense battles with up to 4 players , add up to 4 bots , and use the integrated voice chat to coordinate with your team. Personalize the lobby just the way you like it! With our VR Builder , you can design, modify, and bring your vision to life instantly. Enter the Arena & Prove Your Skills!

rows.name: INVERTA
rows.short_description: Defy gravity in Inverta, a 2.5D puzzle-platformer set in a ruined world. Flip between surfaces, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover apocalyptic secrets. A unique challenge awaits!
rows.description_html: Inverta is a thrilling 2.5D puzzle-platformer where you defy gravity in a haunting post-apocalyptic world! Take control of gravity itself—flip between surfaces, solve mind-bending puzzles, and uncover the dark secrets of a war-torn land. With innovative mechanics, atmospheric storytelling, and challenging gameplay, Inverta offers a unique adventure for fans of indie games, physics-based puzzles, and immersive platformers. Can you escape the ruins of a shattered world? Master gravity, conquer obstacles, and unravel the mystery!

rows.name: slime feet
rows.short_description: slime feet is a linear visual novel, a love story for everyone who has ever had to love through a keyboard. slime feet is about the body horror of an inevitable drawn out death, and the lesbian slime feet cybersex that comes with it.
rows.description_html: slime feet is a linear visual novel. there are no choices. you can not change the outcome. you can only watch. slime feet is about an in-depth emotional exploration and reflection on long distance relationships, disability and illness. slime feet is about finding a sense of intimacy and lesbian sexual connection even in front of the macabre. slime feet is about how foot fetish prevails even when your favorite feet are turning into slime. SYNOPSIS In the sub-zero temperatures of the Arctic stands The Amoninsula Research Facility, a bunker housing the world's top scientists dedicated to studying and containing “Hazards”, anomalies which defy the laws of physics, as well as common sense. After a streak of unlucky incidents, Estelle Mcclendon finds herself in an encounter with a Hazard, becoming a “Host” for “Miasma”, an amorphous floating cloud that seeks to subsume living organisms. rows.name: Stella: into the Shadow
rows.short_description: 'Stella: into the Shadow' is a dark mystical story. When Stella's friend disappears, her life transforms into a detective mystery. Working at a nightclub, forging new connections, and uncovering the city's secrets will force her to reevaluate everything: from those around her to her very self.
rows.description_html: Stella thought she had her life under control—until her best friend sent a chilling message and vanished without a trace. Her search leads to Shadow , a secretive nightclub whispered about in Blackwood’s neon-lit streets. To enter, Stella must follow a trail of puzzles hidden across the city. Behind those doors may lie the truth about her friend — and far more dangerous secrets. Meet characters who could become allies, rivals, or something more: ·         Casey , the charming classmate who makes it easy to drop your guard. ·         Victor , the by-the-book detective unwillingly drawn into Stella’s world. ·         David , the enigmatic club owner who deals in temptations too good to refuse. Features: ·         Explore atmospheric Blackwood: cozy cafés, shadowy alleys, and exclusive neon clubs. ·         Solve puzzles and mini-games that turn investigation into a quest for hidden clues. ·         Shape Stella’s personality and relationships through branching choices. ·         Dive into an emotional story where intrigue, danger, and flirtation intertwine. Samantha’s disappearance is just the beginning. The real mystery is how many secrets you’ll uncover—and which ones will change Stella forever.

rows.name: Hetepheres Tomb - Secrets of the Lost Queen
rows.short_description: An interactive, history-based, virtual reality experience joined with a digital exhibition about one of the greatest discoveries made at the Giza necropolis. Retrace the steps of famous archeologists and ancient royals to find and restore their lost treasures.
rows.description_html: In 1925, the Harvard University & Boston Museum of Fine Arts Expedition under George Reisner made one of its greatest discoveries at Giza: Buried under sand, hidden among other tombs, lay the mysterious tomb G 7000X, which some believe was the final resting place of Queen Hetepheres I., mother of pharaoh Khufu. Join the expedition that discovered this strange tomb and help them solve the mysteries that lay within. Narrated by famous Egyptologist and Harvard Professor Peter Manuelian, you can visit a tomb that has been sealed shut for almost a century. Uncover and restore some of the invaluable artifacts to learn about the researcher's work and how it continues till present times. Modes The game aims to not only be fun to play for individuals but also to be played in an educational contexts (schools, museums, ...). Depending on how much time there is per person, you can choose between three modes*: - Long: Relive the full history of the tomb (Playtime: ~30 min) - Short: Focus on modern archeological work (Playtime: ~15 min) - Exhibition: Only the final exhibition (Playtime: ~5 min) * Each experience ends with players being able to explore the final exhibition.

rows.name: SIGame
rows.short_description: Exciting quiz game where you can test your knowledge, compete with friends and smart bots, and explore a variety of topics!
rows.description_html: SIGame is a classical intellectual game (first released in 2002) that lets you test your knowledge in a competitive atmosphere. In this game, you can challenge both experienced players and smart bots, showcasing your expertise across various fields. Key Features: Diverse Thematic Packs: Play quizzes on general knowledge, books, movies, cartoons and anime, music, and video games. Create Your Own Questions: Become a game creator by designing your own question packs. Invite friends to play in your unique setting and prove how well you know your own questions. Multiplayer Mode: Play with friends, compete in PvP mode, and find out who among you is the true master of intellectual games. SIGame offers engaging gameplay, a wide range of topics, and various game modes. Immerse yourself in the world of knowledge, test your intellect, and enjoy the challenge with SIGame !
