rows.name: Dream Slayers
rows.short_description: Enter the realm of the Dream Slayers, a Fantasy-Themed Extraction RPG where you battle nightmares, survive raids, and escape with powerful loot... or lose it all.
rows.description_html: Take Down The Darkness In Dream Slayers , Nightmares are more than enemies, they're the echoes of fear, regret, and chaos. Face cursed knights and shifting beasts , each more twisted than the last. Conquer the darkness to uncover the truth… or be consumed by it. Create Unstoppable Weapons In Dream Slayers , power is earned through what you find and how you forge it. Discover powerful weapons in the Dream World , then enhance and customize them to suit your style. Enchant gear, refine stats, and build a loadout that evolves with every raid. Enhance The Arsenal  In Dream Slayers , extraction is survival. Venture into the Dream World to claim rare relics and arcane loot  but the deeper you go, the deadlier it gets. Time your escape, trust your instincts, and remember: only what you extract becomes real. Rally Your Army  The Dream World is brutal, don’t face it alone. In Dream Slayers , you and your squad fight to survive and build a legacy . With up to four slayers, Team up, combine skills, and watch each other’s backs. With the right allies, even the impossible becomes possible.

rows.name: Snap Flex
rows.short_description: Snap Flex is a fast-paced card game based on classic Snap. Match ranks or suits, play with points or winner-takes-all. Enjoy offline or online multiplayer with up to 4 players.
rows.description_html: Snap Flex Snap Flex is a fast-paced, reflex-driven card game based on the classic Snap rules. Players take turns placing cards on the table. When two cards match in rank, the first to snap wins the pile. The goal is simple: collect all the cards to win. Flex Mode introduces new ways to play: Match both ranks and suits for a more dynamic, fast-paced experience. Play with point-based scoring , where each successful snap earns points instead of an all-or-nothing win. Game Modes: Offline Play: Compete against CPU opponents or play locally with friends . Online Multiplayer: Join or host a lobby with up to four players and test your reaction speed against others. With simple mechanics and quick rounds, Snap Flex is easy to learn and fun for players of all ages. Note: Online play includes a text chat feature.

rows.name: MeCatVR
rows.short_description: Be a cat in a cozy witch’s house in VR. Explore at your pace, parkour over the clouds, and unveil the house secrets. Relaxed, family-friendly and no text, no HUD, no pop-ups.
rows.description_html: Be a cat. Climb everything. Breathe. MeCatVR is a cozy VR adventure with light parkour. You wander a witch’s warm home and a moonlit courtyard, bat things off shelves, open drawers, and scale a giant tree into the clouds. There’s no text, no HUD, no pop-ups, just natural, hand-driven interactions that keep everything intuitive and language-free. No danger, no rush, just a space to play, explore and feel. What you’ll do Explore and discover the mysteries of the Witch. Find and complete the scattered Altars. Complete Puzzles and unlock powers. Walk, climb and jump, all with Hand-Driven Movements. Break objects, open drawers and move objects with natural interactions. Complete The Ritual and follow the Witch. 🐾 And most importantly, enjoy the experience and have fun! 🐾

In this action-packed game, players face off against hordes of enemies across multiple genre-themed levels, each styled to emulate the film’s era while keeping a fun, arcade-like energy.

rows.name: Cauldron Chaos
rows.short_description: Cauldron Chaos is a multiplayer party game where you control a jelly-boned wizard in chaotic deathmatches. Use magic wands, explosive potions, and quick thinking to outlast your opponents and claim the crown as the ultimate wizard!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Cauldron Chaos – where wizards aren’t born, they’re hilariously ragdolled into magical mayhem! Get ready to grab your quirky wand and dive into frantic, physics-fueled brawls as you jostle, tumble, and blast your way to wizard supremacy. In this topsy-turvy, top-down arena, every match is a riot of explosive potions, bizarre wand power-ups, and unpredictable wizard duels that’ll have you laughing one minute and gasping for air the next. Whether you’re teaming up with a buddy on the couch or unleashing chaos online, no one’s safe when the magic starts flying. Think you’ve got what it takes to outsmart, outblast, and outlast your opponents? Then jump in, stir up some trouble, and show the world that true wizardry isn’t just about casting spells—it’s about embracing the wild, weird, and wonderfully wacky world of Cauldron Chaos! So, grab your robe, dust off that pointy hat, and let revive the madness! Current Game Features: Couch & Online Carnage: 2-16 players with local and online play. Ragdoll Rampage: Launch yourself (and everyone else) across physics-powered maps. Party-Game Pace, Fighter Depth: Easy to pick-up chaos, and Fun To Master. More Features To Come!

rows.name: Poly-Vinyl Pests!
rows.short_description: Poly-Vinyl Pests! takes place many years in the future, where humans are long gone but plastics still litter the earth. Play as two ants from rival colonies in this twin-stick shooter to both squash plastic-laden pests and to prove the superiority of your colony!
rows.description_html: Monsters mutated by microplastics have invaded our realm and it's up to you and your friend to defeat them! Poly-Vinyl Pests, or PVP for short, is an arcade action style game where you and your friend take the roles of the champions from competing ant colonies. Together you’ll defeat deadly decomposers and compete for glory as only one of you can declare yourselves the queen of the anthill. Cooperate and compete! Using twin-stick shooter controls, face off against bullet hell-style boss encounters as well as each other. Outperform your opponent and gain the highest score to be declared the queen of the colony! Gain upgrades! Between battles, upgrade your ant to become more powerful in order to fight stronger monsters and to best your rival! A world filled with plastic! Humanity is mostly gone, but their plastic waste still litters the earth. Play on levels that are filled with trash and detritus, and fight against decomposers that have evolved to use the plastics as part of themselves. This game was created by team IDX Legends over the course of one academic year as part of Champlain College's Game Studio Capstone program.

rows.name: Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan
rows.short_description: A visual novel about living through a sudden and chaotic job loss, and making tough choices about your future. Based on the real-life experiences of foreign teachers living in Japan.
rows.description_html: In “Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan,” you play as Maria Ramirez, an American working in Japan as an English teacher. It’s a rewarding, fun job, and you’re beloved by students and coworkers alike–until suddenly, one day you lose your job. You work for a dispatch English teaching company, and they lost their contract with your school, just one month before the end of the school year. Out of nowhere, you must change the course of your life. You have a loving girlfriend to support you and other friends facing this alongside you, but ultimately you must make an extremely tough choice about your future. This game is based on the real-life experiences of English teachers throughout Japan, on issues that tens of thousands of people endure every single year, and is designed to provide an up-close viewpoint of what the dispatch contract system does to the individuals impacted. Live through real-life shock – You’re an English teacher in Japan, and suddenly, your life is turned upside-down. Experience the chaos of a last-second life meteor. Make tough choices – End your relationship? Risk it all? There are no easy answers to how to face your future. Exploration of underdiscussed issues – Tens of thousands of English teachers in Japan face the same problems every single year, and “Life of a Dispatch English Teacher in Japan” sheds light on these solvable issues to a mainstream audience. A myriad of social issues – Job loss, foreign work visas, cross-country moves, same-sex marriage, adult loneliness–this game covers many different factors in a short time span. Brisk story – Across all endings, the story runs about 6,000 words long, so a full playthrough should take thirty minutes or less. Yuri Kissaten is a game studio that makes narrative-focused games about girls loving girls, founded in 2024 by Fruz and Beatrice Baker. We create experiences with strong stories and memorable characters. All Yuri Kissaten projects focus primarily on LGBTQ+ characters and their relationships, romantic and otherwise. We hope you enjoy our games! This game was created thanks to: Beatrice Baker, the beautiful director and writer. Fruz, the captivating UI and background artist. linguisticspaceship, the alluring programmer. And this game couldn't have been possible if not for the incredible quality Creative Commons assets by character artist sutemo. Thank you so much.

rows.name: The Bright Path
rows.short_description: 'The bright path' is a 45 minutes long educational interactive computer game for Windows which you can use to familiarize yourselves or other unexperienced youngsters with the topics of dangers of drug abuse, addiction and active citizenships in your communities.
rows.description_html: 'The Bright Path' is an educational game, which provides interactive experience to learn more about the topics of drug abuse, drug addiction, dangerous societal phenomena and active citizenship in an interactive, entertaining and immersive way. We recommend to follow-up with a reflection activity to discuss the choices you made during the game. The game is mainly intended for teenagers and young adults who do not have a deep knowledge about the dangers of drug abuse and addictions and it helps them to raise their awareness about the situations which may lead to addiction and the dangers which come with using addictive substances. The game is not intended for education of professionals in the field or university students who are experts on the subject. The game was created in collaboration with local teenagers and young adults in our community.You play as a young man called Rasmus, who is a  volunteer in a fictional city called „Sobercity“, which is plagued by drug abuse, drug addiction and other dangerous societal phenomena. Your goal is to roam through the city and discover local citizens, who are facing various challenges and to help them or not, but remember every choice you make counts towards shaping the fate of the city ! rows.name: The Last Shores
rows.short_description: 🌿 The Last Shores is a chill solar-punk adventure. Clean, explore, and uncover the secrets of a forgotten island while restoring its lost harmony. 🏝️✨
rows.description_html: 🌿 Immerse yourself in a relaxing, contemplative adventure with The Last Shores, a top-down 3D solar-punk exploration game where nature and mystery meet. 🧪 Play as Tal, a young biologist on a mission Freshly graduated from GREEN-CORP University and sent to an abandoned island for a one-year internship, your objective is simple: clean up the entire island, restore the ecosystems and unravel the secrets buried beneath these forgotten lands. But you'll soon discover that there's much more to this island than meets the eye... 🌍 A living, poetic world Collect and recycle waste to bring the island back to life. Repair wind turbines to generate energy. Care for small animals and rediscover lush nature. Soar from cliff tops to explore freely. Unearth buried treasures all around the island ( it'll make memories ). 🔎 An ancient civilization and a family mystery As your adventure unfolds, you'll discover runes, forgotten ruins and a huge sealed chasm. By activating ancient mechanisms and following clues left by your missing father, you gradually reveal the story of a vanished civilization... and perhaps that of your own past. 🎮 An immersive, soothing experience Accessible gameplay, ideal for relaxing. Solar punk-inspired art direction, with bright, enchanting environments. A soothing soundtrack to accompany your exploration. Let yourself be carried away by the gentleness of the wind and the song of the waves... and discover the secrets of The Last Shores. 🌿✨

rows.name: Stick Figure Combat
rows.short_description: Stick Figure Combat is a game where you fight other stick figures to secure the highest score possible. Try to survive as long as possible against endless hordes of grey enemies! Or create your own map and have your own fun!
rows.description_html: Stick Figure Combat is an action-packed, fast-paced battle experience where you fight hordes of relentless grey enemies to achieve the highest score possible. Test your survival skills as you face off against endless waves of foes, each more challenging than the last. Hone your abilities, unlock new weapons, and fight for dominance in an ever-intensifying combat arena. Feeling creative? Build and share your own custom maps to challenge your friends or the community! Whether you’re aiming to survive as long as possible or simply having fun with your own designs, the choice is yours. Key Features: Endless Waves of Combat: Fight through increasingly difficult enemies in a test of skill and endurance. Unlockable Upgrades: Discover powerful tools to help you survive longer and defeat tougher enemies. Competitive Leaderboards: See how you rank against other players and strive to reach the top of the leaderboard. Level Editor: Create your own swarm or zombie mode levels to battle the way you want! Make EXP farms to farm kills & EXP while AFK (away)! Survive. Fight. Create. The battle never ends in Stick Figure Combat ! This version adds more excitement, clarity, and a focus on the game’s key features, helping it stand out more to potential players on Steam!

rows.name: OH？ME
rows.short_description: 'OH?ME' is a pixel-art puzzle game about growth, memories, and farewells. Play as a ghost exploring the fragments of your past, uncovering hidden clues to different endings. Will you move forward, find warmth in memories, or lose yourself in time?
rows.description_html: 'OH?ME' – A journey to find yourself in a maze where memory and reality intertwine. When familiar streets and alleys fragment, and the past merges with the present, you’ll wander through a space that feels both unreal and real. This is a pixel-art puzzle game about growth, memories, and farewells. You play as a ghost, suspended between reality and recollection, exploring the houses, streets, and unsaid words from your past. The maze-like map is filled with traces of your childhood, and objects and scenes serve as vessels for time. Hidden clues guide you toward different endings. You may walk steadily into the future, find warmth in memories, or lose yourself in the cracks of time… but no matter the path, the journey’s end depends on your choices. 'The past is never finished, and the future has yet to begin.' – Are you ready to set out?

rows.name: Fire from the sky: Cagliari 1943 VR
rows.short_description: Fire from the Sky: Cagliari 1943 VR is an immersive experience that transports you to the dramatic days of the Allied bombings over Cagliari during World War II.
rows.description_html: Fire from the Sky: Cagliari 1943 VR is an immersive experience that transports you to the dramatic days of the Allied bombings over Cagliari during World War II. Through the eyes of an affluent family and their household staff, you will relive the terror of air raids, the desperate race to the shelters, and the uncertainty of a future shattered by war. Thanks to a meticulously crafted historical reconstruction, you will explore realistic environments, listen to testimonies inspired by real events, and experience the anguish endured by the civilian population. Fire from the Sky: Cagliari 1943 VR is not just an interactive experience but a journey through memory, allowing you to grasp the true impact of war on everyday life. Put on your headset and prepare to relive history. Finanziato dall’Unione europea – Next Generation EU

rows.name: Dataclysm
rows.short_description: A tech-themed artillery game where players take turns launching computer components at opponents across destructible terrain. Aim carefully, manage your jetpack fuel, and master physics-based projectiles to be the last techie standing in this modern tribute to classics like Worms.
rows.description_html: Dataclysm Gear up for digital warfare in Dataclysm, a turn-based artillery game where tech components become deadly projectiles! In this modern take on classics like Worms, players battle across destructible landscapes, launching keyboards, mice, and computer parts at opponents. Key Features: Tech-Themed Arsenal : Fire computer peripherals and components as projectiles with unique damage patterns Destructible Terrain : Blast through procedurally generated landscapes with precise, physics-based destruction Strategic Combat : Master the jetpack for mobility, perfect your aim, and time your shots for maximum impact Last Player Standing:  Outlast your opponents in frantic battles where terrain constantly evolves Multiple Character Skins : Choose from Adventurer, Soldier, Zombie and more Take turns navigating the battlefield, conserving jetpack fuel, and charging devastating shots. Watch your projectiles follow realistic arcs as they crash into opponents or reshape the terrain to your advantage. With damage scaling based on impact velocity, precision and strategy are your path to victory! Will you master the physics of digital destruction and be the last techie standing?

Experience the school story brought to life by unforgettable girls in this vast fantasy world. If you crave bonds, adventure, and tactical thrills, start your ultimate anime RPG journey today.

Egyptian tomb - Descend into the depths of an Egyptian tomb and help restore ancient texts. rows.name: GnollHack
rows.short_description: GnollHack brings NetHack’s legendary depth to life with graphics, sounds, and voiceovers — a roguelike where wit and mastery decide your fate.
rows.description_html: GnollHack is a traditional roguelike that takes the legendary depth of NetHack and brings it into the modern age. With graphics, sounds, and voiceovers, the dungeon isn’t just a place you explore — it's an adventure full of surprises, dangers, and opportunities that challenge your wit at every turn. This isn’t a game about quick reflexes or fast button-mashing. Every step is turn-based. Every choice matters. You succeed not by clicking fast, but by thinking smart — learning the dungeon’s secrets, mastering its systems, and using skill and cunning to overcome impossible odds.   Modern Action Roguelike Fans If you love randomized item drops and rewards in  modern action roguelikes , GnollHack offers that same “one more run” magic — but in longer sessions. Runs can last hours or even days, filled with emergent stories you’ll remember: desperate escapes, clever victories, and the occasional sudden downfall. There’s no grind or unlock treadmill — only your knowledge and skill carry you forward. Traditional Roguelike Fans Fans of traditional roguelikes will find something rare here: a roguelike that modernizes a classic game without losing depth. GnollHack adds a layer of immersion through visuals, audio, and narration, and bakes vital gameplay information directly into the game, sparing you the need to read wikis. It’s still hardcore, still endlessly replayable — but far more welcoming to play. NetHack Veterans If NetHack is your home, GnollHack is its expanded cousin. It adds new monsters, spells, items, and mechanics while keeping the heart of the game intact. It offers graphics, sounds, and voiceovers, and retains the option to play with the same depth and complexity you know and love. With active development and frequent updates, GnollHack is not just another variant — it’s a continuation of NetHack's legacy. Main Features Outsmart the dungeon: a test of intelligence, skill, and mastery — not reflexes. Experience modern graphics, sound effects, and voiceovers. Create your own stories through emergent gameplay and unexpected twists. Explore one of the deepest, most replayable games ever made. Free to play, with no ads, no microtransactions, and no grind. GnollHack is more than a game. It’s a puzzle, an adventure, and a test of wit. If you’re ready for a roguelike where every decision can mean the difference between glory and a sudden death, then enter the Dungeons of Doom and play GnollHack.   Enabling Dedicated GPU In the case your computer has multiple GPUs, GnollHack uses the integrated GPU by default. If you want to use the dedicated GPU , you must enable it as follows: 1. Open Windows Settings . 2. Go to System → Display → Graphics . 3. Add a desktop app  and select  'C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\GnollHack\GnollHackM.exe'. 4. GnollHackM should appear in the app list. Click on it to expand its options. Select High Performance  as  GPU preference . Troubleshooting If the game is stuck in the loading screen in the ' Done loading ' phase, you can fix the problem as follows: 1. Open Control Panel . 2. Click Clock and Region . 3. Click Region . 4. Select the Administrative  tab and, in the Language for non-Unicode programs section, click Change system locale . 5. Select English (United States)  as the current system locale and click OK. Alternatively, you can download an MSIX installer for the game from GnollHack's GitHub releases page . Installing the game through it will also fix the problem.

rows.name: Higher Than Mush
rows.short_description: A stimulating, yet deeply chill, psychedelic action roguelite platformer. Master your reflexes, collect dopamine, and chase Nirvana... or overdose trying.
rows.description_html: Prepare to get Higher Than Mush , a stimulating, yet deeply chill , action roguelite platformer where every jump, dash, and decision counts! Dive into procedurally generated psychedelic worlds, built with stunning ray-traced visuals and push your reflexes to the limit as you collect dopamine to ascend to Nirvana...or overdose trying! Psychedelic Visual Feast: Immerse yourself in breathtaking, ray-traced environments, brought to life with the power of Unreal Engine 5. Experience Chaos Destruction!  Everything you see can be shattered, crumbled, and blown to bits. Skill-Based Gameplay: Burn for Power, or Play It Safe? The brighter the Mush, the closer you are to overdosing, but the more powerful your dashes become. Procedurally Generated Levels: Endless Variety, Unpredictable Difficulty! Experience challenges that range from surprisingly forgiving to incredibly tough, with a unique level layout every time you play. Prove Your Dominance: Are You the Ultimate 'Mush' Master? Challenge players worldwide and climb to the top of the leaderboards!... or die trying!

rows.name: In Season
rows.short_description: In Season is a chaotic and fun couch Co-op game! Complete orders in time by planting and harvesting crops correctly and gain enough stars to make it to the next season!
rows.description_html: In Season is a chaotic couch co-op game! Play alone or with your friends to complete all your orders in time and deliver vegetables, flowers, fish and more to the farmstand!  Play with 1-6 players locally In Season can be played alone or with up to 5 of your friends locally. Or play online using the Steam Remote Play Together feature. The difficulty of the orders adjusts to the number of players, but the fun remains! Play through all four seasons When you reach 4 stars you can move on to the next level- the next season! Every season has unique crops, but if you make it to the greenhouse in winter, you will have to plant crops from every season all at once! Are you up for the challenge?  Every crop or animal comes with a unique mechanic Every plant requires different treatment. The pumpkin for example is so heavy, it can only be harvested by two farmers (or one very strong farmer, if you are playing alone) . In the little menu book, illustrations explain the crops, that get unlocked one by one.  The Strawfools wish you the best of luck and most of all a lot of fun this season and every season!

rows.name: MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLERS
rows.short_description: When a parasite reawakens detective Clive from death, he is recruited into a secret taskforce to stop those that killed him from weaponizing this newfound immortality.
rows.description_html: JUST LIKE IN THE PAPERS. MORTALITY DECOMP. KILLERS is a short, fast-paced 3rd person horror/comedy hybrid of games like  Hotline Miami and Post Void, with hand-drawn visuals inspired loosely by retro detective comics. You'll step into the well-polished shoes of Clive, an undead detective working to take down the criminals that initially killed him. LIVE. DIE. LIVE AGAIN. When a parasite reawakens detective Clive from death, he is recruited into a secret taskforce to stop those that killed him from weaponizing this newfound immortality. Slay crooks and goons in semi-linear corridor levels that are built for honing in and optimising your own quickest path through. Prepare to die, and then die again.

rows.name: Labyrinthine Dread
rows.short_description: In this Top-Down Horror game, try to escape from an otherwise abandoned laboratory, armed only with a lantern and the keys strewn about in monster-infested rooms.
rows.description_html: Play as Doctor Elizabeth 'Liz' Landrake, a genetic scientist in an alternate Victorian era laboratory. As time has passed, your workplace respite has become desolate, abandoned, and filled with deadly chimaeras who have turned against their creators. Traverse through your laboratory, armed only with your quick reactions and a kerosene lantern, to collect a series of key cards in the attempt to escape this laboratory in lockdown. Along the way, collect notes, remnants of a time before this laboratory got shut down, to provide insight as to who was here alongside Liz. Light is the only thing that seems to keep the monsters at bay, so keep your lantern filled, and try to only use the light when it is absolutely necessary. The Light is Your Friend - Make your way through an abandoned laboratory, finding the rooms filled with light that keeps the apparent occupants at bay. It Has Your Scent - Monsters that lurk in the dark who know where you are even better than you do. The Sounds of a Dangerous Waltz - Hand-crafted compositions and audio to immerse the player in the mind of Doctor Elizebeth Landrake. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Critter Isle
rows.short_description: Jump right in and hatch your first Egglin, let creativity flow as you learn how to manage your Egglin's wants and needs through food and play. Zen out to the blissful comforts of decorating your island how you see fit, and bask in the rewards your Egglins provide as you grow your Egglin empire.
rows.description_html: Welcome to CRITTER ISLE! A wonderful resort where you can immerse yourself in the role of island manager and caretaker for the Egglins, rare and mysterious critters taking the world by storm.  BECOME A FARMER With over 10 different crops, you'll have your work cut out for you learning how to grow all of them and figuring out your Egglin's favorite. DECORATE YOUR ISLAND Every good environment deserves some homey touches, and with over 60 different island decorations, you can customize every inch of your island to suit your fancy. The Egglins will appreciate you for making their world your own. COLLECT EGGLINS Once the first egg hatches you'll be dying to hatch more and collect the over 60 known Egglins throughout the world! And don't worry about losing track of them. The Bestiary logs all of your discovered Egglins throughout your collecting adventures. So are you ready to take this once in a lifetime opportunity and start your Egglin collecting adventure? Just remember, be good to the Egglins, and the Egglins... may be good to you ... possibly. Oh and no return deposit for the Island. Have fun!!

rows.name: Ant Guardians Prologue
rows.short_description: It’s a defense game where you create your own strategy, grow your units, and defend against enemies.
rows.description_html: Prologue Version Information 3 stages and 20 units available 1 hero available Maximum level 10 (Progress from the demo version does not carry over.) Summon Your Units, Build Your Strategy, and Defend! Seal the corrupted crystal while fending off endless waves of invading enemies! Gather resources and summon ally units to defeat increasingly powerful foes. Block entrances with walls or use sturdy units to hold back enemies. Enhance items to make your units even stronger. Learn powerful skills to quickly annihilate your enemies. Create your own unique strategy to complete your mission!

rows.name: Jade Spring
rows.short_description: Relax, potter, and build in Jade Spring, a small Guild Wars 2 decorating and homesteading fan game.
rows.description_html: Jade Spring Currently In Beta Jade Spring  is actively in development as I continue to fix bugs, improve features, and add decorations! This means that you could come across game components which are unstable or incomplete. Tickets or messages about bugs, improvements, or feature ideas would be greatly appreciated. Thank you, and enjoy! About the Game Relax, potter, and build in Jade Spring, a small Guild Wars 2 decorating and homesteading fan game featuring entirely hand-made assets and items. Tend your garden as a Xunlai jade bot, clearing weeds and pests, dispelling Dragonvoid blights, and furnishing your plot with architecture, flora, furniture, and ornaments from across Tyria! Zen Cleaning Engage in mini-games to spruce up your plot, clearing out bugs, invasive plants, and leftover strands of Dragonvoid. Collect Karma from each task to spend on permanent improvements to your gardening and decorating abilities! Granular Decoration Personalise your space using robust tools which let you easily move, rotate, scale, snap, and clear items. Acquire enough Karma to unlock fancy decorations, as well as utilities which allow you to change the time of day, clear the map to start fresh, and fine-tune your environment to suit your creativity. A Guild Wars 2 Tribute Jade Spring is an independent developer’s love letter to Cantha and to Guild Wars 2 in general, featuring hand-made assets, art, models, animations, and music directly inspired by the worlds of Tyria, and filled with small tributes and references. rows.name: SOLANIS
rows.short_description: A thousand years ago, humanity tore the moon from the sky, sealing it within you and chaining you to the earth. But all chains rust. Now freed, you must journey into the scorched, war-torn land you once called home and return the moon to the sky.
rows.description_html: A thousand years ago, humanity tore the moon from the sky, sealing it within you and chaining you to the earth. But all chains rust. It's time to spread your wings once more. Soar between the ruins of a scarred world, exploring floating islands, hidden canyons, and breathtaking monuments, each with unique characters, challenges, and secrets to discover. Using powers divined from the the moon, transform into a shooting star and propel yourself through the air. Peer into the realm of darkness to aid your search for the fallen moon shards. Your choices shape not only your journey, but the fate of those around you. Will you restore the moon to the sky, or forge a new destiny in a world of eternal light?

rows.name: Hauntrick
rows.short_description: Hauntrick is a chaotic, goofy horror game where you hunt cursed objects, perform rituals, and survive bizarre hauntings—solo or with friends. The ghosts? Unpredictable, absurd, and hilariously annoying. Every match is a mix of strategy, panic, and laughter as reality itself starts to unravel.
rows.description_html: A co-op horror game where the supernatural isn’t just terrifying—it’s also completely ridiculous. Face mischievous, unpredictable ghosts, perform chaotic rituals, and survive the ever-growing madness. Can you outsmart the hauntings, or will the trick be on you? 1-4 PLAYER Online CO-OP Team up with up to three friends in this chaotic horror experience. Work together to locate cursed objects, set up the ritual, and deal with the bizarre, unpredictable entities standing in your way. Each game feels fresh, thanks to randomized enemy behaviors, supernatural debuffs, and maps that keep you guessing. UNPREDICTABLE AND GOOFY SPIRITS The spirits in Hauntrick are anything but ordinary. Each one behaves differently—some are goofy, some are unpredictable, and others have their own strange ways of interfering with the ritual. You never know what they'll do next, making every encounter unexpected and full of chaos. EVERY RUN IS DIFFERENT Each session in Hauntrick throws new surprises your way. Procedurally generated maps, randomized cursed objects, and a rotating cast of unique spirits make sure no two runs feel the same. Adapt fast, or get tricked into an early grave. PERFORM THE RITUAL, BANISH THE CURSE Your goal is simple: find the cursed objects scattered around the map and place them in the ritual circle. However, with spirits lurking around every corner, working quickly and efficiently is key—hesitation will only make things harder. BUY, SURVIVE, REPEAT In Hauntrick , collecting coins isn’t just for show—it’s your key to survival. Use your earnings to buy powerful items from the shop, giving you a fighting chance against the unpredictable hauntings. Use the spell, English or Spanish, to freeze spirits in place, turn invisible with a special pill, teleport out of danger, or even arm yourself with a gun. Whether you choose to escape, outsmart, or fight back, the shop ensures that every run offers new strategies to survive the madness. CHAOTIC DEBUFFS: EXPECT THE UNEXPECTED Want to make things even crazier? Enable the Debuff Setting and suffer through randomized effects that change how you play. Lose the ability to jump. Get your controls reversed. Drop items uncontrollably. Or get hit with a surprise game of Red Light, Green Light. SURVIVE THE CHAOS, OR BECOME ITS NEXT VICTIM?

rows.name: This Game is Ground Breaking
rows.short_description: This Game is Ground Breaking - aims to bring back the fun of wanting to smash your friend in the head with a controller!
rows.description_html: OUT NOW! 🎉 BREAKING NEWS: This Game is Ground Breaking… literally. After months of digging deep and breaking everything in sight , we’ve finally done it — This Game is Ground Breaking is now available for FREE! We’ve sacrificed no sleep but a lot of brain cells to bring you a game that: 🎮 Will make you want to bash your friend with a controller 💔 Never let your sibling forget who is better and therefore more loved 🕹️ Makes you realise that you were never good at video games Play it now, so you can get over your depression in preparation for GTA VI  About the Game This game is ground breaking -ly fun! The most popular game at our local gamescom is now on Steam! This Game is Ground breaking is a couch-co-op game made to invoke the absolute chaos of playing split screen arcade games as a kid. This game will make you want to smash your friends head through the TV have unforgettable moments with your friends. 5-10 minutes of pure fun, Remote Play Supported! If you and your 'Friend' wants to play together, you can do so via Remote Play. Follow the instructions below on how to set it up. Note: This is only required if you are playing with a friend on a remote PC, if you both are in the same PC skip this Setup  1. Open the Game  2. The Host will need to have one additional Input Device (Controller) connected apart from the keyboard and mouse. 3. Shift+Tab -> Right Click on a Friend -> Invite Remote Play. 4. Once they have Joined, Shift + Tab again, find the remote play Icon on the bottom, and you should see your friends name on the Remote play list. 5. Click on the Keyboard and Mouse Icon next to the Friends name to Give access. 6. Success! They should now be able to use their own Keyboard &Mouse or a Controller to play with you!. How to Play The objective is simple, outlast your friend in the arena. If you step on a tile, the tile will fall shortly after. So be careful where you tread, If you want to speed up the winning process, shoot explosives at the other friend which will break all the tiles instantly upon impact. This game features ground breaking mechanics and new features such as. - No micro-transactions: If we bother to make a skin, just take it. - No battle-passes that unlock useless items on level up. - No annoying ads asking you to review and rate our game. (We already know its awesome, we don't need you to tell us that.) - Actually having a good time with your friends. (I know it's a bit out there but we think it just might work.) Play with either 2 Controllers, or Single Controller and a Keyboard & Mouse.

rows.name: The Catastrophe
rows.short_description: Set off into space on your personal spaceship and rescue all the lost catstronauts! Navigate through flying obstacles while managing fuel and health. Don’t forget to watch your ship’s weight — it affects your maneuverability. Enjoy a relaxing gameplay experience with pixel art and cozy cosmic vibes!
rows.description_html: Embark on a relaxing, light-hearted space adventure in this 2D spaceflight simulation! In The Catastrophe , you take on the role of a pilot navigating your spaceship through a vibrant, pixel-art cosmos. Your mission is simple but essential — rescue the lost catstronauts scattered across the vast expanse of space and return them safely. Key Features Weight-Based Mechanics : The more catstronauts you have on board, the more weight your ship gains, affecting its maneuverability. Additionally, the amount of fuel you have also contributes to your ship’s mass, further influencing your ability to navigate through tight spaces and avoid obstacles. Obstacles and Hazards : Dodge asteroids, mouse bombs, and other space dangers while staying on course to find all the lost catstronauts. The deeper you venture into space, the more challenging the environment becomes. Charming Pixel Art : Immerse yourself in a visually delightful world where everything—from the fish-shaped spaceships to the feline-themed obstacles — is designed with cute, quirky charm. Relaxing, Casual Gameplay : Enjoy a peaceful experience with no time limits or stressful penalties. Perfect for unwinding while still offering a fun challenge as you manage your ship’s stats.

rows.name: Forgetmenots
rows.short_description: Step onto the stage in Forgetmenots, a story-driven puzzle adventure where memories take center stage. Explore a theatrical world that unfolds like a live performance, solving puzzles in a whimsical yet bittersweet journey about loss and remembrance.
rows.description_html: Welcome to the stage of Forgetmenots , a story-driven puzzle adventure where memories linger like echoes in an empty theater. In this beautifully crafted world, the entire game plays out like a theatrical performance, with shifting stage floors revealing new scenes as you progress through a sidescrolling journey of wonder, mystery, and melancholy. With a vibrant, whimsical aesthetic that contrasts its deeper themes, Forgetmenots tells a heartfelt story about loss and the fleeting nature of memories. Solve creative puzzles that bring the stage to life, uncover hidden moments from the past, and navigate a world where joy and sorrow dance together under the spotlight. Game Features 3D side-scrolling theatre Interact with the world in many different ways. Pick up and throw or push large objects in order to restore the memory to its correct state. Physics-based puzzles and interactions create challenging environments. Explore this thrilling stylized theater  Forgetmenots  is a group project made by students. Expect a short yet thought-provoking game.

rows.name: Naica Online
rows.short_description: Naica is a 8bit Fantasy cross-platfrom MMORPG where you take on the role of a lowly adventurer trying to assist those in peril. Fight, collect or explore what the world of Naica has to offer, secrets lie behind every corner. The world needs your help adventurer, will you answer the call?
rows.description_html: Save the world of Naica Naica started in the Age of Golcondite, also known as the Genesis age by most denizens, during this time the crystalline form of this world was born, cold and barren. Naica felt alone, and in her loneliness she began to dance to warm herself up, with this dance she has created Light and gave her the name Naide - The Goddess of Order which helped her warm her cold exterior. As the saying goes, there cannot be Light without Darkness, as soon as the first dance finished Icaon - The God of Chaos was born in tandem, helping balance the extreme heat of the light. The Rebisphene Age was the consequence of the constant quarrels between Naide and Icaon, both yearning for the attention of their mother, also known as the age of Discord, which created the First Ones - the first proper inhabitants of Naica. They split their loyalties between Naide and Icaon based off their respective promises which only split the world even further. As the ages passed, and quarrels continued, the First Ones became clustered, the most devoted ones still continued to bicker, but the rest became what we now recognize as Naicalites. Their variety came from adapting to their living environments which shifted throughout the ages, hence why even though they share the same ancestors, most Naicalites look nothing alike. Create and Customize Your Hero Choose from one of four native Naica races, the dexterous Vulpian, the mighty Cerbali, scaly Ophimanders or the sneaky Azralians. Take the path of the Warrior, Ranger or Mage, each with 3 distinct playstyles that you can specialize in. Some of which include the Crusher Warrior, the Assassin Ranger or a Chilling Mage. Express yourself by mixing and matching various talents to create a build that is perfect for you! Take up arms against the invading dark forces of the land and equip yourself with enchanted gear from the Age of Verberyl, a time of re-discovery and exploration, which allowed the Naicalites to flourish after the Age of Discord. Harness the magical power within various armor and weapons, and look great while doing it! Assist Your Fellow Naicalites You will encounter many people throughout your adventures in Naica, each with their own personality and quests for you to help them with. It is up to you to help heal the world through good-faith actions and helping your fellow Naicalites during your Journey. They will help you explore the various zones across the world, and guide you on the path to becoming a powerful ally in their fight against the dark forces that have invaded and corrupted Naica. Overcome the Hardest of Challenges During your adventures, you will encounter powerful enemies, treacherous locations and even remnants of the old world in the form of Dungeons. Gather up your party of at least two allies and clear these Dungeons for great rewards! The runes you obtain can be used to help you progress further than ever before. With each Dungeon level you clear, the enemies will become stronger, increasing their tenacity and amount of pain they inflict, but remember, the deeper you go, the better the rewards will be! [shots of dungeon UI selecting the difficulty] Everything that Naica has to Offer Level 40 Cap 3 unique classes with 9 different playstyles With 12 gear sets tailored to each playstyle obtainable in Dungeons and through spending of Ancient Runes 7 beautiful zones filled to the brim with interesting NPCs, various enemies and bosses to encounter With more than 100 quests to complete 3 dungeons which can be cleared endlessly with increasing levels of difficulty and higher rewards in turn Dungeons scale infinitely (currently up to Level 20) 3 battleground arenas for all PvP enjoyers World PvP as well as PvP exclusive gear that will enhance your combat prowess A transmogrification system that allows you to exchange gear pieces without changing your overall look The Gem shop where you can obtain cosmetics and certain conveniences like faster gathering An alchemical talent tree which allows you to customize the effects of your potions

rows.name: Bee careful!
rows.short_description: A defiant Bee puzzle where you will have to control different groups of bees by remote control to collect pollen, avoid obstacles and be able to take them to the honeycomb.
rows.description_html: In this challenging puzzle game, you will be the guide of a swarm of up to 4 groups of bees. Your goal will be to collect pollen from the flowers and take it safe and sound to the honeycomb, facing different obstacles on the way. Control each group with the number keys and direct their movements with the directional arrows. Plan carefully and coordinate your swarm's movements to avoid dangers and overcome challenges in each level. Will you manage to complete all the levels and help the bees to maintain pollination in the world?

rows.name: Echo Rift
rows.short_description: Fight enemies to the beat and bring Rock to the people in this epic rhythm game! Echo Rift is a beat-based combat game where players dance on an arena grid in their fight against the audiocratic elite to bring back music to a silenced world.
rows.description_html: Features: Over a hundred attack patterns to avoid 6 unique stages with 4 minion encounters and 2 boss fights Set high scores with tracked gameplay statistics All original songs Master teleport abilities Comprehensive tutorial Story Beats: Echo always wondered why they felt different, why they always heard a head-thumping tune that no one else seemed to notice. One day, Echo tried to uncover the truth behind this music that was becoming impossible to ignore. Only then did they discover how the elite were hoarding this powerful and vibrant music to themselves in order to keep the masses in an aphonic state of order and obedience. All hope was not lost; there were others like Echo. It was time to rebel! Will you be able to help Echo in their quest to bring Rock to the people? Developer Team: Echo Rift was developed by students from the University of Utah's Division of Games Masters' Program.

rows.name: THE WELL
rows.short_description: Isolation. Hopelessness. Starvation. By the will of an unknown force, you find yourself isolated from the outside world. Now you are doomed to starve to death. No one will come to your aid. No one will hear your prayers.
rows.description_html: The nameless main character—a hermit who lives many miles away from the nearest human soul—after a splendid feast, he suddenly realizes that someone has doomed him to death. Any connection with the outside world was cut off by an unknown force: there was no electricity, the car was broken, and someone destroyed a battery-powered landline phone—the last chance to escape. The protagonist is physically unable to escape; he had chosen to live far away from other people, which was his undoing. Slowly starving and going mad, he drinks water from the well in the hope of at least slightly dulling his unbearably growing desire to eat. One day, realizing that the bucket has caught something heavy, he puts all his strength into pulling out… A human corpse. GAMEPLAY OVERVIEW THE WELL is a first-person psychological linear horror game with elements of exploration, hunting, and story progression. Explore the main character’s property and the surrounding forest. After discovering the corpse straight from the well, the protagonist begins to carry out its orders, as if they came from a living person. Day-by-day plot progression. Explore the main character’s property, shrouded in thick fog, as the story progresses. Find notes, books, and other interactive items that tell you what happens. Execute the corpse’s requests. Even though communication is mostly one-sided, you understand what she needs. Hunting. As a player, you will find yourself in the forest thicket teeming with humanoid creatures. You have to kill them with a slow-reloading rifle and finish them off them with a machete. Basic stealth and noise management included. The core gameplay loop consists of exploring locations, reading notes, finding required items, completing simple objectives, and hunting creatures in small forest areas. KEY FEATURES A short psychological horror game (approximately 30 minutes long). It includes the full story experience, several in-game days, multiple locations to explore, notes to discover, and short hunting encounters. A gradual descent into madness. The transformation of the house into a dump, complete moral decay. Each day alters the environment, giving the player new objectives and areas to explore. Exploration and minimalist combat cycle. A slow-reloading rifle for the ranged attacks and a machete. The basic noise system is implemented—NPC will react to the player’s movement and gunfire, making noise an important part of the encounters.

rows.name: Smoke Break!
rows.short_description: Smoke Break! is a lighthearted 3D stealth puzzle game where you play as Applewood — a living puff of smoke. By breaking machinery, dashing past bakers, and using smoke to grow, you can hunt down the ultimate, yet elusive, burnt pie!
rows.description_html: Smoke Break! is a 3D stealth puzzle game where you play as Applewood, a living puff of smoke, who's hungry for a sweet, charred treat. In this lighthearted adventure, mischief seekers will explore Applewood Factories — a whimsical pie-producing workshop. Cause hilarious hijinks as you delve deeper into this fantastical factory for a deliciously burnt pie! COLLECT SMOKE TO GROW Speedy navigation will burn away Applewood's size. Seek out smoke particles scattered around the factory and absorb them to stay puffed up. CAUSE MISCHIEF Slip through vents, burrow into sacks of flour, and sabotage sweet machinery as you slink your way through pastry-packed corridors.  DON'T GET CAUGHT Beware of the adorably aggressive bakers as they make every effort to keep you out. If that’s not enough, Gumbo the Janitor—a one-man cleanup crew with a turbo-charged vacuum—has zero tolerance for your smoky shenanigans. Stay sneaky, or it’s game over!

rows.name: We Bowling?!
rows.short_description: WeBowling?! is built from the ground up for Speedrunners. In this game you take control of a bowling ball of your choosing and make your way through the obstacles as fast as you can! With 10 current tracks and global steam leaderboards, there are plenty of opportunities for you to get that WR!
rows.description_html: 'We Bowling?!' is what happens when a bowling ball escapes the alley and goes on a wild adventure! Roll, bounce, and yeet your way through obstacle courses packed with ramps, seesaws, moving platforms, and even minigolf-style chaos. The pins are waiting at the end, but can you get there fast enough to top the leaderboards? Speed, precision, and a little bit of luck will decide if you’re a strike or a total gutterball. So, We Bowling!? Or are you gonna split?

rows.name: Remanence
rows.short_description: A first-person souls-like that rewards players for mastering sword combat mechanics. Rise against the robotic cult that has destroyed the world using nanomachines and seek revenge on the cybernetic overlord.
rows.description_html: Remanence is a first-person souls-like that rewards players for mastering the sword combat mechanics. In the remains of a world where technology has progressed to the level of seeming magical, players take the role of a survivor of the apocalypse who aims to rise against the robotic cult that has destroyed the world using nanomachines. Armed with only a sword and little remaining nanomachine power, players must master sword combat and seek revenge on the cybernetic overlord. In their path is an army of machines with a variety of attacks. Some war machines are fast and nimble while others are slow but hit hard. It is up to the player to figure out the best approach to dispatch their opponent. A variety of challenging enemies with adaptive and versatile move sets A strange apocalyptic world to venture through Multiple intense boss fights to master and defeat Tight combat featuring rewarding parrying and repose This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Nitro Battle Racing
rows.short_description: Overtake and blast away your opponents in Nitro Battle Racing! In this arcade action racer, you will compete in exhilarating races using a variety of powerups and abilities to surpass the competition. Unlock new maps through your accomplishments and become the ultimate racer.
rows.description_html: Overtake and blast away your opponents in Nitro Battle Racing! In this arcade action racer, you will compete in exhilarating races either against AI, or your friends in up to 4-player split-screen multiplayer. Race in a wide variety of environments! From dry deserts to neon lit cyberspace, and even all the way to mars, there is no telling where your racing career will take you. Collect random powerups with race defining abilities such as the Rocket Booster which has enough power to pull you to the front of the pack. Pick your favorite vehicle out of 12 unique karts each boasting their own unique stats to fit your preferred racing playstyle. Choose your favorite drift ability and play your way, whether you prefer to play aggressively with the Gatling Gun, defensively with your own Repair Tool, or simply want to zoom past your opponents with the Drift Boost. Whatever you choose just make sure you leave your opponents in the dust! Up To 4-Player Local Split-Screen races 12 Unique Karts and 3 Unique Drift Abilities 9+ Random Powerups 6 Unlockable Stages 3 Difficulty Options for AI This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

Choose your favorite drift ability and play your way, whether you prefer to play aggressively with the Gatling Gun, defensively with your own Repair Tool, or simply want to zoom past your opponents with the Drift Boost. Whatever you choose just make sure you leave your opponents in the dust! Up To 4-Player Local Split-Screen races 12 Unique Karts and 3 Unique Drift Abilities 9+ Random Powerups 6 Unlockable Stages 3 Difficulty Options for AI This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Where Winds Meet
rows.short_description: Where Winds Meet is an epic Wuxia open-world action-adventure RPG set in ancient China at the tenth century. Players will assume the role of a young sword master as they embark on a journey to uncover the mysteries of their own identity. Let the wind carry your legend on an epic journey to the East!
rows.description_html: Overview About the Game Where Winds Meet is an epic open-world action-adventure RPG rooted in the rich legacy of Wuxia. Set during the turbulent era of tenth-century China, you take on the role of a young sword master, uncovering forgotten truths and the mysteries of your own identity. As the wind stirs across mountains and rivers, so too will your legend rise. An Era on the Brink. A Hero on the Rise Immerse yourself in the captivating Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period of China, where epic battles and legendary tales come to life. From the bustling imperial capital to the hidden wilderness, every path is filled with secrets and adventures. In this world, freedom carries weight. Stir up mischief and face challenges, or take the noble route: befriend villagers, forge alliances, and carve your legacy as a Wuxia hero. In a land of possibilities, become the spark that ignites change! An Open World of Infinite Possibilities Explore a vibrant world filled with life, from bustling cities to hidden temples in lush forests—all dynamically shaped by time, weather, and your choices. Experience Wuxia—style traversal: scale rooftops, glide through the air, or use fast travel to swiftly navigate between regions. Uncover thousands of points of interest across 20+ unique regions. Interact with diverse characters, engage in authentic activities, explore ancient cities, discover forgotten tombs, play flutes beneath swaying willows, and enjoy drinks under lantern-lit skies. Master Your Way of Wuxia Combat Tailor your combat approach-melee, ranged, or stealth. Build a loadout that suits your playstyle. Engage in combat with classic Wuxia weapons—swords, spears, dual blades, rope dart, bows, fans, and umbrellas. Switch weapons and employ martial arts and mystic skills like Tai Chi to outmaneuver enemies. Customize your character, choose your role, align with factions, and explore unique professions to shape your identity. Adventure Alone or Forge Your Community Embark on a narrative-driven adventure filled with rich solo gameplay, or team up with up to four friends for seamless co-op experiences. Join or create a Guild to access group activities—intense guild wars, multiplayer dungeons, and epic raids. Show your skill in competitive duels, or enter a shared, evolving world with thousands of fellow adventurers.

rows.name: Online Records: Unknown Seller
rows.short_description: A 22 year old student arranges to meet an online seller at their home to pick up an item. At first, everything seems normal, but as she steps through the door, an eerie feeling creeps in. What was supposed to be a simple purchase soon turns into an experience she will never forget.
rows.description_html: Online Records Online Records is an episodic psychological horror game where each story tells unsettling events that could happen to anyone… even you. Episode 1: Unknown Seller A 22-year-old student arranges to meet an online seller at their home to pick up an item. At first, everything seems normal, but as she steps inside, an eerie feeling creeps in. What was supposed to be a simple transaction quickly turns into an experience she will never forget. Gameplay Online Records is a first-person narrative experience with exploration and interaction mechanics. Key Features Immersive and gripping story , based on everyday events that take a sinister turn. VHS aesthetics and realistic graphics for a truly atmospheric experience. Real-time messages that add depth to the narrative. Choices and consequences that shape the outcome. Are you ready to face the unknown?

rows.name: Goofy Lil Guys
rows.short_description: In this action real time local PvPvE game, players will collect a team of adorable creatures and harness their unique abilities in order to grow stronger before the final fight to the death. 2-4 local players can engage in this cute spin of split-screen battleroyale creature collection.
rows.description_html: Goofy Lil Guys is an Award Winning, cute 2-4 local multiplayer split-screen creature collector game with battleroyale elements tied in. You and your friends will need to find, fight, and tame a team of Little Guys before the storm closes in. Once the skies darken, its last team standing! With over 160 different possible team compositions, players can always try something new! Explore our 3D world inhabited with our adorable 2D creatures, learn and fight with new gimmicks and combo's as you take on the wild creatures in the world. Then, when the time is right, unleash your powerful team against your opponents and come out victorious.

rows.name: Running Horror
rows.short_description: A first-person horror game where you must explore a vast labyrinth, evade a relentless demonic Beast, and find trapped survivors to reverse a miscast spell and escape.
rows.description_html: NOTE: This was a practice project made by amateur game devs to learn the process. Please, be kind. You can’t fight the Beast. You can only RUN. Running Horror is a first-person horror game that traps players in a vast, nightmarish labyrinth with a relentless, otherworldly pursuer. You’ve been caught in the aftermath of a miscast spell, and the only hope for escape lies in finding the scattered survivors who were drawn into the maze with you. Each of these motley characters holds a piece of the puzzle, and only by working through fear, disorientation, and dread can you piece together what went wrong and undo it. There are no weapons. No safe rooms. The only thing keeping you alive is your ability to move quickly and stay calm under pressure. The further you go, the closer the Beast gets, forcing you to balance exploration and urgency. Will you make it out before your sanity breaks... or the creature finds you?

rows.name: Tiny Sheriff
rows.short_description: Tiny Sheriff is a 2D movement platformer where you use weapons as a means of transportation. Master your movement capabilities to take on increasingly daring challenges.
rows.description_html: Tiny Sheriff is a 2D movement platformer where you use weapons as a means of transportation. Master your movement capabilities to take on increasingly daring challenges. Your guns are more than just weapons—they’re your way of getting around! The knock-back from each shot propels you through the air, letting you dash, double-jump, and wall-bounce your way through treacherous terrain. But be careful—taking down enemies can throw you backwards, sending you hurtling into danger! These showdowns are fast, chaotic, and unforgiving. Dodge incoming attacks, keep your momentum, and find the right moment to strike. Stay sharp, stay quick—hesitate, and you’re done for. Cacti aren’t just scenery—they’re out to mess with you. Get too close, and you’ll be eating spikes. Step wrong, and you’ll quickly find yourself in a thorny mess.

rows.name: Shooting Range Simulator: Prologue
rows.short_description: Run your own Shooting Range. Manage your supplies, rent guns, and sell ammo packs. Expand and upgrade your shop; level up your popularity to get even better equipment. Open various cases and sell the skins you got from them. Join shooting tournaments and much more!
rows.description_html: On running your own Shooting Range Shop Adventure you will Host customers every day and try to fulfill their orders; expand and upgrade your shop to even host more customers. You can buy better guns and ammo as your level goes up; customers will always want more! Buy cases and sell what you got from them. Join shooting races and win prizes. You need to manage your resources to grow every day and remain in these hard business environments. Rent various guns and sell ammo packs that fit the gun. You can unlock new guns and ammo types as you level up. Fill your shop with pistols, SMGs, and rifles! Open various cases to hunt rare gun skins. You can sell the skins you got in your shop to open more. As you level up you can open different types of cases, explore new skins!

rows.name: AI T/F Escape: 10 in a Row to Freedom
rows.short_description: You're trapped in a mysterious room. To escape, challenge yourself with a True/False question created by AI.
rows.description_html: When you wake up, you find yourself trapped in a mysterious room. It appears that to escape, you must answer a series of True/False questions correctly. Before you stand two walls—one marked with “T” and the other with “F.” Choose the wall you believe is correct, and with both caution and courage, make your leap. This is a True/False question that puts your knowledge and judgment to the test. Can you answer correctly and escape from this peculiar room? Play Time Approximately 10 minutes to 1 hour Options By turning on “Cheat Mode,” the game will pause even after a question is presented. This allows you the freedom to look things up, so if you find yourself stuck, feel free to try it out. About the True/False questions Not all of the questions are generated solely by AI; some have been personally crafted and adjusted by the creator. Video Streaming and Posting Guidelines This game is available for video streaming or uploading by anyone, whether individual or corporate, without prior permission. Please adhere to the following guidelines when doing so: • Include the URL of the Steam store page in the video description or similar sections. • Monetization is permitted only if you use the features provided by video platforms, such as YouTube’s 'YouTube Partner Program.' • Refrain from streaming or posting content that violates local laws or public decency. Please note that these guidelines may be updated without notice.

rows.name: The Untitled Tower
rows.short_description: When you woke up in the basement of the tower, you were on a mission. In order to prevent this world from ending like this, you I have to go to the princess in the tower, but...
rows.description_html: [Game overview] ``The Untitled Tower'' is an action game in which the main character struggles to save a princess who is imprisoned at the top of a tower by a demon. The protagonist meets unique residents, defeats the bosses that control them, and climbs a nameless tower controlled by a demon. Then the scenario takes an unexpected turn. Highly challenging action game. Various enemies, devices, and bullet hells block the hero's adventure. Part of the barrage can be erased with attacks, and there is an invincible rolling dodge, so you can easily escape attacks and traps that seem impossible to avoid at first glance. Furthermore, each weapon has its own secret tricks (special moves), so by using them, the path will open up automatically. Bosses with unique personalities. More than 90 bosses await you at the end of your adventure. A strange human, a giant caterpillar, a flying tank, and a genie. A variety of gimmicks, such as gravity reversal, action bans, and the sudden start of RPG and block breaking games, also add color to the overwhelmingly voluminous story. Full of many detour elements! In addition to the main story, ``The Nameless Tower'' includes 5 mini-games, sound collection, time attack, hidden bosses, and weapon enhancements. In addition to progressing through the main story, you can also enjoy a change of scenery and test your skills. [remarks] All work was done by a single developer and it took nine years to complete. Play time is approximately 45 ~ 80 hours until the ending. If you are good at action games, we expect you to clear the game in about 24 hours. Graphics, sounds, programs, scenarios, etc. are all made by myself.

rows.name: Echoes of the Night
rows.short_description: Two rival phantom theives collide in a high-stakes heist. Will they fall for each other or betray one another? Race, dodge, and fight to the beat of Barney & Company's debut Album 'No Refusal'
rows.description_html: Get ready for a high-stakes journey through the twilight in Echoes of the Night , a rhythm-action game inspired by Sayonara Wild Hearts . Set to the electrifying sounds of Barney & Company's debut album, this stylish adventure follows two master thieves on a collision course—both chasing the same score, both chasing something more. With six dazzling levels, each pulsing to a track from No Refusal , you'll race, dodge, and fight through a heist gone beautifully wrong. Will they fall for each other or double-cross one another in a winner-takes-all showdown? 💠 Chapter 1 - Drove by a Pretty Place Race through a breathtaking, European-inspired countryside as you dodge traffic and obstacles on your way to the grand castle—your heist begins here. 💠 Chapter 2 - Light It Up (Coming Soon) Mingle among the elite at a lavish masquerade ball, stealing valuables without being caught. But beware—you're not the only phantom thief in the crowd. 💠 Chapter 3 - Liar (Coming Soon) A dance-off like no other! Face off against your rival phantom thief in a rhythm-based showdown, hitting the right moves to outshine—or be outshined. 💠 Chapter 4 - Barney (Coming Soon) The security is onto you! Navigate a sprawling castle maze, avoiding cameras and patrols as you make your daring escape. 💠 Chapter 5 - For What It's Worth (Coming Soon) The grand finale—a high-speed chase atop a moving train! Time your jumps, dodge obstacles, and battle enemies in a climactic confrontation with your rival.

rows.name: Neuro Nightmare
rows.short_description: Neuro Nightmare is a horror game that utilizes brain-computer interface technology to maximize immersion. Run all the levers and escape from boarding schools, running away from monsters. Your concentration and stability directly affect gameplay.
rows.description_html: Make sure to read the Game Setting Manual! You need NeuroSky's Mindwabe Mobile 2 to play the game. Neuro Nightmare is an innovative game that utilizes brain-computer interface (BCI) technology to maximize the immersion of horror games. Players must run away from the unknown in a closed boarding school, operating all the levers to find a way out. But it's not just a survival game—your brain activity directly affects gameplay. The game adjusts the gaming environment by analyzing the player's concentration and stability in real time through BCI technology. The higher the concentration, the wider the field of view, and if you maintain stability, you can use the special ability to hide from monsters. This unique mechanism provides a sense of immersion that sets you apart from conventional horror games. It also includes a typical play mode that doesn't support BCI, and you can enjoy a different gaming experience while comparing the two modes.

rows.name: Project Dreamscape
rows.short_description: Journey through a surreal dreamscape in this hack-and-slash roguelite, expanding your dream one land at a time. Wield a shape-shifting hammer in fast-paced combat, battling waves of Dreamons. Unlock powerful Aspects, gain new abilities, and forge an ever-growing dreamworld in this vibrant adventure.
rows.description_html: Every night when you close your eyes, you enter a mystical world of your own creation. But tonight is different. Your stress, struggles, and strain has all manifested itself into Dreamons - inner fiends that threaten to turn your slumber into a nightmare.  Armed with a mystical shape-shifting hammer and guided by your childhood stuffed animal, you must fight to preserve your dream and confront what lies beneath. Build your dreamscape one land at a time and unlock powerful abilities to face increasingly challenging waves of dreamons. Will you wake up refreshed, or forever trapped in your inner turmoil? Features: Chain combos together with a shapeshifting hammer, keep the combat chains going to increase your power, speed, and rewards. Earn powerful Aspects that grant new combos and abilities that shake up each dream Select and place new lands to expand your interconnected dreamscape. Each land sticks for the entirety of your dream, so place them wisely Battle through the mystical Forest Land, volatile Fire Land, and delectable Food Land, each with unique hazards and enemies Conquer diverse wave types that each require unique strategies to overcome Overcome your inner demons and battle your dreamons for as long as possible. Will morning ever come?

rows.name: Newton Coin Web3
rows.short_description: Newton Coin This is a clicker game. In the game, you need to click on the Coin. You'll get a random Newton - themed gold coin every three hours. With effort and luck, you can continuously expand your gold coin collection!
rows.description_html: Newton Coin - This is a Web3 concept clicker game where you need to click the coin to earn a random Newton-themed gold coin every 3 hours. Through effort and luck, you can continuously expand your coin collection! Drop rates every 3 hours*: Common: 70% Uncommon: 25% Rare: 4.89% Very Rare: 0.1% Epic: 0.01% Ultra Rare: 1/300,000 Legendary: 1/8,000,000 No synthesis function, stable drop rates, top-tier Coins are limited! Every year, except for common coins, the probability of obtaining all other coins increases in difficulty by 16%. Features: This is, first and foremost, a free game about the joy of collecting Newton coins, and secondly, a clicker game. The program is simple, consumes minimal resources, and is safe to use. Rely on your effort and luck to acquire your great Newton coins!

rows.name: Unlog
rows.short_description: Unlog is a fast-paced 2D platformer about a sleepy goblin trying to escape a mysterious dream factory. Dash, wall jump and avoid the traps to get as fast as you can ! Believe us, you'll need it.
rows.description_html: Play Unlog, our very first game ! Master your movements Run , jump , wall jump and dash across this dream factory to escape ! These actions can be used in many contexts to gain speed and believe us... you will need speed . Escape the dream factory YoU'rE nOt WelComE HEre ! The factory is filled with obstacles , traps and we heard something guards the exit so be sure to be ready !  Make this place your playground Unlog is 4 level-long but you can find a timer and a scoreboard to push your limits and maybe beat our own high score...  2:30 min to complete the all game. Are you up to the challenge?

rows.name: Upfall
rows.short_description: Upfall is a game about bouncing, dodging, and near death experiences. Burst bubbles to progress upwards, but be careful to dodge the hazards in the depths. How far will your upfall be? A free game for the in betweens.
rows.description_html: Escape the depths by bouncing on bubbles and avoid the hazards which slowly present themselves. Glowing red = danger... at least to start with! Each new depth you reach causes the colours to change and the hazards to increase, with enough random generation so each upfall is never the same. It's not easy, it's sometimes mean, but with fast restarts, lots to discover, and quick rounds you'll find yourself coming back over and over. Can you find your way back to the surface? Totally, utterly free – The world isn't great right now for a lot of people so we wanted to give back. Upfall is completely free - no ads, no monetisation, no catch Quick rounds – Each fall takes between 2 and 10 minutes so you can play between other games or on your lunch break Unlocks and customisation – Unlock colour palettes, audio styles, ambiences, and characters to customise how the game looks and sounds Keyboard or controller – Play keyboard only, feel the controller vibrate, or watch the DualShock 4/DualSense controller light change colour to reflect the game state Chill but eerie – Simple rules to discover with a creepy, no-jump scares, atmosphere to keep you engaged and coming back Do you want to know what playing a game might sound like in a massive underground oil tank? How about in an otherworldly gasometer , a 60 meter tall silo , or played through a slinky ? Upfall experiments with convolution reverb to put the game into real, strange places around the globe that you can explore as you play. A game by Amicable Animal with art from eggysworld and piano samples from Luci Holland. Made for humans, by humans. (Just so you know: this game is provided as is, and we can't offer support as it's free. It is built in Unity so if you can play Unity games it should run fine!)

rows.short_description: Speed through Vero City in this free-to-play multiplayer racer! Customize your robot with animal-inspired abilities, grab power-ups, and outmaneuver rivals in fast-paced, high-tech races. Will you take the win? Download now!
rows.description_html: Welcome to Vero City , a neon-soaked cyberpunk metropolis where robots rule the streets—and race for glory! In this fast-paced multiplayer racing game, customize your robotic racer with wild animal-inspired abilities, mix and match skills, and outmaneuver rivals in high-speed chaos. Pick up power-ups, dodge obstacles, and claim victory in adrenaline-fueled showdowns. Will you dominate the circuit or be left in the dust? The future of racing starts now—download for free!

rows.short_description: How sharp are your eyes? Can you see it? Is it even there? If you've never seen a dead pixel now is your chance.

rows.name: Just the Boss Fights
rows.short_description: We heard you loved Boss Fights, so we cut everything else! Enjoy an RPG game without any of that boring grind! That's definitely why we did it, no other nefarious reasons...
rows.description_html: What is Just the Boss Fights ? Just the Boss Fights  is a classic 2D platformer RPG with a twist: the game skips all the story, dialogue, exploration, and grind, leaving only the bosses themselves! Unfortunately, our hero wasn't quite prepared for this shift into a boss rush, and finds himself confused at every turn. Join the Hero as he pieces together what's happened to his world. Why are there gaps in his memory? How does everyone seem to know him? And, most importantly, who keeps changing his gear while he's not looking? Features: Experience 4 unique and engaging boss fights! Adapt to an ever-changing moveset to overcome each battle! Find clues to what happened in this world and what's causing the glitches! After you win, up the difficulty with Challenge Mode! Classic pixel art style! Supports both Keyboard/Mouse and Controller! Free to play with no in-game purchases, what's stopping you from taking on the challenge?

rows.name: Modavuj Save The Babies
rows.short_description: Save The Babies is an adventure game where you enter into armed conflicts with robots and try to overcome many platform obstacles. In 8 levels, you need to save 8 girls by overcoming obstacles that become more difficult as you progress.
rows.description_html: Modavuj Games presents the game 'Save The Babies'. The subject of the game Save The Babies A malicious organization that carries out illegal activities wants to access a lot of secret information from the state. For this reason, it has kidnapped the daughters of important statesmen. The organization hides these kidnapped girls in a large industrial zone protected by artificial intelligence robot soldiers. The state has planned a top-secret operation called 'Save The Babies' to save these girls. For this operation, you, our hero, codenamed 'Bodyguard', one of the state's best agents, have been chosen. What's in the game You will engage in armed conflicts with artificial intelligence robot soldiers. You will also use vehicles, motorcycles and bicycles to reach each of the 8 stages. You will try to reach the kidnapped girls by jumping on the moving stone blocks without falling into the sea. You will try to move quickly without getting caught by the rolling stone balls. How to complete the game. You will complete the game when you find the 8 kidnapped girls in 8 different stages. We hope you enjoy the game. Have fun.
