rows.name: Goosthetic
rows.short_description: Arm yourself with sticky boots, a smart-pistol, and the titular 'Goosthetic' grappling prosthetic to swing, slide, jump, boost, and shoot your way out of a twisted and abandoned scientific facility! Escape captivity and evade slime mutations in this fast-paced action-platformer FPS.
rows.description_html: Arm yourself with sticky boots, a smart-pistol, and the titular 'Goosthetic' grappling prosthetic to swing, slide, jump, boost, and shoot your way out of a twisted and abandoned scientific facility! Goosthetic is a fast-paced action-platformer FPS that follows a rejected human subject as he tries to escape captivity and dodge freakish slime mutations as fast as possible. Use a plethora of movement abilities to navigate through the lab at high speeds. Run, jump, slide, boost, and grapple your way out! Annihilate Exploders, Turrets, and flying Dummies with your pistol, one at a time with single-fire action or multiple with its Lock-On ability. Enjoy a rich, gooey environment and fantastic music to jam to as you dodge obstacles as quickly as you can. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.

rows.name: Hide In Dummy
rows.short_description: 'Hide in Dummy' is a multiplayer game where players hide among dummies or become the seeker. The seeker changes every 30 seconds, and the last player standing wins. Dummies spawn when players are caught, creating chaos. Use strategy to survive or outwit the seeker.
rows.description_html: 'Hide in Dummy' is an intense multiplayer game where you either hide among dummies to survive or become the seeker to track down real players. Psychological Warfare with Dummies In a space filled with both dummy AIs and real players, can you perfectly hide? The seeker must use sharp deduction and keen observation to find the players. Changing Seekers, Last One Standing Wins! Every 30 seconds, the seeker changes randomly, and the last player standing wins. But be careful – you might become the seeker at any moment! Chaos-Inducing Dummy Creation System Every time a player is caught by the seeker, a dummy character spawns in a random location, making the game even more unpredictable. Confuse your opponents and survive until the end!

rows.name: Squad 22: ZOV
rows.short_description: Single player tactical action real-time game with active pause to plan orders carefully. Based on real war-time experience of living Russian veterans of war in Ukraine. It's all about modern conflict small infantry groups with some armored vehicle and drone support as well as real events story
rows.description_html: Rather realistic tactics Immerse yourself in realistic tactics and command your squad in Squad 22: ZOV , a gripping tactical strategy game . Utilizing a top-down view with an 'active pause' system, strategically plan every action. Exploit the unique personal skills and attributes of your squad members, deploy a diverse arsenal of weapons and equipment , and utilize drones and external support to dominate the battlefield. Designed with insights from Russian veterans and active soldiers, Squad 22: ZOV delivers an authentic and intense infantry warfare experience. Game is officially recommended by the Russian Military for use as a basic infantry tactic manual for cadet and Yunarmy training.   Dynamic missions Test your skills in a variety of dynamic missions , from defending open areas to storming buildings and executing forest night stealth operations. Rescue hostages , capture prisoners, and leverage ally armored vehicle support , long-range snipers , and artillery strikes . Be prepared to face the same tactics from the enemy as you navigate intense combat scenarios. Encounter and interact with civilians , making choices that impact the unfolding events and the narrative's direction. Your decisions matter! Progression and Content: A Constantly Evolving Experience Progress through campaigns and master an ever-expanding collection of small arms , grenades , ammunition , and special items . We continuously enhance the game with updates featuring new weapon types and mods , armored vehicles , drones , equipment , characters , and locations , ensuring a rich and evolving player experience. Enjoy a continuous stream of content additions as the game grows. Master Combat Micromanagement Exercise complete control over your squad with detailed combat micromanagement . Monitor view angles, ensure squad coverage, carefully manage ammo load , and effectively utilize tactical medicine . As your squad progresses, unlock even more tactical options and strategic depth. Dive into in-depth squad management . History as it is Delve into the complexities of the 2014 and 2022-2024 events through compelling campaigns. Gain insight into the perspectives of those who lived through these periods, understanding how these events shaped their lives and opinions. Explore a narrative based on people's experience and opinions during specific historical conflicts. Why Beta The game is in Beta mode. While we consider it to be in a good state with many game mechanics and complete narrative scenario, there are still some more things we wish to add for it to become a truly modern infantry warfare! Also, we will track player experience and may tune balance. We will keep deploying more content through 2025.

rows.name: Clutchtime™: Tournament Edition
rows.short_description: Shoot threes, slam dunk, block opponent shots and steal the ball. Rebound and run fast breaks. Call timeouts and substitute players. Every basketball action is a card. Manage the time remaining on the game clock. Win 4 games in a row to become a champion!
rows.description_html: Main Game About the Game Clutchtime is a deck builder centered around basketball plays and team synergies . The Tournament Edition brings you 6 difficulty levels which you unlock one by one by winning all games in a single-elimination tournament. Each team has a starting deck of 5 players with 3 cards representing their skills. You can upgrade, trade and remove those cards. At the end of each quarter, you get to pick new cards to add for this game. At the end of the match, you can keep one of those cards in your deck until the end of the tournament. This unique game mechanics allows you to try different cards and builds while playing the match without having to commit to it for the rest of the tournament. Do you have what it takes to become a champion?

rows.name: Shatter Point
rows.short_description: Shatter Point is a fast, fun, and exciting first person shooter. You grapple, run, jump and slide through 20 levels.
rows.description_html: Shatter Point is a fast, fun, and exciting first person shooter. You grapple, run, jump and slide through 20 levels. This game is meant for speed running so please do so. And if you are looking for a short, fun, and FREE game, give it a download. Each level is short but still fun to play with the theme being set around a laboratory where your skills are tested and you try to make it to the end of the level as fast as possible. Some skills that may help you during your testing are:  Shotgun Jumping Wall Running Grappling And of course Shooting

rows.name: Project Origin
rows.short_description: Project Origin is an immersive MMORPG set in a fractured world where players explore, battle, and shape their own journey. Engage in dynamic combat, uncover hidden lore, and traverse a vast, evolving landscape filled with challenges and secrets waiting to be discovered.
rows.description_html: Project Origin is an immersive MMORPG set in a fractured world , where players embark on an epic journey of survival, discovery, and power. Traverse a vast and evolving landscape filled with secrets, ancient ruins, and formidable enemies , shaping your destiny through strategic combat and exploration. 🌍 A World in Chaos Once ruled by four deities, the balance was shattered by betrayal, plunging the world into disorder. As a warrior, mage, or rogue adventurer, it’s up to you to uncover the truth behind the world’s downfall and forge your own path in a constantly shifting environment. ⚔️ Engage in Dynamic Combat Master an adaptive combat system that blends skill-based action with deep RPG mechanics. Whether wielding a sword, casting powerful spells, or striking from the shadows, every fight is a test of strategy, reflexes, and mastery . 🛡️ Forge Your Legend Unravel a Rich Narrative : Explore an interconnected story shaped by your choices. Discover Hidden Lore : Investigate ruins, ancient artifacts, and lost civilizations to uncover the truth of the past. Upgrade and Customize : Develop your skills, enhance your gear, and create a playstyle that fits your vision. 🔥 A True MMORPG Experience Cooperate or Compete : Join forces with allies to conquer dungeons or face off against rival factions. Massive Open World : Dynamic regions filled with NPC factions, real-time events, and hidden challenges. Ever-Evolving Content : Regular updates bring new quests, environments, and world-altering events. Prepare to carve your legacy in Project Origin  - where every journey is unique, and the world reacts to your actions.

rows.name: Word Blitz
rows.short_description: Word Blitz is a puzzle word game about swapping letters and making new words. You will need to make the best of the letters and resources provided, and progress as far as you can. Do you have what it takes?
rows.description_html: The goal of Word Blitz is to make as many words as possible without making mistakes. To create words you will be swapping letters on the board. If this action does not result in a new word you will lose a heart. No hearts remaining and its GAMEOVER. Words must be between 3-5 letters in length.  To assist you in making words there are some extra features you can make use of. Any 3+ combination of the same letter e.g. 'AAA' will also be considered a valid word. Additionally as you make words, you will gain access to a magic feather. This can be used to remove unwanted letters from the board.    Good Luck!

rows.name: Psycutlery
rows.short_description: Grab, throw, eat, and UTTERLY WRECK everything using a mind-controlled spork in this quirky, story-driven, console-styled platforming dramedy. With an emphasis on variety and a grand sense of adventure, Psycutlery offers a surprising full-course meal, despite all unassuming appearances...
rows.description_html: What... IS this? It's a spoon. And yet, it's also a fork. Or is it either? It's a video game-type thing  developed by Luke Tarlowe (formerly known as 'Thunder Dragon').  A console-styled platformer with an action-adventure feel, complete with an expansive storyline featuring multifaceted characters across a widely varied world. Each new level is completely unique from the last.  With an emphasis on variety through the constant introduction of new gimmicks and ways to play, Psycutlery is a game that prompts the question: 'what's next?!' Take control of  Lillian the Alien  and her mind-controlled spork (that YOU can name).  Grab things.  Throw things.  Eat things.  Jump in mid-air up to five times!  Bring down an incomprehensible abomination of evil with a single piece of silverware (plus around 30 different power-ups!), and witness copious craziness unfold across Planet Geozaic! Some things to note... For best results, playing with a controller is recommended (as this is a console-style platformer designed and tested with a controller in mind).  Keyboard controls are supported, but not preferred.  But hey.  Options!  Whatever you use, all controls are rebindable to custom user specifications. Note that this game, though more or less family friendly, may contain some scary parts and dark storytelling moments that might not be suitable for small children. Around a decade in development, and... it's free?? Yep.  All I want is to share my work and keep enjoying my game development hobby (without any of the stresses that come from the business side of things)! This is the full, completed game.  I would like to think of it having ample length and quality comparable to that of a commercial game.  It's a completely original work, having been started between 2011 and 2012.  All characters, art, music and so on are original to this project.  Music was made with the help of me and a few friends (with most of the musical contributions coming from my friend Jon AKA DJ Yoshiman), while everything else has been solo developed by me.  There are absolutely no microtransactions or anything of that sort.  No catches to be found here - I just wish to share my passion with all who might appreciate it.

rows.name: smartPLANT
rows.short_description: The agricultural megacorporation Emmer Technologies is intent on controlling the world-wide food supply with their novel UtopiaBot technology. Play as Dr. Teagan Wixx who must confront Emmer and their controversial food revolution as she also struggles with a complex and very personal mystery.
rows.description_html: In the near future, the use of artificial intelligence has been integrated into virtually every aspect of our lives - including the food we eat. The agricultural megacorporation Emmer Technologies is using cutting-edge AI mechanisms to regulate the growth patterns of crops worldwide. Teagan Wixx, a professor of botany at a local university, considers her contract with Emmer as her dream job. Until she is suddenly let go on the same day that her friend goes missing. Follow Teagan's journey as she employs perseverance and botanical knowledge to unravel an increasingly complex mystery. SmartPLANT ultimately explores the question: what does it mean to be intelligent? Is this a domain exclusive to animals and, perhaps, machines? Can plants think for themselves, and, if so, how should we respond? SmartPLANT is a single-player first-person story-driven exploration game. Explore a thought-provoking narrative adventure that will take at least 4 hours to play. Engage with botany and artificial intelligence at the intersection of fact and fiction. Navigate detailed, bespoke environments in first person. Optimized to play on even the most modest hardware. Learn, solve puzzles, and adjust your perception of the plant kingdom in unexpected ways.

rows.name: Doors
rows.short_description: Doors is a short 3D sci-fi puzzle game. You and your army of clones move in unison to escape the labyrinth one puzzle at a time. Flip levers, open doors, reach high places, see from new perspectives, create clones, swap with them and destroy them to solve puzzles in a desolate landscape.
rows.description_html: Doors is a first person linear puzzle game where you open doors by solving puzzles involving clones. There different doors with unique mechanics. Manipulating clones will be your bread and butter, swapping with them, destroying them, stacking them. Anti-Clone zones will destroy your clones. Anti-Player zones will destroy you, Anti-Swap zones prevent swapping.  This is a short indie game developed by one person with a singular vision. I hope you enjoy it.

rows.name: Passion Rift
rows.short_description: Enter a futuristic reality show where you seduce exotic beings, battle interdimensional monsters, and uncover dark corporate secrets. Build your team, chase desire, and become a star on screen... and behind the scenes.
rows.description_html: In the year 2035, you're not a soldier, explorer, or hero — you're entertainment.  Passion Rift  drops you into the world’s biggest reality show, where fantasy races, corporate conspiracies, and interdimensional horrors collide — along with temptation, rivalry, and desire. A mysterious portal has opened on a tropical island in the Seychelles. Bought for billions and transformed into a luxury resort and broadcast hub, the island is now the heart of Passion Rift  — a deadly show where participants venture into alien dimensions searching for fame, treasure, thrills… and maybe a little pleasure. Thousands of years ago, the portal first touched our world, merging realms and races. Now elves take selfies, goblins shop online, and orcs argue on forums. But stepping through the Rift still means danger, glory... and cameras rolling — even when the lights go down. Every step is filmed. Every decision has a cost   Reality show survival  – compete, progress, and become a global star… or die trying.   Explore alien worlds  – dangerous dimensions filled with monsters, tech, and secrets.   Character progression  – unlock skills, gear, perks, and rise to global fame.   Idle combat  – assemble your squad and let them battle through waves of enemies using unique skills and synergies.   Flirt system  – build bonds, unlock dialogues, and collect sexy outfits for each girl. Corporate intrigue  – uncover the dark truth behind the portal and the show's creators. Over 18 girls from all over the world — and from wildly different fantasy races — have joined the show alongside you. Elves, goblins, orcs, mutants and more, each with unique looks, outfits, and personalities — from shy to dominant, sweet to chaotic. Form bonds through choices, gifts, and flirty banter. Unlock private scenes and stylish and revealing outfits. Some might want your heart. Others just want a taste of the spotlight — or you. Your relationships might just help you survive… or complicate everything. Will they fall for your charm — or leave you behind?

rows.name: Gemstone Realm
rows.short_description: Explore unknown secret caves, successfully hunt monsters inside, and obtain various mysterious power hungry gems. These angry gems not only help us grow, but also have the opportunity to be exchanged for US dollars and fiat currency. Endless Adventure and Wealth - All in the Secret Gem Realm
rows.description_html: Gemstone Realm is a game that uses a triple play mechanism. In the game, players will play as a hero, exploring mysterious worlds and randomly opening portals. Each portal will form a secret realm, where there will be some dangerous monsters and a large number of gems scattered on the ground. Heroes keep coming to fight monsters. We need to be aware that these gems will help us in battle. If the gems are linked together by three, they can have different effects, causing damage and healing wounds. By successfully hunting these monsters, we will obtain various gems that can help heroes grow.

rows.name: Pair Master
rows.short_description: A challenging matching game that requires quick reflexes and memory skills. It includes both single-player and multiplayer modes, with various difficulty levels and objectives to choose from in competitive play.
rows.description_html: This is a multiplayer tile-matching game. The gameplay is very simple. Players need to flip over two identical cards to eliminate them. Remembering the card patterns will help you complete the game faster. The game offers both single-player and multiplayer modes. In multiplayer mode, there are different game variations to choose from. For example, both players may have an identical deck arranged in the same order, racing to see who finishes first. Alternatively, players can compete on the same set of cards, with the winner determined by points. You can also practice in single-player mode to improve your speed and memory.

rows.name: Deal With The Devil: Chapter 1 - Journey to Tuonela
rows.short_description: Point-and-click adventure featuring eerie scenes
rows.description_html: Journey to Tuonela Embark on a dark and mysterious adventure which takes players on a journey through Finnish mythology and the mysteries of Tuonela. John, a father who has experienced a tragic loss, encounters a supernatural entity that wants to make a deal with him. This entity needs John's help to gain access to Tuonela, where there are disturbing disturbances in the movement of souls. Only the soul of a grieving living person can help the entity find answers and restore balance between the realms. Players guide John through the adventure in Tuonela, encountering characters from Finnish mythology and other mythological creatures. Deal With The Devil: Chapter 1 is a thrilling and intriguing story adventure that tells a fictional tale of Finnish mythology. Are you ready to face the forces of darkness and uncover what lies in the depths of Tuonela? Blending AI Art with Uppbeat’s Immersive Sounds The game's visuals and character voices are created using AI technology, while the music and sound effects are from Uppbeat, creating an energetic and engaging atmosphere in the game. Welcome to experience this gaming adventure! A Solo Developer's Creation This game is a solo creation by SoulTradeStudios. Design, programming, and overall implementation are the work of a single developer. Thank you for supporting an independent studio and enjoying this unique gaming experience! Estimated Playtime The estimated playtime is about 1.5 to 2 hours if all dialogues are listened to. Gameplay Style Deal With The Devil: Chapter 1 is a narrative-driven adventure where gameplay is minimal, focusing primarily on following the story and interacting with its characters. While the game offers more to watch and listen to than traditional gameplay mechanics, there are small puzzles to solve along the way.

rows.name: In The Foundations
rows.short_description: A horror visual novel about coming back to your childhood home.
rows.description_html: Echoing themes from Hereditary, The Ritual, and Layers of Fear, In The Foundations is a horror visual novel that centers around family, loss, generational debt, and duty . You didn't want to go home ever again. You're Taylor. Your dad died suddenly a few weeks ago. It looks like he left you the family house. Really though, you swore you'd never come back here. Nothing specific bad ever happened, but the place makes you feel sick to your stomach. Like you're some how allergic. You know it's up to you to at least clean the place out. Your dad and stepmom had been divorced for years, and you've never been close with your half sister, Paige. Fortunately, you get to do this alone, at your own pace. But are you really the only one in the house? As you start the process though, that same feeling from your childhood is still there. But there's more... a presence, maybe? It shifts from terrifying to comforting. And it all seems to circle around the basement that your dad never let you enter. You need to find out what's down there. You need to understand what is in the house with you. And you need to open this lockbox that your dad left behind. Features: 24k+ words 1-2 hours of gameplay a combination lock puzzle 7 distinct endings depending on player choice snow globe Additional Steam Features: music room for tracks that unlocks after beating the game once a mini-crossword that unlocks after each ending (3 5x5 crosswords, 1 6x6 crossword, 3 7x7 crosswords)

rows.name: The Cursed Deep
rows.short_description: Dare to navigate 'The Cursed Deep', a gripping VR game where you command a pirate ship fending off the dreaded leviathans. Load cannons, aim true, and repel the monsters of the deep in this immersive test of skill and courage. Will you conquer the depths or be swallowed by the sea's fury?
rows.description_html: Embark on a High-Seas Adventure with 'The Cursed Deep' An enthralling virtual reality game that casts you as the defender of your own pirate ship navigating through mysterious, treacherous waters. Your mission: **fend off the mythical beasts that rise from the ocean's depths with only your wits and your cannons.** VR Experience In this immersive VR experience, you'll feel the salt spray and the thrill of battle as you stand on the deck of your pirate ship, the sole line of defense against an unseen enemy lurking beneath the waves. With cannon at the ready, you'll load, aim, and fire in a desperate bid to survive the relentless assaults of the deep. You are invited to: Load and Fire: Man your ship's cannon and make every shot count as you face waves of monstrous adversaries rising from the deep. Strategic Defense: Use your strategic skills to manage ammunition and time your reloads, keeping the enemies at bay as long as possible. Mystical Seas: Navigate through fog-laden, uncharted waters filled with dark secrets and hidden dangers. rows.name: Deal With The Devil Chapter: 2 - From Tuonela to Hell
rows.short_description: Point-and-click adventure featuring eerie scenes
rows.description_html: Deal With The Devil Chapter: 2 - From Tuonela to Hell: The Killing Begins Step back into a dark and mysterious world in the second chapter, taking players directly into the depths of Hell. This chapter continues John’s journey through Finnish mythology and the underworlds. John, a father who has experienced a tragic loss, made a deal with the lord of the underworld, Hades. Hades needed John's help to access Tuonela and promised to resurrect John’s daughter in return. Along the way, John and Hades discover that Lucifer has stolen the souls from Tuonela and freed the ancient god Perkele. But they are not alone: Players will also step into the shoes of Surma – the relentless soul hunter of Tuonela, who must kill living beings to acquire new souls to keep Tuonela intact. His role is as crucial as John’s and Hades’s, as without new souls, Tuonela may collapse. Your mission is clear: John and Hades travel to Hell to retrieve the Key of Shadows from Lucifer, an ancient artifact that grants the power to control souls and teleport anywhere in the universe. Prepare to face both Perkele and Lucifer, as well as your own past, and see how far you are willing to go to save Tuonela. A Solo Developer's Creation This game is a solo creation by SoulTradeStudios. Design, programming, and overall implementation are the work of a single developer. Thank you for supporting an independent studio and enjoying this unique gaming experience! A Blend of AI Innovation and Dynamic Soundscapes While the game's visuals and character voices are created using AI technology, many images have also been refined and enhanced by hand. The music and sound effects, sourced from Uppbeat, bring an energetic and immersive atmosphere to the experience. Step into this dark adventure and uncover its mysteries! rows.name: Fate War
rows.short_description: 2025's latest epic strategy simulation game! Lead your Tribe in a vast world with dynamic seasons. Survive using your wit and uncover the secrets of a lost god.
rows.description_html: In an uncharted mythical world, calamities and monsters ravage the land. Survivors flee to Sanctuary, desperate to awaken the gods that vanished during Rangarok and reclaim their power. Amidst the relentless cold, the embers of civilization flicker to life on this isolated island. But ravenous Blackforged, twisted by darkness, now stalk the wilds. Malevolent spirits from another time stir with sinister intent, and emboldened rival Tribes harbor ambitions of conquest... As the Chieftain of your Tribe, how will you rise to the occasion and ensure your Tribe's survival? Game Features: [City-Building, Laidback Management] Intuitive Simulation Gameplay: Build a thriving settlement of your own on a remote island. Easily manage every citizen's daily life, work, and relationships, and watch as their stories unfold through generations. [Landscape or Portrait, Your Choice] Freely Switch Between Modes: Play casually in portrait mode or switch to landscape mode for an immersive experience. [Realistic World, Enhanced Strategic Depth] Intricate Gameplay with Dynamic Environments: The shifting of seasons and day-night cycles hold the key to the Tribe's development speed. Master the elements to turn small gains into great victories. [Free Movement, Tactical Battles] Innovative Combat Mechanics and Systems: Commanders and Lieutenants fight alongside each other in battle. Manage and position four soldier types to outmaneuver foes and turn the tide of battle. [Trade and Auction, Rapid Development] Unique Auction System for Faster Growth: With a fair bidding system on Tribe Bounty, enjoy the thrill of an RPG raid in an SLG title. [Unique Looks, Endless Customization] Wide Variety of Cosmetic Items: With territory decorations, Hero skins, chat boxes, and portraits, create a Tribe that is uniquely yours. [Roguelike Mechanics, Endless Exploration] Open-World Inspired Design with Infinite Possibilities: Original roguelike gameplay where every expedition, from gathering resources to arming your Tribe, brings new excitement.

rows.name: Pantry Raid
rows.short_description: A cooking-themed dungeon-lite game
rows.description_html: Pantry Raid is a rogue lite dungeon-crawler with cooking elements. Players traverse the pantry, defeating food-themed enemies to make meals to improve your character during the course of the game. Featuring: High-energy combat where quick reflexes and sharp strategy are key. With dynamic enemies, fluid movement, and ever-changing buff combinations, every battle is a thrilling test of skill. Dodge, strike, and adapt in the heat of the pantry. Randomized levels and dynamic buff combinations, ensuring no two playthroughs are ever the same. Adapt to shifting strategies as new buffs reshape your play-style. Each buff ties to a flavorful element—like Spicy for fire attacks or Salty for ice defenses—leading to unexpected synergies. Adapt, experiment, and master these dynamic power-ups to dominate the pantry! An adorable crew of cooking critters!

rows.name: • Dread Chess ✣
rows.short_description: ✣ Dread Chess is an original and strange narrative story-puzzle game with sandbox elements. Uncover mysteries by speaking with gods in Latin. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of madness, and reach one of many endings in an unfair game against Death that can be played ONLY ONCE...
rows.description_html: ✣ Dread Chess is an original and strange narrative story-puzzle game that you can play as a chess sandbox by setting asymmetric rules for the players, or explore it in search of different endings and achievments. Key Features Branching Narrative: Multiple endings based on your successes, failures, and the choices you make. Asymmetric Rules Sandbox: Design unfair advantages or crippling handicaps—then see them in action. Option to use Latin as main Language: ' Mortales ludunt, dii rident' Dark Atmosphere: Gothic pixel art, unsettling soundscapes, and a story that lingers. Self-Playing Chess: Observe autonomous matches that reveal hidden truths and secret paths. Spectator Mode: Sit back and watch the AI duel itself, or share the spectacle online. Narrative Mode Confront the God of Madness as it poses three life-or-death riddles—discover the answers by watching enchanted, self-playing chess matches unfold. Each choice echoes through a richly decorated, gothic pixel-art world, leading you toward one of several hauntingly endings. Sandbox Mode Unleash your creativity in a versatile sandbox environment. Customize asymmetric rule sets and go head-to-head against the AI—or a friend—in a variety of modes: Card Mode: Choose from three thematic options (bad, average, good) for each move. Tarot Cards : Global conditions that change the rules of the game. Dice Mode: Roll the die to determine which chess piece you must move—luck may be on your side, or it may betray you. Classic Mode : Pure, classic chess with direct control. Discover Dread Chess and decide for yourself: can you outwit the God of Madness?
